par byas so/ /rengs par byas so/ /ji ltar rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo bskor ba'am/ ji ltar rdza mkhan gyi 'khor lo yongs su bskor ba ltar mi rgod rnams 'dar bar gyur cig /rengs par gyur cig /mgo rmongs par gyur cig /mdud pa ma grol ba'i bar du mchi bar ma gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /cho ga ni shing kun dang / bong bu'i spu bsres te/ bu mo gtsang mas bkal ba'i srad bu la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod bya'o/ /yang na gos kyi mtha' ma la mdud pa bor te/ bde bar phyin nas dgrol bar bya'o/ /'di ni grub pa'o/ /'phags pa mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sarba an+ta ra sam̐ grā sa dhā ra ṇī man+t+ra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad sel ba'i gzungs sngags/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ phyag na rdo rje gzungs sngags 'di su 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / bzlas brjod byed pa de la ni dug dang / mtshon gyis 'chi ba dang / ltogs pa dang / mtshon brgyab pa dang / gcan gzan ma rungs pas za ba dang / mes tshig pa dang / chur 'chi ba dang / 'go ba'i rims gzhan ya nga ba dang / mdze'i nad dang / gsor mi rung ba'i nad ya nga ba dang / g.yang la lhung ba dang / gzhan gyi byad dang / zas kyis brnangs pa dang / bdag rang gis gsod pa dang / de ltar gshis ngan du 'chi ba bcu gsum gyis rkyen byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje gzungs sngags 'di su 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / bzlas brjod byed pa de la ni sa dang nam mkha' la gnas pa'i bgegs dregs pa can ma rungs pa rnams kyis kyang glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ /phyag na

rdo rje gzungs sngags 'di su 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / bzlas brjod byed pa de la las kyi sgrib pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag ste/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba la hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba bigh+nāṃ an+ta rā ya bi nā sha ka ra mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa brgyad brjod na 'grub pa'o/ /nges par 'grub pa'o zhes gsungs so/ /'phags pa bar du gcod pa thams cad sel ba'i gzungs sngags rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a tsa la nā ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das sum cu rtsa gsum gyi khang bu brtsegs pa na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor 'dus pa ni byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang / sa'i snying po dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / 'jam dpal dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / lag na rdo rje dang / byams pa la sogs pa sa bcu pa 'ba' zhig dang ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pa stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dzam bu gling na gnas pa'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / sha za ma rungs pa dag gis mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / yams nad dang / rnam par 'tshe ba dang / dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba dang / sdang ba dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / dus ma yin pa'i rlung dang / ser ba dang / sa g.yos pa la sogs pa byung ste/ de dag zhi bar mdzad du gsol zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bar rnam par dag pa'i sgo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag ste/ sku'i ba spu'i khung bu nas 'od zer me lce rab tu 'bar

ba byung ste/ 'dod pa dang / gzugs dang / gzugs med pa la thug pa me lce 'bar ba gcig tu gyur to/ /de'i tshe nyi ma dang zla ba la sogs pa'i 'od kyang lham me dang / lhan ne dang / lhang nge ma yin te/ lha rnams kyi 'od kyang lham me dang / lhan ne dang / lhang nge ma yin no/ /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / sha za la sogs pa rnams ni rlung drag pos bdas pa'i shing bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi dbyings rnam par mi rtog pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag ste/ mnyam pa'i phyag rgya bshig nas zhabs kyi pus mo sa la brdabs pas thugs kyi bdag nyid kyi brtan pa'i sku can gyi khro bo zhabs brkyang bskum du bzhugs pa dag byung ste/ thabs las byung ba'i khro bo'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa dang bcas nas nam mkha' ma lus pa 'od kyis 'gengs pa'o/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dag na bzhugs pa tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / drag po chen po bzhi po dag ha hūm̐ hriḥzhes bya bas skrag par byed pa/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / ser sna dag 'joms pa/ klu dang/ gnod sbyin dang / sha za yi dgas la sogs pa haṃ maṃ zhes brjod pas skrag par mdzad pa dag sprul to/ /gsung gi bdag nyid kyi brtan pa'i sku can zhabs phyed sa la pus mo dang mthe bo btsugs pa/ zhabs gcig langs te pus mo btsugs pas bzhugs pa'i khro bo brtan pa'i sku can/ shes rab kyi bdag nyid ral gri me 'od dang bcas pas 'od kyis 'gengs pa dag sprul to/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyis brlabs pa las byung ba'i khro bo dag gi sngags smras pa/ na maḥ sa man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ a tsa la ka na tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka khaḍ+ga/ hūm̐ maṃ hūm̐ maṃ zhes brjod de/ phyag rgya ni lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur bcangs te/ srin lag dang mthe'u chung gnyis bsgreng ba ni ral gri'i phyag rgya ste/ g.yas skor du mtshams bcad do/ /na maḥs mat+na badz+rā ṇāṃ/ a tsa la ka na tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐/ a mṛ ta hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod do/ /phyag rgya ni lag pa sor mo rnams brkyang ste mthe'u chung mthe bos mnan pa ni rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya ste/

g.yas nas bskor la bgegs bskrad do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rnam par dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis srung ba gsungs pa ni/ dmar po'i yi ge ram̐ spyi bor bsam ste/ rnam par dag pa'i yi ge 'dis brtan par byas nas/ rdo rje dang ral gris lus me 'od dang bcas par bsgoms te/ na maḥs mat+na badz+rā ṇāṃ/ a tsa la ka na tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ka te bh+yaḥ/ sarba bi ga te bh+yo/bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga ta hāṃ māṃ rak+ṣa/ zhes brjod de phyag rgya ni rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu sbyar te smin mtshams su bca' bar bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub kyi sems rig pa chen po'i srung ba gsungs pa ni/ hūm̐ dang gzhi'i rnam pas bltas te/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ a tsa la ka na tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ka te bh+yaḥ/ sarba bi ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga ta hāṃ māṃ rak+ṣa ma hā ba le/ sarba ta thā ga ta pra me ni ra gardza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa tra tha tra tha/ a pra ti ha te swā hā/ zhes brjod de phyag rgya ni rdo rje'i thal mo sbyar la mdzub mo gnyis nang du bkug la gung mo rtse sprad de/ srin lag gnyis brkyang nas mthe'u chung gnyis cung zhig bkug la snying khar bcas te srung ba ni yum gyi ste/ bgegs dang log 'dren dang ma rungs pa thams cad dran pa tsam gyis 'byer par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ kha zas bye brag bza' ba dang / bca' ba dang / gzhib pa dang / btung ba dang / bldag pa la sogs pa dang / gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro'i bye brag la byin gyis brlab pa mdzad de/ oṃ sarba dharma tā si ta hūm̐ zhes byas pas dag par byas te/ oṃ a mṛ ta oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ/ zhes bya bas ni 'dod pa'i don du'o/ /oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ zhes bya bas lan bdun bdun btab ste bsngos pas tshim par 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya ni mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ ldang bar 'dod na sngags 'di brjod par

bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma sh+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ na mo badz+ra krodhā ya/ daṃ ṣ+ṭod+ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la pa ra shu pā sha ha stā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya/ bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigha naṃ bi nā ya kā nāṃ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti dzī bi ta an+ta ka ra ṇa swā hā/ zhes bya ba brjod do/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la kha nang du bstan te/ mdzub mo bsgreng la brang du bsnol la phyag rgya bcings te/ gtor ma btang zhing 'chag pa'i dus su yang de bzhin no/ /nye reg bya ba dang / khrus bya ba ni rin po che'i bum par dri zhim po'i chu la/ na maḥ sa man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ a tsa la ka na ya a mṛ ta zhes lan bdun bdun btab ste/ lag pa g.yon pas bum pa bzung nas g.yas pa'i gung mo dang srin lag cung zad tsam bkug la/ ri mo can gyi nang du a bsams la chu blugs te/ oṃ shud+dha dun te sho dha na ye swā hā/ zhes bya bas khrus bya'o/ /de skad ces bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la'o/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa dang / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyis me tog dang / rnga dang / bdug spos dang / lha'i zhal zas dang / lha'i bu pho dang / bu mo dag rin po che'i rgyan dang bcas pas shing rta dpag tu med pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pa dag gis bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa dang bskor ba rgya chen po dag byas te byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang thabs cig tu 'dug go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' byams pa spro ba dang ldan pas bcom ldan 'das la blta'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis byams pa'i bsam pa mkhyen nas bsam gtan dang po la mnyam par bzhag ste/ 'dod pa'i bde ba spangs te dga' bar rtog pa tsam mo/ /de nas bsam gtan dang po nas gnyis pa la mnyam par bzhag ste/ rtse gcig pa'i rtog spyod spangs te dga' bde tsam mo/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa nas

gsum pa la mnyam par bzhag ste/ rtog pa dang dpyod pa spangs te bde ba tsam mo/ /de nas bsam gtan gsum pa nas bzhi pa la mnyam par bzhag ste/ tshor ba nye bar zhi ba'i bde ba tsam mo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ting nge 'dzin de dag dang ldan na rnam par dag pa'o/ /byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms kyis ni byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyud spel ba'o/ /de bzhin du chos thams cad ni nam mkha' ltar mtha' bzhi las rnam par grol ba'o/ /na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de phyag rgya ni 'di'o/ /lag pa gnyis so sor khu tshur bcangs te/ mthe bong gnyis nang du bcug la mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ba'o/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gzungs las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung bcas te snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la thugs kyi sa bon 'od kyis nam mkha' kun khengs par bsams te/ sa bon de las chos thams cad tshig gi lam dang bral ba'o zhes bya ba'i sgra dang bcas pas 'phel ba dang 'grib pa'i sgra 'od zer 'phro 'du dang bcas pa'o/ /de nas sna tshogs pa'i gdan 'dam nas skyes pa'i dri ma med cing yongs su rgyas pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i steng du rta bdun pa kun nas 'od 'phro ba 'dam skyes dang ldan pa dag gi steng du nam mkha'i mdog can gyi thugs kyis bon dang bdag nyid gcig pa'i nam mkha'i khams kun tu khyab par 'od kyis 'gengs pa'i shes rab kyi ral gri sngon po dag tu gyur te/ de dag las bdud dang ma rungs pa mtha' dag 'joms pa'i khro bo chen po rnam rtog thams cad yongs su bcom pa dri ma med cing gzhon nu'i sku'o/ /de yang gzhon zhing sku'i sha rgyas pa ni dper na bus pa gzhon nu lang tsho la bab pa'i lus lta bu ste/ de'i sku mdog ni mthing nag tu gnas te/ dper na dbyar gyi char sprin nag po'i mdog bzhin du gnas pa'o/ /nam mkha' ma lus pa thams cad du 'od kyis 'gengs pa ni dper na rta bdun

pa'i 'od kyis gling kun tu khyab pa bzhin no/ /dbu skra gcig tu bcings shing 'phyar ba ni dper na shing a la ka'i 'bras bu bzhin no/ /sku cung zhig 'gying ba dang g.yo ba ni dper na dpag bsam gyi shing yongs 'du sa brtol bzhin no/ /zhabs brkyang bskum du bzhugs pa ni dper na gyad kyi 'gros bzhin no/ /spyan gsum shin tu dmar ba ni dper na pa la sha'i me tog bzhin no/ /spyan steng 'og tu blta ba ni steng 'og gi bgegs bsreg pa ste/ dper na lha ma yin gyi bya gtor ma za ba bzhin no/ /mche ba gtsigs pa ni dper na zla ba phyed pa bzhin no/ /ljags shin tu 'khyug pa ni dper na nam mkha'i glog bzhin no/ /smin ma khro gnyer du bsdus pa ni dper na shing pa la k+ṣa'i lo ma bzhin no/ /phyag g.yas na ral gri bsnams pa ni dper na gza' chen po'i 'od lhung ba bzhin no/ /sbrul gyi zhags pa g.yon na bsnams pa ni dper na rgya mtsho'i mching bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i sku des ni tshangs pa dang / brgya byin dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi po dag dang / phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa rnams dbang du sdud pa/ lha dang / klu ma rungs pa dang / srin po dang / sha za dang / grul bum dang / lto 'phye la sogs pa 'joms par byed pa dag go/ /de'i sngags bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ tra ṭa/ a mo gha tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ s+pho ṭa ya hūṃ/ tra ma ya tra ma ya hāṃ/ tra ta hāṃ maṃ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de ni 'tshe ba dang / rnam par 'tshe ba dang / sdang ba dang / rnam par sdang ba dang / log 'dren dang / rnam par log 'dren dang / srin po dang / lha dang / klu dang / grul bum dang / sha za la sogs pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rlung las gyur pa dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa dang / bad kan las gyur pa dang / 'bras dang / shu ba dang / g.yan pa dang / mdze dang / 'brum bu dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang / rims nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / ldang dub pa dang / yud tsam pa'i rims dang / rtag pa'i rims las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /seng ge dang / stag dang / dom dang /

dred dang / spyang ki dang / sbrul dug can dang / sbrang bu dang / sha sbrang dang / bung ba'i gnod pa las thar ro/ /rgyal po'i chad pa dang / dmag dpung gi 'jigs pa las thar ro/ /rkun po dang / bran dang / bza' mi 'thab cing rtsod pa las thar ro/ /chu yis 'jigs pa dang / me yis 'jigs pa dang / sa g.yos pa'i 'jigs pa dang / lce 'bab pa'i 'jigs pa las thar ro/ /ral gri dang / shak+ti dang / dgra sta dang / mdung dang / mda' dang / mda' bo che dang / 'khor lo dang / mtshon cha'i 'jigs pa las thar ro/ /'chi ba dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba las thar ro/ /mtshams med lnga la sogs pa'i sdig pa kun 'dag par 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / yul mtha' 'khob dang / dbang po ma tshang ba dang / lha tshe ring po dang / log par lta ba 'dzin pa dang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba la mnyes pa med pa dag tu mi 'gyur ro/ /gzungs sngags 'di ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gsungs te/ lan cig brjod pas kyang sdig pa thams cad 'dag par 'gyur ro/ /'di brjod pa'i gang zag des ni chos nyid kyi lam rdo rje lta bu myur ba nyid du thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rta bdun pa'i steng du rnam par dag pa'i yi ge nam mkha' ma lus pa 'od kyis 'gengs pa bsams te/ byams pa'i lta bas lta ba'i phyir hāṃ ser po mig tu'o/ /srog gi lam du ni maṃ nag po bsam par bya'o/ /spyi bor chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i yi ge bsams te/ sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta badz+ra pā ṇi tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ zhes brjod de lag pa thal mo sbyar te/ gung mo bsgreng ba'i rgyab tu mdzub mo cung zad bkug la srin lag kyang de bzhin du byas te/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /'di'i byin gyis brlabs kyis ma rig pa 'joms shing ye shes kyi sku nyid du byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /gser la sogs pa'i snod du kha zas kyi bye brag nas dang / 'bras dang / gro dang / so ba dang / til la sogs pa dang / zho dang / 'o ma dang / sbrang

rtsi dang / kha ra dang / gser dang / dngul dang / zangs dang / mu tig dang / byi ru dag blugs te/ 'bru gsum pa'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs nas sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /phyag rgya ni mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bhā ra saṃ bhā ra hūṃ zhes bya bas 'byung po kun la mchod par bya'o/ /de nas gsang sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa a sa me tri sa me ma hā sa ma ya/ sarba pā paṃ swā hā/ phyag rgya thal mo sbyar la gsol ba gdab ste dam tshig gso ba'o/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gzungs las le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas dam tshig ni 'di yin te/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun ni 'bras bu dang / lam dang / sgrub pa'i khyad par te/ gang nas brtsams te khyad par gyis mchod cing nam du yang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /tshad med pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyud rtag tu sgom zhing smon lam rgya chen po gdab par bya'o/ /sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / sngags dang phyag rgya'i rten rgyun du bcang zhing bral bar mi bya'o/ /lha dang / bla ma dang / byang chub kyi grogs la khong nas 'khrug pa'i sems spang ngo / /srog gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la byams pa dang / snying rje sngon du song bas gnod pa dang / rnam par 'tshe ba spangs te nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /ser sna spangs te sems can la sbyin pa sbyin par bya'o/ /sems can la gnod pa dang / rnam par 'tshe ba spangs pa'i tshul khrims bsten pa'o/ /rang la rnam par 'tshe ba la bzod par bya'o/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa la brtson pa dor bar mi bya'o/ /rnam par g.yeng ba spangs te bsam gtan la mnyam par gzhag go/ /nyal ba dang ldang ba kun tu rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i don la ma yengs par bya'o/ /dam tshig med cing mi gnas pa la bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / sngags dang / phyag rgya la sogs pa kun

bstan cing bshad par mi bya'o/ /srog gcod pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pa la phyin ci log pa dang / brdzun du smra ba ni tshangs par spyod pa dang / spyad par 'dod pas spang bar bya'o/ /dge slong rnams dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / dam tshig dang ldan pa la gus par bya zhing brnyas par mi bya'o/ /thun mtshams kyi sbyor ba dang ldan par bya'o/ /khro ba dang / bab chol du smra ba dang / lad lud dang / bshang gci 'dor ba dang / dri ma 'khru ba dang / skra dang sen mo la sogs pa'i mi gtsang ba de dag dang / /dri nga ba dang / dri ma mi zhim pa dku zhing mnam pa dang ldan pa thams cad spang bar bya'o/ /khang pa ni spos kyi khang pa yid du 'ong ba gtsang zhing dri ma med pa dag bkra shis pa'i sgo shar du bstan pa/ gseng skar dang bcas pa'i khang pa'am/ bram ze'i khyim mam/ dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba'am/ lha khang ngam/ ri bo'i rtse'am/ bya skad sgrogs pa'i sa'am/ dgon pa'am/ bas mtha' 'am/ spang ljongs dag tu dri zhim po'i chus skyong nul byas la/ rtswa'i stan bting ste gnas par bya'o/ /khri la 'dug pa spang bar bya'o/ /zho dang / 'o ma dang / mar dang / la du dang / lag pan dang / snum khur dang / khur skya dang / 'bras dang / 'bras zan la sogs pa dag smyung ba dang ldan pas bza' bar bya'o/ /sha dang / chang dang / sgog pa la sogs pa dku ba'i zas rnams kun tu spang bar bya'o/ /zla ba dang / skar ma dang / tshes grangs la sogs pa ni yar gyi ngo dag la dkon mchog la gsol ba btab la bsgrub par bya'o/ /re ba dang / rnga ma dang / rtsub pa dag ni ma yin no/ /'dod pa'i don du 'jam shing gnag pa la ni 'gal ba med do/ /dus rtag tu yi dam la dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir byams pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pas bsgrub par bya'o/ /sprul pa'i khro bo rdo rje shugs can ni kha dog shin tu gnag pa ste/ nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje chags chen ni mdog de mar po chags pa dang chags par byed pa'i bzhin gyi mda' gzhu'o/ /rdo rje rnon po ni ljang khu ste/ 'dzin cing yongs su 'dzin pa'i bdag

nyid lcags kyu 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje 'bar ba ni mdog dmar po ste/ mi shes pa dang mi shes pa 'joms pa'i bdag nyid kyi rdo rje'i brag 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje khro bo ni ser po ste/ khro ba dang khro bo'i bdag nyid kyi ral gri 'bar ba bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje gtum chen ni mdog ljang nag ste/ btang snyoms dang btang snyoms su gyur pa'i bdag nyid kyi sprin gyi zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje thab bdag ni du ba'i mdog can bya ba dang byed pa'i bdag nyid kyi rdza rnga bsnams pa'o/ /rdo rje stobs chen ni mthing ga ste/ dman pa dang / dman pa'i rang bzhin can gyi gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje rgyu'i stobs ni dmar nag ste/ rten 'brel dang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i bdag nyid kyi be con 'dzin pa'o/ /rdo rje rab 'byed ni sna tshogs phrin las kyi mdog can mtha' dang mtha' las grol ba'i bdag nyid can gyi rdo rje rtse gcig pa bsnams pa'o/ /de dag ni bcu'i bdag nyid can gyi me 'bar ba'i sku las rab tu 'phro ba'o/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs las le'u gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' byams pa la thun mong du de dag ba'i phyir de'i cho ga gsungs pa/ gnas khang yid du 'ong bar dri zhim po dang ldan pa'i sa la maṇ+ḍal mda' gang ba byas te/ ba'i rnam lnga'i skyong nul byas la/ me tog sngon po dgram par bya'o/ /de nas bum pa gser ram/ dngul lam/ zangs las byas pa'i lhung bzed kyi tshad du bya ste/ der rin po che gser dang / dngul dang / zangs dang / byi ru dang / mu tig dang / rnam pa lnga gzhug par bya'o/ /sbrang rtsi dang / bu ram dang / kha ra dang / zho dang / 'o ma dang / mar rnams gzhug par bya'o/ /nas dang / 'bras dang / so ba dang / til dang / gro dang / cu rtse rnams gzhug par bya'o/ /cu gang dang / gur kum dang / dzā ti dang / sug smel dang / ka ko la dang / li shi rnams gzhug par bya'o/ /tsan+dan dang / a ka ru dang / du ru ska dang / gla rtsi dang / rgya spos dang / ga bur la sogs pa'i dri rnams kyang gzhug par bya'o/ /mtsho dang / rdzing dang / lteng ka dang / 'bab chu dang / lu ma bkod ma rnams kyi chu yang blugs

la ba la'am ras la dri'i chus bsang bas mgul pa bcings te gzhag par bya'o/ /dri dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i shing la kha rgyan byas te/ dri dang / spos dang / me tog dang / mar me dang / byug pa dang / lha bshos dang / rol mo'i sgra dag kyang bsham par bya'o/ /'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma yang cha bdun nam lnga la sogs pa bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ a tsa la tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ sarba bigh+nan s+pho ṭa ya/ badz+ra dhṛ ka khaḍ+ga hūṃ zhes bya bas mtshams rnams bcing bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du bsrung ba'i cho ga rdzogs par bya ste/ bum pa la gzungs kyi thag pa btags nas rnam par dag pa'i yi ges yongs su bsgyur ba'i bum pa la bh+ruṃ zhes bya ba'i sa bon las kha dog dang / tshad dang ldan pa'i bum pa'o/ /thugs kyi sa bon las byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das don de kho na nyid las mnyam par bzhugs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa'i gang zag dang bcas pa gdan seng ge'i steng na sna tshogs pa'i gdan pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /chos nyid dang ldan pa'i rnam pa drug gis bcom ldan 'das bsam par bya'o/ /chos nyid dang / sems dang / sems kyi rnam pa dang / sgra dang / sgra brnyan dang / gzugs dang / gzugs brnyan dang bcas pa'i skur nyi ma'i gdan pad+ma dang tshogs kyi bdag po glang sna'i steng du bsams te/ thugs kyi sa bon las ral gri me 'od dang bcas pas nam mkha' kun tu khebs pa'o/ /de las bdud tshar gcod pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi skur bsams te/ mchod pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ pra bar sad kar pra tīts+tsha hūṃ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sar+b+ba te ba tā a tsin t+ya a mṛ ta dhā rā ya swā hā zhes brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ ā ha ra bha ga pā na/ sarba bid+yā dha ra pū dzi te swā hā dzi te swā hā zhes brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dharma dhā tu a nu ga te dhū pe hūṃ swā hā zhes brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ma hā mai tri bh+yo ga te puṣ+pe hūṃ zhes brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sar+b+ba ta thā

ga ta a tsi prā na a bhā ba ga ga na bh+ya ni r+ya ā lo ke hūṃ swā hā zhes brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bu d+dhā nāṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ga ga na sa ma ya gan+dhe hūṃ swā hā zhes brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ ā ha ra sar+b+ba ta thā ga te nai we d+ye pū dza na s+pha ra ṇa ye hūṃ swā hā zhes brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ a bi sma ra ye/ s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dhā tu/ ā kā shāya/ sa man+t+ra ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta pa ri shud+dha maṇ+ḍa le/ ma ma pra ni dhi pu dza na ma be len dharma dhā tu/ a dhiṣ+ṭhā na pā tsa hūṃ swā hā zhes brjod do/ /rdo rje dang dril bu gsil bar bya'o/ /thal mo bkan la mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu cung zhig bkug la sbyar/ srin lag dang mthe'u chung bsnol la mthe bo cung zhig bkug pa ni yon chab kyi phyag rgya'o/ /sor mo rnams gung mo la brten te cung zad bkug nas gung mo bsgreng ba ni bdug spos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /sor mo rnams phan tshun du bsnol te nang du bcug nas/ mdzub mo mthe bos mnan pa ni me tog gi phyag rgya'o/ /mthe bo dang gung mo'i sor mo rtse sprad de/ lhag ma khu tshur bcangs pa ni mar me'i phyag rgya'o/ /mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya lag pa g.yon pas mkhrig ma bteg pa ni dri'i phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo bkan pa'i zur sbyar te/ mthe'u chung gnyis gshibs nas bsgreng ba ni lha bshos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /spyi por lag pa bskor te/ thal mo khong stong sbyar nas dgrol ba ni rgya chen po'i mchod pa ste/ mchod pa'i rdzas rnams rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i lha mos rdzas sbyangs pa'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ a bhā ba swabhā ba mud ga tā nāṃ/ na maḥpre t+ye ka bud+dhā ār+ya shra ba kā nāṃ/ na mo bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ da sha bhū mi pra tiṣ+ṭhi sha ra ṇāṃ/ bo dhi sa twā ya/ ma hā sa twā nāṃ/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ duṣ+ṭa swā hā/ kā ma kra a si mu sa la pa ra shu pā sha ha stā ya/ tsa tur bhu dzā/ tsa tur mu kha ṣa ṭa tsa ra ṇa/ gats+tsha ya gats+tsha ya/ sarba bigh+nan ghā ta bi kṛ tī nā na/ sarba bhū ta bha yaṃ ka ra aṭ+ṭa hā sa ni nī te byā gh+ra tsarma ni bā sa ni/ ku ru ku ru sarba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha/ sarba man+t+ra/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ pa ra man+t+ra/ ā kar+ṣa ya/ ā kar+ṣa ya/ sarba bhū ta/ ni ra ma tha ni ra ma tha/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ maṇ+ḍa la ma dh+ye bhai bas twā dzī bi tin+ta/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ma ma sarba kār+yaṃ/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/

mā bi lam+ba/ sa ma yaṃ/ a nu sma ra hūṃ hūṃ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba ṣaṭa pa ri pūr ka /he bha ga bā na/ kañtsi rā ya si/ ma ma sarbā r+thaṃ sā dha ya/ a mo gha/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa s+pho ṭa ya hūṃ/ tra ma tra ma haṃ maṃ zhes pa bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod par bya ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal bar dmigs la/ las dang rnam par smin pa dang / 'jig pa dang / gnod pa dang / rnam par 'tshe ba dang / nad la sogs pa zhi bar dmigs te bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas gtor bar 'dod pas zlos pa'i tshe gdams pa'i tshul gyis dbul bar bya'o/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gzungs las le'u bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ras ris kyi cho ga gsungs pa/ shing bal shin tu dri ma med pa la bram ze'am gtsang sbra dang ldan pas khrus byas te/ dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba btab la brtag par bya'o/ /rigs ngan dmangs rigs la sogs pa'i ras dag ni spang bar bya'o/ /ras de gur kum dang / gla rtsi dang / a ka ru la sogs pa'i chus bkrus te dag par bya'o/ /de nas sngags 'di gro ga 'am ras la bris nas gdags par bya'o/ /a ā/ i i/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ /ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa zhes bya ba bris te dgod par bya'o/ /de nas sngags 'di lan bdun brjod par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ s+pho ṭa ya hūṃ/ tra tha haṃ maṃ/ oṃ bā kye daṃ na maḥzhes bya ba las thams cad 'grub pa ste/ gur kum dang / tsan+dan dang / gla rtsi'i chu la bsngags shing gtor bar bya'o/ /de nas ri mo mkhan khrus dag par bya ste/ bram ze'i rigs kyis bri bar bya'o/ /tshon ni gser dang / dngul dang/ zangs dang / lcags rang gis bri bar bya ba'am/ yang na dkar rtsi dang / mtshal dang / ldong ros dang / ba bla dang / spang ma dang / mthing shun dang / rgya skyegs dang / rdo sol dang / snag tsa dang / de la sogs pa'i tshon rnams la a ka ru dang / du ru ska dang / tsan+dan dang / gla rtsi dang / rgya spos la sogs pa rnams dang sbyar la sngags 'di lan

bdun brjod de bri bar bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa s+pho ṭa ya hūṃ/ tra thā haṃ maṃ/ bākye hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbi ra hūṃ/ khe tsa ra maṃ zhes brjod la bri bar bya ste/ khyad par bzang po 'dzom pa'i dus su tshul khrims dang ldan zhing dag pa la kha zas byin te spyan dbye bar bya'o/ /bri ba yang de bzhin te/ spyan 'byed pa'i dus su sngags 'di brjod do/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+bhā nāṃ/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa s+pho ṭa ya hūṃ/ tra thā hāṃ māṃ/ ga ga na bar lak+ṣa ṇa/ ka ru ṇa ma ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta tsak+ṣuḥ.oṃ āḥhūṃ swā hā zhes sbrang rtsi gser gyi thur ma la byugs la lan gsum du byug par bya'o/ /bris sku tshad dang ldan pa yongs su zin pa dang / 'dri mkhan la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sbyin par bya ste/ gser ram/ dngul lam/ zangs sam/ rwa'am/ rdo ba dag las byed na yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /gzugs dang sku'i khyad par gyi rang bzhin dang / rang bzhin ma yin pas khyad par tha dad pa dag tu bya ste/ /rang bzhin dang ldan pa la bar chad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir gzugs sku las ni yongs su bsgyur nas byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas khyad par bzang po'i dus su khang pa ba'i rnam lngas byug par byas te/ ras ris dang / thang ka dang / po ti dang / glegs bam la sogs pa maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhugs su gsol te/ spos dang / me tog dang / mar me dang / dri dang / lha bshos la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i khyad par dpag tu med pa bshams te/ gtor ma yang de bzhin du'o/ /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / bla re la sogs pa yang bre bar bya'o/ /de nas khro bo'i sku dang ldan pas sngags brjod par bya ste/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ a mo gha e hi a pra ti ha ta/ a tsa la tse ta e naṃ ta ka ṇaṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ta di ta di/ ta ṭa ta ṭa/ bighān ghā ta ya/ mā ra ya/ khā da ya/ s+pho ṭa ya/ sa taṃ tsa me/ a nu ban+dha ya/ ā dz+nyi ku ru/ a dha ha dha ha naṃ kra/ ka ta ka ta/ ma ta ma ta/ haṃ haṃ maṃ maṃ/ e te ba la e te pa la/ e hi ma hā nu ni bi sha na/ naṭ+ṭa naṭ+ṭa/ ā be sha ya/ ā be sha ya/ a tsa le tse ha/ taṭa taṭa/ da ma da ma/ phaṭa phaṭa zhes 'bum brjod par bya ste/ lha'i sku gnyis la ni bye ba'o/ /zhi ba ni

sprul pa'i sku ste/ sngon du ni de bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /a ka ru dang / du ru ska dang / tsan+dan dang / ga bur dang / gla rtsi dang / rgya sbos kyi chu la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥshākya mu na ye/ ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ a ra ha ta bh+yaḥ/ sa myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+yathā/ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu ni oṃ dza ye/ dza ye/ bākye she swā hā/ oṃ bākye baṃ dza ya/ oṃ bākye niṣ+ṭe ye/ oṃ bākye na maḥ/ oṃ bākye daṃ na maḥ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ haṃ maṃ zhes bya bas sku khrus bya'o/ /de nas rol mo bsgrag par bya ste/ rdzas la sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas nas/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ haṃ maṃ/ oṃ ād+yā nāt+pan na twā ta pra bha swa ra su bi shud dha/ dharma dhātu/ swabhā pa āt+ma ko3haṃ zhes bya ba brjod par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa dpag tu med pas mchod de/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig tu brjod pa'i gzungs sngags so/ /na ma s+t+rai ya dh+wi kā nāṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta ni tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa/ ba la pa la/ ba ta ba tra/ shān+te shān+te/ ha la ha la/ pa ra ba ra/ ma rā ṇa ma rā ṇa/ badz+ra da la s+pho ṭa ma/ li ti ta shi khang / sa man+ta badz+ra ṇi dz+wa la dz+wa la/ na mo stu te/ a mo gha tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sa saṃ ra ṇa ra ṇa/ haṃ hūṃ la badz+ra s+pho ṭa maṃ swā hā/ na ma s+t+wai ya dh+wi kā nāṃ ta thā ga tā nāṃ sarba tra a pra ti ha tā bā p+ti dharmatā ba lī nāṃ/ aṃ a/ /sa ma sa ma sa man+to a naṃ ta tā bāp+ti shā sa ni/ ha ra ha ra/ sma ra sma ra ṇa pi ga ta rā ga /bud+dha dharma te/ sa ra sa ra/ sa ma ba lā/ ha sa ha sa/ tra ya tra ya/ ga ga na ma tā ba ra lak+ṣa ṇe dz+wa la dz+ra la na sā ga re swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta budhā ya/ na maḥsarba bud+dhā bo dhi sa twā nāṃ/ oṃ a ra dze bi re dze/ ma hā bi ra dze/ ma hā bi ra dze/ swa ra te swa ra te/ tra yi tra yi/ bi dha ma ni/ saṃ bhaṃ dza ni ra ma ti/ sid dha a tre traṃ sā hā zhes brjod do/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rnam par dag pa'i gzungs te/ lan cig brjod pa tsam gyis kyang lha dang / sngags dang / phyag rgya thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig gsum dang ldan pa'i gzungs 'dis lha dang / sngags dang / phyag rgya bcings ba rnams nus pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang / sngags dang / phyag rgya rnams kyis ltas dang mtshan ma bar chad med par 'gyur ro/ /srod dang tho rangs la de bzhin gshegs

pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi gzungs 'di rjes su brjod par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i khrus 'di la brtson par bya'o/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+nā nāṃ/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ i ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ maṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ raṃ ho aṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ a shu maṃ bi shud+dhe shud+dhe shud+dhe sa ma ya swā hā zhes brjod do/ /'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i gzungs te/ chu la sngags bzlas nas khrus byas na sdig pa kun 'dag par 'gyur ro/ /rmi lam ngan pa dang / ltas ngan pa dang / mtshan ma ngan pa dang / dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /rims dang / 'brum bu dang / lha gor dang / 'bras dang / shu ba dang / 'go ba'i nad dang / 'tshe ba las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gzungs las le'u lnga pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po la sogs pa tshar gcod pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pa gsungs pa/ dang po chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi e'i rnam pa can gyi nam mkha'o/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu lta bu ba dan can yam̐ las byung ba'o/ /chu'i dkyil 'khor gangs ltar dkar ba'i zlum po bum pa can bam̐ las so/ /sa'i dkyil 'khor gser gyi mdog can gru bzhi rdo rje can lam̐ las byung ba'o/ /de'i steng du ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i tshad dang ldan pa oṃ las byung ba'o/ /me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa 'bar ba dang bcas pa ram̐ las so/ /de'i nang du bh+rum̐ kha dog sna tshogs las byung ba'i khang bu brtsegs pa gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi dang bcas pa'i rin po che sna lnga las grub pa ni shel dang / bai ḍūr+ya dang / byi ru dang / in+d+ra nī la dang / gser las grub pa'o/ /de'i nang sna tshogs pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i gdan no/ /shar gyi 'dab ma ni shel las grub pa'o/ /lho'i 'dab ma ni bai ḍūr+ya las grub pa'o/ /nub kyi 'dab ma ni byi ru las grub pa'o/ /byang gi 'dab ma ni in+d+ra nī la'o/ /mtshams rnams kyang shel dang / bai ḍūr+ya dang / byi ru dang / in+d+ra nī la las grub pa'o/ /dbus su ni tshogs bdag glang sna'i steng du sna tshogs pa'i 'dam skyes dang nyi ma'i gdan no/ /shar du brgya

byin/ lhor lha chen po/ /nub tu khyab 'jug /byang du thags bzangs ris so/ /shar lho mtshams su tshangs pa/ lho nub mtshams su gzhon nu/ nub byang du dga' byed/ byang shar du kun du rgyal ba ste/ lha chen po brgyad kyi steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan no/ /yi ge ram̐ las byung ba'i nyi ma dang mam̐ las byung ba'i shes rab kyi mtshan ma mam̐ dang ldan pa las bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag nyid kyi mi g.yo ba nam mkha'i mdog can nyi ma'i snying po la pus mo reg cing bzhugs pa'o/ /rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' ma lus pa 'od kyis 'gengs pa/ phyag g.yas na ral gri bsnams pa/ g.yon na klu'i rgyal po'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ phu phu zhes bya ba'i sgra 'don pa'o/ /shar du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i rigs yi ge tsam̐ las byung ba'i shes rab kyi mtshan ma tsam̐ dang ldan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i rigs kyi bdag nyid can gyi mi g.yo ba shel gyi mdog can nyi ma'i snying po la pus mo reg cing bzhugs pa rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' ma lus pa 'od kyis 'gengs pa/ phyag g.yas na ral gri bsnams pa/ g.yon pa na klu nor rgyas bsnams pa phu phu zhes bya ba'i sgra 'don pa'o/ /lhor bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i rigs yi ge dhī las byung ba'i shes rab kyi mtshan ma dhī dang ldan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i rigs kyi bdag nyid mi g.yo ba bai ḍūr+ya'i mdog can nyi ma'i snying po la pus mo reg cing bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' ma lus ba 'od kyis 'gengs pa/ phyag g.yas na ral gri bsnams pa/ g.yon na klu'i rgyal po'i zhags pa bsnams pa phu phu zhes bya ba'i sgra 'don pa'o/ /nub tu bcom ldan 'das pad+ma'i rigs yi ge mam̐ las byung ba'i shes rab kyi mtshan ma mam̐ dang ldan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das pad+ma'i rigs kyi bdag nyid can gyi mi g.yo ba byi ru'i mdog can nyi ma'i snying po la pus mo reg cing bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' ma lus pa 'od kyis 'gengs pa/ g.yas na ral gri bsnams pa/ g.yon na klu chu lha bsnams pa phu phu zhes bya

ba'i sgra 'don pa'o/ /byang du bcom ldan 'das las kyi rigs yi ge ham̐ las byung ba'i shes rab kyi mtshan ma ham̐ dang ldan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das las kyi rigs kyi bdag nyid can gyi mi g.yo ba in+d+ra nī la'i mdog can nyi ma'i snying po la pus mo reg cing bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das nam mkha' ma lus pa 'od kyis 'gengs pa/ phyag g.yas na ral gri bsnams pa/ g.yon na klu rigs ldan bsnams pa phu phu zhes bya ba'i sgra 'don pa/ shar lho mtshams su ram̐ las byung ba'i tri shū la ram̐ gyis mtshan pa dang ldan pa'i zhal gcig phyag bzhi ba'i khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba g.yas kyi dang po na tri shū la/ g.yon gyi dang po na klu mtha' yas kyi bu/ g.yas g.yon gyi 'og ma na rdo rje dang thod pa bsnams pa/ lho nub mtshams su ṣam̐ las byung ba'i dbyug tho ṣam̐ gis mtshan pa dang ldan pa'i zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i gshin rje gshed po bai ḍūr+ya'i mdog can/ g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje'i dbyug tho/ g.yon gyi dang po na klu dga' bo bsnams pa'o/ /g.yas g.yon gyi 'og ma gnyis na tho ba phur bu bsnams pa/ nub byang mtshams su ṇa las byung ba'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ṇa'i mtshan pa dang ldan pa'i zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i rta mgrin byi ru'i mdog can/ g.yas kyi dang po na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /g.yon gyi dang po na klu pad+ma chen po bsnams pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi 'og ma na lcags sgrog bsnams pa'o/ /byang shar mtshams su hūm̐ las byung ba'i be con hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang ldan pa'i zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa'i bdud rtsi 'khyil pa in+d+ra nī la'i mdog can/ g.yas dang po na be con/ g.yon gyi dang po na klu stobs kyis rgyu bsnams pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi tha ma gnyis bsnol nas bsdigs pa'o/ /shar lho'i gru chad la lha mo bdug pa ma mdog mthing ga pog phor 'dzin pa dang ldan pa/ lho nub tu lha mo me tog ma mdog dkar mo me tog 'dzin pa dang ldan pa'o/ /nub byang du lha mo mar me ma dmar mo mar me 'dzin pa/ byang shar du lha mo dri chab ma ljang gu dri chu bsnams pa'o/ /de dag ni gzhon nu lang tsho la bab pa mdzes pa'i tshul can hūṃ las bskyed par bya'o/ /shar

phyogs su lha mo rta'i gdong can kha dog dkar mo lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /lho phyogs su lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub phyogs su lha mo dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin pa'o/ /byang phyogs su lha mo ljang gu dril bu 'dzin pa'o/ /de dag ni cung zhig khros pa'i tshul can gyi phaṭa las bskyed par bya ste/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin la yongs su gnas par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis yang dag par brjod pa'i gzungs 'di gsungs so/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dh+ra nāṃ/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā nāṃ/ trai lo kya bi dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā nāṃ/ a kro te ka ya man+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā nāṃ/ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā nāṃ/ tra tha a mo gha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūṃ phaṭa/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ tra tha badz+ra/ a tsa la tse ta da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭa/ na ma sa man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ tra tha rat+na a tsa la pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ tra tha pad+ma a tsa la tsa la ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ tra tha a mo gha karma a tsa la ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa zhes bya ba gsungs te/ lha dang / lha ma yin dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / ma rungs pa dang sdang ba rnams zhi bar byed cing sdig pa dman pa'i las rnams 'dag par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gzungs las le'u drug pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor gyi nang du gzungs sngags 'di bka' stsal to/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā naṃ/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa a tsa la ka na/ tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa/ na ta na ta/ ma ta ṭa ma ta ṭa/ mo ṭa ta mo ṭa ta/ sha ta sha ta/ ṭa ta ṭa ta/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ mo ha mo ha/ mo ha sarba pā paṃ ka ra/ ha sa ha sa/ badz+ra ha sa a mo gha ku ru/ ha sa ha sa/ ma rta ma rta/ gardza gardza/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ā bi sha ya/ ā bi sha ya/ ma hā man+t+ra pa la ka /du na du na/ ti ni ti ni/ khā ta khā ta/ sarba bigh+na na/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ sarba bigh+nan/ku ru ku ru/ ma hā bi ṣa/ sarba pā baṃ/ ma hā badz+ra/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ hrīḥb li ta ra gha na ta ka/ hūṃ hūṃ maṃ maṃ haṃ haṃ/ na maḥs man+ta budhā nāṃ/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ya/ a mo gha e hi/ a pra ti ha ta e hi/ a tsa le tse ta a nan+ta kā nāṃ/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ tsa ru tsa ru/ ta di ṭi ti/ ta ṭa ta ta/ bigh+nan gha ta ya/ mā ra ya/ khā da ya/ s+pho ṭa ya/

sa tsa me/ a nu ban+dha/ adz+nya ku ru ku ru/ a ha sa/ a da na/ kra ka ta ma ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ haṃ haṃ/ a ti pa la i ti ma hā gu ṇa ba shi na/ naṭ+ṭa naṭ+ṭa ta/ a bi sha ya/ a tsa la tse ta/ sarba tra a nut+ta re/ ka tse ta ta ṭa ta ṭa/ ḍa ma ḍa ma/ haṃ haṃ maṃ maṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ tra a mo gha tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa s+pho ṭa ya hūṃ/ tra ma ya tra ma hūṃ tra ṭa/ haṃ maṃ/ oṃ ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ a tsa la tse ta/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya hūṃ/ a sa man ti ka tra ta/ ma hā ba la/ ṣaṭ+pā ra man+t+raṃ/ aṃ aṃ haṃ haṃ/ shudhā trai lo kya tu ṣ+ye tu badz+ra/ a pra ti ha ta bi li bh+yaḥ/ na mo dza la ya tra ta/ aṭ+ṭa ha sa na maṃ haṃ swā hā zhes gsungs ma thag tu 'dzam bu gling na gnas pa'i lha dang / lha ma yin dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye la sogs pa thams cad sreg cing sa la 'gyel bar gyur to/ /de nas cho ga gsungs pa dang / lcags sna lnga las byas pa'i ral gri khru tshad gsum pa byas te/ sngags kyi phreng ba maṃ haṃ zhes bya ba bkod la/ khru do dang ldan pa'i spos kyi maṇ+ḍal byas te/ mchod pa'i rdzas dang ldan pa'i dri bzhag ste/ gzungs sngags 'di khri phrag tu brjod cing bzlas na ral gri nam mkha' la 'phags par 'gyur ro/ /de nas g.yul du zhugs na dpag bsam gyi shing yang dum bu dum bur gcod par 'gyur te/ g.yul las rgyal bar byed do/ /lcags sna lnga las byas pa'i lhung bzed byas te haṃ maṃ zhes bya ba'i yi ge bkod de gser dang / dngul dang / zangs las byas pa'i bum par gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / dpal be'u dang / me tog dang / 'khor lo dang / nya dang / dung g.yas su 'khyil ba rnams dang byi ru bcug pa'am/ yang na zangs la byi ru bcug pa byas la gzungs sngags 'di gro ga'am ras la bris te/ khong pa'am/ mgul du btags nas gzungs sngags bye ba bzlas la lhung bzed nam mkha' la 'phags te gsol ba btab na 'dod pa'i yon tan ci 'dod pa 'byung ste/ ljon pa'i shing bzhin no/ /nam mkha'i tri ta'i lce dang / 'ug pa'i mig dang gnyis cha mnyam pa dang / lcags sna gsum gyi phye ma la khwa ta'i khrag gis ri lu bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig byas te/ thod pa dum bu gcig par bcug la gzungs sngags haṃ maṃ zhes byas pas pad+ma la bskor te gzungs sngags bye ba bzlas na pad+ma nam mkha' la 'phags te/ de

mi dbugs dang bral ma thag gi snying gi khrag rlangs dang sbyar te/ mig ni snang byed du bsam zhing ral gri'i phyag rgyas mig dang rna ba la bskus na thams cad mthong zhing thos la/ khar bcug na rang nyid sus kyang mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta bya bā lo ki te dza ya dza ya/ bā kye daṃ na wa ni tsak+ṣur bi sho dhā ya swā hā/ rnga lpags la bya rgod kyi tshil bu byugs nas mnyes te lham byas la/ haṃ dang maṃ rang gi rkang mthil la bris te/ gzungs sngags bye ba bzlas na lham nam mkha' la 'phags te/ rkang pa la bya rgod kyi tshil bu byugs nas gon na gar 'dod par phyin no/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ oṃ bruṃ ma hā ye gṛ ta swā hā zhes bya bas nam mkha' la 'gro zhing 'phags te bya rgod bzhin du'o/ /skye ba bdun pa'i sha dang / bya rgod kyi sha dang / rtsangs pa'i sha dang / sbrang rtsi rnams sbyar la lde gu byas te/ gzungs sngags bye ba brjod de lus la byugs nas ram nye ba dang / nye'u shing pa dang / pra ma ka ra'i mar dang sbyar ba'i lde gu rnams nang re la srang re cha sbrang rtsi dang / ba ser skya'i 'o ma rnams btang ste/ zla ba gcig tu bsgrubs na nam mkha' la thogs pa med do/ /rta nag po'i mig gnyis dkar po'am/ byi ba nag po rna ba gnyis dkar ba'am/ pha bang dkar po'am/ mi mngal nas skra dkar ba'i srog chags la rma bya'i chu khar phor du blugs pa la gzungs sngags bye ba bzlas te blud la/ de'i mig gnyis ma nor bar bton pa grib ma la skams nas ma rul ba'i phye ma la sngags 'di btab ste/ g.yas g.yon ma nor bar byugs na thams cad mkhyen par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i spyan dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /mon spos dang / gi'u wang dang / stag ma'i shun pa dang / nya mkhris dang / ru rta dang / phug ron gyi mig dang / lce dang / go ro tsa na dang / rtug pa rnams la ri lu byas te/ kham pa'i ga'ur ri lu re re la gzungs sngags haṃ maṃ zhes bya ba brjod de/ ga'u nam mkha' la 'phags nas/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ na maḥyaṃ na ma hā ri bi ni nā ta hrīḥzhes lan bdun btab nas byin na gang 'dod pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /bya rgod dang / bya gag dang / khra dang / stag dang / spyang ki dang / wa dang / de rnams kyi mche ba dang / sder mo dang / bram ze'i rus pa'i thal ba la gzungs sngags bzlas te/ bsgrub pa byas nas dus ma yin pa'i sprin

dang ser ba dag la gtor na sprin rnams 'thor zhing ser ba dang / 'brug dang / thog la sogs pa zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gcan gzan thams cad dang / sha za thams cad dang / khyi dang / phag dang / rnga mo'i rtug pa dang / gu gu la dang sbyar te/ dud pas bdugs na dom kun 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gzungs las le'u bdun pa'o// //oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ gzungs sngags 'di ni sngags kyi rgyal po ste/ lan cig brjod pas kyang 'dzam bu'i gling gi lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin la sogs pa kun zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rims nyin gcig pa dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / zla ba gcig pa dang / ldang dub pa dang / rtag pa'i rims dang / yud tsam pa las thar ro/ /'brum bu dang / lha gor dang / shu ba dang / me dbal dang / g.yan pa dag zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /lan cig brjod pas kyang mtshams med pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rig byed kyi tshig gi dang po dang / /gnyis pa'i dang por bcas pa ni/ /gsum pa dag ni lnga par ldan/ /bzhi pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /lnga pa dag gi lnga pa'o/ /uṣ+ma'i rnams kyi bzhi pa dang / /mthar gnas pa yi gnyis pa ni/ /o yis mtshan pa bri bya ste/ /uṣ+ma rnams kyi gnyis pa dang / /bzhi pa'i ye ge lnga pa dang / uṣ+ma'i yi ge bzhi pa la/ /u yis brgyan cing thig ler bcas pa'o/ /sde tshan lnga pa dag gi ni/ /dang po'i yi ge spangs pa dang / /bzhi pa dang por bcas pa ni/ /snying po'i yi ge bcu pa dag go/ /'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa bsgrub bya'i ming dang bcas pa bris te/ khyi nag po'i thod pa'i nang du bcug la/ gzungs sngags lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te yungs kar gyis brab par bya'o/ /de nas klu yod pa'i gnas su khyer la rang gi lus la gla rtsis byugs te/ chu mig tu thod pa bcug la gzungs sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maṣ+tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ na mo bha ga ba te bud+dha bī rā ya/ tad+ya thā/ phu ṭa phu ṭa/ bha ra bha ra/ mi li mi li/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ phyag rgya ni sor mo rnams brkyang ste mthe'u chung bkug la mthe bos mnan te bskor bar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maṣ+caṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba na mi mi li tsi li dhoṃ/ ban+dha ya/ kro dha ya/ badz+ra la ma ya/ ma ka na ya/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ sarba nā ga ban+dha ban+dha/ nā ga ni sa ra sa ra/ bi ser sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ hra da ya/

sho ṣa ṇa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ phyag rgya ni lag pa'i zur gnyis gshibs te/ srin lag gnyis rgyab tu bsnol la mdzub mo gnyis kyis mnan nas mthe'u chung gnyis gshibs bsgreng la gung mo dang mthe bo gnyis gshibs te spyi bor bzhag nas sngags lan bdun brjod de ldang bar bya'o/ /gu gul dang / yungs kar dang / shing kun dang / dri chen dang / nya'i mkhris pa dang / sgog skya dang / shu dag rnams sbyar te lus la byugs na rdzas kyi bsrung ba'o/ /rgya sol gyi me la bsregs te bdugs na ser ba dang / dus ma yin pa'i rlung rnams zhi bar 'gyur zhing / gdon rnams 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /zho dang / 'o ma dang / mar dang / sbrang rtsi dang / bu ram dang / kha ra dang / 'bras yos dang / dung dang / mtshal dang / rgya mtsho'i lbu ba la sogs pa dag 'khar gzhong du blugs te/ yungs kar la gzungs sngags 'di brjod cing klu mchod par bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maṣ+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya hūṃ hūṃ/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ā nan ta ka /tak+ṣa ka /shaṃ kha pā la/ bā su ki/ ma hā pad+ma/ oṃ ga ta ba la wa ta/ karkoṭa phu swā hā/ zhes brjod pas klu rnams bde ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /char dbab par 'dod na dri zhim po'i chus maṇ+ḍal byas te/ spra tshil la klu'i gzugs sor nyi shu rtsa lnga pa byas nas maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du me tog gtor la gzungs thag btags te gzhag par bya'o/ /snying gar gong gi de gro ga la gi'u wang gis bris la gzhug par byas/ nyin mtshan du mchod cing bal po se'u'i lcug mas byab par byas nas gzungs sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ suṃ su pra ti badz+ra dun te mi li mi mi li ba ri shā ya ba ri shā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de rang smyung bar gnas par bya'o/ /gal te klu rnams kyis char mi 'bebs na klu rnams kyi mgo ardza ka'i dog pa bzhin du 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /spos kyi maṇ+ḍal byas te/ rgya spos kyi me la gzugs bsro zhing gzungs sngags brjod pa ni spogs pa'i cho ga'o/ /dri zhim po'i me la bu ram dang / sbrang rtsi dang / kha ra dang / til la sogs pa'i dgang blugs kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod par bya ste/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bya bas mchod par bya'o/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gzungs las le'u brgyad pa'o// //de nas 'dam skyes pad+ma sna tshogs pa'i 'dab ma can gyi steng du a las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil

'khor/ de'i steng du mum̐ gyi sa bon las byung ba'i shes rab kyi mtshan ma mum̐ dang ldan pa las 'phags pa 'jam dpal mgon po'i sku byis pa lo brgyad gnyis lon pa lta bu gser btso ma'am gur kum gyi kha dog 'dra ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas pa na ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa po ti thugs kar 'dzin pa'i/ shar gyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo sku mdog kha ba la gur gum gyis gtor ba 'dra ba'i zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas na ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa na ut+pa la'i sdong bu dang bcas pa thugs ka na 'dzin pa'o/ /lho'i pad+ma'i 'dab ma la 'jam dpal gsung gi dbang phyug sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas pa na ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ phyag g.yon pa na 'khor lo thugs ka na 'dzin pa'o/ /nub kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la 'jam dpal rnon po sku mdog byi ru bcag pa lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis na ut+pa la gnyis bsnams pa'o/ /byang gi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la 'jam dpal shes rab ral gri sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon gyi dang po nu ut+pa la sdong bu dang bcas pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi 'og ma na mda' 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma na rin po che'i gzhu 'dzin pa'o/ /sku de dag ni ma rig pa'i mun pa thams cad bsal ba'i nam mkha' ma lus pa'i 'od kyis 'gengs pa'i sku'o/ /oṃ dharma dhā tu bā gī shwa ri muṃ zhes brjod pas shes rab dang ldan zhing thos pa 'dzin pa dang yid gzhungs par 'gyur ro/ /rin po che'i bum pa cu gang dang / gur gum dang / a ka ru dang / tsan+dan dkar po dang / gla rtsi la sogs pa dri zhim pa'i chu blugs te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ ar+ha te bh+yaḥ/ samyak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥ/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ku mā ra bhū tā ya/ dhā ra ṇī/ bi shwa saṃ bha ba/ ā gats+tsha ya/ ā gats+tsha ya/ hu lu hu lu/ bruṃ bruṃ bruṃ/ hūṃ hūṃ dzi na dzi ka /mañdzu shri ye/ su shri/

ye ta ra ya maṃ haṃ/ sarba duḥkhe bh+yaḥphaṭa phaṭa/ a mṛ tod bha ba sa ma ya sa ma ya/ ud bha be/ sarba pā paṃ me nā shā ya swā hā/ zhes gzungs sngags 'di bum pa'i chu la lan bdun brjod de khrus byas na sdig pa thams cad 'dag par 'gyur ro/ /dbang po rno zhing thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+had te bh+yaḥ/ samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ na mo mañdzu shri ye/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mañdzu gho ṣa/ ha na ha na/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ma tha ma tha/ bi dh+waṃ sa ya/ ka ra ka ra/ tu tra tu tra/ bhañdza bhañdza/ ā bi sha ya/ ā bi sha ya/ tu tra tu tra/ tu ṭa tu ṭa/ s+phu ṭa sa s+phu ṭa sa/ hṛ da ya sā dha ni/ na maḥsaṃ bo dha ni pra be sha ya/ lau hu ta lau hu ta/ krai te krai te/ pra ban+dha pra ban+dha/ ā be sha ya/ ā be sha ya/ haṃ maṃ sarba bigh+na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes bya bas nad pa la 'bras kyi snye ma'am til la btab ste khrus bya'o/ /gzungs sngags bzlas pa'i khrus byas pas/ las dang nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par smin pa'i sdug bsngal las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /ka ra'i shing gi me la sbyin sreg byas na yang zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /ral gri la btab nas g.yul du zhugs na g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /smyung ba dang ldan pas sku gzugs kyi mdun du bsgrub par bya zhing 'phags pa la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /gro ga'am ras la bris te sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa la gdags par bya'o/ /skud pa la gzungs sngags btab ste mdud pa byas la srid kyis gdungs pa la btags te/ 'phags pa la gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu'am bu mo dag smyung bas 'dug ste/ yi dam du 'don na lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / yi dgas dang / sha za la sogs pa'i gdon mi 'byung ngo / /gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / lce 'bab pa dang / dus ma yin pa'i 'chi bdag las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /stag dang / dom dang / dred la sogs pa'i dud 'gro dag gi gnod pa dang / rlung dang / ser ba dang / dus ma yin pa'i sa g.yo ba rnams zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /yid gzhungs shing thos pa 'dzin pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i bag chags spong ba la gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i sku thams cad thogs pa med pa'i spyan gyis mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dang bu mo dag gis 'di lan cig gam/ lan gsum mam/ bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/ brgya rtsa brgyad du rjod par byed na de'i lus la

mdze dang / phol mig dang / 'bras dang / shu ba dang / g.yan pa dang / lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang / mig dang / rna ba dang / so na ba la sogs pa dag mi 'byung ngo zhes gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis zhal 'dzum pa mdzad de/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo kun nas 'jug pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag ste/ sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dgas dang / dud 'gro dang / gling bzhi'i mi'i 'jig rten du 'od kyis khyab par mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / sum cu rtsa gsum dang / 'thab bral dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi gnas man chad khyab par mdzad do/ /bsam gtan dang po'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag go/ /bsam gtan dang po nas langs te bsam gtan gnyis pa la mnyam par bzhag go/ /gnyis pa las langs te bsam gtan gsum pa la mnyam par bzhag go/ /gsum pa nas langs nas bsam gtan bzhi pa la mnyam par bzhag go/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa las langs nas nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched la mnyam par bzhag go/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched las langs nas rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched la mnyam par bzhag go/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched las langs nas ci yang med pa'i skye mched la mnyam par bzhag go/ /ci yang med pa'i skye mched las langs nas yod min med min skye mched la mnyam par bzhag go/ /de las langs nas de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang / sgrib pa rnam par sel ba dang / 'jam dpal dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / byams pa la sogs pa rnams mngon par dga'o/ /lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i gzungs lo'u dgu pa'o// //'phags pa mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī mi tra dang / bod kyi lotsā ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //

༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya badz+ra kro dha rā dza kalpa la ghu tan+t+ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po'i rtog pa bsdus pa'i rgyud ces bya ba/ dpal 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi nam mkha'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor rdo rje snying por byin gyis brlabs pa'i steng du rin po che sna bdun las grub pa lha'i gzhal med khang bye ba phrag brgyad cus bskor ba'i dbus su dpag tshad 'bum phrag khyab pa'i khang pa brtsegs ma shin tu mtho ba/ kun kyang rin po che du ma'i khri pad+ma dang / seng ges ma tho ba/ dbu rtse rin po che'i zur mangs kyi mchod rten pad+ma dang / 'khor lo dang / gdugs mtho bar drangs pa la dar gyi dpyangs lding ba/ de'i grib ma sa gzhi la bkod pa na byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams lha'i bzhon pa las babs nas nang du gshegs pa/ sna tshogs pa'i dril bu dang / ba dan dang / rin po che'i me tog gi phreng ba dang / dra ba dang / dra ba phyed pa dang / rnga yab dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / rdo rje phyed pa dang / chun 'phyang shar bu la sogs pa du mas mdzes pa/ sgo khyud khyams dang / sgo glegs dang / rin po che'i me long dang / gdugs la sogs pa du mas khyab pa/ rin po che'i pha gu brtsegs te mdzes par byas pa du ma de thams cad kyi dbus su 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po dang lhan cig tu bzhugs so/ /de yang 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / 'jam dpal dang / kun tu bzang po dang / byams pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang / zhi ba'i blo gros dang / sna tshogs bkram pa dang / mkha' 'od me tog 'chang dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang / gzugs mdzes dag pa dang / sa'i snying po dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba phrag bdun dang / shā ri'i bu dang / maud gal dang / rta thul dang / 'od srung le sogs pa bye ba phrag bzhi dang / grags chen snyan pa chen po brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug

dang / lus ngan dang / gshin rje dang / dga' rab dbang phyug la sogs pa lha'i rigs sum brgya dang lhan cig tu chos kyi rnam grangs gsang sngags zhes bya ba la 'jug pa gang zhig byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos dang / 'jig rten skyong ba la sogs pa rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa'i 'khor rnams la dgongs pa tha dad kyi bsam pa dang mthun pa'i bkod pa chen po bskyed pa dang / cho 'phrul du ma bsgyur ba dang / 'od zer du ma 'gyed cing thabs cig tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzum bzhin du 'khor la gzigs nas ljags kyi dbang po bkram ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/ yi ge ming tshig ngag gi sgos/ /sngags dbyibs chos su byin brlabs kyis/ /yi ge sgra tsam phyed dam gcig /mngon sum rjes 'jug ring thung dang / /dbyangs dang gsal byed mtshan mas mtshon/ /sa bcu pha rol phyin bcu bdag /dbang bcu don bcu rnam pa bcu/ /mi 'jigs bzhi dang ma 'dres chos/ /byams dang thugs rje chen po dag /dbyangs gcig gi ni sngags kyis su/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs rab zhi dang / /yid 'phrog dpal 'byor dbang phyug dang / /mthu stobs du ma bskyed pa dang / /rtag gnas thob dang don nges thob/ /rdo rje bla na med sems bskyed/ /mdor na gang gis gang 'dod pa/ /bsam pas sems rnams rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje bla na med pa gsor/ /chos sgra bla na med pa sgrogs/ 'khor lo bla na med pa skor/ ral gri bla na med bzung / /pad+ma bla na med pa chongs/ /rin chen bla med gsal bar gyis/ /dkyil 'khor tshul du spros nas kyang / /mchod rten tshul du bsdu bar gyis/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang / /lha min mkha' lding mi'am ci/ /srin po sha za brjed byed tshogs/ /'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs 'gyur ba'i/ /rnam 'phrul du ma 'di sgyur cig /gsung mchog de skad thos ma thag /lag na rdo rje mthu bo ches/ /dga' mgu thal mo rab sbyar te/ /snyan pa'i tshig gis 'di gsol to/ /gser dang rin chen lnga po las/ /rab mchog ri bor gyur

pa las/ /'gro rnams kun gyi rten gnas dang / /rtags su yang dag 'dzin pa ltar/ /rnam par shes dang phung po bzhi/ /'byung ba rnam par dag bsgrubs pas/ /lha dang phyag rgya phrin las su/ /sngags shes rnams kyis bzung byas nas/ /brtul ba'i ye shes byang chub rim/ /khyad par de la ldan par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa che/ /kun mkhyen ye shes gtso bo ches/ /sku las sna tshogs mdangs 'od can/ /'od zer du ma byung nas kyang / /gzhi dang snying po me tog gis/ /brgyan pa'i zhing rnams khyab byas tshe/ /sa yang rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ /'jig rten skyong dang bdud kyi tshogs/ /ma lus pa rnams brgyal bar 'gyur/ /nyan thos rang rgyal 'dar bar 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi/ /tshogs rnams shin tu skrag par gyur/ /de tshe phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzod spu nas/ /khro bo chen po'i tshogs byung ba/ /'od zer rtse mos drangs nas su/ /zhing dbus dkyil 'khor 'di ru lhags/ /'od zer tshogs kyang rab 'dus nas/ /dpal be'u nyid du thim par gyur/ /de tshe 'od de'i byin brlabs las/ /mkha' la sgra 'di grag par gyur/ /shākya'i mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gang du gzi brjid che bzhugs slad/ /chos kyi dbyings las byung ba yi/ /rgyal ba'i sras po thams cad gshegs/ /dri ma med pa'i dam chos mchog /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul dge ba/ /thos nas byang chub 'dus ma byas/ /'jig rten mgon po brnyes par gyur/ /de nas lag na rdo rje tshogs/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyang / /snyim pa me tog bkang byas te/ /gtor nas phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas/ /dang zhing gus pa'i tshul gyis su/ /pus btsugs thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs/ /mi gnas ye shes che ba'i mchog /yon tan rgya mtsho 'byung ba'i gtso/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rab brgyan pa/ /mtshan min spangs pa'i thub pa che/ /dri med dge ba ji ltar lags/ /gsang

sngags tshul du spyod pa ci/ /'dus ma byas pa'i byang chub gang / /'jig rten mgon po ci ltar 'gyur/ /bdag cag rnams la sman rab dang / /'gro la thugs rje che mdzad phyir/ /mgon po bcom ldan thub pa ches/ /yang dang yang du bshad du gsol/ /de nas yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rkang gnyis gtso bos bka' stsal pa/ /gsang ba'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin/ /shes rab chen po'i spyan ldan pas/ /bdag gzhan phan don la brtson phyir/ /legs par nyon la yid la zung / /yang dag yang dag mtha' min tshul/ /de ni nga yis bshad par bya/ /srog gcod ma byin len brdzun 'khrig /tshig rtsub dbyen dang ngag kyal smra/ /brnab sems gnod sems log lta chang / /dri ro ngan pa'i zas skom dang / /srog can sha khrag log 'tshor bcas/ /slob dpon dge 'dun mchod rten sogs/ /khyad par yul can yo byad dang / /dman zhing nyam thag phrog dgu pa/ /glegs bam 'tshong dang chos kyi zong / /g.yangs ral gri so dug sogs/ /me 'obs ltar mthong spangs nas kyang / /rnam par dkar la sogs par bya/ /yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin stsol dang / /nyan dang 'dzin dang klog pa dang / /mchod pa dang ni kha ton dang / /de dag sems dang sgom pa ste/ /dkar bcu lam la yun ring dang / /nus bcas rgyun mi 'chad du 'bad/ /gtan pa med pa'i byang chub sems/ /shel ltar dri ma med pa'o/ /mchog 'di spyad pas sdug bsngal tshogs/ /myur du gcod pas dge ba'o/ /chos bdag med dang mnyam nyid dang / /rang sems gdod nas dag pa gang / /rgyu 'bras 'du byed med pa dang / /zag bcas bde dang bral ba las/ /byang chub phyogs chos ma lus pa/ /chos nyid bdag med spyod pa ni/ /chos dbyings ye shes mngon byas nas/ /ma 'dres chos rnams rdzogs gsal ba/ /'dus ma byas kyi byang chub ste/ /chos rnams kun gyi gzhi lus so/ /'dod pa'i khams sogs yon tan la/ /shin tu bde rol spyad pa spyod/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs

can rnams kyi/ /lkog tu gyur pa gsang ba ste/ /bskal pa bsam yas dpag med du/ /bslab dka' yangs zab rgya chen rnams/ /sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin du/ /lus ngag yid la gang gnas pa/ /dbyer med tshul du skyob pas na/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis sngags su brjod/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa'i sku/ /yon tan mtha' dag rdzogs pa ni/ /bden pa gnyis la gnas pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mgon/ /la la 'khor los sgyur ba'i gzugs/ /la lar dge sbyong chen po'i gzugs/ /la lar srin po srin mo'i gzugs/ /la lar 'gro ba bzang po'i gzugs/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /seng ge ltar gzigs mdzad la sogs/ /sna tshogs du ma mdzad pa ni/ /rkang gnyis lha min rnam gnyis sogs/ /'gro ba'i mgon por gyur pa'o/ /rtag dang 'dra dang nges med pa'i/ /gtso bo bsam pas gyur pa rnams/ /'jig rten phal pa'i mgon po ste/ /gzugs byad kha dog tha dad pa/ /yul dus rnam pa'i bye brag gis/ /grangs ma byung ba mchod 'os so/ /thub pas gsungs pa'i de ma thag /rdo rje can gyis bzhengs nas kyang / /phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas nas ni/ /spyan sngar 'dug nas 'di skad gsol/ /'dren pa gtso bo bcom ldan 'das/ /sngags zhes pa ni gang gang yin/ /phyag rgya zhes ni ci lta bu/ /ting 'dzin zhes ni ji ltar bshad/ /lus ngag yid la ji ltar gnas/ /dbyer med tshul du ji ltar skyob/ /bdag la phan pa'i don phyir dang / /gzhan la brtse phyir bshad du gsol/ /de nas rgyal ba gtso mchog ni/ /ljags kyi dbang po bkram byas te/ /tshangs pa chen po'i gsung snyan gyis/ /rnam rtog zad phyir 'di gsungs so/ /snying po nye snying rtsa ba'i sngags/ /las kyi sngags su gyur pa ste/ /snying po brjod dang sa bon no/ /nye snying ye shes mchog dang ni/ /gsang ba'i snying po zhes grags so/ /las kyi sngags ni gnyis yin te/ /bdag nyid brtan byed las sngags dang / /sbyor tshogs grub par byed

pa'o/ /phyag rgya lag pa'i 'du byed dang / /rkang pa stabs kyi 'gyur ba'o/ /rtags su mtshon dang 'debs pa dang / /'gyur ba med par byed pas na/ /phyag rgya zhes su bshad pa'o/ /rang gi rtse gcig sems bsdus na/ /sems la lhag pa'i chos 'bebs pa/ /de ni ting nge 'dzin zhes bya/ /de ltar de dag la brten nas/ /snga ma'i gnas de yongs gyur nas/ /sgo nga bral ba'i 'dab bzangs ltar/ /lus 'di mkha' la cher song nas/ /rgyal ba'i zhing khams thams cad du/ /rgyal la dam chos mnyan nas kyang / /rgyal sras kun la bshad pa dang / /skad cig mkhyen pa'i shes pas kyang / /shes bya ma lus phyogs khyab pa/ /lus ngag yid la gnas pa'o/ /sems dang yid ni 'dres pa'i tshe/ /ye shes bde bar shar ba ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dbyer med tshul du skyob ces gsungs/ /'phags pa rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po'i rtog pa bsdus pa'i rgyud las lhag par gnas pa'i don yongs su bkod pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //zhi bas gdul dka' bgegs chen dang / /log 'dren de rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ /sems kyi bye brag thugs chud nas/ /de dang gzugs 'dras gzhom pa'i phyir/ /rtog med nam mkha'i lam gnas te/ /rdzogs sangs gdul dka' 'dul mdzad sku/ /rab 'phags khro bo stobs chen dpal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sras kyi sras/ /mi g.yo'i mtshan grags de la 'dir/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras rtag phyag 'tshal/ /tshangs sogs lha dang lus can kun/ /de la rtag tu mchod par byed/ /rgyal bas byas gzo rgyal sras kyi/ /smon rdzogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /ye shes rdzogs nas mi g.yo'i sa/ /thob pas mi g.yo ba zhes bya/ /phas kyi rgol 'joms dpa' bo ste/ /tshar gcod pa ni khro bo yin/ /sngags kyi bden tshig mi slu bas/ /nyan thos bdud tshogs gyis mi g.yo/ /rtog med bdud la khro bas rgyal/ /rdzu 'phrul bskyod med mi g.yo ba/ /de

bzhin nyid kyi snying po mchog /stong nyid las byung rgyal ba'i sku/ /chos dbyings bdag nyid la bzhugs nas/ /sprul 'dis srid pa'i khams sbyong mdzad/ /mkha' ltar dri med spros bral bas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'byung / /spros med nam mkha'i rang bzhin la/ /tha snyad tsam du gsang sngags zhes/ /brjod kyang ngag gi spyod yul 'das/ /skyob pas tha snyad rtogs phyir gsungs/ /sems med rang bzhin med stong nyid/ /sgyu 'drar yid kyis bsgom pa yin/ /dngos med mnyam mdzes 'dod don rnams/ /gsang sngags mgon 'di brjod pas stsal/ /mu stegs bdag dang srog gang zag /gtso bo skyes bu khyab gnas pas/ /'khor ba rtag 'dod nga rgyal rmongs/ /log pa'i zhags bcings sdug bsngal bskyed/ /bdag med srog med sems can med/ /byed po med cing gtso bo med/ /khyab gnas med cing dngos po med/ /rdzas la rdzogs pa'i rang bzhin med/ /log rtog srid 'ching zhags bcad phyir/ /dngos med sna tshogs gzugs bsgoms pas/ /dngos grol stong nyid go 'phang 'thob/ /phyi nang khyad par der goms pa'o/ /dbu ba chu bur sgyu 'drar bsgom/ /stong nyid las ldang ting 'dzin gyis/ /rnam rtog sdig bcings las grol nas/ /'chi med ye shes go 'phang 'thob/ /phung po khams dang skye mched med/ /kun gzhi med de gang zag med/ /gzung 'dzin med de bcings med par/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis rtag tu bshad/ /kun med kun bral kun spangs pa'i/ /stong nyid byang sems sgyu 'dra bar/ /bag yod pas ni rtag bsgoms na/ /byang chub sems kyi myu gu 'char/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra rdzu 'phrul che/ /mkha' ltar gos pa med pa'i sku/ /sngags spyod byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /byang chub sems kyi sgom pa 'thob/ /ngo mtshar gsungs te thos ma thag /khro bo rnams kyi gtso la bstod/ /rtag tu dag cing dri med pa/ /rnam rtog rgyun 'gags kun rtog med/ /brtag rtog med la zhugs pa yi/ /dpa' bo chen po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos kun g.yo

ba med pa khyod/ /spyod yul kun tu legs sbyar bas/ /kun mkhyen g.yo ba med pa rtag /rang bzhin spros bral khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sems can sna tshogs phan don du/ /mdzad spyod sna tshogs gsungs pa'o/ /dag pa'i lam rnams yang dag 'byung / /rnam dag sems la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mun pa phra rab rdul spangs pa'i/ /sprin bral nam mkha' dag pa ltar/ /mgon po khyod sku shel sgong ltar/ /kun rtog spangs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /spros med nam mkha' lta bu la/ /dngos po thams cad dang bral bas/ /phung khams skye mched shin tu dag /ye shes rgya mtsho phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mkha' la 'ja' shar sna tshogs ltar/ /gtso khyod dag pa'i sems can gzigs/ /ngan 'gro kun sgrol dpa' chen 'khrungs/ /go cha chen po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos nyid las byung snying po ni/ /yi ge gcig pa gzi brjid che/ /sems can sdug bsngal sa gzhi la/ /mun 'khrigs sel la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sngags mchog gtso bo'i gsang ba 'dis/ /rgyal sras chos 'phel shes rab bskyed/ /bla med go 'phang myur 'gro gsungs/ /gtso bo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dngos kun gyur dang bcas pa yi/ /las dang skye las rnam par grol/ /rgyal ba rgyu med bdag nyid 'khrungs/ /gtso mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dngos med ye shes me lce yis/ /'dus byas ri bo kun bsregs nas/ /chos dbyings rang bzhin gcig tu rgyal/ /bla med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bstod pa'i don de thugs chud nas/ /'gro la phan phyir cho ga gsungs/ /gsang sngags log par spyod pa dang / /ser sna log par goms pa las/ /'dod pas non pa'i sems rtog gis/ /sngags pa yi dgas gnas su skye/ /dang pos mar me me tog dang / /zhal zas gtor ma phreng ba sogs/ /mchod pa'i rdzas dang yo byad dang / /mi yi lus dang kha zas la/ /'tshe zhing sgrub pa'i bar du gcod/ /mi sdug nad bskyed lo tog 'tshe/ /gnyis pa gnod sbyin drag gyur nas/ /sha khrag chang la snom zhing rgyug /thos bsam

bsgrub pa'i bar gcod cing / /nad bskyed tshe len log lta bskyed/ /rig sngags 'chang gi gdon gzhom phyir/ /sgrub pos 'bad de sngags brjod bya/ /sngags mthu bskyed pa gtor ma dang / /sbyin sreg phyag rgya sngags bcas dang / /mnan pa'i las kyis nags me ltar/ /thogs pa med par 'joms par 'gyur/ /de dag brtan byed lha yin te/ /de gsal byed par sa ris yin/ /de kun rnam dag gsol byed pa/ /byang chub sems mchog zhi ba ni/ /log rtog 'khor ba'i zo chun la/ /ral gri rnon po'i sta re ltar/ /'phags pa rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po'i rtog pa bsdus pa'i rgyud las de bzhin nyid kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas sngags dang phyag rgya dag /'byung bar rab tu bshad par bya/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā hāṃ/ snying po dam pa'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa s+pho ṭa ya hūṃ/ ṭa ta haṃ maṃ snying po'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā hra ta a mo gha/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa s+pho ṭa ya hūṃ/ tra ma ya hūṃ/ ṭa ṭa haṃ maṃ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /na maḥsarbā pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā a tsa lārka na/ naṭ+ṭa naṭ+ṭa/ moṭ+ṭa moṭ+ṭa/ saṭ+ṭa saṭ+ṭa/ taṭ+ṭa taṭ+ṭa/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ā be sha aḥ/ maṭ+ṭa/ ma la ka /dha ṇa dha ṇa/ ti ṇi ti ṇi/ khā da khā da/ bigh+nā na/ mā ra mā ra duṣ+ṭan/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa traṃ/ ku ru ku ru/ ki ri ki ri/ ma hā bi dza ya badz+ra phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ tri bi la ta ra ga/ /narta ka /haṃ haṃ haṃ/ a tsa la/ te tse/ phaṭa phaṭa/ a hūṃ/ a sa man+ta ka /ṭa ṭa/ ma hā ba la sa tā ma na ya/ traṃ maṃ haṃ/ shu r+ya du lo ka /tu ṣ+yan tu lo ka badz+rī na maḥswā pra ti ha ta ba le bh+yo/ /dza la ma tra ta/ a sa ta na maḥswā hā/ gsang ba'i snying po'o/ /de nas phyag rgya stang stabs kyi/ /sngags brjod pa ni 'dir gsungs so/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ ha na ha na mā ra mā ra ya dz+nyā na/ khaḍ+ga hūṃ phaṭa/ ral gri'i phyag rgya'i sngags so/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ khā da khā da/

pā sha na/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma ha te/ dharma te swā hā/ zhags pa'i 'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba tha/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ ha na ha na/ kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa/ mā ra ya duṣ+ṭa bi nā ya kaṃ hūṃ dza/ go cha'i'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra badz+ra na li/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga pā sha dha ra swā hā/ gtsug tor gyi'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ bhañdza ban+dha da ha pa tsa bha smi ku ru ku ru ha na ha na badz+ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa phaṭa/ tho ba'i'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra kebh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ ṣ+ṭa na ta murti/ da ha da ha/ sādha ya sādha ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ bi dza ya kīrti sā hā/ mgo bo'i phyag rgya'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bhaḥ/ sarba ta tha ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba tha/ oṃ bhu dha ra dha ra/ a tsin d+ya ba la bi kra ma ṇaṃ/ bu ra bu sa la ya/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarba swā hā/ rdo ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pūr ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ badz+ra hṛ da ya/ badz+ra ma taṃ gi swā hā/ snying ga'i phyag rgya'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ hūṃ da ha da ha/ kin tsi rā ya si/ ā na ya shī gh+raṃ/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ duṣ+ṭaṃ/ da ma da ma swā hā/ phyogs bcing ba'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa ba ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ du na du na ma hā pā sha khaḍha dha rā sa pa ri pū ra ke swā hā/ bka' rtags kyi'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ ga ga na gan+dhod bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya/ pa ri pū ra ke swā hā/ dri'i phyag rgya'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ bi shudhā dz+nyā na rā dzi saṃ bha be ga ga nā nāṃ hāḥswā hā/ ma mo'i phyag rgya'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ shud+dha dharma te/ shud+dha shud+dha/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥswā hā/ gtor ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ shud+dha ma hā dz+nyā na swa bhā be/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ma hā na ye swā hā/ bdug pa'i 'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba

ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ ga ga na bi krān+ta gā ma ni ma hā shud+dha na ye swā hā/ me tog gi'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ ha na ha na/ pa ra ma bi shud+dhe dharma na ya pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥswā hā/ zhal zas kyi'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā oṃ a pra ti hi to nad+ya ta/ da ma da ma/ sarba thā/ sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥswā hā/ dpa' bo spyan drang ba'i'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ pi shud+dha bi shud+dha/ sa kra swa bhā be ā na ya/ ma hā na ye swā hā/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan drang ba'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ bi shud+dha swā hā/ ha na ha na/ da ma da ma/ ma hā na ye swā hā/ nyan thos spyan drang ba'i 'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ badz+rā kar+ṣa ya/ shīgh+raṃ/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ ma hā pa ri wā ra swā hā/ pho nya pho mo spyan drang ba'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ ma thā ma thā/ ā na ya ā na ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba de baṃ ta ma ta ma/ ma hā na ya pa ri wā ri hūṃ swā hā/ 'jig rten pa rnams spyan drang ba'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ sa t+ya sa t+ya/ ma hā sā dh+ya ya/ da ma da ma/ ma hā da ma/ ā kar+ṣa ya ā kar+ṣa ya/ a d+ya ba ma hā na ya shud+dhe swā hā/ drang srong spyan drang ba'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ dza ya dza ya/ bi dza ya bi dza ya/ ma hā sa t+ya pa di ni/ sarba hī te swā hā/ sring mo rnams spyan drang ba'o/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ hri hā dā/ ma tha ma tha/ da ma da ma/ ha na ha na/ ma hā na ye/ ma ra ma ra/ ha swā hā/ ma mo rnams spyan drang ba'o/ /na maḥsarbā pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ ha na badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭa gra haṃ/ ma tha ma tha/ bhañdza bhañdza/ sarba gigh+nāṃ/ da ma da ma/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ oṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ rkang stabs tsham ngam gyi sngags so/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/

sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ā kā sha ga ga na s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ 'o thug khur ba 'bru sna tshogs/ /spos dang me tog la sogs pa/ /ci 'byor 'byor pa'i gtor ma ni/ /sngags des spro zhing spel bar bya/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ swa bhā ba sarba thā bh+yo bāṃ swā hā/ na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ lan+dhe sarba ga ga na lab+dha ya swā hā/ na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ oṃ sarba sidhi dwā dha mi haṃ swā hā/ byin brlabs bzhin du bsgyur ba dang / /kun gyis thim par bya ba dang / /'dod pa'i las rnams gang dang gang / /grub par bya ba'i sngags yin no/ /gza' chen brgyad dang rgyu skar dang / /nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnams kyi sngags/ /na maḥsarbā sa pa ri pū ra ke bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā/ ā di d+ya/ so ma/ aṃ gā raḥbudhaḥbṛ haspa ti/ shu kraḥ/ sha naish+tsa raḥ/ rā huḥ/ ke tuḥ/ kṛt+ti kā/ rau hi ṇī/ mṛ ga shi rā/ ar dra pu na rba su/ puṣ+ya/ a sh+le ṣā/ ma ghā purbā phalgu nī ut+ta ra phalgu ṇī/ hastā/ tsi trā swa sti/ bi shā khā/ a nu rā dhā/ dz+yeṣ+ṭha mū la/ pūr+pā ṣā ḍhā/ ut+ta rā ṣā ḍhā shra ba ṇā a bhi dzi ta/ shata bhi ṣā/ dha niṣ+ṭha/ pūrba bha dra pa dā/ ut+ta ra bha drā/ rai ba tī/ a shwa nī/ bha ra nī/ oṃ dang swā hār bcas pa ni/ /rang rang snying po'i sngags yin te/ /gang 'dod las kyang sbyar bar bya/ /mchod pa'i rigs kyang tha dad bya/ /na maḥs man+ta kā ya bāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ oṃ a tsa la ka ṇa tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa s+pho ṭa ya tra ka kha haṃ maṃ/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya bāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ka pa tsa duṃ baṃ/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ sarba bha ya bi ga te bh+yaḥ/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba thā khaṃ rak+ṣa/ ma hā ba li/ sarba ta thā ga te pu ṇ+ya ni rdza te hūṃ hūṃ tra thā a pra ti ha te swā hā/ khro bo spyan gcig drag shul can/ /srung dang bcas par mchod pa dang / /sngags bzlas dngos grub blangs pas 'grub/ /ci 'dod las la cho gas sbyar/ /lag g.yas gung mdzub gshibs te brkyang / /srin lag mthe chung mthe bos mnan/ /shugs drangs tshul phyung

mkha' la 'phyar/ /ral gri phyag rgyas bdud tshogs 'joms/ /g.yon pa khu tshur sdigs mdzub bsgreng / /slar bsgyur byed pa zhags pa'i rgya/ /gung mo mthe'u chung so sor sprad/ /mdzub mo ming med nang du dgug /mthe bo gshibs pa gung 'gram sbyar/ /snying ga bkod de go cha'i rgyan/ /sor 'khyud khu tshur nang du bsdam/ /mtheb gnyis cung bsgyur mgo thod rgya/ /g.yon pa'i khu tshur mthe ba ni/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur nang bcug nas/ /mthe bong g.yas bsgreng tho ba'i rgya/ /phyogs bcur brdungs pa ltar bya'o/ /g.yas pa khu tshur gung mo bsgreng / /spyi gtsug phyag rgya gtsug tu bzhag /g.yon pa khu tshur gung mdzub bsgreng / /bka' rtags phyag rgya rtag tu phyar/ /khu tshur gnyis gshibs lto sbyar ba/ /rdo ba lta bu'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa'i khu tshur snying gar bzhag /snying ga brgyan pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag gnyis sor mo so sor brkyang / /phyogs bcu bcing ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag sbyar gung gnyis nang bcug pa/ /dri yi phyag rgyar bshad pa'o/ /khu tshur rgyab sprad gung mthe bong / /mthe bong gung mdzub sprad dang 'khyud/ /gtor ma sbyin pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo khong stong shubs ltar gdon/ /bdug spos 'bul ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag gnyis so sor gung srin bkug /mtheb mnan bzhag brkyang me tog rgya/ /thal sbyar gung srin mdzub mo bkug /mthe'u chung mtheb brkyang zhal zas rgya/ /skyil krung 'dug ste snyim pa zed/ /mthe bo gnyis ni nang du bkug /sor gshibs nas g.yab byed pa ni/ /dpa' bo gtso bo spyan drang rgya/ /thal sbyar mdzub bkug mthe bos mnan/ /byang chub sems tshogs 'gugs pa'i rgya/ /snyim bskyed mthe'u chung gshibs te brkyang / /lhag ma brgyad pa so sor dgug /nyan thos rang rgyal rdzu 'phrul can/ /ma lus thams cad 'gugs pa'i rgya/ /khu tshur g.yas pa g.yon steng bzhag /mdzub gnyis brkyang ste so sor dgug /cung zad skyed par byed pa ni/ /pho nya pho mo 'gugs pa'i rgya/ /khu
