phyin pa yang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dga' bo khyod kyis 'di'i rjes su chos bzhin yid la byas te/ sems can thams cad kyis mthong zhing thos par bya ba'i phyir yongs su rgyas par ston cig dang / bsod nams tshad med pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /yi dgas kha nas me 'bar ba la skyabs mdzad pa'i gzungs rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /yi dgas mo kha 'bar ma dbugs dbyung ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das yul ser skya na shing n+ya gro dha'i kun dga' ra ba na dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po dang / sems can gyi tshogs chen po dang / thabs cig tu bzhugs te chos ston to/ /de nas kun dga' bo dben par 'dug ste/ nang du yang dag 'jog cing rtse gcig tu yid la byed pas chos mngon sum du byed pa na/ mtshan mo nam gyi cha smad la de'i mdun du yi dgas mo kha 'bar ma 'dug nas smras pa/ kye kun dga' bo khyod gnangs 'chi bar 'gyur te/ yi dgas kyi gnas 'dir skye bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bos smras pa/ brten pa'i thabs ci yod/ yi dgas mos smras pa/ kun dga' bo gal te nang par yi dgas gang gā'i klu bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum gyi bye ma snyed dag la yi dgas re re la yang zas dang skom yul ma ga dhā'i bre bo che bdun bdun tsam byin te/ bram ze'i drang srong 'bum yang tshim par byas la/ bdag gi ming gis dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa byas na/ de lta na khyod kyi tshe yang phyir nur bar 'gyur la/ bdag kyang yi dgas kyi 'jig rten nas shi 'phos te mtho ris kyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas kun dga' bos yi dgas mo kha 'bar ma rid cing mdog ngan la lus skem pa/ kha nas me lce 'bar ba/ lto dang kha skom pa/ ral ba'i phung po g.yengs pa/ spu dang sen mo ring ba mthong ste/ tshig mi snyan cing yid du mi 'ong ba de thos nas/ skrag cing dngangs te/ spu zing zhes

byed nas/ stan las langs te shin tu rings pa dang / shin tu myur ba'i shugs kyis/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ 'dar bzhin du 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das skyabs mdzad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa skyabs mdzad du gsol/ bdag ni gnangs srog 'gum par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis yi dgas mo kha 'bar ma mthong ste/ khyod gnangs 'chi bar 'gyur ro zhes mchi na/ bdag gis thabs ci mchis zhes smras na/ de'i mchid nas gal te khyod kyis yi dgas gang gā'i klung bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum gyi bye ma snyed dag tshim par byas te/ bram ze'i drang srong 'bum yang tshim par byas na/ de lta na khyod kyi tshe phyir nur bar 'gyur ro zhes mchi na/ bcom ldan 'das de la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi ba bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo gang gis khyod yi dgas rnams dang / bram ze'i drang srong rnams tshim par byed par 'gyur ba'i thabs yod kyis ma 'jigs shig /kun dga' bo thams cad du 'od dang ldan pa rgyal chen shugs ldan 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs yod de/ des byin pa tsam gyis yi dgas gang gā'i klung bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum gyi bye ma snyed dag tshim par byas par 'gyur te/ yi dgas dang / bram ze'i drang srong re re la zas dang skom yul ma ga dhā'i bre bo bdun bdun byin par 'gyur ro/ /de ni nga sngon bram zer gyur pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug 'od las ngas bzung ste/ des yi dgas dang bram ze'i drang srong grangs su bgrang ba mang ba dang / ches mang ba dag ngas zas dang skom gyis tshim par byas te/ de dag thams cad yi dgas kyi 'jig rten nas

shi 'phos nas lha'i 'jig rten du skyes so/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis zung la ngo lon gyis shig /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ kun dga' bo 'dis yi dgas kyi gtor ma la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas nas lag pa brkyangs te sgo drung du sbyin par bya'o/ /se gol yang brdab par bya'o/ /de ltar byas nas byin ma thag tu phyogs bzhi'i yi dgas gang gā'i klung bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag gi bye ma snyed dag tshim par byas par 'gyur te/ yi dgas re re la yang yul ma gadhā'i bre bo bdun bdun byin par 'gyur ro/ /de dag zos pa tsam gyis yi dgas kyi 'jig rten nas shi 'phos nas lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams la rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bor zug tu bsnyad par bya'o/ /de ltar byas na bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par 'gyur te/ tshe yang ring bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba phrag 'bum gyi bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu mi ma yin pa rgyu ba 'byung po dang / sha za dang / grul bum la sogs pa dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / gdon dang / yi dgas rnams kyis mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs dang / brtson 'grus dang yang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gzugs dang ldan pa dang / gzi brjid dang ldan pa dang / dran pa dang ldan par yang 'gyur ro/ /bram ze'i drang srong tshim par byed 'dod pa des ni mchod yon dang / dbul bar bya ba dang / snod bkang ba la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas la 'bab chu ga la yod pa'i gnas der sbyin par bya'o/ /de ltar byas nas bram ze'i drang srong gang gā'i klung bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma'i bye ma snyed dag lha'i bza' ba dang / btung ba rnams kyis tshim par byas par 'gyur ro/ /bram ze'i drang srong de dag kyang dbang po tshim par 'gyur te/ de dag thams cad kyis oṃ bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba'i sgra 'byin

par byed la/ sems can de dag kyang bsam pa yongs su dag par 'gyur te/ bram ze'i gzi brjid dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu tshangs par spyod par yang 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang gā'i klung bye ba khrag khrig phrag 'bum gyi bye ma snyed dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan par yang 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu dgra thams cad shig par 'gyur ro/ /me tog gam/ bdug pa'am/ spos sam/ zas dang / skom gyi yo byad la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas brjod byas la/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la dbul bar bya'o/ /de ltar byas na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen ma des phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la lha'i mchod pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa'i mchog gis mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /bla mar byas/ ri mor byas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dgongs shing lung bstan pa dang / lha thams cad kyis kun du bsrung bar yang 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo song la ngo lon yang gyis shig /sems can thams cad la yang yang dag par ston cig /dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs thams cad kyang gyis shig ces nga smra'o/ /yi dgas mo kha 'bar ma dbugs dbyung ba'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /bod skad du/ 'jur 'gegs zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ser sna las cher lhag pa/ gzhan gyi la 'jur 'gegs byas pa'i nyes pa'i 'bras bu 'di lta ste/ 'phags pa shwa ri'i bu dang / 'phags pa maud gal gyi bu gnyis bas mtha' cig na/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab yid la byed cing yod pa las/ nyi ma'i gung la gnyis pos khams seng du mchis pa'i sa na yi dgas mo lus sngo la skam pa/ khog khog zer ba/ skra 'dzings pa/ mig dmar

la g.yon du yo ba/ ma mchu ring la g.yas su yo ba/ ske dang rkang lag shin tu phra la rid ba/ lag pa khu tshur bsdams pa'i sen mos thad kar phug nas sen mo sngo zang nge yod pa/ kha nas sgra rnam pa lnga sgrogs pa ni 'di lta ste/ dgos na zhes bya ba dang / med na zhes bya ba dang / ma sbyin cig zhes bya ba dang / ster na yang mche ches par 'ong ngo zhes bya ba dang / de tsam ches kyis phril byin zhes bya ba dang lnga brjod pa/ skyi zing byed pa cig dang phrad pa las/ der gang zag gnyis po des bsams pa/ dgon pa bas grong yul thag nye la zas mod pas grong khyer du phyin te bslangs pas dkar gsum dang / mngar gsum dang / 'bras dang nas kyi zan la sogs pa bza' ba dang / btung ba mang du rnyed nas yi dgas kyi drung du khyer te phyin nas bstabs pas mi len par gong gi sgra rnam pa lnga sgrogs shing bros so/ /der gang zag gnyis po des shin tu ma dga' nas/ yi dgas mo de'i sems su song nas gzhan yid la ma dran te/ bcom ldan 'das 'od ma'i tshal na bzhugs pa can du de ma thag phyin te/ zhabs la phyag 'tshal bas 'khangs nas thang chad de dri ba ma spobs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyed ci nyes/ dri ba yod na dbugs phyung la dris shig /ces gsungs so/ bcom ldan 'das lags bdag cag ni shin tu ma dga' ste/ nyid la khong yus che nas 'khams pa lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ ci las gyur/ smras pa/ bdag cag gnyis ni bas mtha' zhig na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas gsungs pa so sor rtog pa yid la byed pa las rgyang ring por 'chag tu phyin pa las yi dgas mo lus po sngo la skam pa/ khog khog zer ba/ skra 'dzings pa/ mig dmar la g.yon du yo ba/ ma mchu ring la g.yas su yo ba/ ske dang rkang lag shin tu phra la rid pa/ lag pas khu tshur bsdams pa'i sen mos thad kar phug nas sngo zang nge ba/ kha nas sgra rnam pa lnga sgrogs pa 'di lta ste/ dgos na zhes bya

ba dang / med na zhes bya ba dang / ma byin cig ces bya ba dang / ster na yang mche ches par 'ong ngo zhes bya ba dang / de tsam ches kyis phril byin zhes bya ba dang lnga brjod pa/ skyi zing byed pa cig dang phrad nas/ bdag cag gnyis kyis bsams pas dgon pa bas grong yul thag nye la zas mod pas grong khyer du phyin te bslangs pas dkar gsum dang / mngar gsum dang / 'bras dang / nas kyi zan la sogs pa bza' ba dang btung ba mang du rnyed nas yi dgas mo de'i drung du khyer nas bstabs pas/ kha nas gong gi sgra rnam pa lnga brjod cing gang byin pa mi len par bros te thal na 'di ci las gyur pa dang / 'di la sman pa'i thabs ci mchis zhu ru mchis pa lags so/ /bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag de ni shin tu legs so/ /ngas bshad kyis legs par nyon la yid la zung shig /de ci las gyur na lus sngo la skams pa ni rang gis za ma phod pa las gyur pa'o/ /ske phra ba ni gzhan za zhing spyod pa la bdag gis ser sna byas pa las gyur to/ /yan lag phra la sor mos thad kar phug pa ni gzhan la sbyin pa dag la ches kyis phri la byin ces byas pa dang / rang gis kyang spyod mi phod pa las gyur to/ /skra 'dzings pa ni kun gyi yid du mi 'ong ba byas pa las gyur to/ /mig dmar ba ni 'dod chags kyis yongs su rgyas pa las gyur to/ /g.yon du yo ba ni mig mi legs par gzhan la bltas pa las gyur to/ /ma mchu ring la g.yas su yo ba ni ster na yang ches par 'ong ngo zhes byas pa las gyur to/ /kha nas sgra rnam pa lnga sgrogs pa ni byed pa rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu ste/ sngon brjod pa'i bag chags brtas pa las gyur to/ /de lta bu'i las kyi dbang gis gzhan ci byin yang phan par mi 'gyur te/ chu gcig pu las rang gis sbyin nus pa ma yin te/ gzhan gyi chu la 'jur 'gegs ma byas pas da lta yang chu gtsang ma rtsam pas ma reg pa la sngags lan cig btab ste/ se gol lan cig gtogs te byin na de'i rgyud grol zhing 'dod pa tshim par 'gyur ro/ /de 'di lta ste/ oṃ dz+wa la mi daṃ sarba

pre ta bh+yaḥswā hā/ gsol pa/ de'i 'bru don bshad du gsol/ bka' stsal pa/ oṃ ni ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin te don dam pa'o/ /dz+wa la 'dod pa me ltar 'bar ba'o/ /mi daṃ ni mi'i rgyud kyis ser sna dang 'jur 'gegs byas pa'o/ /sarba ni de lta bu'i las las gyur pa thams cad do/ /pre ta ni yi dgas kyi snying po ste/ las kyi rgyud smin pa'i don to/ /bh+yaḥni las dang sdug bsngal byang bar bya ba'i don to/ /swā hā ni las dang sdug bsngal bkres skom byang bar gyur cig pa'o/ /da myur du song la de ltar gsos cig ces gsungs pas/ de nas de gnyis kyis myur du phyin nas de bzhin du bgyis pas gzod dga' nas longs spyod cing lus bag rlan no/ /de nas chos ston la bab nas gnyis po re mos byas te/ shā ri'i bus bshos gsol nas/ gcig gsol du stsal te/ chab byin pas yang gong bzhin brjod de bros so/ /yang gnyis kyis yid ma ches nas bcom ldan 'das la zhur mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das lags/ bdag cag gis gsungs pa bzhin bgyis lags pas/ gso ru gtub par gda' ba la chos ston yol du dogs nas 'tshal nas yang sngar bzhin brjod cing bros nas yang zhu ru mchis so/ /bka' stsal pa/ de ni khyod kyi san bar du rtsam pa las pas lan pa yin gyis/ lag pa khrus la gzod byin cig /de'i drung du 'gro mi dgos te 'di nyid kyis btub po zhes gsungs so/ /de gnyis kyis khrus bgyis te/ chu sbyin stsal bas yi dgas mo de nyid du 'ongs nas cung zad na mdangs dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di lta bu'i chu sbyin 'di ni 'dir ma zad de dus thams cad du yang yi dam du gyis la thong shig /gzhan la yang rgya cher spel cig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di'i phan yon ni dpag tu med de tshad las 'das so/ /mdo tsam brjod na 'di lta ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mi phyug po rnams la sbyin pa byas pa bas dbul po 'ga' zhig la sbyin pa byas na de'i bsod nams brgya'i char yang mi nye ste/ de ci ste zhe na/ phyug po rnams ni nga rgyal te dregs pa dang rgyags pas gnas ngan

len spro bar byed do/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi dbul po rnams la sbyin pa byas pa bas yi dgas 'ga' zhig la sbyin pa byas na de'i bsod nams brgya'i char yang mi nye'o/ /de ci ste zhe na/ dbul po rnams la ni 'bad du yod/ btsal du yod/ bslang du yod do/ /yi dgas las kyis de lta bu dag ma yin gyi/ ma bsngos na kha ru chud kyang dug chen por 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi yi dgas la sbyin pa byin pa bas 'jur 'gegs kyi yi dgas gcig la chu byin na de'i bsod nams brgya'i char yang mi nye'o/ /de ci ste zhe na/ yi dgas de dag la ni dmigs pas tshim pa dang / bshams pas tshim pa dang / bsngos pas tshim pa dang / reg pas tshim pa dang / rjes kyis tshim pa dang / bshal bas tshim pa yang yod de/ las kyi rim pa bzhin no/ /'jur 'gegs ni gzhan bkag pa'i las kyis sngags dang / phyag rgya dang / dmigs pa gzhan gyis mi thob/ rdzas thams cad la 'thams te bkag pas rdzas gzhan mi myong / gzhan gyi chu gcig pu ma bkag pas/ chu gtsang rtsam pas ma reg pa las dbang med/ rang gi rgyud zhi bar byed pa'i sngags dang / phyag rgya se gol gcig min pa gzhan gang gis kyang thub par mi nus so/ /se gol gcig tu bzhag pa ci zhe na/ gnyis su gyur na gzhan gyi sgrar gyur nas mi thob des na rang gi go ba bskyed pa sgra gcig tu nges pa'o/ /'dis ni bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa dang / nad nyung ba dang / tshe ring ba dang / longs spyod dang ldan pa dang / yi ga 'chus pa rnams 'byed par byed pa dang / mdangs nyams pa rnams gsal bar byed pa dang / 'di gzhan la spel na rgyud grol nas yi dgas kyi rgyud chad de mthar mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ rigs kyi bu de dag gis bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'jur 'gegs zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //zhu chen gyi lo ts+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur te gtan la phab pa// ༄༅/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /

oṃ dz+nyā nā ba lo ki te sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bha ba sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya dza la ni hūṃ/ 'bab chu'am/ mtsho'i 'gram du 'dug ste/ lag pa g.yas pa'i khyor bar chu blugs la/ ye shes skar mda'i snying po 'di lan bdun bzlas te/ chu khyor ba bdun 'bab chu'am/ chur gtor na sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs pa'i yi dgas ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad lha'i kha zas kyi ro dang / btung ba'i ro mchog dang ldan pa 'thob cing yi dgas re re la yang kha zas dang / btung ba yul ma ga dhā'i bre bdun bdun gyis tshim par byas par 'gyur zhing / chu de 'thungs pa tsam gyis de dag thams cad yi dgas kyi skye gnas las thar cing / bde 'gro mtho ris kyi skye gnas su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ khye'u'am/ bu mo'am/ gzhan yang byol song gi skye gnas su gtogs pa'i ri dgas sam/ bya'am/ chu na gnas pa la sogs pa gang gis chu de 'thungs pa de dag thams cad sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing bde 'gro'i lam du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /ye shes skar mda'i snying po rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ pradz+nyā bar+dha nī nā ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ shes rab skyed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ na mo rat+na tra yā la/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bi ba bi ba/ pradz+nyā bar+dha ni/ dza ra dza ra/ me dhā bar+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bud+dhi bar+dha ni swā hā/ rig sngags 'di'i cho ga ni 'di yin te/ nang re zhing rtsab mo khyor gang la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te/ zla ba gcig gi bar du 'thungs na thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab skyed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyā na gar+bha dang / lo ts+tsha ba ban+de klu'i dbang pos bsgyur/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po bid+yā ka ra sing ha dang / zhu chen gyi lo ts+tsha ba ban+de de ba tsan+d+ras zhus te gtan la phab pa// ༄༅/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa

spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ta d+ya thā/ smṛ ti ma ti ma ti/ te dza bid+yā/ hu ru me hu ru hu ru me kṛṣ+ṇa ha ru me swā hā/ shu dag nag po la sngags 'di lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas te zos na gdon mi za bar thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs rdzogs so// ༄༅/ /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgyal ba'i bla mas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba'i bla ma'i gzungs sngags kyi gzhi 'di gang gis bzung bas chos thams cad bzung ba dang bcas par 'gyur ro/ /mi khom pa brgyad las 'das par 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs thams cad du yang gnod sbyin de la bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar byed la de la nad thams cad kyis 'jigs pa med do/ /s+yād+ya the daṃ/ bud+dhe bud+dhe/ dza yot+ta ra/ bo dha ni bo dha ni/ saṃ bo dha ni/ ma hā saṃ bo dha ni/ a dhi sam+bodha ni/ ha la ha la ha la/ hi li hi li hi li/ hu lu hu lu hu lu/ sarba bud+dha/ dharmā ba bo dhi ni/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ sarba pā pa ni/ bud+dha/ adhiṣ+ṭhā ni na swā hā/ 'phags pa rgyal ba'i bla ma'i gzungs rdzogs so// ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā sa mā dza sū tra na nā ma hā sū tra/ bod skad du/ mdo chen po 'dus pa chen po'i mdo zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das shākya rnams kyi ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal na/ dge slong lnga brgya thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba sha stag dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun la mya ngan las 'das pa dang ldan pa'i chos kyi gtam ston par

mdzad de/ de'i tshe na phyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams dag nas/ dbang che bar grags pa dbang che bar grags pa'i lha dag lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed do/ /de nas tshangs ris kyi lha tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gnas pa bzhi zhig 'di snyam du sems te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de ni shākya rnams kyi ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal na/ dge slong lnga brgya thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa zag pa zad pa/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ bdag gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid par kun tu sbyor ba yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i shes pas sems shin tu rnam par grol ba sha stag dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun la mya ngan las 'das pa dang ldan pa'i chos kyi gtam ston par mdzad de/ de'i tshe na phyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams dag nas dbang che bar grags pa dbang che bar grags pa'i lha dag lhags nas bcom ldan 'das dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur byed kyis bdag cag kyang song la/ bcom ldan 'das la re re nas tshigs su bcad pas mngon par bstod par bya ba gor ma chag snyam mo/ /de nas tshangs ris kyi lha bzhi po dag 'di lta ste/ dper na skyes bu stobs dang ldan pas lag pa bskum pa las brkyang ba'am/ brkyang ba las bskum pa tsam gyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas mi snang bar gyur cing / bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lhags te phyogs gcig tu 'khod nas/ tshangs ris kyi lha gcig gis tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ 'dus pa che la gzhol ba yi/ /lha tshogs kun nas lhags gyur pas/ /gzhan gyis mi thub dge 'dun la/ /blta ba'i slad du bdag cag mchis/ /tshangs ris kyi lha gnyis pas tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ drang por gyur pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'di na dge sbyong rab brtson pa/ /kha lo pa ltar mig blangs shing / /dbang po rnams ni legs sdom bgyid/ /tshangs ris kyi lha gsum pas tshigs

su bcad de gsol pa/ dbang phur 'od pa 'obs 'dra ba'i/ /phur bu rab bcom bkrir mi tshugs/ /de dag sred bral dag spyod cing / /'dren pas glang po gzhon ltar btul/ /tshangs ris kyi lha bzhi pas tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ gang dag sangs rgyas skyabs mchi ba/ /de dag ngan 'gror mi mchi zhing / /mi lus spangs par gyur nas kyang / /lha yi lus ni thob par 'gyur/ /tshangs ris kyi lha bzhi po dag gis de skad ces gsol nas de nyid na bag bcum ste 'khod do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i 'khor thams cad la rnam par gzigs nas/ dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag kye ma lha rnams kyi 'dus pa 'di ni che ba yin no/ /dge slong dag kye ma lha rnams kyi 'dus pa 'di ni shin tu che ba yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang dag 'das pa'i dus na byung bar gyur ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la yang 'di lta ste/ dper na da ltar nga'i lha rnams kyi 'dus pa chen po 'di kho na lta bu dag 'dus par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang dag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag la yang 'di lta ste/ dper na da ltar nga'i lha rnams kyi 'dus pa chen po 'di kho na lta bu dag 'du ba gyur ro/ /dge slong dag lha rnams kyi ming dag brjod par byas/ lha rnams kyi ming dag zung shig /gang dag sa la gnas pa dang / /gang dag ri khrod gnas pa rnams/ /seng ge bzhin du tha dad la/ /sems bsdus mnyam par bzhag byas shing / /kun nas 'dus par gyur pa ni/ /spu dag zing zhes byed pa yin/ /gang dag sa la gnas ba dang / /gang dag ri khrod gnas pa rnams/ /seng ge bzhin du tha dad pa/ /sems bsdus mnyam par bzhag byas shing / /kun nas 'dus gyur spu zing zhes/ /byed pa bdag gis brjod par bya/ /yid byad dag cing rab dang la/ /rnyog med

'chi bdag spangs pa rnams/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten mthar thug pa'i/ /lha dang mi yi bar na 'khod/ /slob ma lnga brgya phrag gnyis dang / /gzhan yang brgya dang bcu dag dang / /stong phrag du ma rnams dag gi/ /lha rnams 'dus par gyur pa dag /mtha' nas mtha' ma mi mthong zhing / /phyogs rnams thams cad khyab gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni de mkhyen nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rnam gzigs te/ /de nas ston pas bstan dga' ba'i/ /nyan thos rnams la dge slong dag /lha tshogs mngon par lhags gyur kyis/ /nges par rtogs zhes bka' stsal pa/ /tshigs su bcad pas mthar chags kyis/ /de dag rnams kyi ming brjod kyi/ /rtse gcig gyur pa'i yid kyis ni/ /nga yis bshad pa mnyan par gyis/ /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal gyi/ /gnod sbyin stong phrag bdun po dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /gser can stong phrag drug po kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /shar phyogs rnam rgyal tshal gyi ni/ /ri mnyam stong phrag gsum po dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal

du mngon par zhugs/ /de ltar stong phrag bcu drug kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /gnod sbyin chu srin rgyal po'i khab/ /yangs pa la ni rtag gnas shing / /brgya stong phrag ni mang po yi/ /gnod sbyin bsnyen bkur byed pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /kun gyi bshes gnyen lda brgya dang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po kun gyi lha/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de gnyis kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /shar phyogs mngon par skyong byed pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /dri za'i bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni yul 'khor srung zhes bya/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /de la bu ni mang yod de/ /brgyad cu dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bya stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed par/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub par/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la

phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /lho phyogs mngon par skyong byed pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /grub bum bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni 'phags skyes po zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /de la bu ni mang yod de/ /brgyad cu dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed par/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog lngan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /nub phyogs mngon par skyong byed pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /klu yi bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni mig mi bzang zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /de la bu ni mang yod de/ /brgyad cu dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed par/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /byang phyogs mngon par skyong byed pa/ /rgyal chen grags

dang ldan pa ni/ /gnod sbyin bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni lus ngan po zhes bya/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /de la bu ni mang yod de/ /brgyad cu dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bya stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed par/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /dge dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung / /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang / /byang phyogs na ni lus ngan po/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhi dag /'jig rten skyong ba grags dang ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs po che/ /phyogs bzhi dag ni skyong bar byed/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /de dag gi ni khol po rnams/ /mchod rten mang la gnas bcas pa/ /slu byed g.yon can sgyu ma can/ /sgyu ma shes dang rnam shes dang / /ngan spong khro gnyer lhan cig tu/ /de tshe rdzu 'phrul ston cing lhags/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /gnod sbyin dang / gnod sbyin chen po dang / /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon dang / dmag

dpon 'di dag kyang der kun nas lhags te/ /'di lta ste/ dbang po zla ba chu lha dang / /bha ra dwa dza skye dgu'i bdag /dbang ldan tsan+da na 'dod gtso dang / /mgrin ngan dang ni mgul nges dang / /stobs ldan nor bu nor spyod dang / /sgra rab dang ni nye rnga dang / /ri mnyam gser can gang po dang / /seng ldeng pa dang g.yon can dang / /gnod sbyin ba skyong 'brog gnas dang / /rgyal ba'i khyu mchog mi rgyal po/ /dri za sna tshogs sde dang ni/ /lcags mdung ring dang ma ldan dang / /tshigs lnga ser po yid dga' dang / /gnod sbyin ring po 'khor dang bcas/ /'bras bu gsum dang mgul gsum pa/ /'gro gnas ji snyed yod pa yin/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mgon par zhugs/ /lhan cig 'byung ba'i klu dang ni/ /'jog po dang ni yangs pa'ang 'ongs/ /la ba dang ni mgyogs mchog dag /srung byed 'gro dang lhan cig lhags/ /klu bdag bran bzang bu dang ni/ /yul 'khor srung dang glang po che/ /'jigs byed che dang sa srung bu/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i klu yang 'ongs/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus ba'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /gang zhig klu rgyal zim mnan len/ /stobs ldan mig rnon 'dab chags bya/ /de ming 'dab bzang khra bo yang / /mkha' las tshal du mngon par 'ongs/ /de tshe klu rgyal mi 'jigs byin/ /ston pas 'das bzang bde mdzad cing / /gsung 'jam brjod pa de nyid la/ /sangs rgyas skyabs su nye bar song / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus

pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /lag na rdo rjes pham byas shing / /rgya mtshor rten pa'i lha min rnams/ /thams cad nor lhas sbag gyur cing / /mtsho la skyabs su 'du shes pa/ /thags bzangs ris dang rab bkra dang / /rab sim byed dang btang bzung dang / /stobs ldan bu ni brgyad po kun/ /rnam snang byed pa'i bu rnams dang / /stobs ldan sde dang sgra gcan bzang / /dpa' chen khyod kyi dus lags shes/ /dge slong 'dus pa'i nags tshal du/ /go cha bgos te lhags pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /chu lha mo dang bu mo dang / /zla ba mo yang phyi bzhin 'ongs/ /mdza' bshes ma dang chu lha can/ /lha mo grags ldan nyid kyang 'ongs/ /sa dang chu dang rlung gi dang / /me yi lha mo'ang 'ongs gyur te/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan bdag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /khyab 'jug lha dang gshol can lha/ /mtshem gnyis kyang lhags par gyur/ /zla la gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /zla ba nyid ni mdun du bdar/ /nyi la gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis/ /nyi ma nyid kyang mdun bdar cing / /char pa 'bebs par byed pa dag /rgyu skar rnams kyis mdun bdar lags/ /thams cad bzang po rdo rje can/ /brgya byin khyer 'jig 'ongs gyur te/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus

par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /lha mo tshogs can ma dang ni/ /me lce'i rtse 'dra 'chi ltas can/ /zhi ba mo dang dka' zlog ma/ /me tog gos can 'ongs gyur cing / /rgyu ba mo dang mtshan mchings bzang / /'chi med rnam pa du ma dang / /gang zhig phyogs su char 'bebs pa/ /'dod lha'i dbyangs can ma yang 'ongs/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dag / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing drag ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /sngo bsangs sngo bsangs chen mo dang / /mi 'dra mi 'dra dam pa dang / /rtsed mos myos dang de bzhin du/ /yid rab 'khrug ma'ang 'ongs gyur cing / /phag mo phag mo chen mo dang / /slong ma nges ma lhan cig lhags/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /dkar mo rgyags byed snying rje dang / /gos sngon mo yang 'ongs gyur cing / /skra dkar mo la sogs pa dang / /gos ser mo yang 'ongs par gyur/ /'phrog ma rtag tu myos pa dang / /spel ma rnam pa du mdar/ /dag pa dang ni 'od can ma/ /lha mo grags ldan rnams kyang lhags/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor

rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags//rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /bde byed dga' ldan 'thab bral dang / /nag po btab pa du ma dang / /lum bi ni dang lum bi mchog /skar ma zhes bya legs smon dang / /'phrul dga' rnams dang de bzhin du/ /dbang sgyur rnams kyang lhags par gyur/ /bcu tshan tshogs bcu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /lha tshogs drug cu de dag kun/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan pa dag /ser skya'i gnas kyi nags tshal ni/ /snang bar byas te 'khod pa dang / /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong dag gi/ /tshangs pa chen po zhes bya ba/ /kun 'ged gzhon nu skar rgyal de/ /so sor dbang sgyur dbang phyug bcu/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan pa de dag dang / /lhan cig 'grogs te der lhags pa/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de dag kyang ni 'dus par lhags/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /dbang sgyur byed pa'i 'phrog ma mo/ /kha dog gzugs mchog ldan pa yang / /bu rnams kyis ni yongs bskor cing / /de dag rnams kyi phyi bzhin 'ongs/ /gang dag de yi 'khor rnams dang / /de yang 'dus pa'i nang du 'ongs/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing

'od dang ldan/ /kha dog ldan zhing grags ldan rnams/ /dge slong rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing / /'dus pa'i tshal du mngon par zhugs/ /dbang por bcas dang dbang ldan bcas/ /skye dgu'i bdag dang bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams de dag der lhags shing / /dge slong rnams kyang der lhags so/ /nag pos smras pa'i tshig la ltos/ /'dod chags kyis ni 'di bzung la/ /bcing bgyis dang khyod la legs/ /'di dag kun nas yongs bsdus la/ /'di dag gson por ma btang zhes/ /de na nag po sde bo che/ /sde rnams la ni skul byed cing / /khros shing rang dbang ched gyur nas/ /rang yang mngon par zhugs gyur te/ /lag pas la brdabs nas ni/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i sgra phyung ste/ /de nas lha yis sprin phreng dang / /glog dang bcas pa'i char yang phab/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni de mkhyen nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rnam gzigs te/ /de nas ston pas bstan dga' ba'i/ /nyan thos rnams la dge slong dag /bdud sde mngon par lhags gyur gyis/ /mngon par rtogs zhes bka' stsal pa/ /brtson par byed pa de dag gis/ /sangs rgyas gsungs pa thos nas ni/ /de dag spu yang mi g.yo bas/ /de dag chags bral yin par rtogs/ /rgyal sras nyan thos de dag ni/ /slob ma rnams dang lhan cig dga'/ /de dag g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing / /'jigs bral grags dang ldan pa yin/ /bar gyi sdom ni/ bdun stong gser can ri mnyam dang / /de bzhin gnod sbyin chu srin dang / /kun gyi bshes dang rgyal po rnams/ /de bzhin khol po gnod sbyin dang / /klu dang 'dab bzang lha min dang / /chu lha mo dang khyab 'jug dang / /tshogs can ma dang sngo bsangs dang / /dkar mo bde byed dbang phyug dang / /kun 'ged gzhon dang 'phrog ma dang / /dbang bcas bdud dang dge slong ngo / /de nas gnas gtsang ma'i lha shin tu dbang che bar grags pa rnams mdo sde bstan pas yi rangs par gyur nas de'i tshe tshig 'di dag gis 'dus pa chen po'i mdo bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang

tshig 'di dag gis mdo sde 'di yang dag par bsnyad par bgyi zhing yang dag par brjod par bgyi lags so/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ /tad+ya thā/ te dze te dza ba ti/ tsi tre tsi tra ba ti/ la te la ta ba ti/ kha me kha ma ba ti/ k+ṣe me k+ṣa ma pa ti/ bha dre bha dra ba ti/ ya she ya sha ba ti/ dū te dū ta ba ti/ tsa pa le tsa pa la ba ti/ kha tse kha tsa ba ti/ bcom ldan 'das 'di dag ni gnas gtsang ma pa rnams kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig rnams lags te/ bcom ldan 'das gang zhig mdo sde 'di dang / gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag rmongs pa ma mchis par 'dzin par bgyid na/ de ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'byung po thams cad las bsrung ba bgyis par 'gyur lags so/ /'byung po thams cad kyang dga' bar 'gyur lags so/ /de la bro nad thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur lags so/ /gang du klog pa der dge bar 'gyur zhing de dag la dgung lo bdun du bsrung ba bgyis par yang 'gyur lags so/ /ji tsam 'tshal bar 'gyur ba de tsam gyis dgung char 'bab par yang 'gyur/ 'chad par yang 'gyur/ dgung ser 'beb par yang 'gyur/ 'chad par yang 'gyur lags so/ /bro nad thams cad la byab par bgyis sam/ chab la bzlas brjod bgyis te stsal na/ des de'i bro nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshangs pas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gnas gtsang ma pa dag ma gtogs pa gzugs na spyod pa'i lha'i ris gong ma rnams kyi rig sngags kyang 'di dag lags la/ gsang sngags kyi tshig zhib mo yang 'di dag lags so/ /'di ni 'dir mdo sde yongs su 'dzin par bgyid pa lags so/ /tad+ya thā/ bha le bha la ma le/ dur du le/ hi me/ phub pi se/ kā tsāk+ṣi ku tse si/ ma mī ṇi ṣe re tho ra ṇī/ bam pi bam po ṭi ste ke/ ta ra ke/ gu ru ga ro ṭe/ gug gu mi ti/ tā re rak+ṣa/ sū tra ma nu pā la ya thā/ 'di ni bdag cag gi rig sngags kyi cho ga zhib mo lags te/ gang la la zhig mdo sde 'di dang gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag dum bur

ma gyur par 'dzin tam/ klog par bgyid na de la mi dang / mi ma lags pa dag mchi bar mi 'gyur zhing gdug pa yang mi mchi/ sbrul yang mi mchi/ dug kyang mi mchi la/ de'i lus la gnod pa dag gis mi tshugs par 'gyur lags so/ /'byung po thams cad kyang dga' bar 'gyur lags so/ /ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'byung po thams cad las bsrung ba bgyis par yang 'gyur lags so/ /gang klog par bgyid pa dang / gang nyan par bgyid pa de la dgung lo bdun du bsrung ba bgyis par 'gyur lags so/ /chab la bzlas brjod bgyis te gtor tam/ 'tshal du stsal na de'i bro nad thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'dod pa'i bdag po thams cad kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag cag gi yul yang lags te/ mdo sde 'di yongs su gzung ba'i rig sngags ni 'di lags so/ /tad+ya thā/ lin+te li pe/ lo pe/ ba pe/ pad ke/ ka me/ kā tse kā tse k+ṣi/ kā tsa pi ga le/ du me du me/ ta ṭe tra ṭe/ ta da tra/ ṭetra ṭā k+ṣi/ go lā/ ko li/ ki ka ko li ke sā dhā/ sū tra ma nu pā la ya thā/ ud gṛh+ṇa ya tse ti/ bcom ldan 'das gang zhig gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag dang / mdo sde legs par gsungs pa 'di dum bur ma gyur ba dang / mnyams par bzung ste srung bar bgyid na de ni thams cad las bsrung ba bgyis par 'gyur lags so/ /'byung po thams cad kyang dga' bar 'gyur lags so/ /ji tsam 'tshal bar de tsam gyi dgung char 'beb par yang 'gyur/ 'chad par yang 'gyur/ dgung ser 'bab par yang 'gyur/ 'chad par yang 'gyur lags so/ /'byung po dang gdon rnams las yongs su thar bar yang 'gyur lags so/ /dug 'byin par yang 'gyur lags so/ /chab la lan bdun bzlas brjod bgyis te/ gtor tam 'tshal du stsal na des bro nad thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag

gi rig sngags 'di yang de bzhin du mdo sde 'di yongs su 'dzin par bgyid cing / 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha gong ma rnams kyis ni rjes su yi rang bar bgyis la/ 'og ma rnams kyis kyang legs par rjes su yi rang bar bgyis pa lags so/ /tad+ya thā/ bī re bī re ba ti/ to ṭe to ṭa ba ti/ bha dre bha dra ba ti/ go ne go na ba ti/ me ghe me gha ba ti/ dz+wa la ne dz+wa la na ba ti/ bhu ti bhu ta ba ti/ kho ra te kho ra ta pa ti/ i dan sū tra ma nu gṛh+ṇa ṭha/ a nu pā la ya tha tse ti/ bcom ldan 'das gang zhig mdo sde 'di dang gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag dum bur ma gyur par 'dzin par bgyid na de ji srid 'tsho'i bar du 'byung po thams cad las srung bar bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /de la mi dang mi ma lags pa 'ga' yang 'tshe bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /gang du klog pa der ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srung ba bgyid par 'gyur lags so/ /sems can thams cad kyang dga' bar 'gyur lags so/ /de la zil gyis gnon pa 'ga' yang 'byung bar mi 'gyur lags so/ /de yi lus la bro nad rnams kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur lags so/ /sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs par yang 'gyur lags so/ /gang du klog par 'gyur ba der dgung lo bdun du bsrung ba bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /'byung po dang gdon rnams las thar bar yang 'gyur lags so/ /dug 'joms par yang 'gyur lags so/ /bro nad thams cad sel bar yang 'gyur lags so/ /skud pa'am chab la bzlas brjod bgyis te bcings sam gtor na bro nad thams cad dang bral bar yang 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po chen po bzhis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi'i rig sngags 'di yang mdo sde 'di yongs su 'dzin cing grub par bgyid pa lags so/ /rnam thos kyi bus gsol pa/ tad+ya thā/ ku re ku ra ṇī/ mo re mo ra ṇī/ kā tse kā tsa nī/ kri mi kri mi ṇī/ yul 'khor srung gis gsol pa/ pu re po re/ pu ra tī/ ho re ho ra ṇī/ pra ho re pra ho ra ṇī/ 'phags skyes pos gsol pa/ ke she ke she

pa ti/ ke sha na/ mi ke sha/ ṭhe ti ṭhe ni ma ri ti/ mig mi bzang gis gsol pa/ tsakre tsakri ṇī/ tsakra ba gi ṇi/ bhi ti ri rmi ni/ shi mi shi mi/ shā ma ne ti/ bcom ldan 'das gang zhig rgyal po chen po bzhis brjod pa'i rig sngags kyi cho ga zhib mo 'di bzhi dang / mdo sde 'di dum bur ma gyur pa dang / ma bkol bar legs par bzung ste srung bar bgyid na/ de ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsrung ba bgyis par 'gyur lags so/ /de la 'byung po thams cad dang / bro nad thams cad kyang slar mi ldog par 'gyur lags so/ /gdug pas zin pa dang / dug thams cad las kyang thar bar 'gyur lags so/ /skud pa'am/ chab la bzlas brjod bgyis te/ bcings sam/ gtor cing 'tshal du stsal na/ cho ga des de la 'grub par 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la lha ma yin dang / rlung lhas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi rig sngags 'di yang yongs su 'dzin par bgyid pa lags so/ /tad+ya thā/ ga le/ ga ga ga le/ ga le ga ni/ khi ni khi ni/ ghu ṣe ghu ṣe ghu ghu ṣ+ya/ kha na kha kha ne/ kha na kha ni/ lu pe lu pi/ lu pa lu pi ti/ bcom ldan 'das gsang sngags 'di dag dang / mdo sde 'di dum bur ma gyur cing / ma bkol bar bzung na ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsrung bar 'gyur lags so/ /de'i bro nad thams cad kyang rab tu zhi bar 'gyur lags so/ /lus la dug gis mi tshugs par yang 'gyur lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mdo sde 'di'i dgongs pa yongs su gzung ba'i slad du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas lhags pa rnams kyis rig sngags dag smras pa lags na/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi tshogs dang bcas pas kyang yang dag par rjes su yi rang bar mdzad cing / kun tu gzung ba dang / bsrung ba dang / bsgrub pa dag legs par bshad du gsol/ de ltar na rigs kyi bu de dag gi sbyin par bgyi ba'i chos kyi mdo sde 'di 'bras bu dang bcas par 'gyur lags so/ /de nas

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyed kyis gsang sngags kun tu bzung ba 'di ni grub pa yin te/ nga nyan thos kyi tshogs dang bcas pas kyang mdo sde 'di'i grub pa dang / bsrung ba dang / bsgrub pa dag bshad par bya ste/ de nyon cig dang bshad par bya'o/ /gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin lags te/ bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi tshogs dang bcas pas mdo sde chen po 'di grub par bgyi ba'i slad du bsrung ba dang / bsgrub pa dag bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo sde 'di grub par bya ba'i phyir bsrung ba dang / bsgrub pa dag bka' stsal pa/ de la rgyun du zhugs pa rnams kyi grub pa ni 'di yin no/ /ta la ta la/ tan ta la/ ta to ta le me te/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams kyi grub pa ni 'di yin no/ /sa le sa sa li ti/ phyir mi 'ong ba rnams kyi grub pa ni 'di yin no/ /la te la te lo la te/ dgra bcom pa rnams kyi grub pa ni 'di yin no/ /dhu pu dhu pu/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ka tsi bi ka tsi/ ka tsa bi ka tse ti/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi grub pa ni 'di yin no/ /dha me dha me/ dha me dha me/ dha se dha se/ dha re dha re/ dha ro dhi dhi ti/ de la srung ba ni 'di yin no/ /ti na ti ri tsa ri ṣa/ piṅga la k+ṣi rak+ṣa/ mtshams bcad pa ni 'di yin no/ /bad+dha bad+dho ti/ bad+dha si ri mi ti/ bad+dha ku ṣe bad+dha/ ghu ghu ṣe bad+dha ghu ṣe ghu ṣe ya ma ba dha bhi/ sgrub pa ni 'di yin no/ /pe ṣe sā dha ya/ tu tu li sā dha ye ti/ zhag gsum smyung ba byas pas tshes bco lnga'i nyin par gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag dang / mdo sde 'dis bcom ldan 'das la mchod par byas te/ kha shar phyogs su bltas la srung ba lan brgya brjod par bya zhing / bzlas brjod lan brgya byas la/ mdud pa re re la brgya rtsa brgyad byas na bsrung ba byas pa yin zhing / lan gsum spu zing zhes byed par yang 'gyur te/ sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa ni ma gtogs so/ /zla ba yar gyi ngo'i tshes bcu gnyis la bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas la skud pa de lag tu blangs te bzlas shing mtshams gcad par byas te/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad brjod cing mdud pa brgya rtsa brgyad byas te/

mtshams gcod par byed na lan bdun spu zing zhes byed par yang 'gyur ro/ /lho phyogs nas ce spyang mos lan bsum sgra phyung ste 'dug par gyur na/ /de nas mtshams bcad par shes par bya'o/ /des de bzhin du smyur ba byas te/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin par khrus byas la/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas te/ skud pa blangs la/ nyan thos kyi tshig rnams dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi cho gzhi mos lan bdun bzlus te/ bzlas brjod lan rtsa brgyad brjod cing mdud pa brgya rtsa brgyad byas la/ skud pa lag tu blangs te/ rig sngags thams cad lan cig bzlas brjod byas shing sgrub pa byas na char pa chen po dang / rlung chen po yang 'byung ste/ mtshams kyi phyi rol du ldang zhing 'bab par 'gyur la/ skad cig gis 'chad par yang 'gyur te/ lan bdun gyi bar du yang brjod par bya'o/ /de nas lha'i bu sprin chen zhes bya ba dang / sprin bzang zhes bya ba gnyis 'ongs te/ de'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal zhing grub pa sbyin pa dang / rjes su yi rang bar yang 'gyur ro/ /de la grub pa ni 'di dag yin te/ sprin ni ku tsu ku tsa zhes bya'o/ /sprin bzang kyi ni 'di yin te/ ka ra ka ra kā ra ra zhes bya'o/ tshig 'di dag dang skud pa lag tu blangs pas mdo sde dang / gsang sngags rnams bsams na gang bya bar 'dod pa de dag thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo sde dang / rig sngags 'di dag thams cad kyis chu'am skud pa la bzlas na gang byed par mi 'gyur ba de med de las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bdag dang / gzhan dag bsrung ba'i phyir mdo sde 'di gzung bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur cing / /sa dang bar snang dag la 'khod pa rnams/ /skye dgu rnams la rtag tu byams byas cing / /nyin dang mtshan du chos kyang spyod gyur cig /mdo chen po 'dus pa chen po'i mdo zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /

pradz+nyā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dharma sā ga ra nā ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das bā rā ṇa sī na drang srong smra ba ri dgas kyi nags na dge slong lnga brgya tham pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa dang / dge slong de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la nyan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dge slong dag ngas ni chos zab mo mthong bar dka' ba/ rtogs par dka' ba/ cha phra ba/ brtags pa/ mkhas shing shes pas rig par bya ba rtogs so/ /ngas ni skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / skye bo phal po che'i don dang / lha dang / mi rnams la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ro/ /ngas thogs pa med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i phyir nges pa kho nar bsgrub par bya'o/ /dge slong dag chos kyi rgya mtsho'i gzungs zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dran pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ blo gros kyi blo dang ldan pa/ rtogs pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ brtan pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ shes rab kyi blo dang ldan pa/ gsung gi mchog dang ldan pa/ spobs pa mchog dang ldan pa/ mkhyen cing gzigs pa dag gis bstan cing bshad pa yod de/ gang dag de shes pa dang / gang dag de 'dzin pa de dag gis ni myur ba kho nar chos lnga thob par 'gyur ro/ /lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ thos pa 'dzin pa'i dran pa dang ldan bar 'gyur ba dang / brjed ngas pa med pa'i dran pa dang ldan zhing chos bzung ba rnams chud za bar mi 'gyur ba'i blo gros dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / rnon po thob pa'i rtogs pa

dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / yi ge dang don dang tshig la 'jug pa'i spobs pa thogs pa med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba dang / sems can rnams kyi rgyu'i lam mngon par shes nas sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa la mkhas par 'gyur ba ste/ chos lnga po 'di dag ni sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bzhag go/ /da ltar nga yang 'jog go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo chos thams cad kyi sdoms kyi gzhi bsdu ba khyod la bstan par bya ste/ des na khyod kyis ma thos pa'i chos rnams thos par 'gyur ro/ /thos pa'i chos rnams 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /gzung ba'i chos rnams ni nyams su len par 'gyur ro/ /nyams su blangs pa'i chos rnams ni gzhan dag la khong du chud par byed do/ /tshig gi rab tu dbye ba lnga ni 'di lta ste/ 'du byed kyi tshig gi rab tu dbye ba dang / de bzhin du ma thos pa'i chos kyi tshig gi rab tu dbye ba dang / bla na med pa'i tshig gi rab tu dbye ba dang / sa nas sa brtags pa'i yi ge'i tshig gi rab tu dbye ba dang / nges pa'i tshig dang brda sna tshogs kyi tshig gi rab tu dbye ba'o/ /de la 'di dag ni gzi byin rten par byed pa'i tshig rig sngags dang ldan pa ste/ gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / grul bum dang / yi dgas dang / sha za 'dzam bu'i gling du lhags pa thams cad kyis gang zag de la zas kyi sna grangs rnams dang / sman rnams sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig chos las byung ba gzhan dag la mi gnod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za rnams kyis mnos pa/ bstan pa yongs su 'dzin pa ni 'di dag yin te/ kun dga' bo gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag nyon cig /khyod phyis 'gyod ta re/ s+yād ya the da na/ karma ke ta ma nuts+tshe/ ra te ru ta gran dra ma/ thu ma na/ nai la ta/ a saṃ ku la s+thā/ bu mi a nu sma ri/ i shaṃ ga ma i sha s+thā/ kle na a nu ga te/ yā mu la gum bhe/ pa bhe ma gur ba ya ba/

a s+ya bākya s+ya bi laṃ ga/ be la ma tha/ shrī ba ba rī pañtsa ka/ pra sa te/ a ba be la/ a gra be la/ ni shi khu u tse dzu me/ u dze dzu me/ kun dga' bo 'di dag ni gnod sbyin gyi dbab pa grub pa dang / gnod sbyin gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung mthong ba la bsnyen bkur yang byed byed/ rim gro yang byed byed pa rnams 'ching ba ste/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis gnod sbyin dbab pa grub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa rnams zung shig /kun dga' bo gang la la gsang sngags kyi tshig skyon med pa'i tshig 'di dag 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / kun chub par byed pa de la ni rgyal po chen po bzhi sems bzhin du gnas so/ /kun dga' bo gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag bzung bas ni dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo shar gyi lus 'phags kyi gling na ni gnod sbyin srid pa snang byed ces bya ba gnas so/ /kun dga' bo nub kyi ba lang spyod kyi gling na ni gnod sbyin cher spyod ces bya ba gnas so/ /kun dga' bo byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling na ni gnod sbyin rnam grags zhes bya ba gnas so/ /kun dga' bo 'dzam bu'i gling na ni gnod sbyin grags thob ces bya ba gnas te/ /kun dga' bo gnod sbyin de dag gis kyang rjes su dran par 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo gnod sbyin gzhan gzi brjid za ba gang yin pa de dag kyang dad pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /dad pa thob par gyur nas kyang dad pa mi phyed par thob par bya ba'i phyir 'gro bar byed do/ /kun dga' bo de la 'di dag ni shes bzhin gyi tshig drang srong gis bstan pa dag yin te/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa drang srong gi mchog gi tshig gi mchog srog chags 'byung po thams cad la rnam par mi 'tshe ba'i tshig rnams zung shig dang ngas bshad do/ /kun dga' bo de la nga'i phyir na 'brang ba'i gnod sbyin gang yin pa de dag gis kyang bar chad byed mi nus so/ /s+yad ya the dan/ dan dha ra ma hā ha ra ha ra ma ba ra na/ rud dra tra/ ku ma ti dri tra/ in+d+ra

man tu ke/ a ba te/ sa ha rā/ sa dhu ma ti/ i la la ba ma ti/ a ba ti/ ta ra pa ra/ yi biṣ+ṭa/ sa da biṣ+ṭa/ a ba tiṣ+ṭha/ pa ri brta/ i sha brda/ sa da brta/ kra ma kra ma ti ran/ a si ba tsa ma la bi na ha thi/ ṭha sha su re/ dhu ra dhu ra/ uk+g+ra muk+g+ra/ uk+g+ra pa ti/ bi sa ra gra ma ti/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i gling bzhi pa chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gnod sbyin dang / 'byung po dang / grul bum dang / yi dgas dang / srul po dang / klu dang / dri za dang / sha za gnas pa gang yang rung ba de dag gis khyim gyi nang na gnas pa dang / lam du zhugs pa rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i tshig 'di dag thos nas dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di dag zung shig /phyis 'gyod ta re/ de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /gnod sbyin grub pa 'di dag ni/ /gling bzhi dag na gtso zhes bya/ /gsang sngags 'di dag su 'chang ba/ /de yi dran pa 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa yi/ /gnod sbyin de dag lhags nas ni/ /chos rgyal rnams kyis bstan pa dag /nyams par gyur pa de la ston/ /dpag tshad brgya phrag mang po yang / /mthar gyis su ni song nas kyang / /zab cing don dang ldan pa yi/ /tshig 'di dag ni mnyan par bya/ /'di dag chos kun rtsa ba ste/ /de dag mkhas rnams nyan par gyis/ /drag po dag gis thos na yang / /phyi nas mchog tu dga' ba ste/ /gang la bde dang sdug bsngal med/ /de la de ni dga' bar 'gyur/ /sa 'di chags pa med pa ste/ /sangs rgyas sa ni bsam mi khyab/ /chags pa med par bstan pa yi/ /bsam yas sa de thob gyur nas/ /nyi ma sprin las byung ba ltar/ /de nas sa steng de bzhin snang / /'di la skye mched phung po rnams/ /dben dang byang chub yan lag dbang / /dge ba'i chos ni zab mo rnams/ /sangs rgyas gsungs pa ci yang yod/ /de yi thos pa'i tshogs rnams gang / /nams kyang chud

zar mi 'gyur te/ /ma thos chos rnams de dag thos/ /nyes dang nyes min rnams la mkhas/ /rtogs par khong du chud pa'i mchog /mig bzad rnams kyang dag par 'gyur/ /'chang ba dang ni ston byed pa/ /de ni rtag tu sangs rgyas bsngags/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni chos rnams la/ /the tshom mi mnga' bden pa gang / /bden des bdag la lung mnos pa/ /ci yod thams cad gnas gyur cig /sangs rgyas rnams ni 'byung rnams la/ /byams pas gnas pa'i bden pa des/ /rang gi sems dang gzhan sems la/ /ston pa rab tu gnas gyur cig /gling bzhi'i gnas kyi gnod sbyin dag /ma dad pa dang dad pa bstan/ /gang la rtog pa mi snang ba/ /de la de kun don ston 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin skar gdong gang yin dang / /glang chen sna dang khyad par stobs/ /drag po dga' byed gsod byed dang / /zla ba mgo med lug gsod pa/ /dpa' sde dang ni lag dpa' dang / /srin po dang ni sa 'dzin pa/ /ljang gu kha dang rna bzang dang / /ral gri'i sdu can bong bu rnams/ /thams cad grub par byed par shog /gsang sngags 'di dag su 'dzin la/ /gnod sbyin srin po de dag ni/ /spro bar gyur nas 'dzud par byed/ /rtag tu de ni spobs pa dang / /tshig rnams dang ni lung bstan dang / /nges pa'i tshig dang chos kun dang / /yi ge rnams la mkhas par 'gyur/ /lung mnos pa yang chud mi za/ /rtogs pa mtha' yas 'phel bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu don dang yi ge la/ /de yi shes pa 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha rnams dang / /mi mjed bdag po tshangs pa yang / /de yi legs bshad nyan pa rnams/ /de yi mod la dran par byed/ /s+yād ya the dan/ hu ku na/ mu ku na/ ha ra ṇa/ bi ha ra ṇa/ i sha saṃ kra ma ṇa/ oṃ su mu kha/ ta ka ṇa/ a ga ṇa a pri ya/ u s+thā me/ ko ba ha re/ u ru pa/ pra ba ṇa tan/ saṃ pra me ba ha dza ga re/ pra shi ga re/ gu ḍha ba ne/ ut+ta na/ bi gu ṇa/ i sha ku na/ a tu la tu la/ aṃ ṭi ba ṭi/ ba ri tsa mo sha/ ha ra dza ga ta/ e ba

saṃ pra mu khe/ a ga ba re/ ṭha hu sa hu/ i ti ya/ thā hu/ tsa tur dwī pi ka yan/ ṭha hu ma hu/ uk+g+ra hu/ dhā ra sa hu/ saṃ gra ha/ a bi na gra ha/ a bi na gra ha/ pradz+nyā bṛd dha ye/ ṭha hu sa hu/ ka ra ku ru/ dha sa hu/ de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ /gsang sngags kyi ni tshig 'di dag /gang gis lag dang lus la yod/ /de ni thos la rmongs pa med/ /de ni shes rab med mi 'gyur/ /skar mda' ji bzhin nyi ma bzhin/ /zla ba ji ltar snang ba bzhin/ /de ltar thos dang don gyis kyang / /mya ngan 'das pa'i bar la reg /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe gsang sngags 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /s+yād ya the dan/ tsa ra dhe bi tsa ra dhe/ a maṃ ku te/ a ti mi ti/ pa ra ha re/ gha ṇa bhe/ hi bar me/ ma hā pra ti bā hā ne/ dza ya dza ya/ a nu ke/ pa la pa le/ uk+g+ra ba ti/ swa ra swa ra/ a bi sa re/ gu gun de/ pra bi bar+dhe/ sa me/ a dzi te dza ye/ nu pa le su/ khom su san dhi ni ku ma no/ /sak+ṣe/ tsā pi tsā pe/ tsu pe/ tsu lu tsu lu/ pu lu pu lu/ bya ba pra sa re/ ka ra ka bhin dhe/ bi dzā bi dze/ a pra ti san dhi/ nā nā nu ma ti/ pra na nu ma ti/ a ri da si/ dzeṣ+ṭha nu pa ni de/ a saṃ gra a ba ti/ rig sngags bsdus pa'i gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag lus la thogs te 'chang na/ gling bzhi pa chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / grul bum dang / yi dgas dang / sha za gnas pa de dag thams cad dbang du 'gyur zhing / dbang du ma gyur pa rnams kyang dbang du 'gyur ro/ /don thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pas gnang ba bzhin du 'tsho ba'i mthar thug gi bar du 'chi bar mi 'gyur/ med par mi 'gyur ro/ /de la cho ga ni 'di yin te/ dgon par 'dug la gzungs sngags 'di dag thams cad zhag bdun gyi bar du brjod de/ nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du dran par bya'o/ /de nas zhag bdun lon pa'i 'og tu bsam pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/

bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhi dang / pradz+nyā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban+de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya bigh+na bi nā ya kā ra tā dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa bgegs sel ba'i gzungs/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ dga' bo tshogs kyi bdag po su gang tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po 'dzin pa des cho ga thams cad dang dgongs pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /tad+ya thā/ na mo stu te/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ da ra da ra/ ḍa ha ḍa ha/ grih+ṇa/ bhañdza bhañdza/ na mo stu te/ ru ru tsa tsa ye swā hā/ a bhu trā/ bi na duḥkhan man tsed+dha pa ra sa ma gats+tsha ti/ ha ha ya/ ma hā ha stik+ṣa ta na na/ pra go ba ye mo/ /ku ru ku ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ na mo na maḥswā hā/ nang par langs te sngags lan bdun bzlas la/ chu khyor ba gang steng dang / 'og gi phyogs su gtor cig dang bgegs thams cad bcings par 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags sgrub 'dod pas skud pa dkar po la mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig por te/ lag pa la bcings na rig sngags 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bgegs thams cad bcings par 'gyur ro/ /gang na tshogs kyi bdag po snang ba der sngags 'di lan cig bklags na yang bgegs rnams par chad mi byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ 'khor de dag thams cad dga' ste/ lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /'phags pa bgegs sel ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //

gu gul ser po dang / pha bang gi rtug pa kun la rku ba'i rtag pa sbyar ba'i du bas gdugs na/ 'go ba'i nad pa'i gan du phyin yang mi tshugs/ gos pa la thug na myur du sel/ khyim du 'byung po gnod pa dag la rab tu bsngags so// //༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ā ṭā nā ṭī ya ma sū traṃ nā ma ma hā sū tra/ bod skad du/ mdo chen po kun tu rgyu ba dang / kun tu rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i mdo zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs so/ /de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu kha dog 'phags pa/ g.yog 'khor gnod sbyin du ma dang / g.yog 'khor gnod sbyin brgya phrag du ma dang / g.yog 'khor gnod sbyin stong phrag tu ma dang / g.yog 'khor gnod sbyin 'bum phrag du ma dang ldan pa nam sros pa dang / bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de'i tshe rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu'i kha dog gi mthus rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal thams cad snang ba chen pos gsal bar gyur to/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to/ /rkang gnyis dam pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /blo ldan khyod kyis gang mkhyen pa/ /lha rnams kyis ni de ma 'tshal/ /dpa' chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas gang dag 'das pa dang / /da ltar byung dang ma byon pa/ /thams cad la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /khyod la'ang bdag ni skyabs su mchis/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma gang dag gnas mal dgon pa dang / nags 'dab dag dang / bas mtha' dag na gnas pa dag kyang mchis la/ de la gnod sbyin dang / mi ma lags pa gdug pa gnyug mar gnas pa gang dag bcom ldan

'das kyi gsung rab la mngon par dad pa dag dang mngon par ma dad pa dag kyang mchis te/ gnod sbyin dang / mi ma lags pa gdug pa gnyug mar gnas pa gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab la mngon par dad pa de dag ni shin tu nyung la/ gnod sbyin dang / mi ma lags pa gdug pa gnyug mar gnas pa gang dag bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab la mngon par ma dad pa de dag ni ches mang lags te/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge slong rnams dang / dge slong ma rnams dang / dge bsnyen rnams dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams 'di ltar bdag nyid bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / bde ba la reg par gnas par bgyi ba dang / gnod sbyin dang / mi ma lags pa gdug pa gnyug mar gnas pa mngon par ma dad pa dag mngon par dad par bgyi ba dang / mngon par dad pa rnams kyang slar zhing 'phel bar bgyi ba'i slad du kun tu rgyu ba dang / kun tu rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher 'dzin cing / kun chub par bgyid na legs so legs so zhes gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bu la cang mi gsung bas gnang bar mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos kyi bus bcom ldan 'das kyis cang mi gsung bar gnang bar ri gnas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar kun tu rgyu ba dang kun tu rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher gsol to/ /skye bo gang dag gtong phod cing / /phra ma mi mchi ser sna bral/ /gang dag sangs rgyas skyabs mchis pas/ /mi de rnams kyis rnyed pa lags/ /gang gi 'char la brten nas ni/ /des na nyin mor brjod pa yi/ /nyi ma chen po'i dkyil 'khor can/ /nyi gdugags gang 'char 'gyur ba yi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags

dang ldan pa ni/ /dri za'i bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni yul 'khor srung zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /dri za rnams kyis yongs bskor cing / /dri za rnams kyis mdun gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /gau tam rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol mchi/ /de ltar shar gyi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes skye bo mchi/ /phyogs de mngon bar skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags/ /gang na yi dgas zhes bgyi ba/ /rgyab kyi sha 'tshal phra ma can/ /srog gcod bgyid pa ma rungs pa/ /'jungs shing mi snyan smra bgyid pa'i/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /grul bum bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni 'phags skyes po zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /grub bum rnams kyis yongs bskor cing / /grul bum rnams kyis mdun gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i

gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal pa/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /gau tam rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol mchi/ /de ltar lho yi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes skye bo mchi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags/ /gang zhig nub pa kho na las/ /des na mtshan mor brjod pa yi/ /nyi ma chen po dkyil 'khor can/ /nyi gdugs gang du nub 'gyur ba/ /de na mtsho chen zab mo ni/ /shin tu 'da' bar dka' ba ste/ /de ni chu sngon rgya mtsho zhes/ /skye bos rtogs pa mchis pa yi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /klu yi bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni mig mi bzang zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /klu rnams kyis ni yongs bskor cing / /klu rnams kyis ni mdun gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /gau tam

khyod la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol mchi/ /de ltar nub kyi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes skye bo mchi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid cing / /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags/ /gang na byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /dga' zhing lhun chen lta mdzes dang / /gang na mi rnams tshe lo ni/ /brgya phrag bcu pa skye 'gyur zhing / /de dag mi rmo mi 'debs la/ /gshol yang 'cha' par mi bgyid cing / /tshe ring mdog dang ldan pa dang / /nges par yongs su spyod bgyid cing / /zas su sā lu kha dog dang / /dri dang ro dang ldan pa dang / /dri bda' me tog tshogs 'dra zhing / /lha yi bdud rtsi 'dra ba 'tshal/ /na li ke ra bskol bgyis nas/ /tshod mar de 'tshal sran tshod min/ /gang na me lce'i rtse 'dra ba'i/ /sman dga' khrung bar 'gyur ba yi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa ni/ /gnod sbyin bdag po rgyal po ste/ /ming ni lus ngan po zhes bgyi/ /de ni nye du lhan cig tu/ /glu dang gar gyis rtag tu rtse/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis yongs bskor cing / /gnod sbyin rnams kyis mdun gyis bltas/ /de la bu ni mang mchis te/ /brgyad cu dang ni bcu dang gcig /de dag ming mthun grags pa ni/ /dbang po zhes bgyi stobs po che/ /lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed pa/ /kun tu gzhan gyis mi thub lags/ /de dag rnams kyis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen mthong nas/ /skyes bu cang shes khyod la 'dud/ /skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal zhes/ /mi yis phyag bgyis khyod la ni/ /rgyang ring gnas shing phyag 'tshal lags/ /bdag la dge bas gzigs su gsol/ /khyod la mi min phyag 'tshal ba/ /de skad yang dang yang du thos/ /de slad bdag ni 'di skad ces/ /'dren pa rgyal la phyag 'tshal cig /gau tam rgyal la phyag 'tshol cig /sangs rgyas rig dang zhabs ldan pa/ /mya ngan 'das la phyag 'tshol mchi/ /

te ltar byang gi phyogs de ni/ /bzang ba lags zhes skye bo mchi/ /phyogs de mngon par skyong bgyid pa/ /rgyal chen grags dang ldan pa lags/ /shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung / /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ /nub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang / /byang phyogs na ni lus ngan po/ /rgyal po chen po de bzhi dag /'jig rten skyong ba grags dang ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs po che/ /phyogs bzhi dag ni skyong bar bgyid/ /rgyal po dag gi mngag gzhug pa/ /gnod sbyin 'dod dgur mchi ba rnams/ /de dag glang po che 'tshal zhing / /phyogs phyogs dag tu rnam par rgyu/ /de dag ni chi bas rta dang / rnga mo dang / khyu mchog dang / ma he dang / ra dang / lug dang / sbrul dang / bya dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / gzhon nu dang / gzhon nu ma la 'tshal zhing phyogs phyogs dag tu yang mchi lags so/ /glang po che gcig gis shing rta drangs shing phyogs phyogs dag tu yang mchi lags so/ /chibs rta dang / rnga mo dang / khyu mchog dang / ma he dang / ra dang / lug dang / sbrul dang / bya dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / gzhon nu dang / gzhon nu ma gcig gis shing rta drangs shing phyogs phyogs dag tu yang mchi lags so/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po stobs po che'i/ /gnod sbyin 'dod dgur mchi ba rnams/ /bzhon pa de dag 'tshal nas ni/ /phyogs bzhi dag ni skyong bar bgyid/ /rgyal po dag ni grong khyed dag /sna tshogs mkha' la rgyu ba mchis/ /'di lta ste/ kun tu rgyu ba dang / kun tu rgyu ba ma lags pa dang / sa la kun tu rgyu ba ma lags pa dang / gar bcas sa steng kun tu rgyu ba dang / sbubs can dang grong khyer sbubs can zhes bgyi ba dag lags so/ /byang phyogs na mtsho ka pi bang ka zhes bgyi ba yang mchis lags so/ /nub phyogs na grong khyer sar pa gsar ldan dang / gos can dang / gos mchog can dang / pad+ma can dang / pad+ma bzang po can dang / sa gzhi can zhes bgyi ba dag kyang mchi lags so/ /chab rgyun mang po'i

gnas gyur pa/ /'dzin pa zhes bgyi'i mtsho mchis te/ /chab rgyun tha dad de las byung / /de las dgung char 'bab par 'gyur/ /btsun pa grong khyer u shi ra'i sbubs kyi pha rol na/ lus gnas dang ni gnas yangs dang / /de bas gnas yang rgyun lugs can/ /rgyun lugs mang dang de bas mang / /bar snang mkha' la bya ltar gda'/ /btsun pa grong khyer sbubs can gyi pha rol byang phyogs na 'dun sa bya gar can zhes bgyi ba de mchis te/ der ni gnod sbyin rnams 'du zhing gnas lags so/ /rkang mi sdug la mchu 'phyangs dang / /'jigs rung lto spu can dag mchis/ /de na ljon shing 'bras bu rtag /rma bya khrung khrung sgra snyan dang / /khu byug sgra skad chen po dang / /shang shang te'u dag sgra 'byin cing / /rma bya rnams kyi sgra dag kyang / /gau kum bha dang chun lag dang / /bya rnams sna tshogs skad 'byin cing / /me tog sbrang rtsi'i ro la dga'/ /lus ngan po de glu gar gyis/ /pad+ma can dang lhan cig rtse/ /btsun pa grong khyer lcang lo can gyi pha rol na rgyal po dpa' bo zhes bgyi ba yul 'khor mu khyud na mchis lags so/ /bdag gang na mchis pa'i 'dun sa de ni khyu mchog can zhes bgyi ste/ /bdag gi ming ni rnam thos kyi bu zhes bgyi lags so/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ /tad+ya thā/ i li mi li/ i li mi li/ kiṭ+ṭi mū le/ hi li kiṭ+ṭi mū le/ hu du me/ hu du ra du me/ gau ri/ gan+dha ri/ go do ha ni/ o ke mo ke swā hā/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag gis dri za rnams dang / dri za chen po rnams dang / dri za'i sde dpon rnams dang / dmag dpon rnams kyi ming brjod par bgyi lags so/ /'di lta ste/ 'dod myos dga' bas myos pa dang / /glu yi myos pa spun dang ni/ /phreng bas myos dang sbrang rtsis myos/ /me tog myos pa spun rnams dang / /rtag tu myos dang dpal gyis myos/ /nor gyis myos dang dga' byed dang / /ut+pal pad+ma zla ba dang / /lnga 'dzin dang ni khu byug sgra/ /tum bu ru dang gtsug lnga dang / /gser spyod bu mo

gser can dang / /pa ba sangs dang phur bu dag /'gro gnas ji snyed rgyal po lags/ /de dag bdag gi spun lags te/ /de dag la bdag dri za 'di ni bdag la 'tshe'o/ /dri za 'di ni bdag mi gtong ngo zhes mchi zhing de dag la go bar bgyid lags so/ /bdag la 'tshe ba'i dri za dang / /bdag mi gtong ba'i dri za yis/ /legs par smras pa 'di thos na/ /ardza ka yi dog pa bzhin/ /de yi mgo tshal bdun du 'gas/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ /tad+ya tha/ kun+tu le/ kun+tu le/ kun+tu le/ kun+tu phe/ e hi e hi/ sa dā mat+ti ke/ sa dā bhaṇ+ḍi ni ke/ tiṣ+ṭha tuṣ+ṭa/ bad+dho si swā hā/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la kun tu rgyu ba dang / kun tu rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun pa'i mdo/ /rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher lung mnos shing 'don par bgyid pa de la/ gal te dri za'am/ dri za mo'am/ /dri za rgan po'am/ dri za rgan mo'am/ dri za'i bu pho'am/ dri za'i bu mo'am/ dri za'i 'khor pho'am/ dri za'i 'khor mo'am/ dri za'i mngag gzhug pa'am/ dri za'i mngag gzhug ma 'tshe bar bgyid pa glags lta zhing glags tshol ba la la zhig nye bar mchi zhing / nye bar 'greng ngam/ nye bar mchis par gyur na glags mi rnyed cing gnas mi rnyed la/ dri za rnams kyi dri za 'du ba'i nang du mchir mi chud cing / rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du yang gnas mi 'thob ste/ de'i mgo ardza ka'i dog pa bzhin tshal pa bdun du 'gas lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ /dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la kun tu rgyu ba dang / kun tu rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher lung mnos shing 'don par bgyid pa de la/

gal te sha za'am/ sha za mo'am/ sha za rgan po'am/ sha za rgan mo'am/ sha za'i bu pho'am/ sha za'i bu mo'am/ sha za'i 'khor pho'am/ sha za'i 'khor mo'am/ sha za'i mngag gzhug pa'am/ sha za'i mngag gzhug ma 'tshe bar bgyid pa/ glags lta zhing glags tshol ba la la zhig nye bar mchi zhing / nye bar 'greng ngam/ nye bar mchis par gyur na glags mi rnyed cing gnas mi rnyed la/ sha za rnams kyi sha za 'du ba'i nang du mchir mi chud cing / rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du yang gnas mi 'thob ste/ de'i mgo ardza ka'i dog pa bzhin tshal pa bdun du 'gas lags so/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ /tad+ya thā/ hu me hu me/ hu me le/ hu mi la/ bā tī ye swā hā/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag gis grul bum rnams dang / grul bum chen po rnams dang / grul bum gyi sde dpon rnams dang / dmag dpon rnams kyi ming brjod par bgyi lags so/ /'di lta ste/ byin dang nye byin kri mi sha/ /rtsib logs che dang gsus po che/ /lag bcu dang ni sa la rgyu/ /g.yon phyogs nag po dmar po dang / /sprin mdog dang ni dri med dang / /rna ba ring dang 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /ral ba can dang stobs bcu dang / /srid sgrub dang ni 'dod dgur mchi/ /'jog po dang ni bya ba sbed/ /la ba bzang ldan gsum po dang / /tshon kun dang ni mig bkra po/ /'gro gnas ji snyed mchi ba lags/ /de dag ni bdag gi spun lags te/ de dag la bdag grul bum 'di ni bdag la 'tshe'o/ /grul bum 'di ni bdag mi gtong ngo zhes mchi zhing de dag la go bar bgyid lags so/ /bdag la 'tshe ba'i grul bum dang / /bdag mi gtong ba'i grul bum gyis/ /legs par smras pa 'di thos na/ /a rdza ka yi dog pa bzhin/ /de mgo tshal pa bdun du 'gas/ /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ /tad+ya tha/ si re bi si re/ si re bi sa re/ si re bi sa re/ kṛṣ+ṇa tsha ga le/ ka rā ḍa/ piṃ ga le swā hā/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos

dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la kun tu rgyu ba dang / kun tu rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher lung mnos shing 'don par bgyid pa de la gal te grul bum mam/ grul bum mo'am/ grul bum rgan po'am/ grul bum rgan mo'am/ grul bum gyi bu pho'am/ grul bum gyi bu rma'am/ grul bum gyi 'khor pho'am/ grul bum gyi 'khor mo'am/ grul bum gyi mngag gzhug pa'am/ grul bum gyi mngag bzhug ma 'tshe bar bgyid pa glags lta zhing glags tshol ba la la zhig nye bar mchi zhing / nye bar 'greng ngam/ nye bar mchis par gyur na glags mi rnyed cing gnas mi rnyed la/ grul bum rnams kyi gru la bum 'du ba'i nang du mchir mi tshud cing / rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du yang gnas mi 'thob ste/ de'i mgo ardza ka'i dog pa bzhin tshal pa bdun du 'gas lags so/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la kun tu rgyu ba dang / kun tu rgyu ba ma lags pa dang mthun pa'i mdo/ rig sngags dang / srung ba dang / sug pa rkang pa la phyag 'tshal bar 'gyur ba 'di nyid rgya cher lung mnos shing 'don par bgyid pa de la/ gal te yi dgas sam/ yi dgas mo'am/ yi dgas rgan po'am/ yi dgas rgan mo'am/ yi dgas kyi bu pho'am/ yi dgas kyi bu mo'am/ yi dgas kyi 'khor pho'am/ yi dgas kyi 'khor mo'am/ yi dgas kyi mngag gzhug pa'am/ yi dgas kyi mngag gzhug ma 'tshe bar bgyid pa glags lta zhing glags tshol ba la la zhig nye bar mchi zhing nye bar 'greng ngam nye bar mchis par gyur na glags mi rnyed cing gnas mi rnyed la/ yi dgas rnams kyi yi dgas 'du ba'i nang du mchir mi chud cing / rgyal po'i pho brang lcang lo can du yang gnas mi 'thob ste/ de'i mgo ardza ka'i
