gab med pa'i sa phyogs gtsang mar bla re sngon po bre/ ba dan sngon po dpyang ngo / chos smra ba lus bkrus la yan lag brgyad pa la nye bar gnas shing / gos gtsang ma sngon po bgos la/ spos dri zhim pos bskus nas/ zas dkar gsum zos la/ stan sngon po'i steng du 'dug nas/ kha shar phyogs su bltas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gsol ba btab nas sprin chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi le'u 'di nyin mtshan rgyun mi 'chad par bklag par bya'o/ /chu sngon pos bka' ba'i bum pa gang ba bzhi gzhag par bya'o/ /gtor ma dang / bdug pa dang / me tog ci nus kyis sbyar ro/ /de la chos smra bas phyogs bzhir ba'i lci ba'i khu bas bri bar bya ste/ shar phyogs su khru gsum tsam du klu'i rgyal po mgo gsum pa/ klu'i g.yog 'khor sna tshogs dang bcas pa ba'i lci bas bri bar bya'o/ /lho phyogs su khru lnga tsam du klu'i rgyal po mgo lnga pa klu'i g.yog 'khor sna tshogs dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o/ /nub phyogs su khru bdun tsam du klu'i rgyal po mgo bdun pa klu'i g.yog 'khor sna tshogs dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o/ /byang phyogs su khru dgu tsam du klu'i rgyal po mgo dgu pa klu'i g.yog 'khor sna tshogs dang bcas pa bri bar bya'o/ /chos smra ba rang gi lus bsrungs la byams pa la gnas te/ sems can thams cad la snying rje'i sems nye bar bzhag nas/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la gsol ba btab la klu rnams dang dge ba'i rtsa ba bgo bar bya ste/ 'di ni cho ga'o/ /gang zhig char mi 'bab pa'i tshe sprin chen po'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u 'di klog na/ nyin zhag gcig gam gnyis nas nyin zhag bdun tshun chad gdon mi za bar char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /rgya mtsho ni dus las yol yang srid kyi/ thub pa chen po'i gsung rab char gyi cho ga 'di ni gzhan du mi 'gyur ro/ /de lta mod kyi tshul khrims dang / yon tan la gnas te 'chal ba'i tshul khrims dang / sha dang nya sha la sogs pa yongs su spang bar bya'o/ /'o thug dang / zho dang / 'o ma

dang / 'bras chen bu ram can la sogs pa dang / mngar gsum za zhing bklag par bya'o/ /de ltar na 'grub par 'gyur te/ thub pa'i rgyal pos gsungs pa bzhin du the tshom med par bya'o/ /'phags pa sprin chen po theg pa chen po'i mdo las char dbab pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u zhes bya ba drug cu rtsa bzhi pa cho ga dang bcas pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / shī len dra bho dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo ts+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te skad gsar chad kyis kyang bcos nas gtan la phab pa// //༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ma hā me gha bā ta maṇ+ḍa la sarba nā ga hṛ da yam̐ nā ma ma hā yā na sū tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ /sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgya mtsho chen po na nor bu rin po che'i rtse mo can gyi khang pa brtsegs pa na klu stong du tshang ba'i klu'i tshogs chen po klu thams cad kyang rdzu 'phrul che zhing dkyil 'khor chen po dang ldan pa sha stag la 'di lta ste/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / klu'i rgyal po nye dga' bo dang / klu'i rgyal po yang dag bskul dang / klu'i rgyal po glog phreng can dang / klu'i rgyal po gzi can dang / klu'i rgyal po gzi can chen po dang / klu'i rgyal po btang bzung dang / klu'i rgyal po dung dang / klu'i rgyal po e la'i 'dab dang / klu'i rgyal po mtshams bzang dang / klu'i rgyal po stobs kyi rgyu dang / klu'i rgyal po glog 'byung dang / klu'i rgyal po snang ldan gtsug phud can dang / klu'i rgyal po sprin chen rnam par 'phrul dang / klu'i rgyal po sprin chen rgyas byed dang / klu'i rgyal po 'brug sgrogs dang / klu'i rgyal po char 'byung dang / klu'i rgyal po skar mda' gtong dang / klu'i rgyal po dus min sgrogs dang / klu'i rgyal po 'brug skad dang / klu'i rgyal po glog rab tu gtong ba dang / klu'i rgyal po sa 'dzin dang / klu'i rgyal po sog ma med

dang / klu'i rgyal po legs mthong dang / klu'i rgyal po rnam par snang dang / klu'i rgyal po 'brug chen sgrogs dang / klu'i rgyal po 'od chen lam lam dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid dang / klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang / klu'i rgyal po mdongs bu dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal 'dzin dang / klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra dang / klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra rnam par sgrogs pa'i skad dang / klu'i rgyal po la ba dang / klu'i rgyal po 'dren byed dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal mgrin dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal bzangs dang / klu'i rgyal po sha sho'i sgra chen dang / klu'i rgyal po ding ding sgra dang / klu'i rgyal po rab 'joms dang / klu'i rgyal po char 'byung dang / klu'i rgyal po rlung chen rnam par 'phrul dang / klu'i rgyal po rlung rab tu gtong dang / klu'i rgyal po 'jog po dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal ldan dang / klu'i rgyal po dpal dkrigs dang / klu'i rgyal po bkra shis dang / klu'i rgyal po sprin rgyas byed dang / klu'i rgyal po sprin gyis dga' byed dang / klu'i rgyal po sprin gyis 'gebs pa'i rigs dang / klu'i rgyal po legs par 'gebs pa dang / klu'i rgyal po rnam par rtse dang / klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bu dang / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang / klu'i rgyal po 'od bzangs dang / klu'i rgyal po mthong dga' dang / klu'i rgyal po don yod dga' dang / klu'i rgyal po sprin gyi dkyil 'khor gyis legs par 'gebs dang / klu'i rgyal po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / klu'i rgyal po sprin las chu 'byin dang / klu'i rgyal po bde mthong dang / klu'i rgyal po rlung 'byung dang / klu'i rgyal po rlung 'khrug par byed pa dang / klu'i rgyal po gtsug na nor bu dang / klu'i rgyal po chen po de dag dang / gzhan yang klu'i rgyal po chen po stong dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te/ de dag thams cad kyang klu'i rdzu 'phrul chen po dang / klu'i rnam par 'phrul pa chen pos nam mkha' la di ri di ri sgrogs shing / /rdzi char chen po rab tu 'bebs te/ bcom ldan 'das la sri zhu bya ba dang chos mnyan pa'i phyir lhags so/ /kye klu chen po dang klu dag tshur

sheg /mu lu mu lu/ tsa ṭa tsa ṭa/ pa ṭa pa ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa swā hā/ glog 'bar ba rab tu phyung zhing / rdzi char chen po'i rgyun thong la char phob cig /kye kye klu chen po dag sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa dran par gyis shig /kye klu chen po dag tshur sheg tshur sheg /'dzam bu'i gling du char rab tu phob cig /gu ḍu gu ḍu/ mu ḍu mu ḍu/ hi hi hi hi/ tsu ḍa tsu ḍa/ ma hā nā ga hṛ da ya/ sarba nā ga nā/ ā kaḍ+ḍha ya/ sañtso da ya/ shī gh+rān da ra swā hā/ sprin chen po rnam par 'phrul pa'i+i rgyan bkod pa dag gser snam gyi mtha' rin po che thams cad kyi tshon gyi lda ldi mdzes pa/ mu tig gi rgyan phreng rab tu 'phyang ba rgya mtsho chen po'i sprin dag dang / lha'i rin po ches mdzes par byas pa'i gzhal med khang me tog rab tu 'phyang ba rgya mtsho chen po'i sprin dag gis nam mkha'i dkyil kun du khebs par byin gyis rlobs la/ rin po che'i sprin rab tu 'phyang zhing / lha'i ras bcos bu mang po mu tig gi rgyan phreng rgya mtsho chen po'i sprin dag dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa zab mo sna tshogs kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis sgra sgrogs pa rgya mtsho'i sprin dag dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi rgyan bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam pa sna tshogs yang dag par ston pa rin po che bkod pa chen po'i rgya mtsho'i sprin dag gis nam mkha'i dkyil kun du khebs par byin gyis rlobs te/ sprin chen po rnam par 'phrul pa'i sgra sgrogs pa rgya mtsho chen po'i sprin dag dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi lha'i bla re'i dril bu'i sgra snyan par sgrogs pa rgya mtsho'i sprin dag dang / bya'i tshogs thams cad skad 'byin cing me tog gi char chen po rab tu 'bebs pa rgya mtsho chen po'i sprin dag dang / rgya mtsho sprin chen po sgra cher sgrogs shing lha'i rin po che rab tu 'phyang la mu tig gi lda ldi rnam pa sna tshogs rab tu 'phyang ba rgya mtsho'i sprin dag dang / gser skud kyis brgyan pa'i snang ba chen po can gyi rtse mos nam mkha' kun du khebs par byed pa rgya mtsho chen po'i sprin dag dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi phreng pa'i 'od kyi

dkyil 'khor gyis nam mkha' kun du khebs par byed pa la mkhas pa rgya mtsho'i sprin dag dang / snang ba dang ldan pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i sgras kun du khebs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i sprin dag gis nam mkha' mngon par khebs par gyis shig /klu dang klu'i rgyal po thams cad tshur sheg /sa'i steng 'dir 'brug sgra sgrogs shing char phob cig /char rab tu phob cig /char kun du rab tu phob cig /di ri rir sgrogs shig /glog chen po snang ba rab tu phyung shig /'du zhing kun du 'du la tog yar dar dir zhing 'dug ste/ klu'i skad chen po yid du 'ong ba'i sgra chen po 'byin cing dbyangs chen po rab tu sgrogs pa dag 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig /gha ḍa gha ḍa/ ghi ḍi ghi ḍi/ hu ḍu hu ḍu/ ghu ḍu ghu ḍu/ ga ṭa ga ṭa/ gi ṭi gi ṭi/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ tsa ṭa tsa ṭa/ pa ṭa pa ṭa/ kye kye klu dang / klu chen po dag tshur tshur tshur sheg tshur sheg /dhu dhu dhu dhu/ hā hā hā hā/ hī hī/ hūṃ hūṃ/ 'brug sgra chen po sgrogs shing / rlung chen po rab tu gtong bdag sangs rgyas kyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ kye kye klu dang / klu'i rgyal po dag klu thams cad la yang dag par bskul gyis 'dzam bu'i gling du char phob cig /ghu ḍu ghu ḍu/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ha ha/ he he/ klu chen po dag 'dus shig sa'i steng du char rab tu phob cig /ghu ḍu ghu ḍu/ ki ri ki ri/ tsi ri tsi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ di ri di ri/ ki li ki li/ zhing thams cad yongs su gang bar gyis shig /'bru dang / shing ljon pa dang / rtswa dang / shing gel pa dang / sman thams cad rab tu skye bar gyis shig /byams pa'i sems kyis tshur sheg /sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang / lag na rdo rje'i bden pa dang / klu thams cad kyi bden pas klu chen po dag tshur sheg tshur sheg swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po mdongs bu la yang dag par bskul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid la yang dag par bskul lo/ /chos kyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/

klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas la yang dag par bskul lo/ /dge 'dun gyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bu la yang dag par bskul lo/ /lag na rdo rje'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po 'jog po la yang dag par bskrul lo/ /tshangs pa'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po dpal mgrin la yang dag par bskul lo/ /dbang po'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po sa srung gi bu la yang dag par bskul lo/ /khyab 'jug gi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po phreng ba can la yang dag par bskul lo/ /drag po'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can la yang dag par bskul lo/ /drang srong gi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po skrag 'bros byed la yang dag par bskul lo/ /lha'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can chen po la yang dag par bskul lo/ /klu thams cad kyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po rab 'joms la yang dag par bskul lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa la yang dag par bskul lo/ /srin po'i bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir char rab tu phob cig swā hā/ klu gong ma gong ma thams cad kyi bden pas char rab tu phob cig /char phob cig /ma 'phyi b.ratshur sheg tshur sheg /kye kye klu chen po dag klu thams cad kyi snying po la yang dag par bskrul lo/ /kun nas drang ngo / /sa ras ra/ hā hā/ dhu ma dhu ma/ hā hā hā hā/ hi hi hi hi/ e h+ye hi/ tha tha tha/ tsa tsa tsa ra ta/ zhing thams cad kun gang bar gyis shig /'bru thams cad kyi char phob cig /rlung chen po rab tu thong shig drum̐ drum̐/ ghum̐ ghum̐/ pum pum/ ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ni pā ra ṇi/ stam+bha ni/ mo ha ni/ dzām̐ gu li/ puk+ka si/

pra hā nī/ ma tam̐ gi/ dza ye bi dza ye/ ha ha swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen snying po dpal gyi gzi brjid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen rab 'joms pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'byung dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen po dang / de bzhin bshegs pa sprin chen kun du 'gebs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug chen sgrogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen rgyas mdzad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug chen rnam par sgrogs pa sgra'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'jigs mdzad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen srung dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen rnga sgra dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug chen sgra dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen dpal gyi gzi brjid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen dbyangs snyan dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen skar ma'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen tshub ma'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen shin du brtan pa'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen sprin bstan pas dga' ba mdzad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'ur 'ur sgra dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen 'jigs pas 'jigs mdzad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen thog tog char 'bebs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin rnam par 'phrul ba'i rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen bkra shis kyi cheng dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi phyir de bzhin gshegs pa sprin chen po sprin chen snying po thams cad la yang dag par bskul lo/ /klu thams cad kyi bden pas klu thams cad kyi snying po la yang dag par bskul lo/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' lung gis myur du sheg shig /kye kye klu dang klu chen po dag tshur sheg tshur sheg /hu lu hu lu/ su ru su ru/ dha pa dha pa/ gha ra gha ra/ bhu ru bhu ru/ ma 'phyi bar sangs rgyas kyi bden pas tshur sheg /chos kyi bden pas tshur

sheg /dge 'dun gyi+i bden pas tshur sheg /klu thams cad dang / klu chen po gong ma gong ma dag gi bden pas 'dzam bu'i gling du char phob cig /a la la zhes gar byed cing / a la la zhes glu len pa dang / a la la zhes klu'i rnam par 'phrul ba chen po byed cing 'du la char gyi rgyun chen po 'bebs shing / klu chen po rnams kyi chos kyi sgra yid du 'ong ba'i ston pa dag /gu lu gu lu/ nā ge nā ge/ tsa ṭa tsa ṭa/ nā ga nī/ hā hā hi hi/ nā ge nā gi ni nā ge/ sarba nā ga biṣ+ṭa ma bha ni mā ra ṇi/ sarba nā ga biṣ+ṭa ma bha na/ ma ra ṇi ma re ta ra ṇi/ ta ra ṇi/ ta re/ ta ra ta ra/ tā re/ kā bi la ke shi/ bi kṛ ta dam̐ṣ+ṭ+ri/ bha yā nā ge/ ā kaḍ+ḍha/ mā bi la m+pa tha/ bid+yud dz+wa re/ gho rā rū pi ṇi/ kā le/ a kā le/ gardzi ta/ sarba megha bi kurba ṇi/ sañtso da ni/ sarba k+ṣe tra na/ a pū ra ṇi tsakra /tsakra brti/ hi ri hi ri/ bhe ghe bhe ghe/ sma ra sma ra/ kā li kā li/ ma hā kā li/ hṛ da yam̐/ pra bi sha aṣ+ṭe/ mat+te/ sarba nā ga /ā ka r+ṣa ṇi/ pū ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐/ rat+na tra ya/ bi kurbi te/ badz+ri ṇi/ badz+re badz+ra pā ṇi/ kā la sho dhi re/ nā ga rū pi ni/ su rū be/ bho gi bho gi/ ma hā bho gi/ bho ga rū ba ta ya/ ba le/ bar+ṣa ni/ sarba nā ga sañtso da ni swā hā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maṣ+tsa ṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ su rū pe/ kā la rū pi ṇi swā hā/ chos smra bas thog ma kho nar bsrung ba'i cho ga byas la/ chos gos kyi grwar lan bdun bzlas brjod byas te/ mdud pa bdun bor nas rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba 'di zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du rgyun ma chad par bklag par bya'o/ /shar phyogs su ni ba lang gi lci bas klu'i rgyal po mgo gsum pa zhes bya ba 'khor dang bcas te bri bar bya'o/ /lho phyogs su ni klu'i rgyal po rab tu rgyas byed ces bya ba mgo lnga pa 'khor dang bcas te bri bar bya'o/ /nub phyogs su ni klu'i rgyal po snang ldan gtsug phud can zhes bya ba mgo bdun pa 'khor dang bcas te bri bar bya'o/ /byang phyogs su ni klu'i rgyal po sprin sku la zhes bya ba mgo dgu pa 'khor dang bcas te bri bar bya'o/ /bla re dang / gos sngon po dang /

rgyal mtshan sngon po dang / lha bshos thams cad kyang sngon por bya'o/ /klu gnad la dbab pa ni mngar gsum gyis bya'o/ /mngar gsum gyis dgang blugs bdun yang klu'i snying pos sbyin sreg bya'o/ /sprin gyi rgyal po rnams kyang bris te char gyi rgyun 'bebs la phan tshun thug cing mthar glog 'gyu bar bya'o/ /'dir dbab pa ni khur ba bkra shis ldan dang / pen rtse dang / sha dang / nya sha dang / sbrang rtsi las byas pa'i zas mchog rgyas par bya'o/ /de nas chos smra ba gtsang zhing gos gtsang ma bgos pas rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po bklag par bya'o/ /de nas klu rnams dang po'i nyin mo nas brtsams te/ di ri rir sgra sgrogs par byed cing / sgra yid du 'ong bdag 'byin par 'gyur te/ le'u 'di la the tshom dang brnyas par mi bya'o/ /gal te rgya mtsho dus las yol na 'di yang char las yol bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal gyi snying po brtsegs pa rnam par bsgrags pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnga sgra sgrogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin gdal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'brug sgrogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin kun du ston la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin 'dzag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin rnam par rgyas mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin gyi

yan lag mdzes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin lta bu'i na bza' man bas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin gyi 'brug skrun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin gyi phreng ba can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin 'thor la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin gyi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'brug sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin gyis byin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'brug sgra rnam par sgrogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin gyi chub la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprin sdud la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'brug nges par sgrogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can thams cad la bde legs su gyur cig /'byung po thams cad la byams par gyur cig /dud 'gror gyur pa thams cad 'jigs pa med par gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /

sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi cho ga /sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gzigs pa'i cho ga 'di grub par gyur cig /tad+ya thā/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+phu ṭa swā hā/ char mi 'bab pa'i tshe dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la zhig gis mgo bkrus te gos gtsang ma bgos la/ byams pa'i sems dang ldan pas de bzhinagashegs pa'i mtshan 'di dag yi ger bris nas/ gdan gtsang ma la bzhag ste/ pog phor bdun gyi nam mkha' la gyen du 'dug cing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rnams lan lnga bcu'i bar du brjod la mchod pa chen po byas te/ zhag bdun gyi bar du rgyun ma chad par byas na char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u klu thams cad kyi snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu chen gyi lo ts+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ta pa swī nā ga rā dzā pa ri prits+tshā nā ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das yul ma ga dhā na lus 'phags ri'i dbang po'i brag phug na bzhugs te/ de nas klu'i rgyal po gzi can kha dog shin tu 'phags pa dang ldan pa nam sros pa dang bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das lus 'phags ri 'di ni ring po dag dge slong rnams la 'tshe na/ de la bdag gis ji ltar mi 'tshe bar bgyi/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis klu'i rgyal po gzi can la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /klu'i rgyal

po legs so legs so/ /'di lta bur khyod kyis bya ba yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag de'i phyir dug dang / sman chen po bcwa brgyad po 'di dag gi ming zung shig /tad+ya thā/ paṇ+ḍa re/ ka ra ṭe/ ke yū re/ bo dh+yaṃ ga ma te/ bin+du ma te/ a ra ḍa/ ta ra ḍa/ ta ru ḍa/ da ha da ha na/ e ta da ha/ dze le dze la/ pha le/ sha ta sha ta/ ku le na ku li/ e kar ṣi ta rad+ga priṣ+ṭi/ dge slong dag su zhig dug dang / sman chen po bcwa brgyad po 'di dag gi ming 'dzin pa de'i lus la rims kyis mi tshugs/ dug dang / mtshon dang / byad dang / ro langs dang / nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pas mi tshugs/ de la ring po dag 'tshe bar mi 'gyur ro/ /su zhig 'di dag 'dzin pa de ji srid 'tsho'i bar du bsrung ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+yā gra ha mā tṛ kā nā ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags ma bcom ldan 'das ma gza' rnams kyi yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'brog gnas kyi grong khyer chen po na/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / bdud dang / gshin rje dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / mig dmar dang / gza' lhag dang / phur bu dang / pa ba sangs dang / spen pa dang / sgra gcan dang / mjug rings dang / rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa du mas bstod cing / rdo rje chen po dam tshig gi rgyan gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i seng ge'i khri la bzhugs te byang chub sems dpa' du ma dang thabs

cig pa la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje gtum po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sde dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje gzhu dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i bdag po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje rgyan dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du gzigs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i tog dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhal ras rgyas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i spyan dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun brgya phrag du ma rnams kyis yongs su bskor zhing mdun du bdar la chos ston te/ bkod pa chen po'i rgyan yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bya ba/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba'i chos ston par mdzad do/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis lag na rdo rjes 'khor de rnams la bltas nas langs te/ bdag gi rdzu 'phrul gyi byin gyis brlabs kyis bcom ldan 'das la lan stong phrag du ma bskor ba byas te/ phyag 'tshal nas spyan sngar 'dug ste/ snyems pa dang bcas pas skyil mo krung legs par bcas pas 'khor de rnams la bltas te/ rdo rje thal mo rang gi snying gar sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom

ldan 'das gza' rnams ni gtum zhing gtum pa'i gzugs can/ drag cing drag pa'i gzugs can/ khro zhing khro ba'i sems kyi sems can rnams la rnam par 'tshe zhing gnod par bgyid la mdangs 'phrog par bgyid de/ kha cig ni nor rdzas 'phrog par bgyid/ kha cig ni srog 'phrog par bgyid/ sems can tshe ring po kha cig ni tshe thung bar bgyid/ de ltar sems can rnams la gnod pas 'tshe bar bgyid pas na/ de'i phyir bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs gang gis sems can rnams la bsrung bar 'gyur ba bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje gang khyod kyis sems can rnams la phan par bya ba'i don du snying rje bskyed nas/ gsang ba chen po shin du gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa la zhu bar byed pa legs so legs so/ /de dag ngas bshad kyis nyon la legs par rab tu zungs la yid la gyis shig /gza' rnams gtum pa'i gzugs la shin tu khro zhing 'jigs pa rnams la mchod pa bzang po mchod yon dang bzlas brjod bzang po gsang ba las ches gsang ba ngas bshad par bya'o/ /de dag mchod pas mchod 'gyur zhing / /gnod pa byas na gnod byed pa/ /gza' de kun gyi kha dog dang / /ji ltar dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / /lha rnams dang ni lha min dang / /mi'am ci dang klu dag dang / /gnod sbyin rnams dang srin po dang / /srul po dang ni mi rnams dang / /drag po gzi brjid chen po dag /khros pa zhi bar byed pa yi/ /gsang sngags rnams dang mchod pa dag /rim pa bzhin du bshad par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa nyid kyi thugs ka nas snying rje rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer 'bar ba phyung nas/ gza' rnams kyi spyi bor zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas de nyid kyi skad cig nyid la nyi ma la sogs pa'i gza' rnams langs nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bdag cag

rnams la sman yon btags par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das gang gis bdag cag rnams 'tshogs nas yo byad du gyur par byed pa'i chos smra ba rnams la bsrung ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang rim gro dang chad pa bzlog pa dang / mtshon cha spang ba dang / dug gzhil ba dang / dug gsad pa dang / mtshams bcad pa dang / sa bcing bar 'gyur ba rnams bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pas gza' rnams kyi mchod pa dang gsang sngags bka' stsal pa/ ji lta ba'i rim pa'i kha dog gi dbye bas phyogs rnams su dri'i dkyil 'khor byas la pad+ma sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad du byas pa'i 'dab ma bris te/ lte ba yang sor bcu gnyis pa la sgo bzhis mdzes pa rim bzhin du byas pa la pad+ma rgyas pa'i steng du lha nyi ma bsam par bya ba ni lus gzi brjid kyi phung po li khri nye bar 'bar ba lta bu nyi ma stong dang mtshungs pa'i 'od zer can no/ /oṃ mai gho lkā ya swā hā/ shar du zla ba dkar po/ om̐ shi tām̐ sha be swā hā/ me'i mtshams su mig dmar po/ oṃ rak+tām̐ ga ku mā rā ya swā hā/ gshin rje'i phyogs su rgyal rigs gza' lhag mdog ser po/ om̐ budhā ya swā hā/ bden bral du phur bu dmar ser/ oṃ pṛ ha spa ta ye swā hā/ nub kyi phyogs su pa ba sangs dkar po/ oṃ a su rot+ta mā ya swā hā/ rlung du spen pa mig sman ltar shin tu gnag pa/ oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa war+ṇ+ṇa ya swā hā/ lus ngan po'i phyogs su sgra gcan dmar nag /oṃ a mṛ ta pri yā ya swā hā/ dbang ldan gyi mtshams su dud sprin gyi mdog lta bu'i mjug rengs/ oṃ dz+yo ti ke ta be swā hā/ shar gyi sgor rje btsun sangs rgyas/ lho sgor phyag na rdo rje/ nub sgor 'jig rten mgon po/ byang gi sgor 'jam dpal lo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol gyi byang shar du gza' thams cad do/ /shar lho'i

mtshams su khyim rnams dang rgyu skar rnams so/ /lho nub du gnod pa thams cad do/ /nub byang du rje btsun rigs pa chen mo'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi sgo'i phyi rol gyi shar du yul 'khor srung / lhor 'phags skyes po/ nub tu mig mi bzang / byang du lus ngan po'o/ nyi ma'i 'o thug dang / zla ba'i zho zan dang / mig dmar gyi sran ma ma sha'i bza' ba dang / lhag pa'i mar gyi khur ba dang / phur bu'i 'o ma dang / pa ba sangs kyi khur ba dang / spen pa'i sran ma ma sha dang / mud ga bsres pa dang / sgra gcan gyi til gyi thug pa dang / mjug rings kyi til kyi thug pa dang / bu ram gyi tshod ma'o/ /gnod sbyin gyi gtor ma ni yul 'khor srung gi zho zan no/ /'phags skyes po'i zho dang sran ma ma sha'i bza' ba'o/ /mig mi bzang gi 'o thug gi bza' ba'o/ /lus ngan po'i zho dang sran ma ma sha'i bza' ba dang bu ram chang dang sbyar ba'o/ /ji lta ba'i rim pa'i kha dog gi me tog dbul lo/ /ji lta ba'i rim pa'i kha dog gi bdug spos dbul lo/ /ji lta ba'i rim pa'i kha dog gi ba dan dbul lo/ /so so la mar me dbul lo/ /ji lta ba'i rim pa'i mchod pa bya'o/ /mar dang sbrang rtsis dung phor bkang ste/ rin chen sna lnga bcug la mchod yon dbul zhing gdong la yang dar bcing bar bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje gza' 'di rnams kyi snying po'i sngags bklags pas 'grub pa rnams yin te/ ji lta ba'i rim pa'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i spos kyi dkyil 'khor sor bcu gnyis pa byas pa'i dbus su mchod par bya'o/ /kham pa'am zangs la sogs pa'am/ gser dngul gyi snod du mchod yon phul nas/ re re la yang bzlas brjod lan brgya rtsa brgyad rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje de nas yang de'i 'og tu gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sngags kyi tshig rnams lan bdun brjod par bya'o/ /de nas gza' nyi ma la sogs pa'i gza' thams cad kyis srung bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /dbul ba'i gdon las grol bar byed do/ /tshe zad pa rnams tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje yang gang zhig dge

slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma rnams sam/ sems can gzhan sems can gyi skye bar gtogs pa gang dag gi rna lam du thos na/ de dag kyang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje yang gang zhig gza' rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mchod cing / nyin gcig bzhin du klog par byed pa'i chos smra bar byed pa de la gza' rnams thams cad kyis rnam pa thams cad du bdag nyid kyis bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /de'i rigs rgyud kyi dbul ba yang nyams par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs bka' stsal pa/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/ na mo pad+ma dha rā ya/ na mo ku mā rā ya/ na mo gra hā ṇāṃ/ sarbā sha pa ri pū ra kā nām̐/ na mo na k+ṣa trā ṇām̐/ na mo dwā da sha rā shi nām̐/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ bud+dhe bud+dhe/ badz+re badz+re/ pad+me pad+me/ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ sma ra sma ra/ krī ḍa ya krī ḍa ya/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ mār+dha ya mār+dha ya/ ghā ṭa ya ghā ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nām̐/ ku ru ku ru/ ma ma kār+yāṃ/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha/ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ/ k+ṣā pa ya k+ṣā pa ya/ shān+te shān+te/ dān+te dān+te/ dā ma ya dā ma ya swā hā/ dru tān dar+sha ya/ āt+ma naṃ/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa mām̐/ sarba satwāṃsh+tsa/ sarba gra hā na k+ṣa tra/ bi dh+waṃ sa ni bar+t+ta ya/ bha ga ba ti ma hā mā ye/ pra sā da ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ/ sho dha ya sarba pā pam̐ tsaṇ+ḍe tsaṇ+ḍe/ tu ru tu ru/ tsaṇ+ḍe ni tsaṇ+ḍe ni/ mu yu mu yu/ mu tsu mu tsu/ ba ha ba ha/ u gre u gra ta me/ pū ra ya me/ ma nor thaṃ pa ri pū ra ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ a dhiṣ+ṭhi te sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ swā hā/ hūm̐ swā hā/ hṛ swā hā/ dh+rum̐ swā hā/ dh+riṃ swā hā/ pad+ma dha rā ya swā hā/ ā di t+yā ya swā hā/ sau mā ya swā hā/ dhā ra ṇī su tā ya swā hā/ bu dhā ya swā hā/ pṛ haspa ta ye swā hā/ shu krā ya swā hā/ kṛṣ+ṇa war+ṇ+ṇā ya swā hā/ rā ha be swā hā/ ke ta be swā hā/ bur+dhāya swā hā/ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ pad+ma dha rā ya swā hā/ ku mā rā ya swā hā/ sarba gra he bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba nak+ṣa tre bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba dā da sha rā shi ni bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba u

pa dra be bh+yaḥswā hā/ oṃ sarba pid+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lag na rdo rje gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi sngags kyi tshig 'di dag ston zla tha chungs smin drug gi zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bdun nas brtsams te/ gso sbyong blangs nas tshes bcu bzhi'i bar du nyin gcig bzhin du mchod cing brjod par byas nas de nas nya la nyin mtshan thog thag bklags na de la lo dgu bcu rtsa dgu'i bar du 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /skar mda' ltung ba dang / gza' dang rgyu skar gyis gdungs pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /gza' thams cad kyis mchod par 'gyur ro/ /gza' rnams kyis de la ci 'dod pa'i mchog ster bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gza' de rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la legs so zhes gsol nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /'phags ma gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sku ring la bsgyur ba las/ dus phyis dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal ldan sa skya'i dben gnas su rgya dpe la gtugs nas shin tu dag par byas pa'o// //༄༅༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ gra ha mā tṛ kā nā ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'brog gnas kyi grong khyer chen po na/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / bdud dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / mig dmar dang / pa ba sangs dang / phur bu dang / gza' lhag dang / spen pa dang / sgra gcan 'dzin dang / mjug rings rnams dang / rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa mang po rnams kyis bstod pa/ rdo rje chen po'i dam tshig gis byin gyis brlabs kyis rdo rje'i khri la bzhugs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' du ma dang yang

thabs cig ste/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje gtum po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje sde dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje gzhu can dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i bdag po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i rgyan dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu gzigs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i tog dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhal ras rgyas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad+ma'i spyan dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'jam dpal gzhon nu dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis bskor cing mdun gyis bltas pa la chos ston to/ /bkod pa chen po'i rgyan gyi nor bu zhes bya ba thog mar dge ba dang / bar du dge ba dang / tha mar dge ba dang / don bzang po dang / tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba'i chos ston to/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes 'khor de dag la bltas te/ langs nas rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi byin gyis brlabs kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la lan brgya stong du mar bskor ba byas te phyag 'tshal nas spyan sngar 'dug ste/ snyems pa dang bcas pas skyil mo krung legs par bcas nas/ 'khor de dag la 'gying bag tu bltas te/ rdo rje'i thal mo rang gi snying gar bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gza' mi bzad pa/

mi bzad pa'i gzugs can/ drag shul can drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/ khro ba khro ba'i gzugs can dag sems can thams cad la 'tshe bar bgyid pa/ tho 'tsham par bgyid pa/ mdangs kyang 'phrog par bgyid cing / kha cig nor zas 'phrog par bgyid/ kha cig ni srog 'phrog par bgyid/ sems can tshe ring ba kha cig ni tshe thung ngur bgyid do/ /de ltar sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bar bgyid pa de rnams kyi slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs gang gis sems can thams cad la bsrung bar 'gyur ba bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang yang khyod kyis snying rje bskyed pas sems can thams cad la phan par bya ba'i phyir gsang chen bas kyang ches gsang ba de bzhin gshegs pa la zhu bar byed pa legs so legs so/ /de'i phyir legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig dang / gza' mi bzad pa'i gzugs can shin tu khro ba dang / shin tu 'jigs par byed pa rnams kyis mchod pa dang / mchod yon dang / bzlas brjod bzang po gsang ba bas kyang ches gsang ba ngas bshad do/ /de dag mchod pas mchod gyur cing / /gnod pa byas na gnod byed dang / /gza' de kun gyi kha dog dang / /ji lta bur ni 'gyur ba dang / /lha rnams dang ni lha min dang / /mi'am ci dang klu dag dang / /gnod sbyin rnams dang srin po dang / /mi rnams dang ni mi ma yin/ /drag po gzi brjid chen po dang / /khros pa zhi bar byed pa de'i/ /gsang sngags rnams dang mchod pa dang / /rim pa bzhin du bshad par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa nyid kyi thugs ka nas snying rje rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer bkye ste/ /gza' rnams kyi spyi bor zhugs so/ /de nas de'i mod la nyi ma la sogs pa'i gza' thams cad langs te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la lha rdzas kyi mchod pa byas te/ phyag 'tshal nas pus mo btsugs nas thal mo sbyar ba byas te/ bcom

ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bdag cag la sman yon btags par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis chos kyi rnam grangs gang gis bdag cag rnams la sogs pas chos smra ba rnams la bsrung bar 'gyur ba dang / yongs su bskyab pa dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / mtshon cha spang ba dang / chad pa spang ba dang / dug gzhil ba dang / dug gsad pa dang / mtshams bcad pa dang / sa bcing ba rnams bgyid par 'gyur ba bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas gza' rnams mchod pa dang / gsang sngags bka' stsal to/ /oṃ mai gho lkā ya swā hā/ om̐ shi tāṃ sha be swā hā/ oṃ ra k+tāṃ ga ku mā rā ya swā hā/ oṃ bu dhā ya swā hā/ oṃ bṛ ha spa ta ye swā hā/ /oṃ a su rot+ta mā ya swā hā/ om̐ kṛṣ+ṇa bar+ṇ+ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ ta pri yā ya swā hā/ oṃ dz+yo tiṣ+ke ta pai swā hā/ lag na rdo rje 'di dag ni gza' dgu'i gsang sngags kyi snying po bklags pas grub pa yin te/ kha dog dang mthun par spos kyis dkyil 'khor sor bcu gnyis pa byas pa'i dbus su mchod par bya'o/ /kham pa'am/ zangs la sogs pa'am/ gser dang dngul gyi snod du mchod yon phul nas/ re re la yang bzlas brjod brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /lag na rdo rje de'i 'og tu gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig lan bdun brjod par bya'o/ /de nas gza' rnams thams cad srung ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /dbul ba'i gdon las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe zad pa las tshe ring por byed par 'gyur ro/ /lag na rdo rje dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / gzhan yang sems can gyi rigs gang yin pa dang / gang dag gi rna lam du grags pa de dag kyang dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje gza' rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mchod

par bya ste/ nyin gcig bzhin du klog par byed pa'i chos smra ba gang yin pa de la gza' thams cad bdag nyid kun gyis bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur ro/ /de dang rigs gcig pa rnams kyi dbul ba yang sel bar byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i gza' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyu skar rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gza' khyim bcu gnyis po rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ta d+ya thā/ bud+dhe bud+dhe/ badz+re badz+re/ pad+me pad+me/ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ sma ra sma ra/ krī ḍa ya krī ḍa ya/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ mār+dha ya mār+dha ya/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba bigh+nā na/ ku ru ku ru/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha/ bhin+da bhin+da/ k+ṣā pa ya k+ṣā pa ya/ shān+te shān+te/ dān+te dān+te/ dā ma ya dā ma ya/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag nyid myur du bstan du gsol/ bdag 'khor dang bcas pa dang / sems can thams cad la bsrung du gsol/ bsrung du gsol/ gza' thams cad dang / rgyu skar rnams kyi gnod pa bzlog tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdzu 'phrul chen po mnga' ba sdang ba'i sems can rnams bsal du gsol/ bdag gi sdig pa rnams skam du gsol/ /tsaṇ+ḍe tsaṇ+ḍe/ tu ru tu ru/ tsaṇ+ḍe ni tsaṇ+ḍe ni/ mu yu mu yu/ mu tsu mu tsu/ ba ha ba ha/ u gre u gra ta me/ pū ra ya me/ ma nor thaṃ pa ri pū ra ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhiṣ+ṭhi te sa ma ye swā hā/ om̐ swā hā/ hūm̐ swā hā/ hrī swā hā/ dh+ram̐ swā hā/ dhṛṃ swā hā/ pad+ma dha rā swā hā/ ā di t+yā ya swā hā/ sau mā ya swā hā/ dhā ra ṇī su tā ya swā hā/ budhā ya swā hā/ bṛ haspa ta ye swā hā/ shu krā ya swā hā/ kṛṣ+ṇa bar+ṇ+ṇa ya swā hā/ rā ha be swā hā/ ke ta be swā hā/ bud+dha ya swā hā/ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ pad+ma dha rā ya swā hā/ ku mā rā ya swā hā/ sarba gra he bh+yaḥswā hā/

sarba nak+ṣa tre bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba dwā da sha rā shi ni bh+yaḥswā hā/ sarba u pa dra be bh+yaḥswā hā/ oṃ sarba bid+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ phyag na rdo rje 'di ni gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig dngos grub thams cad kyi gzhi yin no/ /phyag na rdo rje gang yang gza' rnams kyi gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag ston zla tha chungs yar gyi ngo'i tshes bdun nas brtsams te gso sbyong dang ldan par byas te/ tshes bcu bzhi'i bar du gza' rnams la mchod pa byas te gzung bar bya'o/ /de nas zla ba nya'i nyin mtshan thog thag bklags na de dag la lo dgu'i bar 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /gza'i 'jigs pa dang / skar mda' ltung ba dang / rgyu skar gyi gnod pas 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro/ /gza' thams cad la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /gza' thams cad kyis ci 'dod pa sbyin par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la gza' rnams kyis phyag 'tshal te/ legs so legs so zhes gsol te mi snang bar gyur to/ gza' rnams kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// ༄༅༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ba su dhā rā nā ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa nor gyi rgyun ces bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das kau shām+bī na tsher ma can zhes bya ba'i nags mchog chen po na/ dge slong lnga brgya tsam gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa rab tu mang po dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te/ de'i tshe kau shām+bī'i grong khyer chen po na/ khyim bdag zla ba bzang po zhes bya ba/ dbang po nye bar zhi ba/ yid nye bar zhi ba/ bu pho dang / bu mo dang / gza' mi mang po dang ldan pa/ dad cing

che ru dad pa zhig gnas pa de/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ lan 'bum phrag du mar bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gal te zhus nas zhu ba lung bstan pa'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag la skabs phye na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdag phyogs 'ga' zhig zhu lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag zla ba bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyim bdag khyod ci dang ci 'dod pa dris shig dang / khyod kyis ji skad dris pa'i dri ba lung bstan pas ngas khyod kyi sems rangs par bya'o/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / /khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dbul por gyur pa las ji ltar dbul ba ma mchis par 'gyur zhing / bro nad kyis thebs na yang bro nad ma mchis par 'gyur ba lags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen bzhin du khyim bdag zla ba bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyim bdag khyod ci'i phyir dbul po'i don du 'dri/ de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni dbul ba mang ba dang / gso ba mang ba dang / bu pho dang / bu mo mang ba dang / gza' mi mang po dang ldan pa lags te/ de'i slad du gang gis sems can dbul po rnams kyi dbul ba ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / bro nad kyis thebs pa rnams bro nad ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / mdzod dang / bang mdzod mang po dang ldan

par 'gyur ba dang / sdug pa dang / yid du mchi ba dang / mthong na yid du 'thad pa dang / dbang phyug tu 'gyur ba dang / sbyin bdag mdzod pas mi 'tshal zhing / dbyig dang / gser dang / nor dang / 'bru'i mdzod dang / bang mdzod rnams dang / nor bu dang / mu tig dang / rdo rje dang / bai ḍūr+ya dang/ dung dang / man shel dang / byi ru dang / sa le sbram dang / dbul bas ma 'tshal cing 'byor bar 'gyur ba dang / khyim gyi bu smad dang / bza' mi rnams brtan par 'gyur ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs de bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par bshad du gsol/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag zla ba bzang po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /khyim bdag 'das pa'i dus bskal pa grangs med pa 'das par gyur pa de'i tshe de'i dus na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i/ kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i dbyangs zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ste/ rigs kyi bu ngas de bzhin gshegs pa de las nor gyi rgyun ces bya ba'i gzungs 'di thos te/ bzung zhing bcangs bklags/ kun chub par byas/ rjes su yi rang bar byas shing / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan te/ rigs kyi bu da yang ngas de bshad pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzungs 'di'i mthus mi rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /mi ma yin pa rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /gnod sbyin rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /srin po rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /yi dgas rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /sha za rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /'byung po rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /

grul bum rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /brjed byed rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /gnon po rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /lus srul po rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /lha rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /lha ma yin rnams rnam par tho 'tsham par mi byed do/ /zas su mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang / zas su gcin 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su khrag 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su sha za ba rnams dang / zas su rnag 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su zhag za ba rnams dang / zas su rkang za ba rnams dang / zas su ngar snabs za ba rnams dang / zas su stor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su dbugs rngub pa dang / 'byung ba za ba'i bar rnams rnam par 'tshe bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di dag rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gi khyim na yod dam/ snying la yod dam/ lag na yod dam/ glegs bam du chud dam/ thos par gyur tam/ kun chub par byas sam/ bklags sam/ bzung ngam/ rjes su yi rang bar byas sam/ gzhan dag la rgya cher rab tu bstan pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de la yun ring po'i don dang / phan pa dang / dge ba dang / grub pa dang / bde ba dang / lo legs par 'gyur ro/ /su zhig de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la mchod pa byas te/ nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di nam phyed na lan gnyis sam/ lan gsum mam/ lan bzhi bton na de'i lha yi rangs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la dga' ba dang / chos gdags pa byas pas dga' ba dang / dge 'dun gdags pa byas pas dga' ba dang / chos smra ba la dga' ba dang / lhag pa'i bsam pas bdag nyid 'ongs te/ 'bru'i char 'bes so/ /na mo badz+ra dha ra sā ga ra ni r+gho ṣā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ su rū pe/ bha dre/ bha dra ba ti/ aṅga le/

maṅga le/ maṅga la ba ti/ a le/ a tsa le/ a tsa la ba le/ ud+gha ta ni/ ud bhe da ni/ pa s+ya ba ti/ dā na pa ti/ dha n+ya pa ti/ shrī ma ti/ pra bha ba ti/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ nirma le/ ru ru/ su rū be/ su rū pa ma le/ bi ma le/ tsa le/ a tsa na ste/ an na ste/ bin na ste/ bi shwa ke shi/ bi shwa ni shi/ aṅku re/ maṅku re/ pra baṅku re/ bī ra me/ bi dha me/ ri ri me/ di di me/ du du me/ kha kha me/ ta ta re/ ta ra ta ra/ tā ra tā ra/ badz+re badz+re badz+re ba me/ ṭa ke ṭa ke/ ṭha ke ṭha ke/ ug+ke bug+ke/ ṭha ke ṭha ra ke/ a brta ni ba ra sha na/ ṣa da ni badz+ra dhā ra sā ga ra nir+gha ṣā na/ ta thā ga ta ma nu sma ra/ sma ra sma ra/ sarba ta thā ga ta sat+ya ma nu sma ra/ dharma sat+ya ma nu sma ra/ saṅg+gha sat+ya ma nu sma ra/ da ta da ta/ pū ra pū ra/ pū ra ya pū ra ya/ pū ra ṇi/ bha ra bha ra ṇi/ a ma le/ su maṅga la/ shān+ta ma ti/ shu bha ma ti/ maṅga la bha ni/ ma hā ma ti/ ma hā ma ti/ bha dra ba ti/ pra bha ba ti/ su tsan+d+ra ma ti/ ā gats+tsha/ ā gats+tsha/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ ā ba ra ṇi ma nu sma ra swā hā/ pra bha ba ma nu sma ra swā hā/ dī dī ma nu smar swā hā/ te dzo ma nu s+a ra swā hā/ bi dza ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ hṛ da ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ sarba satwa bi na ya ma nu sma ra swā hā/ oṃ ba su dhā re swā hā/ oṃ pa su shri ye swā hā/ oṃ shri ba su swā hā/ oṃ ba su swā hā/ rigs kyi bu 'di ni nor gyi rgyun ces bya ba'i gzungs te/ gzungs sngags 'di'i mthus mu ge dang / nad dang / 'chi ngas 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu su zhig de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa byas te/ nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag nub gcig bton na/ de nas dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /rgyas pa'i don du bdag gi khyim mam/ gzhan gyi khyim mam/ gnas gtsang ma bang mdzod dam/ gnas gang du yang rung bar de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / sangs rgyas dang /

byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / gsang sngags kyi lha'i phyir tsan+dan gyis dkyil 'khor gru bzhir byas te/ nub gcig bton na/ rigs kyi bu de'i khyim nor bu dang / 'bru dang / gser dngul dang / yo byad thams cad kyi rgyun mi chen po'i tshang tsam gyis gang bar 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa dang / gnod pa thams cad kyang med par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir khyod rab tu bsgrims la nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di zung zhing / chongs shig /lhogs shig /ston cig /gzhan dag la yang dag par rab tu ston cig dang / de khyod kyi yun ring po'i don dang / phan pa dang / bde bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das legs so zhes gsol te/ khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos bcom ldan 'das las nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di thos nas tshim zhing dga' la mgu zhing yi rangs te/ rab tu dga' nas/ dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis nor gyi rgyun ces bgyi ba blangs lags/ gzungs su zin lags/ bzung lags/ bklags lags/ kun chub par bgyis lags/ rjes su yi rang bar bgyis lags te/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan par bgyi lags so/ /de'i skad cig tsam la khyim bdag zla ba bzang po'i bang mdzo rnams yongs su gang bar gyur to/ /de nas khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos bcom ldan 'das la lan 'bum phrag du mar bskor ba byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad nas song ngo / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod song la khyim bdag zla ba bzang po'i khyim nor dang / 'brus yongs su gang ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / mdzod chen po dang / bang mdzod yongs su gang ba rnams la ltos/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom

ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan nas kau shwam+bī'i grong khyer chen po ga la ba dang / khyim bdag zla ba bzang po'i khyim ga la ba der song ste phyin nas nang du zhugs pa dang / nor dang / 'brus yongs su gang ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / rin po che phun sum tshogs pa dang / yo byed thams cad kyi mdzod chen po dang / bang mdzod rnams kyang yongs su gang bar mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang tshim zhing dga' la mgu zhing yi rangs te rab tu dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo ya mtshan du 'dzin cing / dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gis khyim bdag zla ba bzang po nor mang ba mdzod chen po dang / bang mdzod rnams kyang nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu khyim bdag zla ba bzang po dad cing mchog tu dad cing dge ba'i bsam pa can des nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs 'di bzung zhing rab tu bton te/ blangs shing / bklags/ kun chub par byas/ rjes su yi rang bar byas shing / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /kun dga' bo de'i phyir khyod kyis kyang nor gyi gzungs 'di long zhig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /ston cig /zung shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston cig dang / de ni skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / skye bo mang po la bde ba dang / 'jig rten la snying brtse ba dang / skye bo phal po che dang / lha dang / mi rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro/ /kun dga' bo su zhig rig sngags 'di las gzhan du smra ba ni lha dang bcas pa dang / bdud dang bcas pa dang / tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang / dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin

du bcas pa'i 'jig rten na ngas ma mthong ngo / /lan gnyis su bton tam/ lan gsum du bton kyang 'gal bar byed pa de ni gnas med do/ /kun dga' bo gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag ni mi phyed pa yin no/ /kun dga' bo 'di dag ni sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba zad pa rnams kyi rna lam du grags par mi 'gyur na glegs bam la yi ger bri ba dang / yid la gzung ba lta ci smos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal te/ gzungs sngags 'di ni sems can dbul po dang / nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba dang / 'jigs pa dang / sems can sdang bas gnod par byas pa thams cad kyi don du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa dang / bshad pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang / rab tu phye ba dang / bsngags pa dang / bkrol ba dang / gsal bar mdzad pa dang / bskyed pa dang / byin gyis brlabs pa dang / chos kyi phyag rgyas btab pa dang / bstod pa dang / snyan par brjod pa dang / go bar mdzad pa dang / bsnyad pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las langs te/ de'i tshe thal mo sbyar nas ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod cing tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /sangs rgyas chos kyang bsam gyis mi khyab lags/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa la dad rnams kyis/ /rnam par smin pa 'ang bsam gyis mi khyab lags/ /zhi ba ci yang mkhyen pa thams cad mkhyen/ /chos kyi rgyal po rga shi mi mnga' ba/ /ye shes pha rol bgrod par phyin gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo tshim zhing dga' la mgu zhing yi rangs nas rab tu dga' ste/ dga' ba dang yid bde ba skyes nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis

bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo 'di ni khyim bdag zla ba bzang pos zhus pa zhes bya bar zung shig /nor dang / 'bru dang / rin po che thams cad kyi gter zhes bya bar yang zung shig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bsngags pa nor gyi rgyun gyi gzungs zhes bya bar yang zung shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / dge slong de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa nor gyi rgyun ces bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das nor rgyun ma'i rtog pa bshad par bya ste/ dang po re zhig dpyid zla tha chungs kyi dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes gcig la rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor song ste/ de nas nu ma'i bar chu'i nang du nub par byas te 'dug la nyi ma la mngon du phyogs par yongs su brtags la ji snyed gnas kyi bar du bzlas pa bya'o/ /bza' ba thams cad spangs te/ nyon mongs shing smra bcad byas te/ nub bdun du bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma'i thang sku yang dbu skra ma gtogs pa gur gum dang / tsan+dan gyis byug par bya ba ni nub mo snga bar langs te/ chur khru bdun zheng du khru gsum ste/ khru bcu dang bcas pa la tshon sna ma lus pa gso sbyong dang ldan pa'i lha bzos bcom ldan 'das ma mdog ljang ser sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa na 'bras bu chen po bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pa na sgrub pa po rnams la ster ba'i rin po che'i za ma tog mu tig dang / rdo rje pha lam dang / bai ḍūr+ya'i 'bras bu can bsnams pa'i phyag dang ldan pa bya'o/ /steng du lha'i bu rin po che'i char mngon du 'bebs bzhin pa bya'o/ /g.yas logs su dpal chen mo pad+ma'i phyag can sgrub pa po la nye bar dgongs pa la gnas bzhin pa bya'o/ /g.yon logs

su pad+ma'i dpal rin po che yis snyim pa gang ba bya'o/ /'og tu sgrub pa po pad+ma'i lag pa can bya'o/ /de nas thang sku sku gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du nub phyogs su kha bstan la bkram ste/ de nas nye bar spyod pa'i gtor ma ma gtogs pa mdzod kyi bzhes pa yang dbul zhing dri zhim po'i me tog gis mchod pa chen po byas la tsan+dan dang a ga ru'i bdug pas bsreg par bya'o/ /zhun mar gyi mar me brgya dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas stan gcig la gnas te bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhal la dmigs la nub mo mtshan bzlas pa byas na/ de nas skya rengs shar ba'i dus su skyes bu chen po tsam gyi nor rin po che thams cad kyi rgyun 'bab cing khang pa gang bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na mtshan mo phyed na chu'i nang du zhu gsal brgyad brgya bzlas par bya'o/ /zla ba gcig tu gcig gi sbyor bas nor gyi rgyun 'bab par 'gyur te/ mi shes par kha cig 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na rgyal po'i dkor mngon par 'dod na nyin mo chu'i nang du bzlas pa bya zhing mtshan mo'i phyed na til gyi sbyin sreg brgyad brgya byas na rgyal rigs las rnyed pa chen po thob bo/ /yungs kar mar las bsres nas sbyin sreg byas na rgyal po dbang du byed do/ /kun du ra'i sbyin sreg byas na rgyal po'i blon po dbang du byed do/ /kha cig gis sbyor ba gang gis mtshan mo bcom ldan 'das pad+ma'i gdan can dran par byas na sbyin bdag chen por 'gyur ro/ /yang na sgrub thabs chen po bshad par bya ste/ cho 'phrul gyi dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes gcig nas brtsams te/ zas ci srid du bcad nas gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du thang ka nub phyogs su bstan la dgram zhing / nyin mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bklag cing mtshan mo stan gcig la gnas pas nub yal gyis bzlas pa byas na nor gyi phung po chen po rnyed de/ 'thor gnod byas kyang 'dzad par mi 'gyur te/ lha khang chen po bya'o/ /cho ga 'di'i cho 'phrul gyi dkar po'i phyogs la bzlas pa byas na 'khor los sgyur ba thob cing / bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma dngos su mthong zhing phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems

dpar 'gyur ro/ /ci ltar de ltar tshangs spyod bya zhing kha na ma tho ba'i zas chang dang / nya sha la sogs pa spang zhing mtshan mo bzlas pa byas na dbul por mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la 'phags pa kun dga' bo dang / zla ba bzang po yongs su dga' nas khyim bdag zla ba bzang po'i don du gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma'i rtog pa rdzogs so// //na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ ba sudha re swā hā/ snying po'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ ba su shrī swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ ba su swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'i yang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /thal mo sbyar te gung mo gnyis dang de nas srin lag gnyis dang / mthe'u chung gnyis gshibs te/ sdigs mdzub phan tshun gnyis sgrel la/ mthe'u chung gnyis cung zhig bsnol te/ rtse mo gnyis rgyab sprad de khab lta bu byas la/ gung mo sprad pa la mtheb mo zung cig de'i 'og tu sbyar te/ rig pa bcas pa ni rab tu bzung ba'i rtog pa las gsungs pa ste/ las thams cad sgrub pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma'i gzungs ni thub pas gsungs pa'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ shrī ye shrī ye ka ri/ dha na ka ri/ dha na ka ri/ dha na ka ri swā hā/ bsgrub par bya ba'i sngags so/ /rig pa 'di'i dang po re shig dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni sor mo rnams thal mo sbyar la mtheb chen dbus su bcug pa ni bcom ldan 'das ma'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /oṃ sa ma ye/ sa me sa ma ya ka ri/ ma hā sa ma ye swā hā/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang sngags so/ /phyag rgya de nyid las gung mo dang sdigs mdzub kyi tshigs gsum pa bskul zhing mtheb chung gnyis cung zad phyir phyung ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /'di ni dbab pa dang / bsdu ba dang / bsgrub bya'i sngags kyis bya'o/ /phyag rgya de nyid la sdigs mdzub gnyis brkyang ba ni me tog gi phyag rgya yin te/ oṃ ba sun dhe swā hā/ me tog gi phyag rgya de nyid las gung mo brkyang ba ni bdug spos kyi phyag rgya yin te/ sngags ni/ oṃ ba su

dha ri swā hā/ phyag rgya 'di ni ming med brkyang ba'i phyag rgya yin te/ sngags ni/ oṃ ba su dha ma ti shrī ye swā hā/ phyag rgya 'di nyid la mtheb chung gi sen mo mtheb chen gyis bkab ste/ sor mo gzhan rnams ni rdo rje'i mtshan nyid du byas pa ni mar me'i phyag rgya ste/ sngags ni/ oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇi swā hā/ sen mo gan rkyal du byas la mthe bong gnyis logs su sbyar ba ni gtor ma'i phyag rgya ste/ sngags ni/ oṃ ba sudhā ri ṇi swā hā/ lhag ma nye bar spyod pa nyi shu rtsa ba'i sngags kyi thun mong gi phyag rgya'am/ sngags kyis basprub par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i thang ka'i cho ga ni nyams pa med cing / skra'i nyams pa med pa skud pa ma chad pa'i ras zheng du mtho gang gi tshad nyid la ring du mtho do byas te steng du bcom ldan 'das bri/ g.yas su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs bya/ g.yon du rdo rje 'chang bya/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'og thang ka'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das ma bri ste/ gser gyi mdog can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gos srab mo'i sham kag mnabs pa/ de bzhin du gos srab mo'i stod g.yogs can kha dog sna tshogs kyi gos kyi sham thabs dang ldan pa'o/ /de nas 'og phyogs su sgrub pa po lag na mchod pa'i cho ga bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa pos gtsang sbra byas gos gtsang ma gyon te/ gso sbyong yan lag brgyad bya'o/ /de'i mdun du bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig byas la ji ltar 'byor pas mchod pas cho ga bya'o/ /de nas sgrub po dang ldan pas smyung ba byas te/ zhing gi dbus su thang sku bzhugs su gsol te/ dri dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / nye bar longs spyod pa'i gtor ma byas la brgyad brgya bzlas par bya'o/ /thang ka'i 'og tu lan brgya rtsa gcig gis bsngags byas pa'i bum pa chus yongs su gang ba gzhag par bya'o/ /bum pa'i chus gtor ma btang zhing / glang bu dang thong 'dzin gnyis la gtor bar bya'o/ /glang bu'i mgul pa dang / thong 'dzin gyi mgul bar me tog gi phreng ba gdags par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi mdun du sngags pas chu yi rgyun zhing la lan g.yas

logs su bskor bar bya ba ni sngags pas mdun du 'gro zhing sngags pa'i steng ni zhing rmor 'gro bar bya'o/ /phyis sa bon 'debs pa'i dus su cho ga 'dis brgyad brgya sngags la sa bon spar ba gang la lan bdun bzlas te zhing la gtor bar bya'o/ /sa bon gdabs pa'i cho ga'o/ /da ni zhing rnga ba'i dus su yang cho ga 'dis bya'o/ /cho ga lhag pa ni 'dir dge slong bzhi la zhing gi mtshams bzhir ci 'dod ston mo byas te/ de nas sngags pas chad pa bdun bzlas pa byed cing rnga ba ni lo tog rtsa ba byas pa'i cho ga'o/ /da ni g.yul 'chag pa bya'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ g.yul 'chag pa'i dus su sngags pas rang nyid gtsang sbra byas la gos gtsang ma gon la shar du zhal bstan te/ sku gzugs bzhugs su gsol la dri dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / yang na nye bar longs spyod pa'i gtor ma byas la bzlas pa byas te/ 'bru'i phung po'i mtshams bzhir gzhon nu ma gsar du bag ma byas shing khyo yod pa'i bud med bzhi la ston mo byas la/ de snyed kyi mthar zad pa med par gnas so/ /de nas skyes bus 'bru 'jal zhing grangs byed pa'i dpral ba la sngags dgod par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i sngags de snyed du smra bcad byas la bzlas pa bya'o/ /ji snyed du sngo la bltas na gnyis 'gyur du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /de snyed bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas 'bru'i lhag ma de mi 'jal bar 'chings pa'i mi la sogs pa bos shing sbyin pa'am/ dge 'dun la sbyin par bya'o/ /g.yul 'chag pa'i cho ga'o/ /da ni 'bru bang mdzod du 'jug pa'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ dang po re zhig mdzod kyi sgo g.yas g.yon du 'byung po gnyis gcer bu gsus pa 'phyang ba/ dbang po 'phyang ba/ g.yon pa'i lag na 'bru'i snod bzung zhing 'bru skyug bzhin pa/ gser gyi mdog /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa gnyis bri bar bya'o/ /mdzod kyi khang par yang dri dang / byug pa dang / mchod yon sbyin zhing gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i thang ka'i mdzod kyi nang du bzhugs par bya'o//

de nas 'o ma'i chu rgyun gtor bzhin pa'i sngags pas 'gro bar bya zhing / de'i rgyab nas de nas bri bar khyim du gzhug par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la 'bru'i mdzod khang du phyag rgya gzhag par bya'o/ /de nas mdzod kyi khang pa'i sgo ru dge 'dun gyi ston mo byas la dri dang / me tog dang / bdug pa la sogs pas mchod do/ /nor rgyun ma'i gzungs rdzogs par bklag par bya'o/ /gtor ma rgya chen po byas la thang ka'i mdun du de nas skyes bus 'bru phyir 'byin par byed de/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang 'dra bar bsam la gur gum gyis gro ga la sngags bris la spyi bor bcings la kha gos kyis bkab la nyi ma re re zhing 'bru phyir dbyung bar bya'o/ /mdzod khang gi sgo ru nyin re nor rgyun ma zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi mdo bklag par bya'o/ /sngags pas bsgrub bya'i sngags bltas la dus gsum du brgyad brgya bzlas par bya'o/ /ji ltar rnyed pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma nor rgyun ma'i gzungs kyi rtog pa rdzogs so// ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ga ṇa pa ti hṛ da ya/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri la dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sha stag dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo gang la la tshogs kyi bdag po tshogs kyi dbang phyug gi snying po 'dzin na de'i las thams cad grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzung bas dgos pa 'grub cing gsang sngags thams cad kyang dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /tad+ya thā/ na mo stu te ma hā ga ṇa pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ ha na ha na/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ dhā ba dhā ba/ bhañdza bhañdza/ stam̐ bha stam̐ bha/ dzam̐ bha dzaṃ bha/ mo ha mo ha/ de hi de hi/ dā pa ya dā pa ya/ dhā na dhā n+ya sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/

sa ma ya ma nu sma ra ma hā ru dra ba tsa nī ye swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ su ru su ru swā hā/ oṃ mu ru mu ru swā hā/ oṃ pā pa shām̐ ti ba su puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ aṅg+gu ta bin+du k+ṣu bhi ta tsit+ta ma hā bi dā raḥsamā gats+tsha ti/ ma hā bha ya/ ma hā ba la/ ma hā pa ra kra ma/ ma hā ha sti/ ma hā dak+ṣi ṇi ya pra tsi da ya mi swā hā/ ta d+ya thā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ oṃ gaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥ/ oṃ na mo na maḥswā hā/ kun dga' bo rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la zhig tshogs kyi bdag po tshogs kyi dbang phyug gi snying po 'di rtsom zhing gsang sngags sgrub pa/ dkon mchog gsum mchod du yul gzhan du 'gro'am/ rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du 'jug na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la me tog dang / bdug pas mchod pa byas te/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po 'di bklags na las thams cad 'grub kyis 'di la the tshom ma za shig /'thab pa dang / rtsod pa dang / khrag khrug dang / yul 'khrugs pa thams cad kyi nang du yang dran par byas na thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /nyin gcig bzhin du nang bar langs nas tshig tu bton na thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyis mdangs 'phrog par mi 'gyur zhing thag ring por yongs su spong bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po rdzogs so// //༄༅༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā ga na pa ti tan+t+ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ tshogs kyi bdag po chen po'i rgyud ces bya ba/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas dpal ldan tshogs bdag che/ /phyag 'tshal dpal ldan tshogs bdag dgyes/ /gzugs brnyan

maṇ+ḍal gru bzhir bzhag /zla ba drug tu mchod par bya/ /lha yi 'khor los sgyur ba dang / /tshe 'di nyid la skal ba mnyam/ /bsod nams chen po thob par 'gyur/ /longs spyod lha dang mnyam pa dang / /tshe yang ring ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /mi la sogs pa dbang du 'gyur/ /lha yi bu yang bran bzhin 'gyur/ /bdag gi bsgo ba nyan par 'gyur/ /klu yang de yi bsgo ba nyan/ /bran bzhin las rnams byed par 'gyur/ /lha yi longs spyod mnga' ris las/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dngos grub sgrub pa'i skal ba can/ /gdul bya'i dbang gi sku sprul pa/ /lha chen tshogs bdag chen pos bya/ /dngos grub dam pa mchog sgrub na/ /mthu stobs phun sum tshogs ldan zhing / /longs spyod yid bzhin 'phel bar byed/ /'jig rten phan mdzad lha yi lha/ /gang gis mchod pa dngos grub yin/ /lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po'i rgyud las dngos grub 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas dben pa'i gnas su ni/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi dag bya ste/ /ba yi lci bas legs par byug /'jam zhing mnyen la dbus mtho ba'i/ /dbus su tshogs bdag sku gzugs bzhugs/ /me tog dkar pos de la gtor/ /bdag nyid gcer bur byung byas te/ /log 'dren gzugs kyis yang dag mchod/ /ba ra ta ka zla ba drug /nyin re bzhin du dus gsum du/ /gsang sngags brgya ni rtsa brgyad bzlas/ /yid la re ba thams cad rdzogs/ /bsam pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /oṃ ni bkra shis dpal dang ldan/ /gsang sngags mgo la gzhag par bya/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi/ /dngos grub ster byed yi ge yang / /de 'og gral la gzhag par bya/ /nyi ma lta bu'i yi ge yang / /de yi rjes la bklag par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang po/ /yi ge mchog ni blang bar bya/ /gsal byed yi ge dang po yang / /de yi mjug tu brjod par bya/ /rin chen yi ge swā zhes bya/ /las kyi yi ge hā zhes bya/ /dngos grub 'dod

pas gsang sngags bzlas/ /lha chen dngos grub sgrub pa'i rgyud las lha'i dngos grub kyi gsang sngags bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis po'o// //de nas tshogs kyi bdag po bshad/ /tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dkar/ /glang po che yi mgo bo can/ /mche ba ya gcig chag pa dang / /phyag g.yas la phug bsnams pa/ byi ba'i gdan la bcibs pa/ rin po ches sku brgyan pa/ zla ba tshes pas dbu brgyan pa/ 'od gsal ba/ 'od zer 'phro ba/ mdog bzang ba/ kha dog bzang ba/ gsus pa che ba/ rgyan gyis spud pa'o/ /dngos grub sgrub pa'i rgyud las tshogs kyi bdag po bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par me tog dkar po blangs te/ tshogs kyi bdag po'i sku gzugs bris te/ kha dog dkar po glang po che'i dbu can/ phyag g.yas na la phug bsnams pa/ g.yon na rin po che'i nor bu bsnams pa/ gsus pa che ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zla ba dang byi ba'i khri la bzhugs pa mkhas pas bya'o/ /de la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bdag la zhal phyogs par bzhag la/ bdag nyid log 'dren gyi gzugs kyis yang dag par mchod do/ /tshogs kyi bdag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa sgrub pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas dbang ldan gyi mtshams su tshogs kyi bdag po dkar po glang po che'i mgo can/ byi ba la zhon pa/ mig gsum pa/ zla ba phyed pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas na la phug dang dgra sta 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa tri shūl dang thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa khu tshur bcangs pa'i mdzub mo dang gung mo brkyang la mdzub mo bkug la gung mo'i tshigs su bzung bar bya ba ni tshogs kyi bdag po'i phyag rgya'o/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i phyag rgya bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas gsang sngags bstan pa ni/ /oṃ ni dpal ldan mgo la bzhag /de nas yid bzhin nor bu ni/ /rin po che yi yi ge bri/ /sde tshan gsal byed dang po yang / /de yi rjes su bri bar bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i

mtshan dang po/ /dbyangs yig brgyad pas mdzes par bya/ /gsal byed dang po'i yi ge yang / /blo yis blangs te yid kyis bri/ /sde tshan gsum pas gsum pa la/ /dang po'i bzhi pa sbyar bar bya/ /sde tshan bdun pa'i gsum pa la/ /gsum pa'i dang pos 'og tu sbyar/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i yi ge la/ /bzhi pa'i lnga pa zla la bzhag /dbyangs yig gsum pas brgyan par bya/ /bzhi pa'i gsum pas de nas brjod/ /dngos grub bsgrub pa'i yi ge ni/ /de yi rjes la bri bar bya/ /gsang sngags drag po'i yi ge yang / /kun gyi mthar ni brjod par bya/ /gsang sngags 'di yi dngos grub ni/ /'jig rten dbang phyug nyid kyis byin/ /dgos pa thams cad grub par 'gyur/ /tshogs bdag chen po'i gsang sngags bstan pa'i le'u sta drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang gsungs pa ni/ /dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa yi/ /mtshan gyi gsang sngags zhes bya ba'i/ /dngos grub bsgrub pa'i snying po ni/ /dpal dang yaṃ gi yi ge ste/ /oṃ zhes bya ba mgo la bzhag /yid bzhin nor bu'i yi ge las/ /nyi ma'i yi ge 'og tu spras/ /dbyangs yig drug pa'i 'og tu sbyar/ /thig le nā das brgyan par bya/ /mtshan gyi dang po'i yi ge ni/ /de yi rjes la brjod par bya/ /bzhi pa'i lnga pa de nas sbyar/ /lnga pa'i dang po bri bar bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang po/ /'byung ba rlung gi yi ge yang / /dbyangs yig brgyad pas brgyan pa ni/ /de yi rjes la bri bar bya/ /zhi ba'i yig 'bru gnyis pa yang / /kun gyi mthar ni brjod par bya/ /mtshan gyi gsang sngags zhes bya ba/ /'dod pa thams cad grub byed yin/ /mtshan gyi gsang sngags bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad par bya/ /skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par ni/ /me tog dkar po'i rtsa ba blang / /tsan+dan dkar po dag las ni/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i sku gzugs ni/ /mthe bong gi ni tshad tsam bya/ /gsus pa chel phyag bzhi pa/ /mkhas

pas byas te legs par bya/ /rin po che yi snod du gzhug /dkar chen mngon par gsal ba'i tshe/ /nang gi cha ris sku khrus gsol/ /gsal zhing dang sa la yid du 'ong / /dri dang ldan pa'i bum pa yi/ /me tog dkar po'i dri yi ni/ /'dag chal ldan pas khrus bya'o/ /de nas de ma thag tu ni/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su spyan drangs la/ /me tog dkar po dbul bar bya/ /la phug la dur bcas pa yi/ /gtor ma chen po'ang de nas dbul/ /spos dang dri dang mar me dang / /lha bshos dag gis mchod par bya/ /gsang sngags 'di la phug dang / /la du dang / chu dang / dkar gsum gyi gtor mas tshogs kyi bdag po la phul te/ spos dang me tog rnams kyang dbul/ de ltar byas na phyis bgegs byed par mi nus so/ /tshogs kyi bdag po mchod pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas la phug ces bya ba/ /ro brgyad ldan pa'i yungs ma ste/ /zas rnams kun gyi mchog kyang yin/ /ro mchog brgyad dang ldan pa yin/ /kha dang skyur dang bska ba dang / /mngar dang tsha dang lan tshwa'i ro/ /bzhun dang bro mchog che ba yin/ /nad sna brgyad kyi gnyen po yin/ /mkhris pa bad kan 'dus pa dang / /khrag dang chu ser ma zhu ba/ /rlung dang rims nad kun la phan/ /'di 'dra byung ba'i kha zas med/ /lha rnams kun gyi mchu yang 'gul/ /dngos grub 'grub pa'i zhal zas yin/ /tshogs kyi bdag po mchod par bya/ /la du zhes bya'i zhal zas ni/ /mngar gsum 'bras bu gsum pa ni/ /de bzhin zhim pa'i spos kyis bran/ /bag zan gyi ni ril bu bya/ /'o ma mar du btsos byas la/ /tshogs pa'i gtor ma chen po bya/ /mar dang khur ba mngar gsum dang / /mthun pa'i zhal zas sna tshogs kyis/ /tshogs bdag chen po mchod par bya/ /de ltar tshogs kyi bdag po la'o/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i sku gzugs lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du bzhugs la/ sems gzhan du ma yengs par bzlas brjod 'bum byas

la/ la phug la sngags kyis btab ste tshogs kyi bdag po mchod na tshe 'di nyid la 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang bsod nams mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /me tog dkar pos mchod na rgyal po la sogs pas pham par mi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po la sogs pa sgrub par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po dang blon po la sogs pa bdag gi dbang du 'dus par 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub sgrub pa'i zhal zas bstan pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas cho ga bshad par bya/ /dngul zhes bya ba'i rin chen la/ /tshogs bdag chen po'i gzugs byas te/ /yid bzhin nor bu lag na thogs/ /dkyil 'khor chen po khru gang tshad/ /rin chen me tog dkar po dgram/ /gsang sngags 'bum du bzlas byas pas/ /nad dang sdug bsngal zhi bar 'gyur/ /shel dang dung las chogs bdag sku/ /mkhas pas ji ltar 'byor par bya/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar 'gyur/ /rin chen shel las tshogs bdag sku/ /mthe bong gi ni tshad tsam bya/ /se na pra zhes bya ba'i sngags/ /rig pa 'bum du bzlas byas te/ /shel gyi sku de khrus byas nas/ /skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par ni/ /bdag nyid shar du kha bltas nas/ /gos dkar gyon te khrus byas la/ /thal sbyar yid kyis gsol ba gdab/ /bdag la gnod pa'i bgegs gang yin/ /shel gyi sku de me long steng / /mi g.yo mi 'gul rab tu bzhugs/ /bdag nyid khrus byas shar du blta/ /dza ra pa dang rkun ma ni/ /gang yin me long nang du 'byung / /de tshe de yi ngos zin 'gyur/ /tshogs bdag shel gyi sku de ni/ /mchod pa rab gsal legs byas la/ /nā ga ku ru zhes bya ba'i/ /rig pa 'bum du bzlas byas na/ /nad dang sdug bsngal gyis nyen la/ /sku de bstan pa tsam gyis ni/ /nad rnams thams cad sos par 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal las kyang thar bar 'gyur/ /zhi ba chen po'i cho ga yin/ /rin chen gser zhes bya ba la/ /tshogs bdag chen po'i sku byas te/ /rgyal gyi nyin par mig phye nas/ /mchod pa rab tu gnas pa bya/ /ba

ra zhes bya'i gsang sngags ni/ /'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas pa yis/ /sku gzugs bzhugs pa'i khyim der ni/ /nor rnams thams cad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /gser gyi tshogs bdag mthong ba yis/ /bgegs rnams thams cad nor 'bul 'gyur/ /bgegs kyis gnod pa mi nus te/ /rgyal po bzhin du mchod par 'gyur/ /gser gyi tshogs bdag gnas pa yi/ /sa phyogs rin chen char pa 'bebs/ /gser gyi tshogs kyi bdag po la/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po thams cad kyis/ /nor rnams thams cad 'bul ba yin/ /bdag nyid phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i sku gzugs mchog /byas pa'i yon tan rnams la ni/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis gter kha 'byed/ /skye ba 'di dang phyi ma la/ /rtag tu yo byad 'phel bar 'gyur/ /nor gyi bdag po rnam thos bus/ /rgyal po bzhin du bsnyen bkur byed/ /de nas dpal ldan tshogs bdag gi/ /sku gzugs dkyil 'khor gru bzhir gzhag /bha ga zhes bya'i gsang sngags ni/ /bzlas pa 'bum du byas pa yis/ /tshe de nyid la dngos grub ni/ /ci 'dod pa ni sbyin par mdzad/ /lha yi rgyal po'i mnga' thang ni/ /sgrub pa po la stsol bar mdzad/ /shin tu thugs rje'i bdag nyid pas/ /dpal ldan tshogs bdag thugs rje can/ /thugs rje'i phung pos dbul ba skyob/ /nor lha chen po'i bdag nyid 'di/ /dar ram ras la legs bris te/ /rgyal gyi nyin par spyan phye nas/ /gang gi khyim du bzhugs pa de'i/ /sa phyogs de ni bkra shis 'gyur/ /zangs la tshogs bdag chen po'i sku/ /mkhas pas legs par bzo byas te/ /tsan+dan dmar pos byugs pa'i sar/ /maṇ+ḍal steng du legs par bzhag /ban+du ka yi me tog dang / /pad+ma rā ga rin chen dang / /me tog dmar po kun gyis mchod/ /braṃ zhes bya ba'i rig sngags bzlas/ /rgyal po'i bu mo dbang du 'gyur/ /lha yi bu mo klu mo dang / /mi'am ci yi bu mo dang / /
