༄༅༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa ra pad+ma dzā la mū la tan+t+ra rā dza nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma dra ba zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la gus par phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das hi ma la ya'i tshal chen po tsan+dan sdong po dang myu gu rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs chen po dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te/ 'di lta ste/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa ga ya 'od srung dang / tshe dang ldan pa rlangs pa 'od srung dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun 'ged gzhon nu dang / tshe dang ldan pa ma 'gags pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / tshe dang ldan pa maud gal gyi bu chen po dang / tshe dang ldan pa rab 'byor la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po stong nyis brgya lnga bcu dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'di lta ste/ pad+ma dkar po dang / nyi 'od dang / gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal po dang / pad+ma'i spyan dang / ye shes dbang phyug dang / pad+ma'i dbang phyug dang / rdo rje snying po dang / rin chen snying po dang / kun tu bzang po dang / sgrib pa rnam par sel ba dang / nam mkha'i snying po dang / byams pa dang / 'jam dpal dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug dang / phyag na rdo rje dang / blo gros mi zad pa dang / nam mkha'i mdzod dang / blo gros rgya mtsho dang / mthu chen po thob pa dang / zla 'od dang / dra ba can gyi 'od dang / spobs pa brtsegs pa dang / mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad sel ba'i blo gros la sogs pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po grangs med pa dang / gzhan yang gtsor byams pa la gnas pa'i dge slong mang po dang / dge slong ma mang po dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma mang po dang / lha'i tshogs dang / klu'i tshogs dang / de bzhin du gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang /

grul bum dang / sha za dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa bye ba phrag drug dang / khro bo chen po rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang / rdo rje gshin rje gshed dang / rdo rje gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / rdo rje rta mgrin dang / rdo rje bgegs mthar byed dang / rdo rje gtsug tor dang / rdo rje gnod mdzes rgyal po la sogs pa bdun cu dang / spyan ma dang / mā ma kī dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma dang / 'od zer can dang / dbyangs can ma dang / phag zhal ma dang / khro gnyer can dang / ri khrod ma dang / dug sel ma dang / nor rgyun ma dang / dkar mo dang / yid bzang ma dang / rnam par rgyal ma dang / dpal phreng mo dang / sa 'dzin bzang mo dang / rdo rje dbang phyug ma la sogs pa stong phrag drug brgya dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe 'khor de dag thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das la bla ma dang / bkur sti dang / rim gror bya ba'i phyir mchod pa du mas mchod cing bsngags pa du mas stod par byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po thugs rje chen po yongs su 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu sa chen po rnam pa drug tu g.yos shing ltas bco brgyad du gyur to/ /de'i ltas de mthong nas lang ka'i rgyal po sgra sgrogs shin tu snyems pa dang ldan nas rang gi 'khor du ma dang lhan cig der lhags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das sgra sgrogs kyi sems kyi rtog pa thugs su chud nas sku'i gnas thams cad nas 'od zer bye ba phrag du ma byung ngo / /'od zer de dang sa g.yos pa de dag gis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyang gsal bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe sgra sgrogs snyems pa dang bcas pas de'i 'khor thams cad kyis 'dzam bu'i gling du yams nad la sogs pas rnam par 'tshe ba de thugs kyis yongs su dgongs nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gdong bcu gcig pa drang srong rig sngags 'chang bye ba phrag brgya stong dang lhan cig bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar lhags nas zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ g.yas phyogs

su bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus lha'i tshogs rnams kyi nang nas lha'i bu rin po che pad+ma'i dra bas brgyan pa zhes bya ba bzhengs te thal mo sbyar te byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye ma mgon po thugs rje can/ /rig sngags 'chang ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ /che ba'i byin brlabs ldan pa rnams/ /sgra sgrogs snyems pa gzhom pa dang / /nyon mongs rtsad nas gdon pa dang / /sems can rnams la phan pa dang / /bdag la shin tu sman pa'i phyir/ /sku dang rjes su mthun pa yi/ /rig sngags sbyor ba khyad par can/ /snying po dam pa bshad du gsol/ /de tshe 'khor tshogs thams cad kyis/ /mkha' phyogs me tog char gyis bkang / /bcom ldan thub pa'i dbu la ni/ /rin chen me tog gdugs su gyur/ /lha rnams gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /yon chab bdug spos dri dang bshos/ /ci 'byor dad pa'i stobs kyis phul/ /thub pas nam mkha'i mdzod du brlabs/ /lha yi bu mo du ma yis/ /rol mo sil snyan 'phan gdugs dang / /bla re rgyal mtshan lhab lhub dang / /lda ldi na bza' du mas mchod/ /de nas mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /pad+ma gzhon nu'i zhal mnga' bas/ /bzhengs 'dzum thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /ston pa la ni 'di skad gsol/ /sgra sgrogs bzhin gyis snyems pa dang / /mda' dang rtsal gyis dregs pa ste/ /'di ni legs brtsams las byung min/ /shin tu log pa las kyang min/ /sngon dus sangs rgyas gdong mdzes kyi/ /bstan pa la yang mgo btang ba'i/ /bsod nams grangs kyis byung ba yin/ /lag pa du mar 'khrul pa ni/ /zas dang snod dang gos nor rgyan/ /bskal pa bzhi bcu'i mchod sbyin te/ /de nas rtsal dang shugs kyang yin/ /mda' ni bh+ring gi ri ti yi/ /byin brlabs sngon du byed mod kyang / /grangs med tshul khrims bral bas ni/ /srin po'i rigs su 'khrungs pa dang / /'khor bcas gzhan la gnod gyur yin/ /ngas ni ngang tshul rmad byung

ba'i/ /lus kyis bde gshegs sbyin pa dang / /sgrub brtson legs byas mtha' yas pa/ /spyod bzang la gnas bsgral ba'i grangs/ /gang gā klung gi rdul dang mtshungs/ /de skad 'bras bu de tsam ste/ /dang po'i las can ci snyed la/ /phan gdags gzhi ni bya ba'i phyir/ /cung zad bsdus nas brjod bya ste/ /legs par nyon la yid la zung / /sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa ni/ /gang gā klung bcu'i snga rol gyi/ /cher 'das ba yi snga rol na/ /bde gshegs rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mtshan/ /man dā ra yi dri zhes bya/ /'jig rten ston pa byung ba'i tshe/ /bdag ni khyim bdag drag por gyur/ /thub pa de la rig sngags mnos/ /thob ma thag tu bskal pa'i grangs/ /bzhi khri snyed kyi 'khor ba snyil/ /de rjes bskal pa gang gā klung / /bye ba snyed gcig snga rol na/ /bde gshegs rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mtshan/ /thogs med pad+ma brgya yi spyan/ /gtsug tor yon tan rab rgyas pa'i/ /'od zer rgyal po zhes bya ba/ /'jig rten ston pa bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /bdag nyid drang srong bdag por gyur/ /rig sngags 'di mnos bsgrubs pa yis/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhal mthong zhing / /skye med chos la bzod pa thob/ /de rjes 'das dus bskal ba ni/ /bye ba phrag brgya'i snga rol na/ /bde gshegs rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mtshan/ /tshe dpag med ces 'jig rten du/ /ston pa byung ba bdag gis mnos/ /de tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /bdag la dbang bskur lung bstan mdzad/ /khyod kyi sngon du bskal pa'i grangs/ /brjod mi lang nas rig sngags phyir/ /yang dag stong phrag stong snyed kyang / /dang po'i mchod sbyin chen po byas/ /bye ba phrag grangs bcu gcig tu/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dbang bskur blangs/ /de dang de yi rnam smin mchog /sangs rgyas zhing khams rab 'byam du/ /yang dang yang du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /phyis ni 'dren pa shākya zhes/ /mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'khrungs tshe/ /mi yul las kyang khyad par du/ /

yi dgas gling du skyes pa 'ga'/ /gtan la 'dud 'phel bya ba'i phyir/ /mtshan mo mun nag sprin rum du/ /skad cig glog 'gyu ci lta bar/ /rig sngags 'chang ba gdong bcu gcig /yan lag stong dang ldan pa la/ /spyan ni chig stong sum cu pa'i/ /mtshan dang ldan pa'i sku 'byung 'gyur/ /de tshe skal ldan la la zhig /mtshan nas brjod cing sku la mos/ /rig sngags zlos pa po gang zhig /'jig rten 'dod pa kun grub cing / /phyi nas ye shes nyis 'gyur ro/ /lung bstan de skad thos pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bcu gcig /grangs snyed zhal nas gsungs pa yi/ /rig sngags snying po gdong bcu gcig /mthu chen thogs pa med pa ste/ /'gro la sman cing bde ba dang / /nad kun sel byed sdig kun sbyong / /bkra shis med pa kun zlog cing / /rmi lam mtshan ma ngan kun sel/ /dus min 'chi dang ngan sems zlog /rtag tu dpal dang sems bde thob/ /mya ngan sdug bsngal ngal ba sel/ /rtsod 'khrug thams cad zhi ba dang / /bdud dang gdon bgegs zhi bar 'gyur/ /'jig rten smon pa kun grub cing / /bdud dang bar chad mtshon cha'i nad/ /dbyig pa brdeg dang bcing ba dang / /btson rar bcug dang mtshon chas brtsal/ /gsod sar khrid dang yan lag bcad/ /mig 'bru mtshon gyis btsab pa dang / /chu dang me dang rlungs g.yos/ /dug dang byad stems ro langs dang / /chom rkun mi ma yin rnams gnon/ /rig sngags 'di yis bsrungs pa dang / /len dang 'dzin dang 'dri ba dang / /klog dang kha ton bshad sogs rnams/ /brtson la 'jig rten lhar bcas dang / /bdud dang tshangs pa dge sbyong dang / /bram zer bcas pas gnod pa med/ /sngon gyi las drag yod pa yang / /byang zhing bsrabs te med par 'gyur/ /nges pa'i dngos po 'di lags pas/ /rig nas mngon sum yid ches par/ /rnam par rtog med sems kyis blang / /de slad skyabs dang skyob pa dang / /srung dang dbugs 'byin dpal mgon dang / /

gling dang khang khyim 'di nyid yin/ /nye ring sa phyogs ci srid par/ /mtshams bcad nas ni rig sngags dang / /'byung po rnams kyis 'tshe ba med/ /gang gis sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal mchod/ /skyabs su 'gro zhing sdig pa bshags/ /mngon par dga' zhing gzungs sngags 'dis/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pa la/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas ma lus pa/ /mtshungs par yi rang legs par sbyin/ /rtsa ba bzhi dang mtshams med lnga/ /ma lus sdig kun byang bar 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin srin po sogs snang yang / /bzung nas byams pa snying rje'i sems/ /dang po bskyed nas bla med kyi/ /byang chub sems mchog sa la dgod/ /gang gā klung brgya'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /mtshan nas brjod cing bstod pa bas/ /rigs kyi bu 'am bu mo gang / /bdag gi ming brjod dran byed cing / /rig sngags rgyun du brjod na de/ /myur du mchog dga'i sa 'thob cing / /lag pa'i mthil nas mthong ba ltar/ /bla med byang chub myur du 'byung / /rtse gcig dran pas gus byas te/ /rtag tu nang par sngar langs nas/ /chos bzhin du ni dge bgyis te/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du gang brjod pa/ /tshe 'dir phan yon bcu thob 'gyur/ /rtag par lus la nad med dang / /lha dang sangs rgyas kun gyis bsrung/ /nor 'bru rin chen gos rnyed dang / /dgra sdang dul zhing 'jigs med dang / /bza' rnams bkur cing rigs btsun thob/ /dug dang 'dre gshin gdon bral dang / /lus la dri zhim kun dga' dang / /bsam ngan mi snyan rjod byed dang / /rims nad bral zhing dgang sla dang / /dus min 'chi ba sangs par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang yon tan bzhi thob ste/ /'chi khar sangs rgyas zhal mthong dang / /mkha' la 'od 'byung lhas mchod dang / /nam yang ngan 'gror mi 'gro zhing / /bde ba can nam bde 'gror skye/ /rig sngags 'di dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /ye shes snying po 'dzin pa la/ /byang chub sems dang sangs rgyas kyi/ /rnam par thar pa'i chos sgo 'thob/ /bskal pa du mar dge bsags dang / /rig sngags 'di rnyed 'gyur ba ste/ /dad

ldan khrel yod ngo tsha shes/ /blo bzang brtson ldan snying rje che/ /mdog dkar ngang bzang gsong por smra/ /sems 'jam lus ngag dal bar spyod/ /bla ma la gus brtul zhugs che/ /sred pa chung zhing sbyin la dga'/ /sangs rgyas gus shing sems bcas pas/ /nyin mtshan rgyun du rig sngags 'don/ /bcu bzhi 'am ni bco lnga dang / /khyad par du ni tshes brgyad la/ /gso sbyong sku yi mdun du blang / /skyon med tsan+dan dkar sogs shing / /rigs bzang las byas sku gzugs sam/ /yang na sa rdo rin chen sogs/ /bzang las bde bar gshegs gzugs bya/ /yang na ris su bris kyang rung / /sku gcig po 'am lha tshogs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas par byas pa la/ /mngon sum bzhin du dmigs byas na/ /myur du mngon sum mthong bar 'gyur/ /yon tan kun gyis brgyan pa yi/ /bum pa chu dang bcas pa la/ /sngags brjod pas ni 'dod don kun/ /'grub 'gyur the tshom mi bya'o/ /nad dang 'phrod pa'i sman rnams la/ /sngags bzlas bza' 'am byugs pas sam/ /bdugs pa tsam yang gnod pa sel/ /srad bu 'am ni gos dag dang / /phyag rgyas gdags kyang de bzhin no/ /'dod pa gang dang gang la yang / /me yi las kyi sbyor ba bya/ /gsang sngags 'dod 'dzin yid byed pa/ /bdag kyang rjes su 'jug par bya/ /de skad gsungs pa'i de ma thag /byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /sngags kyi ngo bo nyid la ni/ /ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma rang bzhin med pa'i chos/ /sna tshogs gzugs su snang ba la/ /brjod rtog bral ba'i skad cig ni/ /zhi ba'i che ba nyid yin no/ /srid pa dngos po med pa la/ /dmigs par byed pa bsgom pa'o/ /dmigs pa mthar thug med mthong ba/ /de ni bsgom pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /kun tu bzang pos gsang sngags kyi/ /don la ched du 'di ltar brjod/ /e ma sku gsum tha dad par/ /lus ngag yid kyi don las byung / /don gcig pa yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /sku gcig tu ni nges par gzung / /gang la gang

phan bskyed pa la/ /'ja' tshon bzhin du snang mod kyang / /tshig gis brjod pa'i sprul tsam ste/ /ye shes sku la dbye ba med/ /sgrib pa rnam sel las la ni/ /ched du brjod pa 'di ltar brjod/ /e ma dngos po ngo bo nyid/ /ma byung ma skyes ma 'gags pa/ /skye 'gag lta bu'i cho 'phrul ni/ /sku des phyag rgya sngags su snang / /yon tan chu yi rlabs bzhin du/ /skye ba'i ngo la gsal bar byed/ /nan tan gyis ni de nyid kyang / /rgyu ba med cing khong du chud/ /byang chub sems dpa' sa snying gis/ /rgyu la ched du 'di brjod do/ /e ma rang bzhin rnam dag la/ /thog med blo yi mun pa'i dbyings/ /rnam rtog bag chags kyis dkrugs nas/ /blo bur dkar nag las su snang / /dkar po sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun/ /de la sgro btags byang chub sems/ /de las byung ba'i phrin las kyis/ /nyon mongs las kyi sgrib pa sbyong / /mgon po byams pas sngags sgrub kyi/ /lam la ched du 'di ltar brjod/ /e ma gdod nas grol zhi'i sems/ /chu ltar dang bar snang mod kyang / /sna tshogs 'gro ba'i gzugs byung bas/ /mun pa thibs pos rnam par bsgyur/ /de nyid sems kyi snang ba'i phyir/ /'bad rtsol med pa'i sems kyis grol/ /rtsol ba sems kyi dri mas ni/ /dri ma med pa'i sems 'ching 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i snying pos sngags ming la/ /ched du 'di ltar brjod par mdzad/ /e ma stong pa mtshan ma bral/ /kha dog dbyibs bral chos nyid dag /dga' ba'i sems chen gsal byed pa/ /shes rab chen po'i yi ge min/ /mtshan dpe ye shes bde ldan sku/ /gang gang don du de snang ba/ /snying rje chen po'i ring shugs kyis/ /'byung 'gyur yi ge ta yi don/ /byang chub sems dpa' pad mos ni/ /gnas lam 'di ltar ched du brjod/ /e ma rgyu rkyen nam mkha' la/ /nyi zla skar rgyun 'khor ba yis/ /gsal nas nyin mtshan bye brag brjod/ /nyon mongs ma rig sred len gyis/ /'du byed srid pa'i las bskul te/ /rnam shes ming gzugs skye mched drug /reg

tshor skye rga shi sdug bsngal/ /gsal byed dag pa gnyis kyis dag /phyag na rdo rjes 'bras don la/ /ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma zab cing rgya che ba/ /sngags mthu bla na med pa ni/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi shes/ /shes pa nyid kyang rdzas med la/ /shes bya rdzas su ga la yod/ /shes pa yul gyi rnam par ni/ /rtog pa'i gzung 'dzin gyis bsgos pa/ /de zad nas ni grol bar 'gyur/ /de nas rig pa'i lha mo'i tshogs/ /spos dang me tog 'thor byed cing / /snyan pa'i sngags kyi glu yis ni/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la bstod/ /om̐ bcom ldan mgon po thugs rje spyan ras gzigs/ /zhal grangs mdog dbyibs du ma cir yang snang / /stong dang brgya dang bcu gcig drug dang gcig /byams pa'i zhal bzang mnga' ba'i mgon la 'dud/ /spyan ma'i'o/ /om̐ rab dgyes zhal mdog du ma cir yang 'gyur/ /la la byams pa snying rje dga' ba'i zhal/ /la la 'dod rmongs ser sna chen po'i zhal/ /khro sdang gtum chags lta ldan phyag 'tshal lo/ /mā ma kī'i'o/ /om̐ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dbang bskur rdzogs pa'i zhal/ /bstan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rgyal po'i phyag /mdzad pa grangs med chub pa'i phyag rgyar ldan/ /gdan gnyis zhabs gnyis gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na bza' dkar mo'i'o/ om̐ mdzad pa thugs rje'i dbyings la thug med kyang / /rtsom pa rgya mtsho rgyun mi chad mdzad pas/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam par spyod pa yi/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sgrol ma'i'o/ /om̐ nyi ma gzi ldan 'od zer 'gyed pa ltar/ /'jug dgongs mi mnga' kun rtog mun bral yang / /bskal pa rgya mtshor khyad par don gsal ba'i/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'od zer can ma'i'o/ /om̐ sems kyi rgyud 'gags mya ngan 'das pa'i tshe/ /'dod chags byung ma thag tu yal ba ste/ /nyon mongs rtsa ba bcad nas pha mtha' med/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbyangs

can ma'i'o/ /om̐ nyon mongs bdag tu bzung na 'khor bar skye/ /de la yang yang brtags na ngan 'gror skye/ /rang bzhin med par shes nas grol bar 'gyur/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phag gdong ma'i'o/ /om̐ chos rnams dag par mthong na mtho ris thob/ /gnyis 'dzin rtog pa chad na mya ngan 'da'/ /sgyu ma'i sems dang ldan na gzhan don 'byung / /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro gnyer can ma'i'o/ /om̐ rang tshul spyod la chags pas sa bon rul/ /gzhan tshul dman par brjod pas zhing sa tshig /lus ngag gtsang sbra tsam las byang chub rig /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa 'dzin ma'i'o/ /om̐ bdag lta mun pa'i dug gis brgyal ba la/ /bdag med phyogs bral ye shes bdud rtsi sman/ /pha rol phyin bcu spyod dang rtogs stsol mdzad/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dug sel ma'i'o/ /oṃ ngang tshul bzang spyod nga rgyal zhen pa med/ /gzhan spyod btang snyoms byas nas rang sems spyod/ /sred med bzod ldan ngang gis rgol ba lags/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ri khrod ma'i'o/ /om̐ khrel yod ngo tsha shes shing gtong la dga'/ /dad dang thos ldan tshul khrims shes rab bzang/ /chog shes 'dod chung 'di dang gzhan du phyug /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor rgyun ma'i'o/ /om̐ yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin nyan klog dang 'chad/ /kha don 'dzin sems bsgom brtson de la chu'i/ /khrus sogs smyung gnas dkar gtsang yon tan stsol/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar mo'i'o/ /om̐ rang sems dul zhing lus ngag bag yod spyod/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das mchod dam pa 'dzin/ /thos bsam bsgom brtson de ni dgra las rgyal/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i glu'o/ /om̐ tha dad kyis 'ching dbyer med grol ba yi/ /thabs dang shes rab bde chen byang chub lam/ /rnam

thar ye shes mtha' yas dpal ster ba/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal phreng ma'i glu'o/ /om̐ bsam pa bzang po gser gyi sa gzhi la/ /byang chub phyogs chos dpag bsam shing chen 'khrungs/ /ye shes thugs rje rgyun chu rlan mdzad pa'i/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yid bzang ma'i glu'o/ /sgra sgrogs 'khor bcas 'dar gyur te/ /rlung gis btab pa'i rtswa dang mtshungs/ /thal mo spyi bor sbyar nas su/ /ched du brjod pas 'di gsol to/ /om̐ mgon po rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /gtso bo rab tu che ba'i lha/ /bsod nams du mas skyed pa'i sku/ /ye shes mtha' yas thugs mnga' ba/ /blo ldan srid mthar mdzad pa po/ /tshul ldan tshul khrims la sbyor mdzad/ /gtsang ldan bram ze tshangs pa che/ /mdzad spyod mkha' mnyam spyod phyag 'tshal/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa che/ /'khor la legs so legs so zhes/ /om̐ āḥhrīḥhūm̐ swā hā bcas/ /yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ /lcags kyu can gyis nya ra nas/ /klu phyugs 'bum phrag 'dren pa ltar/ /dge sbyong kun slong dkar pos ni/ /byang chub rin chen gling 'jog mdzad/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma dra ba zhes bya ba las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan thub pa che/ /mgon po yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sna tshogs snang ba zhes bya ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms bzhugs nas/ /yan lag cha shas thams cad las/ /'od zer sna lnga bye ba phrag /drug cu drug cu'i mtha' gzhal ba/ /grangs med dag ni bkye bar mdzad/ /zhing khams grangs med bdun gyi mtha'/ /phyogs bcu ma lus thams cad du/ /'od kyis gang nas 'od de las/ /snyan pa'i tshigs bcad 'di snang ngo / /sangs rgyas dang ni chos la brnyas pa spang / /le lo che dang spyod pa chog 'dzin spang / /'gyod dang chos la ma nges 'byed pa spang / /nga rgyal che dang 'dod chags spyod pa spang / /'gro rnams med na byang chub lam med

do/ /'gro la brten nas byang chub che thob 'gyur/ /byang chub che lam thugs rje chen po ste/ /'gro rnams med na gang la skye bar 'gyur/ /de skad grags pa'i de ma thag /phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs sangs rgyas sras/ /brjod kyis mi lang gtso bo mchog /spyan ras gzigs dbang grangs med gtso/ /thams cad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /mi mjed zhing 'dir lhags par gyur/ /'di nas shar phyogs zhing khams ni/ /grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid nas/ /zhing khams seng ge spungs par ni/ /sangs rgyas seng ge rol pa yi/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang seng ge'i sgra/ /mdog dkar shel gyi ri 'dra ba/ /byang chub sems mchog bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /dngul gyi me tog du mas gtor/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / /rmad byung chen po'i tshigs bcad kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i gti mug mun pa bcom/ /shes rab mtha' yas gsal bar mdzad/ /bdag kyang snying po 'di yi mthus/ /phrin las 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /om̐ hrīḥsiṃ ha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa/ /snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /lho yi phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid kyi/ /zhing khams rin chen brtsegs pa na/ /sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzhugs pa'i/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu 'khor los skyur ba byed/ /gser gyi ri bo mdog 'dra ba/ /byang chub sems tshogs bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan

mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /rin chen gser gyi me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar byed/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / /rmad byung che ba'i tshigs bcad kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i ser sna 'ching ba bcad/ /sbyin pa'i 'byung gnas gter chen rdol/ /bdag kyang snying po 'di yi mthus/ /phrin las 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /om̐ pad+ma dhā ra dha ke hūm̐ phaṭa/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang / thub pa'i ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid kyi/ /zhing khams pad+mo brtsegs pa na/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma'i 'byung gnas bzhugs/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can/ /pad+ma nir te shwa ri gtso/ /pad+ma rā ga'i ri 'dra ba/ /byang chub sems tshogs bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /pad+ma rā ga'i me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar mdzad/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / /rmad byung chen po'i tshigs bcad kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i 'dod chags 'dam rdzab bskams/ /tshul khrims byug spos char du phab/ /bdag kyang snying po de yi mthus/ /phrin las 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /om̐ pad+ma nir te shwā ra hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /byang gi phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid kyi/ /zhing khams rdo rje bkod pa na/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje thogs

med bzhugs/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /thugs rje chen po mi gshol ba/ /rin chen mar gad ri bo 'dra/ /byang chub sems tshogs bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /mar ga ta yi me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar mdzad/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / /rmad byung chen po'i tshigs bcad kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i le lo'i nags tshal bsregs/ /brtson 'grus bskul ba'i me phungasbar/ /bdag kyang snying po de yi mthus/ /phrin las 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /om̐ rat+na a gra a pra ti ha ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /byang shar phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid kyi/ /zhing khams gter chen brtsegs pa na/ /sangs rgyas don yod 'byung gnas bzhugs/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /rje btsun don yod zhags pa can/ /shel gyi ri bo'i mdog 'dra ba/ /byang chub sems tshogs bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /rin chen shel gyi me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar byed/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / /rmad byung chen po'i tshigs bcad kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i zhe sdang ri bo bcom/ /bzod pa'i nyi ma lhang nger mdzad/ /bdag

kyang snying po 'di yi mthus/ /phrin las 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /om̐ hrīḥtrai lo kya bi dza ya a mo gha pā sha a pra ti ha ta hrīḥha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /shar lho'i phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid kyi/ /zhing khams bdud rtsi brtsegs pa na/ /sangs rgyas sman gyi 'byung gnas bzhugs/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /rje btsun ha la ha la che/ /pu sha ra ka'i ri bo 'dra/ /byang chub sems mchog bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /pu sha ra ka'i me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar byed/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / /rmad byung chen po'i tshigs bcad kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i phrag dog dug sdong sprul/ /bsam gtan bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho rlabs/ /bdag kyang snying po de yi mthus/ /phrin las 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /om̐ ha la ha la hrī pad+ma gar+bha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /lho nub phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid na/ /zhing khams pad+mas brgyan pa na/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma'i snying po bzhugs/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /rje btsun pad+ma spyan gyi lung / /zangs ma zhun gyi ri bo 'dra/ /byang chub sems mchog bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /

bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /zangs ma zhun gyi me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar byed/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / /rmad byung chen po'i tshigs bcad kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur/ /'gro ba rmongs pa'i thibs po bcom/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi rlung chen 'phyo/ /bdag kyang snying po de yi mthus/ /phrin las 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /om̐ pad+ma a laṃ kā ra hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /nub byang phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid na/ /zhing khams stong brgya zhes bya bar/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig dpal bzhugs so/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /rje btsun rdo rje chos dbang phyug /nor bu spug gi kha dog 'dra/ /byang chub sems mchog bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /spug gi snying po'i me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar byed/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / /rmad byung chen po'i tshigs bcad kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i mnar sems zhen pa bsal/ /mthu stobs chen po'i rdo rjes btab/ /bdag kyang snying po de yi mthus/ /phrin las 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /om̐ badz+ra dharma dhā tu hūm̐ swā hā/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /steng gi phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid na/ /zhing khams gtsug tor

brtsegs pa na/ /sangs rgyas gtsug tor rgyal po bzhugs/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /ha ri ha ri ha ri la/ /zhen zhes rab tu grags pa yi/ /rje btsun chos kyi gtsug tor de/ /in+d+ra nī la'i ri bo mdog /byang chub sems tshogs bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /in+d+ra nī la'i me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar mdzad/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / /rmad byung chen po'i tshigs bcad kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i log lta'i sgrib g.yogs sel/ /dag pa'i smon lam 'khor lo bskor/ /bdag kyang snying po de yi mthus/ /phrin las 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /oṃ bh+rūm̐ hrīḥha hūm̐ swā hā/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /'og gi phyogs kyi zhing khams mchog /grangs med bdun gyi mtha' nyid na/ /zhing khams za ma tog mdzes na/ /sangs rgyas gnon pa'i dpal bzhugs so/ /drung du byang chub sems dpa'i gtso/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang ni/ /rje btsun mgrin pa sngon po rgyal/ /an+da rnyil gyi ri bo 'dra/ /byang chub sems tshogs bye ba phrag /bcu dang lhan cig mkha' la gshegs/ /glog 'gyu bzhin du zhing 'dir byon/ /bcom ldan mgon po thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du ma byas/ /'dab ma stong dang ldan pa yi/ /an+da rnyil gyi me tog ni/ /rgya che du ma 'thor bar mdzad/ /bde bar gshegs so rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'od zer ngo mtshar ldan pa dang / /rmad byung chen po'i tshigs bcad kyis/ /zhing rnams rnam par g.yos par 'gyur/ /'gro ba'i shes bya'i sgrib nags sel/ /ye shes ral gris rtsa ba bregs/ /

bdag kyang snying po de yi mthus/ /phrin las 'di nyid grogs bgyid do/ /om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ snying po de skad phul nas kyang / /thub pa'i ga la de logs su/ /'khor bcas dga' ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar nas bzhugs/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang tshogs 'dus nas/ /rig sngags mthu chen 'chad pa dang / /gzhan don rdzogs par mdzad pa de'i/ /shin tu dga' bar mdzad pa la/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kun/ /phyag rgya rnams ni spyi bor bzhag /'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis legs so byin/ /nam mkha' snyan pa yis kyang bkang / /de tshe phyogs bcur bzhugs pa yi/ /khro bo'i rgyal po ma lus rnams/ /sa steng thams cad gar gyis bkang / /g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang zla gam dang / /zlum po gru bzhi gru gsum 'gros/ /mchong dang gyed mchongs hril po dang / /rdebs dang btsir ba'i tshul gyis su/ /bgegs rnams stabs kyis tshar gcod mdzad/ /lag pa thal sbyar phye btsum bskyed/ /sor mo gcig bsnol gcig 'khyud dang / /kun bsnol kun 'khyud kun gdengs dang / /rgyab bsnol res 'khyud kun 'khyud dang / /re mos 'khyud sgreng kun sgreng dang / /mnyam gzhag dang ni mchog gi rgya/ /sa gnon skyabs sbyin mchog sbyin sogs/ /phyag rgya du ma bgegs sel mdzad/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /gdong bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba'i/ /snga na med pa'i rig sngags rmad/ /ngo mtshar 'byung zhes thos ma thag /lus kyang shin tu 'dar gyur nas/ /rgyal mchog gtso bo drung lhags te/ /phyag 'tshal thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /spyan sngar 'dug ste 'di skad gsol/ /gang zhig gdong ni bcu gcig pa'i/ /rig sngags lan cing 'dzin pa dang / /rgyun du 'don dang yid la byed/ /'jig rten mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i tshogs 'di rnams/ /gang gis yid la byed pa'am/ /yang na ji tsam dran yang rung / /dge ldan rigs kyi bu de ni/ /phyogs

bcu rgyal ba rnams kyi sras/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bshes/ /rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyi yab/ /byis pa rnams kyi gnyen yin no/ /bdag cag rnams ni de yi 'bangs/ /skyes bu khyu mchog chen po ste/ /bsod nams rnams kyi gter ldan zhing / /de yi tshul khrims ral ba med/ /mi de skye ba don yod de/ /lha gnas dag nas spu gseb tu/ /ye shes 'od zer bdud rtsi 'dzud/ /'jig rten 'di yi nad rigs dang / /gdon rigs ci snyed yod pa 'am/ /rig sngags byad stems ma lus pas/ /de la tshugs par mi 'gyur ro/ /cho ga bzhin du spyad pa yis/ /tshangs pa'i tshe tshad gnas nas kyang / /shi ba sems brgyal med par ni/ /gnas 'pho tshul gyis mtho ras 'jug /rgyal ba'i zhing du gshegs nas kyang / /rgyal ba rnams la chos nyan cing / /rgyal sras rnams dang stabs gcig tu/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs pa brnyes te/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan gyur nas/ /skad cig glog 'gyu ji bzhin du/ /'gro ba ma lus dag byed cing / /zhing rnams ma lus dag par byed/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma dra ba zhes bya ba las lha byung ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas lag na rdo rje 'dzin/ /bzhengs te thal sbyar thub pa la/ /phyag 'tshal phyogs su 'khod nas ni/ /gsang ba bstod nas tshig 'di gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang po/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang kun/ /rang rang gnas nas gshegs nas byon/ /'gro ba thugs brtse chen po yis/ /snying po byin brlabs ldan la gsol/ /rmad du byung ba'i snying po la/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang / /rig pa 'dzin rnams mthun par dgyes/ /'on kyang 'gro rnams bzung ba dang / /dngos grub thams cad myur ba dang / /snying po mthu dang ldan pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje che rnams kyi/ /byin brlabs ldan pa rtsa ba'i sngags/ /'dren pa de ring bshad du gsol/ /rig sngags nyi ma zla ba'i 'od/ /rtsa ba'i sngags kyis sprin bral byed/ /'gro la thugs

brtse mdzad pa dang / /bdag la phan pa'i don slad du/ /rgyal ba mya ngan kun bral ba/ /rtsa ba'i gzungs sngags bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa ches/ /sdig pa kun myur sgrol bya ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi thugs rje las/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang seng ge'i sgra/ /rtsa ba'i rig sngags 'di gsungs so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ /na maḥ.ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā /om̐ a ka ṭe bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ṭi ka ṭe/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe/ ka ro ṭe bī r+ya swā hā/ yon tan ye shes tshogs rnams kun/ /rig sngags 'dis ni nges par bskyed/ /khyad par du ni mdzen dal/ /rtswa las byung ba'i me bzhin no/ /rtog ldan rnam shes brgyad kyi gzhi/ /sbyor phyir maṇ+ḍal lha ma pa brgyad/ /ba ser skya yi bdud rtsis byugs/ /yan lag bcu gnyis mgor bcas pa'i/ /sngags grangs byin gyis brlabs byugs nas/ /lhag ma yan lag thig ler bya/ /cung zad lce la myang bas ni/ /dus dus sum brgya drug cu'i tshad/ /nyi ma grangs kyis dag nas ni/ /lo gcig dus su rtogs ldan 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa che/ /dpal bskyed 'tshe ba bzlog pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /mgon po yid bzhin 'khor lo yi/ /rtsa ba'i rig sngags 'di gsungs so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rwa ya/ bo dhi sa twā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ tsakra warti bad+ma tsin+ta ma ṇi dzā la ma hā pad+me ru ru tiṣ+tha dz+wā la ā kar+ṣa ya hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /glo bur gnod pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /bdun phrag sngags grangs dang mnyam pa'i/ /yungs kar ser po brgya rtsa brgyad/ /rang gi lus sam yan lag la/ /mchod dang bcas pas gdags par bya/ /de la yang yang gsol ba btab/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa ches/ /khams gsum dbang du bya ba yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la

snyoms zhugs nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /mgon po pad+ma gar dbang gi/ /rtsa ba'i gsang sngags 'di gsungs so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ sarba satwā bā sa nā gā dhi pa ti ni/ /na maḥsarba satwā bi sa na/ ā ha ra ṇi/ na maḥsarba satwā ba yo dha ra ṇā ya/ na maḥstaṃ bha pra sha ma nā ya/ na maḥsarba satwā bo dhi tsit+ta tsi ka ti sa na ka rā ya/ na maḥsarba satwā ba na dha na ts+tshe da na ka rā ya/ na maḥsarba satwā duḥkha bi mo k+ṣa ṇa ka rā ya/ na maḥsarba an+ta kā ra ba'i dha nā ma kā ra/ na maḥsarba bid+yā dha ra rā dzā pra sha pra sta ye/ ma hā yo ga yo gī shwa rā ya/ ha sa ha s+ya nā ya/ na ma skṛ twā i daṃ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra mu khong gir+ṇ+ṇa ri shi bi ri dā/ nā ga yak+ṣa rā k+ṣa sa/ shākya brah+ma lo ka pā lā ya/ biṣ+ṇa ma he shwa ra/ nā rā ya ṇa skan dha/ ku ber/ a su re n+d+ra/ ma tṛ ga ṇa/ na ma skṛ twā/ badz+ra badz+ra khu ṇa sa hṛ da ya/ ha ya grī ba nā ma ya ma hṛ da ya m+nga/ war+t+ya ṣ+yā mi/ a ba pra me yo ta sā dha ka na a ba ha na/ sarba pi nā ya kaṃ a mo ghaṃ/ sarba karmā bhi ṣiñtsa/ bi nā ya kaṃ/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ ta ru la/ ta nu ta la/ bi ta ru la/ sarba bi ṣa ka ka/ sarba bud+dha bid ni/ pra dzā ba ti ta/ a na la bi s+phu li ka/ aṭ+ṭa hā sa ke shwa rā ya/ a to pa pra bi tā ya/ badz+ra khu ra ni rge ti ta/ tsa li ta pra pu da ta la/ badz+rod shīn+taṃ ta ti/ si ta ma du to ga ta pra na ma ṇa pa kā ra ba ra duṣ+ṭaṃ/ bid+yā ka ma ga saṃ bha k+ṣa na kā ra/ sarba bid+yau ba twa he sha kā ra/ pa ra ma shān+tiṃ kā ra/ bud+dha bo dhā ya ma ti/ bha ga bā na ha ya grī ba sarba bid+yā hṛ da ya/ mā par ta yi ṣ+ya mi/ kha tra kha dra/ ma hā ro ṭa/ ma na traṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa āt+ma swa sti taṃ man+taṃ/ sid+dha sā dha/ sarba karma su me/ sid+dhe sid+dhe/ de hi de hi/ ā be sha a be sha/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ sarba gra he ṣu a pra te ha ta/ dhu na dhu na/ bi dhu na bi dhu na/ ma tha ma tha/ pra ma tha pra ma tha/ sarba pa ra kra ma kṛ tā n+t+ra gra/ ka khor da du ra laṃ ghi ta hi ba shi ka bi shi ka ta/ sā sha diṣ+ṭā/ bi ṣa tsūr+ṇa yo ga a bhi tsa ra/ ba shī/ ka ra ṇaḥsid+dha añdza na/ tsa ku mo ha na tsin+ta/ piṃ she sa na kā ra/ nir+ya a pa ra bṛ ṣa ka ra na/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ ma

hā bo dhi sa twa/ rin dha di sha nam̐/ sarba bha ye bh+yaḥsarba satwā nāṃ/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa mā ma nu twa dharma saṃ bha a nu dz+nyā taṃ me karma shī gh+raṃ/ ku ru ku ru phaṭa/ ha ya grī ba phaṭa/ badz+ra daṃ ṣ+ṭ+ro ta ka ṭa bhā ya pa ra se nā phaṭa/ ye ke tsita mā ma e hid shi go pa kā ya kra min to/ man+t+ra yan+t+ra sa man ti/ dza pa ya ri dzu hu ti/ ka khor da ku rban di nāṃ/ sarba dza mu khen+d+ra pra ta na tā ya phaṭa/ na maḥsarba duṣ+ṭa gra ho ta sā da nā ya ha ya grī ba sid dh+ya n+tu me man+t+ra pa dā ni swā hā/ om̐ a mṛ tod bha bā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ na maḥsarba sa twāṃ sh+tsa sid dh+ya na tu/ me man+t+ra pa dā ṇi swā hā/ gang zhig klus non spyi la ni/ /dung gi me tog sngags stong gis/ /byin gyis brlabs nas gu gul bdug /lus la thogs na legs par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa ches/ /thogs med sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /mgon po thugs rje mi bshol ba'i/ /rtsa ba'i rig sngags 'di gsungs so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ā r+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ na maḥsarba bhi ma tsa ka raṃ/ sarba rog pra sha ma na ka raṃ/ /sarba byā da na bha da ka ram̐/ uṣ+ṭ+rak+ṣa ṇa pa dis sa twe bh+yaḥtā rā saṃ mya ka tā rā ṇaṃ/ da sha di ka bo dhi satwe bh+yaḥn maḥsaṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ko ṭī ṇāṃ/ a he na ma s+t+ri da ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa ra shud+dha dhā ra ṇi/ ma hā ru ṇi kā ya a gra bī sh+ya ti/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ a gra nā ma dz+wa la sa ti kā ra/ ma hā kā ru ṇā byu pa sa man+ta ha ra na tu/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dza ṭa dza ṭa/ dzi ṭi dzi ṭi/ dzu ṭu dzu ṭu/ ra ra ra ra/ ri ri ri ri/ ka la ka la/ ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ ma hā saṃgra ha/ a nu ha raṃ tu/ e h+ye hi sa na dhā ya/ e h+ye hi/ tsa ta tsa ta/ tsi ti tsi ti/ tsu tu tsu tu/ sarba bo dhi satwa/ pra ṇi dha na gṛh+ṇa/ kā ra a nu sa na dhā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ sa bhu ba e h+ye hi/ ra la ra la/ ru lu ru lu/ dh+ya na bi mok+ṣa sa mā dhi/ sa ma ba tī bhish+tsa ra/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ tsa la tsa la/ tsi li tsi li/ tsu lu tsu lu/ bo dhi bo dhi/ e h+ye e h+ye/ bud+dho bud+dho/ bud+dha sat+yen/

dharma sat+yen/ saṃ ga sat+yen/ om̐ ṭe/ s+thā ṭe s+thā sarba ma hā mai tri bhu ni pa ran tu/ ma hā kā ru ṇa me ghaṃ mā ma sarba rā ga ni ba ra yan+tu/ bu na bu na/ bi bu na bi bu na/ ma tha ma tha/ pra ma tha pram tha/ om̐ ṭa s+tho ṭa s+tha/ e h+ye e h+ye/ mā ma sarba sha pu yan+tu/ karma bi sho dha ya/ ma hā kā ru ni kā ya/ ma hā pad+ma nā dā ya/ pad+ma a pā ya swā hā/ shwe ta ādz+nyā u pa bi dhā ya swā hā/ ka ru ri ni swā hā/ shu ba dz+nyā+e swā hā/ tsakra ṇāṃ swā hā/ ya me ye swā hā/ oṃ da tse bi bud+dhe bh+yaḥswā hā/ saṃ s+phe tshe bh+yoḥbud+dhe bh+yaḥswā hā/ a du pa du ke bh+yoḥbyā dhi de swā hā/ bi de ke bh+yo byā te bh+yaḥswā hā/ bai dha de bh+yoḥbyā de bh+yaḥswā hā/ swa na ni pradz+nyā+e ke bh+yoḥbyā de bh+yaḥswā hā/ bhū mi aṃ ti ri ka sha tsa re bh+yo byā dhe bh+yaḥswā hā/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ na tra ṭa ta ṭ+ra/ tri ti tri ti/ tu tu tu tu/ nā ma ma sarba bha ye bh+yaḥs a pa tra be bh+yaḥrak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ gra sa gra sa swā hā/ ma tha ma tha/ pra ma tha pra ma tha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ na maḥ.ār+yā pa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ ādz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ sha ra ka ri'i sa bon las/ /stong du bzlas nas dri chu dang / /lhan cig skrangs la byugs pas ni/ /lhog nad drag po 'joms par byed/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa ches/ /rig sngags sbod gtong gzhom pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /mgon po don yod zhags pa yi/ /rtsa ba'i rig sngags 'di gsungs so/ /na ma s+t+rai yadh+ra a nu ga ta pra tiṣ+ṭhi te bh+yaḥsarba bud+dhā bo dhi satwe bh+yaḥn maḥpra t+ye ka bud+dha ār+ya shrā pa ka saṃ ghe bh+yo a tī ta anā ga ta pra t+yāta pan ne bh+yaḥn maḥsaṃ myak+ga tā nāṃ/ na maḥsaṃ myaka pra ti pan+na nāṃ/ na maḥshā ra dā tī pu trā ya ma hā ma ta ye/ na maḥ.ārgya mai tre ya pra mu khe bh+yo/ ma hā bo dhi satwa saṃ ghe bh+yaḥn maḥsu pra tiṣ+ṭha ta shai len+d+ra rā dza pra mu khe bh+yaḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ.a ra ha da bh+yaḥsaṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yo bha ga bang bh+yaḥn maḥsu par+ṇa par+ṇa su pra ti bhā sa bi na rti he shwa ra rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥsiṃ ha bi krī ḍi ta rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya a mi tā bhā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥsu pra tiṣ+ṭhi ta/ ma ṇi kū ṭa rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥs man+ta ra smyud

ga ta shrī ṭa rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ na mo bi pa sh+yi ne ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥshi khi ne ta thā ga tā ya/ na mo bi shwa bhu je ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥkra kuts+tsha na dā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥka na ka mun ye ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥkā sh+ya pā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥshākya mu na ye ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ mu ne mu ne ma hā mun ye swā hā/ om̐ sa sem me ma hā sa me rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sarba satwāṃ sh+tsa sarba pā paṃ pra sha ma ne swā hā/ na maḥsu pa ri kī rti nā ma dhe yā ya shri ye ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥs man+ta a wa bhā sa bi dzi ta saṃ grā ma shri ye ta thā ga tā yu/ na maḥ.in+d+ra ke tu dh+wa dza shri ye ta thā ga tā ya/ na mo rat+na pra bhā se shwa ra rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ na mo a pra ti ha ta bhai ṣa dz+ya rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ na mo bi krān+ta gā mi ne ta thā ga tā ya/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ na ma a tī ta a nā ga ta pra t+yud ban+ne bh+yaḥsarba bud+dhe bho dhi sa twe bh+yo/ bha ga bad bh+yaḥ/ tad+ya thā/ smṛ ti bar+dha ni/ ma ti bar+dha ni/ ga ti bar+dha ni/ dhṛ ti bar+dha ni/ pradz+nyā bar+dha ni/ pra ti bhā na bar+dha ni/ dh+yā na bar+dha ni/ sa mar+th+ya bar+dha ni/ bi pā sh+ya nā bar+dha ni/ sarba bo dhi bak+ṣa dharma bar+dha ni/ sa ka la bud+dha dharma pa ri pū ra ṇī ye swā hā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shū rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ na mo ma hā s+thā ma prāp+tā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ e bh+yo na maskṛ twā i daṃ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra mu khod gi rna a mo gha pā sha rā dza nā ma hṛ da yaṃ ta thā ga tā saṃ mu khaṃ bhā ṣi taṃ ma hā tāṃ pa ra ṣa ma dh+ye a ha mi dā nī mā brta ta yi ṣ+ya mi sid+dh+ya na mu me man+ta pa dāḥsarba kā rā ṇi/ sarba bha ye bh+yo/ ma ma sarba satwā nāñtsa rak+ṣa bha ba tu/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ma ra ma ra/ mi ri mi ri/ mu ru mu ru/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka/ sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tsi ri tsi ri/ bi ri bi ri/ pi ri pi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ mahā pad+ma hasta/ ka la ka la/ ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ ma hā shud+dha satwa/ bud+dh+ya bud+dh+ya/ bo dha bo dha/ bo dhi bo dhi/ bo dha ya

bo dha ya/ ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ku ṇu ku ṇu/ pa ra ma shud+dha satwa/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ ma hā s+thā ma prāp+ta/ tsa la tsa la/ sañtsa la sañtsa la/ bi tsa la bi tsa la/ pra tsa la pra tsa la/ e ṭa ṭa/ e ṭa ṭa/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ ti ri ti ri/ tu ru tu ru/ e h+ye hi ma hā kā ru ṇi ka/ ma hā pa shu pa ti be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ sa ra sa ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ pa ra pa ra/ ba ra ba ra/ ma ra ma ra/ la ra la ra/ ha ra ha ra/ hā hā hī hī/ hū hū/ om̐ kā ra prah+ma be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ sa ra sa ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ na ra na ra/ ba ra ba ra/ ha ra ha ra/ rasmi sha ta sa ha sra pra ti maṇ+ḍi ta sha rī ra/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ta pa ta pa/ bhā sa bhā sa/ bh+ra ma bh+ra ma/ bha ga wa na so ma/ ā di t+ya/ ya ma ba ru ṇa/ ku be ra/ brah+men+d+ra/ bā yu/ ag+ni/ dha na da/ de pa ṛ ṣi ga ṇa a bh+ya ra tsi ta tsa ra ṇa/ su ru su ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ ghu ru ghu ru/ sa nad ku mā ra/ ru dra/ bā sa la/ biṣ+ṇu/ dha na da/ bā yu/ ag+ni/ ṛ ṣi/ nā ya ka/ bi nā ya ka /ba hu bi bi dha be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ tha ra tha ra/ gha ra gha ra/ ya ra ya ra/ la ra la ra/ ha ra ha ra/ pa ra pa ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ba ra ba ra/ ba ra dā ya ka /sa man+taṃ a wa lo ki ta/ bi lo ki ta/ lo ke shwa ra/ ma he shwa ra/ tri bhu ba ne shwa ra/ sarba gu ṇa sa ma a laṃ kṛ ta/ a ba lo ki te shwa ra/ mu hu mu hu/ mu ru mu ru/ mu ya mu ya/ muñtsa muñtsa/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sarba satwāṃsh+tsa/ sarba bha ye bh+yaḥ/ sarbo pa dra be bh+yaḥ/ sarbo pa sarge bh+yaḥ/ sarba gra he bh+yaḥ/ sarba byā dhi bh+yaḥ/ sarba bi ṣe bh+yaḥ/ sarba dz+wa re bh+yaḥ/ e baṃ/ ba na dha ba na dha na/ tā ṭa na/ tardza na/ rā dza/ taska ra/ ag+ni/ u dka /bi ṣa/ shas+t+ra pa ri mo tsa ka /ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ku ṇu ku ṇu/ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ in+d+ri ya/ ba la/ bo dh+yaṃ ga /tsa tu ra/ ār+ya sat+ya saṃ pra kā sha ka ta pa ta pa/ ta ma ta ma/ da ma da ma/ sa ma sa ma/ ma sa ma

sa/ /dha ma dha ma/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā/ ma hā ta mo an dha ka ra bi dha ma na/ ṣa ṭa pā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ka /ma la ma la/ mi li mi li/ mu lu mu lu/ ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ṭha ṭha ṭha ṭha/ ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi/ ṭu ṭu ṭu ṭu/ ṭhi ṭhi ṭhi ṭhi/ ṭhu ṭhu ṭhu ṭhu/ e ne ya tsarma kṛ ta pa ri ke ra/ e h+ye hi ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ī shwa ra/ ma he shwa ra/ ma hā bhu ta ga ṇa saṃ bhañdza ka/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ pa ra pa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ ba ra ba ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ki ṭi ki ṭi/ ku ṭu ku ṭu/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ma hā bi shud+dha bi ṣa ya ni bā si na/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka shwe ta ya dz+nyo pa bī ta/ rat+na mu ku ṭa/ mā lā dha ra/ sarba dz+nyā shi sa si kṛ ta dza ṭā mu ku ṭa/ ma hā ang bhu ta/ ka ma la a laṃ kṛ ta ke ra ta la dh+yā na sa mā dhi/ bi mok+ṣa a pra kaṃ bya/ ba hu satwa san+ta ti pa ti pā tsa ka /ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa ba sho dha ka /sarba dz+nyā dz+nyā na ba ri pū ra ka /sarba byā dhi pa ri mo tsa ka /sarba satwa ā shā pa ri pū ra ka /sarba satwa sa mā shwā sa na ka ra na moḥstu te swā hā/ a mo ghā ya swā hā/ a mo gha pā shā ya swā hā/ a dzi tā ya swā hā/ a pa rā dzi tā ya swā hā/ a mi tā bhā ya swā hā/ a mi tā bha su tā ya swā hā/ ma ra sa n+ya pra marda nā ya swā hā/ a bha yā ya swā hā/ a bha ya pra dā ya swā hā/ dza yā ya swā hā/ bi dza yā ya swā hā/ dza ya bi dza yā ya swā hā/ ba ra dā ya swā hā/ ba ra pra dā ya swā hā/ a kā la mṛ t+yu pra sha ma nā ya swā hā/ i dañtsa me karma ku ru na mo stu te swā hā/ om̐ ra ṇa ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ om̐ dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ om̐ dza dz+riṃ dzū swā hā/ om̐ hūm̐ dza ya swā hā/ om̐ hrīḥtrai lo kya bi dza ya a mo gha pā sha a pra ti ha ta hrīḥhaḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ om̐ ba su ba ti swā hā/ om̐ ā ro li ka swā hā/ om̐ ba hu le ba hu le swā hā/ om̐ ā ro li ka hrīḥhrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ni ya ta a ni ya ta be da nī ya a shu bha s+ya me bha ga bā na karma ṇo a she ṣa taḥk+ṣa yaṃ ku ru swā hā/ om̐ pad+ma hastā ya swā hā/ om̐ bud+dha dharma saṃ ghā ya swā hā/ rabs chang thod par ro bsregs sa/ /yungs kar ser po dri chur bcas/ /bskyed de myu gus sngags stong brjod/ /'bras bu la ni

khri brjod bya/ /lus la thogs na byad stems sogs/ /nad dang gdon rnams myur du sel/ /gzhan dag las rnams gang la yang / /bdun bdun grangs kyi sngags kyis sbyar/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa ches/ /ltos 'gro bas ni rab rgyal ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /mgon po ha la ha la yi/ /rtsa ba'i rig sngags 'di gsungs so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twā ya/ sarba su re shwa rā ya/ na maḥ.ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ na mo ma hā s+thā ma prāp+ta/ ār+ya mai tri ār+ya mañdzu shrī/ ār+ya badz+ra pā ṇi a dhi kaṃ /bo dhi satwa ma hā satwe bh+yaḥ.a te na maḥkṛ to bha ga bā na/ ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa ra taṃ hṛ da ya sarba karma pa daḥsarba gra ho ts+tshe da na ka raṃ/ bha ba a ma ra ṇi bi nā sha ka pa shī taṃ/ s+yād ya the daṃ he bo dhi sa twa/ ma hā bo dhi satwa/ bri ya bo dhi satwa/ he hā lo ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ ba ra ma mai tri tsit+ti ta/ tsit+ta kā ru ṇi ka /ku ru ku ru/ k+ṣa ma ga ma bi haṃ ga ma bi ya ti/ bi dza yan+ti ma hā bi dza yan+ti/ dhu ru dhu ru/ dhu ru dhu ru/ dha ra dha ra/ tsa yan+t+ra man+t+ra/ na mo me h+ya dhi/ sarba satwā pā ya/ pra da sa/ ha ra ha ra/ ha ri bha h+ya nod bha/ bā bā bā bā/ bhā ba nā ga/ ku ru ku ru/ tu ru tu ru/ ghu ru ghu ru/ su ru su ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ su pra si dha/ satwa ma bi ma la/ pha la pha la/ mūrte/ ār+yā ba lo ki ti shwa rā ya/ pa ra ma kā ru ṇi ka ru kṛṣ+ṇa dz+nyā na dha/ dza ṭā mu ku ṭa bi laṃ ba/ pra laṃ ba/ tsa le tsa le/ ma la ma la/ ka la ka la/ ha la ha la/ ga la ga la/ ta la ta la/ da la da la/ tu lu tu lu/ hu lu hu lu/ hi li hi li/ he bo dhi satā/ na ma s+t+ya dh+rā nu/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hrīḥku ru ku ru/ hṛ da ya/ a n+ya sma ra/ sa ma ya a nu sma ra/ dzā ti a nu sma ra/ i daṃ me ka r+yaṃ ku ru/ ma nor thaṃ me/ pa ri pū ra ya/ sid+dh+yan+tu/ me man+t+ra pa dā ni swā hā/ snga bar khrus byas gos gtsang gyon/ /bcom ldan spyan sngar nyin re bzhin/ /ba lci sa la ma lhung pas/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi lham pa ni/ /bcu gsum

bzlas nas byug par bya/ /lhag mas nad rnams thams cad la/ /byugs pa tsam gyis sos par nges/ /zla ba drug gis bdud rnams zhi/ /'dod pa thams cad skongs gyur te/ /mtshams med lnga byas mis kyang 'grub/ /gal te grub par ma gyur na/ /bdag gis mtshams med las byas te/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun bsrungs yin/ /snying rjes snying rje can 'grub 'gyur/ /sdang bas khro ba grub gyur te/ /rtag pa'i gnas 'dod blo gros can/ /rnam par mi rtog btang snyoms kyis/ /'dod pa kun 'grub zhen pas byin/ /yid la byed pas 'ching bar 'gyur/ /se'u po che yi lcug ma la/ /ro bsregs thal ba khri phrag bdun/ /sngags nas gtor bas char ches pa/ /char pa myur du 'chad par byed/ /dri chu gla rtsir bcas pas ni/ /sbrul gyi gdug pa sel bar byed/ /lto 'phye'i rigs dang sbrang rgod sogs/ /'jigs pa rnams ni 'grib ba'i phyir/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa ches/ /shes rab rnam grol zhes bya pa'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /mgon po pad+ma rgyan lung gi/ /rtsa ba'i rig sngags 'di gsungs so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ na ma ār+ya a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ na mo ma hā s+thā ma prap+tā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ na mo bi pu la bi ma la/ su pra ti pu la/ sūr+ya sha ta yaṃ/ a saṃ khe ya/ sū r+ya sha ta sa ha sra/ a dhi ke ra/ e bha pa te mūrta ye/ ma hā ma ṇi mu ku ṭa kaṇ+ḍa la/ a laṃ kā ra dhā ra ṇī/ bha ga ba te pad+ma mā le/ sarba lo ka a pā ya sha ma na ye/ bi bi dha mu khas ma be sha /ā bi sha sarba satwa pa ri mo tsa kā ya/ bhu ra bhū ba swā hā/ ma hā lo ki shwa rā ya/ na ma s+tha mi ra ba tra bi nā sha ka /rā ga be sha mo hā dz+wa la sha ma ka sha ma sha na kā ra/ rak+ṣa ka sarba a bha ya durga ti pra sha ma na kā ra/ sarba sa ma sha na kā ra/ sarba ā shā

pa ri pū ru ka /sarba ta thā ga tā sarbaṃ dha na kā ra e h+ye hi ma hā bo dhi satwa ba ra da pad+ma a ba lo ka saṃ bud+dho/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ dza ṭa mu ku ṭa/ a laṃ kṛ ta shi ro ma ṇi/ ka na kā rā dza ta/ badz+ra bai ḍū r+ya a laṃ kṛ ta sha rī+i ra a ma ta ta dza na ka ma a laṃ kṛ te pra bhā ra ṇa sha ta sa ha sra a bi la sha ta kā ya/ ma hā bo dhi satwa ba ra da/ bi daṃ kha da ma/ bi nā sha ya/ bi nā sha ya/ ma ha yan+t+ra ma kle sha ka pa ta/ a ba bo dhi bha/ bo dhi yaṃ tra/ gha ra tsa ra/ ka pra ma tha na ka ra/ pu ru ṣa pad+ma pu ru ṣa/ saṃ pra ra ṇa/ pu ru ṣa siṃ ha/ bi ra bi ra/ dza su ta na ta ḍa ba ri bṛ ta/ dha ma dha ma/ sa ma sa ma/ dhu ru dhu ru/ pra sha sa ma ya/ pra sha sa ma ya/ ki ri ki ri/ bhi bi ri/ bhi bi ri/ tsi ri tsi ri/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bi dhi ri bi dhi ri/ bi ri bi ri/ mu ru mu ru/ mu ya mu ya/ muñdza muñdza/ d+yu nu d+yu nu/ bi d+yu bi d+yu/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ga ya ga ya/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ ha sa ha sa/ pra hā sa pra hā sa/ nā ga bi bi dha ke sha se sa na/ ha ra ha ra/ saṃ ha ra saṃ ha ra/ du ru du ru/ ma hā maṃ gha la sha ra ṇi/ sha ta pra se/ ka ba a pa bhā sa te bi bi dha pā sa na sha ma ka sha sa ka /rā ga kā ma hā bo dhi satwa/ bha ra bha ra swā hā/ thub po she dang shu dge la/ /khri phrag bzlas nas 'thungs bas ni/ /shes rab chen po 'phel bar byed/ /nad la mthun pa'i sman dang sbyar/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba ka rar bcas/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig yang na bdun/ /sngags brjod snga bar mid par bya/ /de yang dbyangs snyan shes rab 'phel/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa ches/ /dgongs pa bla med ces bya ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /mgon po rdo rje chen po yi/ /rtsa ba'i rig sngags 'di gsungs so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ na mo bha ga ba te/ bai ro tsa na pra bhā rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ saṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ sarba ādz+nyā ya/ an+dha kā ra mā ma yi tra/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sā dha ni sā dha ni/ sid+dhe

sid+dhi/ sid+dhe dhā ra/ bha ga ba te/ pa raṃ pa ra/ kle sha da mi na/ a dz+nyā she ṣa ma ṇi sha ma ya/ sarba pā pa bi shud+dhe/ dharma ni dha ma ni/ mā la dz+nyā go tsa re a paṃ go tsa ri ni sā shaṃ mur+dhi/ su kha ra pra te/ sarba kle sha da ba ni/ bi dha ma ni/ bi dha ma ni/ bi dha ma ni/ bi nā sha bi nā sha /bi nā sha ya bi nā sha ya/ bha ga ba te/ bu ra sa bi ma la ba dhi/ sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ pra sa ra pra sa ra/ bi sa ra bi sa ra/ ā dz+nyāṃ ma i hi sa hā srā ṇāṃ/ tsit+ta na kā rā ma/ a ba ra na k+ṣā ba yak+ṣā ba yā mi ta su bhū ta bi shā ya/ pā sha bi da ni pā ra mi tā bhā dz+nyā na go tsa re/ pā sha sha ba ti/ sha sha mā le ni kā ra ṇa go tsa re/ ma hā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣe ka ma ti su bi ni sh+tsi ta da dha/ he he bha ga ba te ma hā kā ru ṇi ka ya/ ku ru ku ru/ bi shi dha ma ba na/ mā ma sarba satwā bho ma hā kā ru ṇo ta sā dha ke na/ sañtsa sañtsa saṃ brta ya/ sam+bha la pra ro ha ya me/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ bi dza ya ba ri shud+dha ya/ a mu ka bi ku ru bi/ dza ya na/ sa ra sa ra/ me gha ga te/ mā mā mā/ bo dhi tsit+taṃ sa ma bud+dhe ma na san+tu ṣe/ bo dhi mi ri kā ra ni/ bud+dha bo dhi prā de/ nā ra ka pre ta ti r+ya ka ga ti duḥkha gu la ni/ de ba ma nu ṣ+ya ga ti saṃ bi da ni pa ga to kle sha sarbā nurda dharma/ pa ri pū ra ṇi badz+ra dharma sid+dha n+tu me man+ta pa dā ni swā hā/ snga bar langs nas khrus byas te/ /skyil krung mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can/ /yid kyis phyag 'tshal nyi shu gcig /rdo rje chos las dad pas brjod/ /brgyad dang bcu bzhi bco lnga la/ /gos gsar gyon nas gso sbyong blang / /me tog tsan+dan dkar sogs mtshod/ /don grub sdig sel shes rab 'phel/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa ches/ /bdud rnams 'joms pa rdo rje yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /rtsa ba'i rig sngags 'di gsungs so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwā rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ na mo bha ga ba te a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a r+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ ha ri ha ri/ bid+da na dha ma ka /bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ i la mi li/ tsi la tsi

li/ tu le tu le/ ku ru me ku ru me/ si ri si ri/ bi si ri/ tsa ra ya/ be sha re/ gau re/ gha na dha re/ tra mi ṇi/ ma taṃ gi /puk+ka si/ ka ṭa ya/ mā la tsaṇ+ḍā li/ hu ru mā li ni/ tsi li tsi li/ gra na sau mad r+sha ne ku ru/ tsan+d+ra mu khi/ la ghu ma ṇa ya ma ti/ ār+ya dak+ṣi ṇa bud+dhe/ sarba bid+yā nāṃ/ mā ma pra sā dha ni/ sarba bid+yā nāṃ/ ī shwa ri swā hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ sarba a pa ri pū ra ka na/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ha ha ha/ ma ma ma/ dhi ri dhi ri/ hi ri hi ri/ shān+te pra shāt+ne/ sarba bā pa k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri/ a ba lo kā ya kā ru ṇi ka /bodhi tsit+ta ma na si ku ru ba ya lo kā ya/ mā ma sma ra sma ra/ sa man+ta ya pūrbe/ sat+t+ya a dhi ṣ+ṭhā na kri taṃ te na sat+ya na/ sa tsi ba tsi nā/ sarba ak+ṣa mi/ pa ri pū ra ya/ bud+dho k+ṣe tra me/ ba ri sho dha ya/ ma me kash+tsa/ pi he tha nor+tha bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṣā naṃ swā hā/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ dze te dze te/ ma hā dze te yaṃ/ ma hā dze te yaṃ/ mā ma kā ya/ dush+tsa ri staṃ bha/ bha ga dush+tsa ri staṃ bha/ ma no dush+tsa ri staṃ bha/ dha ri ta tra staṃ bha/ ta ta sarbaṃ k+ṣā pā ya/ ā lo ka ya/ sarba ta thā ga tā/ dha ri ṣā nāṃ tsi ma hā biṣ+kaṃ k+ṣa mid pod sed dha ri ṣā ṇāṃ/ ma dhu ma dhu/ a ba bhā/ sa me dha ri ṣā ṇāṃ/ sarba ma ku sha la a bhi ba ra daṃ da na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ na ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ sma ra pra ti dz+nyā ma hā satwa sid+dh+yan+tu me man+t+ra ba deḥswā hā/ sngags 'di gur gum tshan+dan gyis/ /gro ga la bris sku'i mchod rten/ /sku gdung bcas par gzhug par bya/ /yang na sku gdung dang bcas pa'i/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang sku la gdags/ /tshes brgyad nas ni nya yi bar/ /bum pa mchod pa brgyad bshams te/ /dri dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i/ /'o thug zho dang 'bras chan mar/ /tsan+dan dkar po dri ga bur/ /gtor ma dkar dang dmar bcas pa'o/ /gtso bo'i mdun du dpe med sa/ /g.yas su dung can 'jigs sam g.yon/ /sna ma'i me tog brgya rtsa brgyad/ /gtor zhing dus gsum mchod de bkru/ /sdig sbyang rmi lam 'od du 'bar/ /bdud rnams zlog par byed pa la/ /rtse gsum sor brgyad tshad la ni/ /thod pa

skam po ser drug ste/ /dbus su rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ /seng ldeng yu ba khru gang pa/ /de yi rten yang sor drug ste/ /de ni zur brgyad ldan pa la/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ /pad+ma ral gri lcags kyu mda'/ /mdung rnams g.yas nas bskor bar dgod/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod bya ste/ /mtshan mo sngas su gzugs par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa ches/ /dug gi chogs rnams 'joms pa yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /rje btsun mgrin pa sngon po yi/ /rtsa ba'i rig sngags 'di gsungs so/ /namorat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ sarba ban+dha ts+tshe da na ka rā ya/ sarba pā pa sa mu dro ts+tsho ṣa ṇa ka rā ya/ sarba byā dhi pra sha ma ṇa ka rā ya/ sarba i t+yu pa dra ba bi nā sha na ka rā ya/ sarba bha ye ṣu trā ṇā ya ta s+ya na ma skṛ taṃ/ i maṃ ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa ra ha ba nī la kaṇ+ṭha nā ma hṛ da ya mā brta yiṣ+yā mi sarba ar+tha sā dha naṃ shu bha tse ta naṃ/ sarba satwā nāṃ/ pā pa mārga bi sho dha kaṃ/ ta d+ya thā/ a ba lo ki lo ka ma ti/ lo ka ga ti/ e h+ye hi/ ma hā bo dhi satwa/ he bo dhi sa twa/ he ma hā bo dhi satwa/ he pri ya bo dhi satwa/ he ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /sma ra hṛ da yi/ e h+ye hi/ ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa ra/ pa ra ma mai tri tsit+ta kā ru ṇi ka /ku ru ku ru karmaṃ/ sā dha ya sā dha ya/ bid+yāṃ/ de hi+i de hi me/ a raṅga maṅg+ga ma/ bi haṃ ga mi ha sid+dha/ yo ge shwa ra/ hu du hu du/ bīr+ya n+te/ ma hā bīr+yan+te/ dha ra dha ra/ dhā ra ṇe shwa ra/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ bi ma la a ma la mūrte/ ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa ra kṛṣ+ṇā dzi na mu ku ṭa a laṃ kṛ ta sha rī ra lam+ba pra lam+ba pi lam+ba/ ma hā sid+dha shud+dha dha ra/ ba la ba la/ ma hā ba la/ ma la ma la ma hā ma la/ dz+wa la dz+wa la ma hā dz+wa la/ kṛṣ+ṇa pak+ṣa kṛṣ+ṇa bar+ṇ+ṇa kṛṣ+ṇa pā sha ni r+ghā ta na/ he pad+ma ha sta/ dza ya kā ra/ ni shā tsa re shwa ra/ kṛṣ+ṇa sarba kṛ ta ya dz+nyo pa bī ta/ e h+ye hi bā rā ha mu khi/ tri pu ra da ha ne shwa ra/ nā rā yā ṇa/ ba la rū pa be ṣa dha ri/ he nī la kaṇ+ṭha/ he ma hā ha la ha la/ bi ṣa ni rdza ta/ lo ka s+ya/ rā ga bi ṣa nā sha nan/ dwe ṣa bi ṣa nā sha naṃ/ mo ha bi ṣa nā sha na ni rmo k+ṣa ṇa/ hu lu hu lu/ muñtsa muñtsa/ mu hu mu hu/ ha la ha

la/ ma hā pad+ma na bhi/ sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ budh+ya budh+ya/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ tawa nī la kaṇ+ṭha/ e h+ye hi/ bā ma s+thi ta saṃ ha mu kha/ ha sa ha sa/ muñdza muñdza/ ma hā aṭ+ṭā ṭ+ṭa ni/ r+ṇā di ne/ e h+ye hi/ bho bho ma hā sid+dha/ yo gī shwa ra/ ban+dha ban+dha bā tsaṃ/ sā dha ya sā dha ya/ bi d+yāṃ sma ra s+t+waṃ he bha ga bān/ lo ka bi lo ka s+t+waṃ/ ta thā ga tāṃ/ da dā hi me dar+ṣa ṇāṃ/ pra sādha ya me swā hā/ sid dhā ya swā hā/ ma hā sid dhā ya swā hā/ sid+dha yo gi shwa rā ya swā hā/ nī la kaṇ+ṭhā ya swā hā/ bā rā ha mu khā ya swā hā/ si haṃ mu khā ya swā hā/ ma hā na ra siṃ haṃ mu khā ya swā hā/ sid+dha bid+yā dha rā ya swā hā/ pad+ma ha stā ya swā hā/ ma hā pad+ma ha stā ya swā hā/ badz+ra ha stā ya swā hā/ ma hā badz+ra hastā ya swā hā/ kṛṣ+ṇa sarba kṛ ta yadz+nyo ba bī tā ya swā hā/ ma hā kā la mu ku ṭa dha rā ya swā hā/ tsakra ā yu dha dha rā ya swā hā/ shaṃ kha shab+da nir+ṇā da na ka rā ya swā hā/ bo dha na ka rā ya swā hā/ bā ma skan+dha dai sha s+thi ta kṛṣ+ṇā dzi nā ya swā hā/ bā ma hastā byā gh+ra tsarma ni bā sa nā ya swā hā/ lo ke shwa rā ya swā hā/ ma hā lo ke shwa ra ya swā hā/ sarba sid+dhe shwa rā ya swā hā/ rak+sha rak+ṣa māṃ swā hā/ ku ru rak+ṣa mūrti nāṃ swā hā/ na mo ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ sid+dh+ya n+tu me man+t+ra pa deḥswā hā/ smug bu me len sbur len dang / /shel dang bai ḍūr+ya ka ra ma/ /gser gyi snod du khur bcas ba/ /maṇ+ḍal dbus bzhag sngags khri brjod/ /mug khri rdo yi kong bur ni/ /chur bcas snga dro sngar byas nas/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig sngags brjod do/ /khong du 'thungs pas dbyig dug dang / /sbyar dug lhan cig skyes dug dang / /bza' nyes tsam yang sel 'gyur na/ /dug rigs gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /dogs pa'i the tshom mi bya'o/ /dad can shes rab ldan pa'i mi/ /rtsa ba'i gsang sngags gang la yang / /nan tan rtse gcig tu brjod na/ /de yis thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang zhig dad pa'i lcags kyu dang / /blo yi ra bar ldan pa la/ /lha klu 'bum phrag mthus skyob cing / /dkar po dge ba kun slong sems/ /byang chub rin chen gter thob par/ /sngags kyi mthus ni

mdzad pa ste/ /sngags la nyes dad med pa la/ /bstan na rang nyid nyams par 'gyur/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma dra ba zhes bya ba las rigs kyi khyad par gyi sngags byung ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bsdus pa'i dngos/ /'jig rten mgon po sa bcu'i dbang / /stobs bcu rgyas pa'i rang bzhin can/ /pha rol phyin bcu lhun grub pa/ /sa bcu gcig tu rdzogs nas kyang / /phyogs bcu kun du khyab mdzad pa'i/ /bcu gcig pa yi mtshan nyid nyid/ /bsod nams skal bar ldan pa'i mis/ /rang gi lus la sngags dgod bya/ /sngags dang bcas pa'i lus la ni/ /sred med bus kyang mi tshugs na/ /'jig rten gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /byad dang sha za ro langs dang / /'byung po mtshon dang grib gnon dang / /ltas ngan rnams ni myur du sel/ /bla ma las byung rim pas ni/ /myur du bla med byang chub 'gyur/ /bla ma'i lung dang bral bas ni/ /nams kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /spyi bor yi ge om̐ dkar po/ /nan tan du ni bsam par bya/ /dpral bar yi ge āḥljang gu/ /de bzhin du ni bsam par bya/ /lce yi steng du yi ge mchog /hrīḥyig dmar po 'od ldan bsam/ /snying gi phyogs su hūm̐ sngon po/ /lte bar ha yig ser po ste/ /de bzhin gsang bar ho ljang gu/ /bshang ba'i gnas su ho sngon po/ /pus mo gnyis la sa ser skya/ /rkang mthil yi ge ha ljang ser/ /lag mthil gnyis la hūm̐ dkar po/ /lag ngar la ni hrīḥsngon te/ /dpung par yi ge hraṃ dgod bya/ /yi ge tshogs kyis byin brlabs nas/ /gang dang gang yang rung ba yi/ /rtsol ba rnams la 'jug par bya/ /stsol ba de dang de dag kyang / /sngags kyi byin brlabs las byung zhing / /lus kyang sngags kyi ngo bo nyid/ /sngags kyis bskyed pa'i lus nyid ni/ /sngags dang bcas pa'i lus su 'gyur/ /sngags kyi lus kyi rigs rnams kyi/ /zhing khams du ma sbyangs nas kyang / /'gro ba rnams kyi lus su ni/ /'gro ba grol ba'i spyod pa ni/ /kun bzang mchog

dang mtshungs pa ste/ /'gro dang dbyer med don rig 'gyur/ /don de ma lus thob pa'i thabs/ /ngag gis rig par gyur ba yis/ /rig 'dzin zhes bya'i dngos po ste/ /de la gang gnas de yi ming / /rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bya ste/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs pas mi shes/ /lhag dang bcas pa'i rtsom pa ni/ /shin tu ngal ba nyid yin te/ /ngal ba nyid kyis gol ba'i lam/ /bgrod par dka' ba de spangs nas/ /shin tu bag yangs bde ba'i lam/ /skal dman yang dag sgrub 'di la/ /nan tan du ni 'jug par bya/ /ston pas de skad gsungs pa'i tshe/ /'khor rnams dga' nas thal sbyar te/ /mkha' la me tog gtor nas kyang / /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang gtso/ /thams cad kyis ni phyag 'tshal te/ /bskor ba du ma byas nas kyang / /gdong bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba'i/ /zhal dang sku yi 'du byed la/ /'dzum bzhin du ni bltas nas kyang / /gsang ba'i sems dang ldan pa dag /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /phyogs bcu rang rang bde bar 'khod/ /de nas 'jig rten mgon pos ni/ /'gro ba'i don du rig sngags gsungs/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don rdzogs phyir/ /las kyi sbyor ba'ang tha dad do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ /na ma ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ ar+ha da bh+yaḥsaṃmyak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥn ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ iṭ+ṭe baṭ+ṭe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su ma/ ba re/ i li mi li/ tsi ti dz+wa la ma pa na ya swā hā/ shud dhā ya swā hā/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya swā hā/ 'di gsungs tshe na sa chen yang / /rnam pa drug tu g.yos par gyur/ /rtsa ba'i snying po stong brjod pas/ /dngos grub ci dang ci 'dod 'grub/ /gzhan yang sngags pas kun gyi dbur/ /sngon gyi phyag 'tshal bzhi po brjod/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ.ar+ha da bh+yaḥsaṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥ

na ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ ha ra ha ra/ i li mi li/ tsi li tsi li/ khe le ha la swā hā/ dkyil 'khor nang du 'dug pa'i sa/ /chu dang gos la bdun bdun brjod/ /khrus byas gos gon nang du 'jug /snod sogs rdzas gzhan dag kyang bsam/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ ar+ha da bh+yaḥsaṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yeḥ/ na ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ dhu ru dhu ru/ ha ra ha ra swā hā/ bdun phrag re re btab pa yis/ /spos bsregs pa dang mar me sbar/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ saṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ.ar+ha da bh+yaḥsaṃ myak+saṃ bud dhe bh+yaḥn ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ si ri si ri/ dhi ri dhi ri/ si dhi ri si dhi ri swā hā/ me tog byug spos me tog phreng / /bdun bdun brjod la sku gzugs la/ /gtor dang byug dang gdags par bya/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ.ar+ha da bh+yaḥsaṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥn ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ sā dhe sā dhe/ so hi so hi/ so du so du/ bshos gtsang me tog 'bras bur bcas/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod nas ni/ /zhal zas dag gis rnam par mchod/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ.ar+ha da bh+yaḥsaṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥn ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ sā mā dhi si/ tsa le tsa le/ tsu ru tsu ru/ su ru su ru/ mu ru mu ru swā hā/ me tog dkar po'i shing dum bu/ /sum

cu bzhi mar sbrang rtsir ni/ /zhag gcig sbangs nas nyin gcig gam/ /nang re nub par re re la/ /sngags re btab nas bsregs nas gzod/ /ci dgos pa rnams bsgrubs na 'grub/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ.ar+ha da bh+yaḥsaṃmyak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥn ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ i li mi li/ pi li ti li/ tsi li ti li swā hā/ chu 'am thal ba yungs kar la/ /lan bdun sngags nas phyogs bzhir gtor/ /sa phyogs nye ring gang du yang / /mtshams gcod pa yi mchog lags so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ saṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ ar+ha da bh+yaḥsaṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥn ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ bi ti bi ti/ ti ṭe ti ṭe/ pe de pe de/ ka tsa ka tsa/ bha ga bā na/ ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ sarba sā dha naṃ swā hā/ sku sogs slar yang spyan drang dang / /rang nyid gnas nas ldog don phyir/ /chu la lan bdun btab pa yis/ /bkrus nas dgongs pa de dag 'grub/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ saṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ.ar+ha da bh+yaḥsaṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥn ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ badz+ra hūm̐ hriḥhoḥ/ 'jig rten 'pho la rab dga' bas/ /zas skom byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa ches/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms zhugs nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ /mgon po zhal ni bcu gcig pa/ /rtsa ba'i rig sngags 'di gsungs so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ.ar+ha da bh+yaḥsaṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥn ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/

ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ na maḥsarba byū ha bi hi sarba a haṃ bud+dha shra ba ke saṃ ghe bh+yaḥ/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ saṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ.ar+ha da bh+yaḥsaṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yaḥ/ na ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ a bha ya dā na/ sarba pa ta gha ra twā na ka raṃ/ sarba ār+yā ya gha ba pañtsa pra sha ma na ka raṃ/ sarba bi shud+dha/ kā la hi ghā ba hā/ bi gra hā/ bra ma ṇa ka raṃ/ sarba pā paṃ nā sha ya ka raṃ/ sarba bh+ya da be ta la/ pi sha mar+dhe na/ dur swa pa na/ durni mit+taṃ/ sarba bigh+ṇāṃ bi nā ya kāṃ/ bo dhi satwā ka raṃ/ pa ra tsakra/ dur bhe k+sha/ sha ki bha ya ni sa ra ka raṃ/ sā de ba/ nā ga /yak+sha/ gaṃ dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga /sarba ts+tshe da na ka raṃ/ sarba pi shā tse ke ṭa bha/ su k+ṣa dha gha dha/ krats+tsha ka li ra/ be ṭa li/ a maṃ ga la/ bi nā sha kā rā ya/ na mo nā tha ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /e ka da sha mu khaṃ/ sa ha sra bhu dzaṃ/ sa ha sra ne traṃ/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ dza ka ri/ yu di ta hā ra ṇa/ bi tsi tra mu khi/ e ka su mu kha/ sarba saṃ gha ma hā ra ṇi dza muṇ+he/ sa ha sra bhu dza ma hā ne traṃ/ ma hā shrī ni na laṃ kā ra/ ma ṇi kuṇ+ḍa ya sa na dha hā sa nat+te/ bi tsi tra mū la dha re/ tsan+d+ra sūr+ya/ a ti re ka /ā kā sha ga ga na tsa ri ṇe/ maṃ ga la sha ri dzī mu te be pit+ta pi na maṃ ga le/ bhu ri mi tra kā ra ne/ tsu ru tsu ru shwe ta pā de/ mu ru mu ru/ shat+ta a ba nat+te/ hu ru hu ru/ pa bīt+t+ra mu khi/ ku ru ku ru/ tsi tra mu khi/ ā di d+ya pā shā pa ra ṇi ni/ dzaṃ bha ni/ maṃ ga dha ni/ sarba pā ṇi ni/ sarba bīr+ya ram+bhe/ ma hā ni/ a mo gha pā sha ha sta/ sarba bha ya pi tsa yo ni ra tsa ri/ ag+ni bi shwa/ u da ka/ bā ya/ pra sha ma ni/ ka khorda ni/ bā na/ oṃ hi ri hi ri/ dza ya ka ri/ ba la ka ri/ da na ka ri/ te dzaska ka ri/ bhi ba bhi/ pra sha ma ṇi/ yud dhā ni par tsakra sha ma ṇi ni ba ra s+ya/ bi na ni/ mu dot+te ra ni pra bhu na bhe la/ ma ṇi ma ṇi/ ma hā ma ṇi/ ma ṇi dha re/ trai lo ka /a laṃ ka ka ri ti būrna ka ri/ bi daṃ sa ni/ ba ra bhe na/ pit+t+ra pā ṇi ni/ sarba bīr+ya karma ṇi/ su da ni/ sarba byā dhi ni/ pra

sha ma ṇi swā hā/ om̐ tsi li mi le swā hā/ tsi li tsi li swā hā/ mi li mi li swā hā/ si li si li swā hā/ tsi li li tsi li li swā hā/ tsin+dha li ma ti ni swā hā/ ūr+dha ke sha piṃ ga la ke to dhe ma nu mu khaṃ swā hā/ om̐ ka ra ka ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ muñtsa muñtsa muñtsa ya/ muñtsa ya/ pra shā ma ya/ pra shā ma ya/ yu dho da dhā ra ṇi phaṭa/ tsit+ta ni ra mā la ka ri phaṭa/ a su ra nā ri ki ti ha phaṭa/ dza ya ka ri phaṭa/ ska ti ri phaṭa/ sa ha sra bhu dze phaṭa/ sa ha sra ne tre phaṭa/ sarba bha dra dha ra na ma sa kṛ te phaṭa/ sarba bha ya bi mok+ṣa ṇi phaṭa/ ma ra tsa kra na pa ra ra ṇi phaṭa/ pa ra sai n+ya si gru pa ṇi phaṭa/ sarba kṛ t+ya ka ma si du ni phaṭa/ sarba byā dhi pra sha ma ni phaṭa/ sarba byā dhi bi nā sha ya phaṭa/ sarba gra hota ts+tshin+dha ni phaṭa/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ/ sarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twā nāṃ/ sa pa ra sa pa ra/ naṃ te tsa ri sa ma nāṃ/ sarba pra ya pra te bh+yaḥsarba yut+te bh+yaḥdus kṛ te bh+yaḥsarba kṛ ta kā khorda/ sarba bi ṣe bh+yaḥsarba kā ya bāk+tsit+ta si tse bh+yaḥrak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ swā hā/ sa ha sra bhu dze/ sa ha sra ne tra/ e ka da sha mu khi/ ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ sid+dh+ya na tu me man+t+ra pa dā ni swā hā/ rje btsun zhal ni bcu gcig pa'i/ /sngags 'di yon tan mtha' yas te/ /gang la 'di ni gtsug tor du/ /yid bzhin nor bu thogs dang mtshungs/ /'chang dang klog par byed pa des/ /mtha' yas yon tan rnyed par 'gyur/ /nad dang gdon rnams sel ba dang / /khyad par du ni sdig kun 'byang / /ba dkar mo yi bdud rtsi lngas/ /maṇ+ḍa la 'jam po lnga byugs la/ /gtsang sbra ldan pas dbus su ni/ /shing sku ring bsrel ldan pa bzhag gzhan yang ring bsrel ldan pa yi/ /sku gdung bzhi ni phyogs bzhir te/ /tshad ldan pa yi bum pa ni/ /lnga po dbus dang mtshams su ste/ /rigs lnga'i mdog dang phyag rgya can/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang mchod pa dang / /srad bu tha dad bre bar bya/ /ci 'dod phyag rgya bri byas te/ /tshes gcig nas ni bcu bzhi'i bar/ /'dod la dmigs nas sngags brjod de/ /bzhi khri rdzogs nas bco lnga la/ /

'dod pa gsol gdab khrus byas nas/ /ci 'dod myur du 'grub pa dang / /bdud dang bar du gcod pa dang / /rnam par 'tshe dang mi mthun pa/ /khrus kyis nges par sel bar 'gyur/ /sngags brjod yon tan mtha' yas rnams/ /bsdus nas sgrub po bla ldan 'gyur/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang gi/ /sngags gang brjod pa tsam la yang / /gshis ngan shi ba bco lnga med/ /skye bzang bco lnga thob par 'gyur/ /mu ge rgyal po'i chad pa dang / /dug dang mtshon dang g.yul 'gyed dang / /stag sogs sbrul sogs gcan gzan gdug /dug can zas dang me chus 'chi/ /srog chags mdun du nyal nyes dang / /g.yeng byed dang ni lha 'dres gtses/ /gsor mi rung dang bdag lceb rnams/ /de la nam yang mi 'jigs so/ /rgyal po chos ldan yul skye zhing / /'phags pa bzhugs dang dus bzang yul/ /bshes gnyen bzang dang dbang po tshang / /dge la dga' zhing tshul khrims ldan/ /bran khol bzang zhing nor mang rtag /gzhan gyis bkur zhing dgos 'dod sbyor/ /sems bder 'jig rten skyong bas bsrung / /sangs rgyas zhal mthong don zab brtags/ /gzhan yang dman la byams sems bskyed/ /snying rje mchi ma 'khrug pa dang / /yon tan dran nas spro ba dang / /dkon mchog gsum la dad pa dang / /phul du byung ba'i blo yis 'phel/ /tshul bzhin ma yin yid bral dang / /bka' lung sde snod dad pa rnams/ /yang nas yang du skye bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar spros pa'i gnas mthong na/ /sngags 'dis rang bzhin med par byas/ /om̐ swa bhā ba shud dhāḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā ba shud dho3 haṃ/ 'dzin pa drag po'i blo byung tshe/ /sngags 'dis stong pa nyid du bya/ /om̐ shū n+yatā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ gang gis lus ngag yid g.yo na/ /sngags 'dis brtan par byin gyis brlabs/ /om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gang la gnod yod sems ldan dang / /ngang gis sa gzhi bgegs yod pa/ /bsal phyir seng ldeng dkar po ni/ /brag la skyes

shing gzhon pa las/ /sor drug tshad ldan phur bu ni/ /brjid ldan rtse mo rno dpal can/ /mgo bo rked pa rgya mdud tshul/ /sor tshad phyed phyed ldan pa la/ /zur ni bcu drug rked pa la/ /sor gnyis zur brgyad ldan pa'o/ /sor gsum zur gsum rtse rno ba/ /dpal mtho cung zad par reg pa/ /ngos dang skabs ni zab pa ste/ /sngags kyi byin brlabs ldan pa brgyad/ /khang ba'i zur dang phyogs bzhi por/ /g.yas su phyogs par gzugs par bya/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya dz+nyā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā ar+ha te bh+yaḥsaṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ltas ngan thams cad 'joms pa dang / /gnas khang byin gyis brlab pa dang / /tshe dang longs spyod rtag pa dang / /dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dang / /dang po thal mo sbyar byas te/ /phyis ni lag g.yon sdigs mdzub bcas/ /om̐ dang a la la la ho/ /zhes brjod rngam cing khang pa yi/ /nang du 'jug pa khro bor bcas/ /de nas hūm̐ sgras se gol gtogs/ /de nas om̐ āḥbadz+ra dang / /s+thā na pā ṇi bh+yaḥ.a haṃ/ /rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa brjod/ /shin tu 'jam pa'i stan la ni/ /rdo rje skyil krung gis gnas nas/ /bsrangs te mig ni sna rtser phab/ /dal ba'i rlung ldan rkan la ni/ /lce ni cung zad reg par bya/ /lte ba cung zad 'khum pa yis/ /sems ni bag yod gnas par bya/ /rtag pa ma yin mi rtag min/ /gtsang ma ma yin mi gtsang min/ /bde ba'ang ma yin sdug bsngal min/ /bdag dang ngar min bdag med min/ /blang dang dor ba'i 'jig tshogs min/ /sems ma yin zhing sems byung min/ /phung khams skye mched med ma yin/ /yid min rtag min mi rtag min/ /mun pa ma yin shes rab min/ /'gro min 'ong min gnas ma yin/ /sna tshogs sprin glog du ma ni/ /'dod gzugs du ma sgyur byed pa/ /mkha' byung nam mkha' la ni thim/ /
