ra/ /bsregs pas glo nad sel bar byed/ /'bras bu gsum dang zho sha lnga/ /bsregs pas snying nad sel bar byed/ /'u su sbrang dang byi dang ka/ /bsregs pas mchin pa'i nad sel 'gyur/ /me tog kha dog lnga bsregs na/ /pho ba la sogs nang grol nad/ /ma lus thams cad zhi bar byed/ /lus mdzes pa yang thob par 'gyur/ /nor 'dod pas ni seng ldeng mer/ /ba ser zho dang mar bsreg bya/ /gos mdog gang dang gang 'dod la/ /de dang mtshungs pa'i me tog dang / /srad bu sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /shing mdog de dang mthun pa yi/ /dri zhim dag la bsreg par bya/ /rnyed 'gyur the tshom mi bya'o/ /pri yang ku dang ka ling ka/ /pad+ma'i ze ba yal sdong la/ /bsregs cing gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /gter gyi longs spyod rgyas par 'gyur/ /'bras dang myu gu'i 'bras bu sogs/ /bsreg na longs spyod brtan par 'gyur/ /dan ḍod pa la 'bras bu gsum/ /brgya bsregs bu dang bu mo 'phel/ /'bras yos 'phel bar 'dod pas kyang / /spri ka dza ti me tog dkar/ /ba dkar 'o ma zho mar bcas/ /bsregs pas 'khor dang dmag dpung 'phel/ /de 'bum grangs kyis rgyal srid 'thob/ /mngar gsum bil ba'i 'bras bu la/ /'bum gyis rang nyid rgyal por 'gyur/ /sngags mthu rgyas pa'i don du ni/ /nim pa'i shing la mar dang ni/ /yungs kar dkar po sbrang bcas la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bsreg par bya/ /gang gis rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /dbang du bya bar 'dod pa yis/ /yungs kar rgyal ba'i yungs kar bcas/ /rgya sran drug tu bsreg par bya/ /gnod sbyin mo rnams dbang 'dod na/ /mya ngan med pa'i yam shing la/ /'bras bu gsum dang gur gum ni/ /stong phrag gcig tu bsreg par bya/ /gnod sbyin tshogs dbang byed pa la/ /'bras bu gsum pa'i shing la

ni/ /'bras bu gsum dang gu gul la/ /stong phrag gnyis su bsreg par bya/ /lha rnams dbang du bya 'dod pas/ /a rur yi shing sa ra la/ /'o ma zho mar sbrang rtsi la/ /sum stong bsregs pas lha dbang 'gyur/ /bud med dbang du 'dod pas ni/ /til dang 'bras sogs phub ma la/ /'bras dang rang byung brtsa rtsa brgyad/ /bsregs pas bzang mo dbang du 'gyur/ /byis pa dbang du 'dod pas ni/ /pri yang ku yi sbyin sreg bya/ /las rnams gang dang gang la yang / /de dang mtshungs pa'i sems kyis sbyor/ /zhi ba zhi ba'i yid kyis te/ /skal bzang blo ni rgyas pa la/ /chags dang 'dun sems ldan pas ni/ /dbang du 'gyur la the tshom med/ /khro dang bcas pa'i yid kyis ni/ /drag po'i las su 'gyur ba yod/ /brtan po dal 'byor ldan pa'i blo/ /rgyun rtag gsal ba yod gyur pas/ /ci ltar bsam pa de 'grub kyi/ /gzhan du yang ni de ltar min/ /mig la skyon zhugs lus kyi ni/ /dngos gang gsal bar blta ba ltar/ /bla ma dang ni bral gyur na/ /sngags kyi byin brlabs snang ba med/ /lus ngag yid kyi sgo nas kyang / /rnam pa kun du bla ma la/ /smod pa 'bad de spang bar bya/ /smad pas dmyal sogs ngan 'gror 'gro/ /bla ma'i ngag las byung ba dang / /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya mchod/ /om̐ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wā la tiṣ+ṭha sid dha lo tsa ne sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā/ bsang gtor dang ku sha dgram pa'i sngags so/ /om̐ dz+wā la dz+wā lā na lārka swā hā/ /sbar ba'i sngags so/ /na maḥs man+ta bud dhā ṇāṃ/ om̐ ag+na ye ā dī pya a bi sha ma hā shri ye ha bya ka bya ba ha nā ya swā hā/ /mchod mar gyi sngags so/ /om̐ sarba pā pam̐ da ha na badz+rā ye swā hā/ /til gyi sngags so/ /om̐ sarba saṃ pā de swā hā/ /zho dang zan dam pa'i 'o/ /om̐ badz+ra bha smiṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ /ut+pa la lo/ /om̐ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ 'bras kyi 'o/ /om̐ badz+ra a

pra ti ha ta badz+ra swā hā/ ku sha'o/ /om̐ badz+ra bi dzā ya swā hā/ lag pan gyi'o/ /om̐ badz+ra mā le puṣ+pa ye swā hā/ mngar gsum dang dkar gyi'o/ /om̐ badz+ra ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ nas kyi'o/ /om̐ ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ /sran ma ma sha'i 'o/ /om̐ badz+ra ghasma ri swā hā/ gro'o/ om̐ badz+ra yadz+nyā ya swā hā/ u dum bā ra'o/ /om̐ ti ti pri mi swā hā/ /byang chub shing ngo / /om̐ badz+rā r+thā ya swā hā/ /n+ya gro dha'o/ /om̐ badz+ra naṃ kā ya swā hā/ a mra'i'o/ /om̐ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ thams cad du bsang ba'o/ /chus ni dag par byed pa dang / /rdul sogs mun pa zhi bar byed/ /zhi ba chu yi dkyil 'khor bar/ /dkar po zlum po kho na'o/ /sas ni rtswa shing 'bru me tog /skyed dang dngos po rgyas par byed/ /rgyas pa'i sa yi dkyil 'khor ltar/ /ser po gru bzhi pa na'o/ /rlung gis sdud dang 'byed pa dang / /dbang du byas nas g.yo bar byed/ /dbang la rlung gi dkyil 'khor ltar/ /zla gam dmar po'i kha dog go/ /mes ni smin cing sreg pa dang / /drag shul gyis ni yal bar byed/ /drag po gru gsum me'i dkyil 'khor/ /nang dmar rgyab ni nag por bya/ /mkha' la nyi ma shar ba ni/ /mun pa'i sgrib pa zhi bar byed/ /zhi la shar du bltas pa ste/ /dpal ldan gos kyang dkar po'o/ /nyi ma byang du 'gro ba'i tshe/ /dngos po rgyas par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /rgyas pa byang du bltas bya ba/ /gos ni ser ram ljang gu shis/ /nyi ma thal nas mtshan mo ni/ /dbang du dngos po 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /dbang la nub phyogs bltas pa dang / /gos kyang dmar ser rab tu shis/ /nyi ma lhor 'gro'i dus su ni/ /shin tu grang ba'i chu yis ni/ /rtswa sogs dngos rnams bsad nas kyang / /des dang 'thor dang dengs pa dang / /skabs dang g.yar dang dub ba dang / /rab tu g.yos dang bcas par 'gyur/ /mngon spyod lho yi phyogs bltas nas/ /gos kyang sngo dang nag po bya/ /tsam pa ka dang pu ti ka/ /lag skyes pad+ma dkar po dang / /ku mud dkar po zla seng rnams/ /chu gtsang dang bar bcas pa dag /

zhi ba'i las la mchod par bya/ /mañdzu nā ga bi sha ri/ /su mu le dang a spras dang / /gser mdog chen po chu dung dang / /tsi'u le ser dang pad+ma ser/ /chu bo chen po chur bcas pa/ /rgyas pa'i las la bsngags pa'o/ /mu tsi na dang man du dmar/ /lo yi che dang nya sha rnams/ /sin dhu ra dang pad+ma dmar/ /ku mu da rigs dmar po rnams/ /lu ma'i chu dang bcas pa ste/ /dbang gi las la mchod par bya/ /ut+pal k+ṣe pa la ka dang / /ud khye pa dang ma mi shi/ /dzu mod sbyin la mgo bo dang / /phag rna daṇ+ḍota pa la rnams/ /khron pa'i chu dang lhan cig tu/ /mngon spyod las la mchod par bya/ /sā lu dkar po zan dang zho/ /pri ka spos ni zhi ba la/ /sā lu dmar po'i zan 'o ma/ /tsan+dan dmar po dbang la 'o/ /gro dang ma sa bser ba'i zan/ /hu lu ka ni rgyas pa la'o/ /nas dang bra bo'i zan gu gul/ /btsos pa'i sha dang lhan cig ste/ /dwag po'i las de zhal zas dang / /bdug spos bye brag shes par bya/ /rtsi mar dang ni a ba se'i/ /sdong bur ldan pa'i mar me ni/ /zhi ba'i las la shin tu shis/ /yang na pad dkar sdong bu'o/ /til lam shin tu dngas ma dang / /sa ri ha yi sdong bu ni/ /rgyas pa'i las la shin tu shis/ /yang na ba yi lag gi cha/ /na ke la yi mar dang ni/ /pad+ma dmar po'i mar dang ni/ /dbang gi las la shin tu shis/ /yang na ba ya ma ri'o/ /yungs dang tsi la mar dang ni/ /tsi tra'i sdong bu mar me ni/ /yang na gso ma'i shun pa yis/ /mdog dmar dal zhing gsal ba ni/ /gangs ri'i rtse ltar dkar 'bar ba/ /bar bre smra gul spos dkar dri/ /zhi ba'i las ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /mdog dmar g.yo zhing mog pa la/ /nyi ma thal ka'i ri rtse 'dra/ /shib sgra ma li ka la'i dri/ /dbang gi las 'grub the tshom med/ /mdog ser mig g.yo dngas pa la/ /nyi ma shar ba'i ri ltar 'bar/ /lha pa sgra tsam pa ka yi dri/ /rgyas pa'i las 'grub the tshom med/ /le brgan mdog ldan 'khyim zhing smug /hur

sgra rul dri bro ba dang / /nags kyi ri bo ltar 'bar ba/ /mngon spyod las la 'grub par 'gyur/ /'jig rten ting 'dzin ldan grub pa'i/ /drang srong rigs la dpag med kyang / /me yi lha ni bzhi bcu bzhi/ /sbyin sreg las la spang bar bya/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i ting 'dzin can/ /bcu gnyis grangs ni gzung bar bya/ /gnya' na ka dang sa bi ki/ /tuk+ṣu se'u mya s+ye tro dang / /lto ba yid skyes khro bo dang / /dmar po mṛ ta cho ma li/ /bhi su ya ki bcu gnyis po/ /phan 'dogs la sogs las la sbyar/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg thal bas ni/ /'byung po phra mo zhi bar byed/ /dbang gi thal bas 'byung po 'ching / /rgyas pas 'dod pa'i las sbyin byed/ /ri bo'i rtse la gtor bar bya/ /drag pos 'byung po sel bar bya/ /lam gyi gzhung du gtor bar bya/ /zhi dang dbang gi zhing phyogs dang / /ra ba skyed mos tshal du gtor/ /dag par byed pas chu bo ltar/ /rgyas pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / /gang bar byed pa rgya mtsho ltar/ /sbyin sreg gis ni lha mnyes shing / /sngags bsgrub sngags kyi las rnams 'grub/ /drang srong tshogs rnams thams cad dang / /dri za'i tshogs rnams thams cad dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams thams cad ni/ /sbyin sreg gis ni rab dga' nas/ /rnal 'byor grogs byed bsrung ba dang / /skyob phyir tshe ring dpal 'phel zhing / /nad med longs spyod rgyas pa dang / /bsam pa bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma dra ba zhes bya ba las me la brten pa'i sbyor ba'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' che/ /rdzu 'phrul 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ /mkha' la yi ge sprul nas ni/ /'gro don sna tshogs mdzad pa zhig /'khor bcas dkyil 'khor der lhags nas/ /phyag 'tshal bskor ba du ma byas/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis rgyas par mchod/ /phyogs gcig 'khod nas ston pa la/ /mgrin gcig gsung ni snyan pa yis/ /'di skad tshig ni gsol

ba 'debs/ /om̐ mtshan dang dpe byad brgyan pa'i sku/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /chos kyi longs spyod ji snyed pa/ /rdzogs par longs spyod mdzad phyag 'tshal/ /gang la mkho ba de'i gtso bo/ /'dren pa gzugs brnyan du ma 'chang / /sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul mdzad pa'i sku/ /bde ba che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'gyur rnam dag byang chub lam/ /phyogs chos byang chub sum cu bdun/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs brtson mdzad pa/ /chos rnams lhun grub sku phyag 'tshal/ /rnam dag rgya mtshor ldan rnams la/ /thugs rje rgya mtsho rgyun byung nas/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho spyod mdzad pa'i/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs phyag 'tshal/ /sngags dang rdzas dang phyag rgya'i rim/ /sna tshogs kyis ni don mdzad phyir/ /theg pa kun las khyad par du/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /nan tan sgrub pa smos ci dgos/ /sngags dang phyag rgya 'chang bas kyang / /nad dang gnod sel bskal pa yi/ /sgrib rnams 'byang bas khyad par 'phags/ /dbul po rigs dang dman pa yang / /zhugs ma thag nas bde ldan zhing / /cung zad grub nas nus mthu ni/ /dpag med 'byung bas khyad par 'phags/ /mgon po bcom ldan rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dpal chen ye shes kun gyi mdzod/ /'od zer nyi ma 'bum gzi can/ /'gro ba 'dren gtso dad dpon gyi/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang gi/ /sngags dang phyag rgyar bcas pa yis/ /'gro la sna tshogs phan don du/ /ci ltar 'gyur mdzad bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa che/ /pad+ma'i spyan gdangs 'dzum mdzad nas/ /tshangs pa'i gsung ni snyan pa yis/ /'gro la phan phyir 'di skad gsungs/ /dge byed phyag rgya sngags dang bcas/ /'gro la phan phyir zhus pa ni/ /legs so rdzu 'phrul 'khor lo che/ /shes rab 'chang ba khyod legs so/ /sems dpa' chen po de phyir ngas/ /khyod la ngo mtshar legs par bshad/ /khyod kyang rtse gcig yid kyis nyon/ /legs par zung la rgya cher spros/ /ras sam gro ga shing shun

gang / /'jam zhing nag ris med pa la/ /gur gum gi'u wang sen rtsi dang / /tsan+dan gyis ni phyag rgya bri/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud bcas/ /'od dang ldan pa bri bar bya/ /dha ra dha ra dang po ste/ /gnyis par dhi ri dhi ri spro/ /gsum pa dhu ru dha ru ste/ /iṭ+ṭe biṭ+ṭe bzhi lnga pa/ /tsa le tsa le gnyis bri'o/ /pra tsa le gnyis drug par ro/ /ku su me dang ku su ma/ /bdun pa bris te brgyad pa la/ /ba le i li mi li bri/ om̐ mi tsi ti dza lam dang / /swā hā ra bcas pa dbus su'o/ /phyag 'tshal bcas sngags mtha' mar bri/ /rab rdzogs sngags kyis lhar dmigs nas/ /gtsang ma'i mchod pas mchod bya ste/ /sngags stong brjod nas lus la gdags/ /'di ni bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /nad dang yams dang gdon rnams dang / /'jigs pa brgyad las skyob par nges/ /rig sngags bzlog na khyad par du/ /rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga la/ /'od kyi ra ba zlum po yi/ /ri mo gnyis dang bcas pa bri/ /rwa rnams la ni hūm̐ gnyis par/ /rig sngags bzlog dang bcas pa bri/ /lte bar om̐ hrīḥswā hā'i bar/ /bdag nyid bsrung zhes bri bar bya/ /mu khyud dang por bri bar bya/ /gzigs dbang yid bzhin nor sngags so/ /gnyis par gdong bcu gcig pa'i sngags/ /gsum par pad+ma gar dbang gi/ /sngags rnams g.yas su bskor bar bya/ /gal te nad yams bzlog pa la/ /'dab brgyad pad+ma mu khyud gsum/ /sngon ltar yi ge bkod pa la/ /mu khyud gnyis par spyan gyi sngags/ /gsum par rten 'brel sngags bris nas/ /lus sam mgul du thogs pas ni/ /nad rims dang ni lhog 'brum sogs/ /rlung gis rdul bzhin sel bar 'gyur/ /de nas tshig de thos ma thag /lha min bu mo nad bdag mo/ /sa tu de bi zhes bya ba/ /bzhengs te thal mo sbyar byas te/ /bu mo khris ni mgrin gcig tu/ /bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad gsol/ /rje btsun 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig po/ /mgon po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag gi sngags 'di gang 'dzin pa/ /gal te 'brum nad byung na ni/ /bdag ni sems can dmyal bar 'gro/ /

dam bcas 'di ni dran par bya/ /tre ba la bya'i ka ka ba ni ta/ /su ma ya bi lā sa ka ka ra ni/ /ki shun pañtsa tra li he na yi/ /ke na ka ta tsa ra ṇi/ /ya mirnan da ma na tsa/ /ya mi bar nad bur dwa/ /dwa tsa pid tra tsit+t+ra nad dam/ /sa stu de wi me bha ba/ /lha mos de skad gsol ma thag /mgon pos 'di skad bka' stsal to/ /om̐ om̐ bha bita bit+ti mi ti/ ga tsan+d+ra ka ra ni/ a mu ka s+ya ka s+ya/ lo hi ta gam̐ dha pa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ byin brlabs ldan pa'i sngags de ni/ /rgyun du bzlas pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /om̐ ha na se rū pa dha ri swā hā/ srad bu mnyams dkar po la/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig mdud par bya/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bzlas nas kyang / /lus sam mgul du gdags par bya/ /kraṃ hi ti ka ti ga tra tha pra gshig /ta thā yo thā tsa la he hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sran ma rdog po re re la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad brgyad bzlas pa yi/ /'bru bdun thum por byas pa zhig /dri bzang bcas la mgul du thogs/ /yams nad kun dang 'brum nag nad/ /shin tu gdug pa kun sel 'gyur/ /de nas rig sngags 'chang ba mo/ /dpal phreng mas ni 'di skad gsol/ /bdag gi rig sngags 'di zlos pa/ /rims nad kun dang bral bar 'gyur/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ /na ma ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ri ṇi kā ya/ na mo badz+ra mā ra bi dza yā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ badz+re badz+re/ ma ha badz+re/ sarba bhī ra thā/ ha na ha na badz+ra/ sarba dz+wa ra pra shra ma na ye swā hā/ mi skra mi rus sle tres dang / /gu gul yungs kar sgog skya dang / /shing kun gla rtsi 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs phyed phyogs bzhir hrīḥyig bri/ /mtshams bzhir bris te dbus su ming / /sngags 'di mu khyud dang po la/ /gnyis gdong bcu gcig pa yi sngags/ /bris nas lus sam mgul du thogs/ /nad rims thams cad sel ba dang / /rnal 'byor kun dang ldan par 'gyur/ /de nas spyan ras gzigs dbang gis/ /'gro ba'i don du 'di skad gsol/ /rang 'byung can gyi ras la ni/ /sen rtsi'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ /mu khyud gsum dang ldan pa bri/ /rtsibs bzhi hrīḥl g.yon skor du/ /hrīḥghi wa shiṃ ku ru hrīḥ/ /mu khyud dang por mgon po ni/ /pad+ma gar dbang sngags bri'o/ /gnyis pa ut+pal

dmar po phreng / /gsum pa lcags kyu nyi shu gcig /dbus su bam̐ yig hrīḥr bcas bri/ /lha dam nyid kyang dam byed na/ /'gro ba gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /gsol dang bkra shis brjod pa dang / /bgegs kyi gnod pa sel 'dod pas/ /rtse gsum rdo rje rgya gram ste/ /dbus su spyan ras gzigs dbang mgon/ /pad+ma gtsug tor sngags bri'o/ /rwa rnams kun la hūm̐ yig ni/ /bgegs ming ud tsa ta yis bskor/ /mu khyud dang po spyan ras gzigs/ /ha la ha la'i sngags bri'o/ /gnyis pa khro bo rta skad sngags/ /gsum par bgegs dgra'i sngags bris la/ /de rgyab me yi phung po bri/ /gang zhig 'khor lo 'di bris pas/ /sred med bu ltar mthu che ba/ /gdug pa can yang 'thor byed na/ /phran tshegs dbyer ba smos ci dgos/ /gang la ser sna rnams chags shing / /longs spyod 'phel bar mi 'gyur na/ /phun sum tshogs ldan dpal 'phel phyir/ /skyob pa'i phyag rgya bshad par bya/ /rgyal po 'am ni dge 'dun la/ /gtsang ldan ras bzang blangs nas kyang / /dag par bkrus te dri bzang byug /legs par brgyan nas thig btab ste/ /gur gum dang ni gla rtsi yis/ /pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug bri/ /phyogs bzhir 'dab mar dpal be'u ste/ /mtshams bzhir yid bzhin nor bu bri/ /mtshams brgyad la ni yi ge gaṃ/ /om̐ dang badz+ra da ke hūm̐/ /yi ge drug gis bskor bar bya/ /mu khyud dang por mi bshol sngags/ /gnyis pa gdong bcu gcig pa'i sngags/ /gsum pa ut+pal phreng ba ste/ /yang tog rtse 'am mdzod bzhag nas/ /gsol btab mchod na longs spyod 'phel/ /bud med gang zhig bu 'dod pas/ /de bzhin pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /phyogs bzhir hrīḥni mtshams su drang / /dbus su khye'u yi gzigs shig bri/ /phyogs bzhir yid bzhin nor bu bri/ /sngags bu stsol bcas bri bar bya/ /mtshams bzhir om̐ dang a ma ra/ /dzī wa na tī ye swā hās bskor/ /mu khyud dang po spyan ras gzigs/ /pad+ma rgyan lung can gyi sngags/ /gnyis par gdong bcu gcig pa'i sngags/ /gsum par ut+pal dmar po'i phreng / /'od 'phro rtag par mchod pa dang / /phul du byung ba'i bstod pas bstod/ /

gsol ba 'debs shing sngags bzlas na/ /bu stsol 'gyur la the tshom med/ /bsrung dang nor 'phel dbang byed dang / /bu slong ba yi phyag rgya ni/ /smin drug snar ma rgyal la bri/ /lhag ma rnams ni ci bder bri/ /gang zhig sems stor yid mi dga'/ /glo bur yi mug skye 'gyur na/ /pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa yi/ /dbus su rang gzugs mtshan ma bri/ /'dab mar rdo rje mdog bzhi pa/ /gdong bcu gcig pa'i sngags kyis bskor/ /mu khyud la ni spyan ras gzigs/ /don yod zhags pa'i sngags bri'o/ /gnyis par rdo rje phreng ba bri/ /de'i rgyab 'od kyi phreng ba bri/ /rtag par mchod cing gsol ba gdab/ /nad sel tshe ring bsod nams 'phel/ /gang zhig shes rab 'dod pas ni/ /dpal be'u rgyal po'i du mar ni/ /tri yig rgyab tu sngags 'dis bskor/ /om̐ dang kā la de ka la/ /ma ni swā hā zhes pa bri/ /de rgyab mu khyud 'khor ba la/ /mgrin pa sngon po'i rtsa sngags bri/ /de rgyab 'od kyi ra ba bri/ /gang gis 'di 'chang mchod pa la/ /nad dang gnod pa kun bral te/ /dug dang rims nad 'joms pa dang / /shes rab myur du 'phel bar 'gyur/ /yul du lo thog nyams pa dang / /thog 'brug ser ba rgod pa dang / /klu dang sa bdag gnod pa ste/ /de bas la sbyor ba bshad par bya/ /shing kun dkar po mnyams pa/ /nyams dga'i sbyor ba nyi rim la/ /rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa/ /mig sman gyis ni bri bar bya/ /grwa rnams la ni hūm̐ yig la/ /om̐ dang dzi ni ti ti te/ /hūṃ phaṭa ces pa'i sngags kyis bskor/ /mu khyud dang po mgon po che/ /gdong bcu gcig pa'i sngags phreng bri/ /gnyis par thugs rje chen po mgon/ /mi bshol ba yi sngags kyis bskor/ /gsum par rdo rje phreng ba dang / /me yi 'od dang ldan par bri/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bstan tsam gyis/ /klu yi rgyal po mthu ldan rnams/ /'khor dang bcas te lus skams 'gyur/ /gang gi khyim du gdod pa dang / /ma he rta sogs yams nad can/ /bsal ba'i thabs kyi phyag rgya ni/ /brtan par drang srong tshogs rnams nyon/ /ko bi da ri'i shing la ni/ /khru gang khru gnyis dbyibs gru bzhi/ /gas grugs chag sogs med

pa la/ /shin tu srab 'jam sor gnyis rngams/ /shing de la ni rta babs gzugs/ /'khor lo gdugs dang bcas pa yi/ /brtsegs pa'i g.yas zur dang po ni/ /rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga ste/ /gnyis pa ut+pal dmar po'o/ /gsum pa 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ser/ /bzhi par pad+ma dkar po'o/ /g.yon zur dang por pad+ma dmar/ /gnyis pa ut+pal sngon po'o/ /gsum par nor bu bzhi rgya gram/ /nang khang du ni pad+ma bya/ /'dab ma brgyad pa 'od ldan pa'o/ /lte ba dang ni 'dab brgyad la/ /om̐ dang pi shā tsi par+ṇa/ /sha ba ri sarba byā dhi/ /pra sha ma ni swā hā zhes/ /baṃḥyig la ni bskor bar bri/ /mu khyud dang po spyan ras gzigs/ /gdong bcu gcig gi sngags bri'o/ /gnyis par chos kyi gtsug tor gyi/ /rtsa ba'i phreng sngags bri bar bya/ /rgya skyegs dang ni mtshal yin te/ /de la shing spyin byug par bya/ /mchod dang gsol gdab sngags dag ni/ /bdun stong re re brjod byas nas/ /sgo gong la gdags byung 'jug tshe/ /'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rta phyugs yams nad ma lus la/ /rig pa'i lha mo'i tshogs bcas pa'i/ /'jig rten mgon gyi rig sngags mthus/ /myur du sel bar mnan pa dang / /bzlog dang bcing bar mdzod ces brjod/ /phyugs bdag chen pos skyong ba ltar/ /glang po rta bong ma he'i tshogs/ /brtan zhing nad dang gnod pa med/ /shin tu 'phel zhing rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dmag dpung chen po 'jigs pa la/ /khyad par du ni skyob pa yi/ /phyag rgya sbyor ba mnyan par gyis/ /yung bas ras sam shing la ni/ /pad dkar steng du kha ṭ+wāṃ dang / /ral gri 'od ma bri bar bya/ /de la gdu bu gsum gyis bskor/ /dang po gdong bcu gcig pa'i sngags/ /gnyis pa seng ge sgra yi sngags/ /gsum par ha ya chen po'i sngags/ /de rgyab me yi ra ba bri/ /'di la gsol ba btab nas ni/ /g.yul ngor khyer te zhugs pa gang / /dgra dpung chen po 'bros 'gyur te/ /rang nyid g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /longs spyod phyir ni byang bltas bri/ /dbang byed pa ni nub tu ste/ /g.yul bzlog pa ni lhor bltas bri/ /lhag ma rnams la shar bltas bri/ /dkar

ser dmar dang sngo ba yi/ /dbye bas zas dang gos shes bya/ /'dzum dang rngam dang dgod dang khro/ /bzhin gyi rnam pa bshad pa yi/ /sngags dang sngags kyi 'od phreng dang / /lha yi kha dog dbye ba dang / /snod la sogs pa'i dbye ba dang / /rgyan yang de ltar shes par bya/ /kun kyang rin chen pad+ma'i gdan/ /kha dog sna tshogs ldan par ni/ /sngags kyis yig 'bru'i lha rnams bzhugs/ /sngags rdzogs nas ni sngags su dmigs/ /gang gis phyag rgya 'chang byed la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams dang / /rig pa'i lha mo'i tshogs rnams dang / /'jig rten 'dren pa'i tshogs bcas dang / /spyan ras gzigs dbang tshogs chen dang / /khro bo tshogs bcas ma lus dang / /'jig rten skyong ba grags ldan rnams/ /ci 'dod las rnams ma lus pa'i/ /grogs dang dpung du byas nas ni/ /tshul bzhin du ni bsgrub pa la/ /brtson 'grus gang dang gang gis kyang / /the tshom du ni mi bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma dra ba las phyag rgya la brten pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas mkha' la gshegs pa yi/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i drang srong mchog/ /mtshan dpe du ma rgyas pa che/ /nyi ma'i gong bu zhes bya ba/ /drang srong rje dpon tshogs kyi mchog /'gro don rdzogs mdzad thugs rje can/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mgon po la/ /sangs rgyas tshig gis 'di skad gsol/ /om̐ 'od zer du ma ther zug gi/ /srid 'dam stug po sel byed rgyal/ /yon tan ye shes kyis brgyan sku/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs phyag 'tshal/ /gsung snyan yan lag brjod bral chos/ /bag chags ri bo snyil mdzad rgyal/ /skye 'gag bral ston sde snod gsum/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs phyag 'tshal/ /skye 'gag gnod bral mnyam bzhag pa/ /ting 'dzin shes rab 'phel mdzad rgyal/ /ye shes gzigs pa mtha' yas thugs/ /mgon po spyan ras gzigs phyag 'tshal/ /sna tshogs sman dang sngags sbyar nas/ /lha yi gong bu'i ril bu ni/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa

yi/ /dngos grub ma lus rdzogs pa yi/ /thugs rje'i nyi ma lham mdzad ba'i/ /mgon po pad+mas bshad du gsol/ /'gro rnams ma rig 'dam la zhen/ /srid pa'i thag pas rgya gram bcings/ /'dod chags zhe sdang mun pas g.yogs/ /nga rgyal phrag dog chu bos g.yengs/ /ngan rtog log lam g.yang sar ltung / /bag med ser sna'i dug gis myos/ /sdig pa'i grib mas rnam par rgyas/ /bag chags 'thug bo'i ri bos mnan/ /mgon po khyod ni thugs rjes ngal ba med/ /nyes pa'i rgya mtsho bsal ba'i phyir/ /shes rab thabs 'byung bshad du gsol/ /de nas 'jig rten mgon po rje/ /thugs rje thugs dpal mnga' ba yi/ /thugs dam rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu bcas/ /khyad par gsung 'di bka' stsal to/ /mtha' dag gzugs sgra thos pa dang / /rdzu 'phrul bsgyur dang gzhan sems shes/ /'das dang ma 'ongs don shes dang / /mtha' yas shes drug las spyod pa/ /dngos dang rtags dang cha mthun gyis/ /rnam pa bcwa brgyad dag tu 'gyur/ /phra dang yang dang mchod par bya ba dang / /bdag por gyur dang dbang du 'gyur ba dang / /gar yang phyin yang 'dod dgur ldan pa dang / /dga' mgur gnas te dbang phyug yon tan no/ /rnam pa brgyad kyis dper bya yis/ /longs spyod dbang dang lus la dbang / /tshe la dbang dang rkang mgyogs dang / /chu la mi 'bying mkha' la 'gro/ /sa 'og 'gro dang mi snang ba/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod sogs/ /dngos po gang dang gang bsgrub rnams/ /ril bu las ni 'byung 'gyur gyi/ /gzhan ni myur du 'grub mi 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ril bu ni/ /mtshams med la sogs byed pas kyang / /rnyed ma thag tu dngos grub 'gyur/ /nye dang dbang ldan lha yi sras/ /ma mos dbang du byed gyur na/ /'byung po sha za lha min mi/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro 'byung po klu/ /dud 'gro la sogs rdzogs gzugs can/ /sems can gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /dngos grub bzang po 'dod pa yis/ /khyad par ril bus 'di bsgrub bya/ /gi'u wang dang ni lig

bu mig /ldong ros bzang por sbyar ba yi/ /ril bu rgya sran tshad byas nas/ /snod gtsang nang du gzhag par bya/ /sku yi mdun du sngags brjod na/ /sngan chad ma mthong snang ba'am/ /sgra thos sam ni bde gshegs gzugs/ /yid 'ong mngon du byung ba sogs/ /mar ngo gsum gyis 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de nas zla ba gzas bzung tshe/ /ci 'byor mchod de snyim par bcug /bzlas brjod byas nas nyi shar na/ /du bar 'thul dang dri can 'gyur/ /dud 'thul lus la byugs pas kyang / /snang ba dang 'od gzugs can dang / /'dzam gling phyogs rnams rgyu ba dang / /longs spyod che dang ldan 'gyur te/ /shi 'phos nas ni dga' ldan gnas su skye/ /dri ma tsam gyis lus byugs kyang / /'gro ba thams cad dbang byed cing / /thos pa 'dzin cing sgyu rtsal mkhas/ /shi nas 'dzam gling 'di nyid du/ /lcang lo can gyi gnod sbyin ni/ /'khor la gzhon nu'i rigs su skye/ /yang na mi yi rgyal po'am/ /glang po nyid du skye bar 'gyur/ /'bar ba lus la bskus na blta/ /rig sngags 'chang lus nyi shar mdog /bskal par gnas te 'dod dgur spyod/ /'jig rten kun du thogs med rgyu/ /mkha' ldings 'og chu bran 'gro/ /sangs rgyas kun nas phyin nas kyang / /dbang por gnas te rgyal por gnas/ /sprul pa'i rdzas kyis bde bshegs mchod/ /'dod nas shi 'phos 'jig rten khams/ /gzhan 'das sangs rgyas dag tu skye/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yis/ /bdag nyid yid du 'ong 'dod phas/ /gur gum ga pur gla rtsi dang / /gi'u wang bsregs nas sngags stong bzlas/ /brdungs te phye mar byas nas kyang / /sngags stong bzlas te chu gtsang gis/ /ril bu rgya sran tshad byas nas/ /re re la yang stong stong brjod/ /rlung dang nyims ma reg pa/ /bskams nas snod gtsang gzhag par bya/ /ril bu tsam cig mur na yang / /rgyal po blon po 'khor bcas kyis/ /mthong na bu bzhin

gzigs pas na/ /tha mal skyo bo smos ci dgos/ /nor rnams gzhan gyis ster ba dang / /bsgo ba la ni ngag btsan 'gyur/ /ga pur gur gum gi'u wang dang / /tsan+da na gnad brda dang / /gla rtsi dag ste cha mnyam du/ /re re sngags stong bzlas nas su/ /brdungs te ril bu byas pa da ga /g.yon pa'i zhal la gdags par bya/ /bdun nas nya yi bar du ni/ /sngags bzlas pa dang mchod pa bya/ /bdugs pas nad dang gdon rnams sel/ /mig la byugs pas rgyal po dang / /rgyal mo bu dang bu mo dang / /blon po la sogs dbang du 'gyur/ /khar bcug tsam gyis grol bar 'ong / /gdams pa thams cad don yod 'gyur/ /spyi bor btags na byad stems dang / /g.yul las shin tu rgyal bar 'gyur/ /gal te phye mas bdugs pas kyang / /sdig pa thams cad byang 'gyur te/ /kun gyi mthong dang dga' ba dang / /gzi byin 'phags pa kun gyis mchod/ /ga bur gla rtsi gur gum dang / /tsan+dan gla rtsi ka ko la/ /spos kyi rgyal po pad+ma dang / /ut+pal sngo dang tsan+dan dmar/ /re re la yang stong stong bzlas/ /cha mnyam phye ma gi'u wang bcas/ /ril bu tsa na ka tshad bya/ /grib skams byas nas lus la 'chang / /gling bzhi kun khyab rgyal srid 'thob/ /kra ku la yi thang chu dang / /ldong ros bed dang ut+pal sngo/ /rgya mtsho lbu ba gi'u wang dang / /yungs dang skyer pa gur gum dang / /ga bur dang ni gla rtsi gsum/ /re re la yang sngags stong bzla/ /de nas sku yi mgul btags te/ /stong bzlas dril nas ril bu bya/ /mig nad sel na chu dang sbyar/ /so nad la ni ka ka ru/ /rna ba'i nad la ru rta ste/ /ut+pal mu tig mig nad la/ /gre ba'i nad la ba sha ka/ /glo nad la ni ba le ka/ /sha ka ra yi thang dang sbyar/ /rlung nad la ni mar dang sbyar/ /mkhris nad la ni tig ta dang / /bad kan la ni sga dang sbyar/ /mdze nad la ni dug mo nyungs/ /ma zhu ba la kha ru tshwa/ /skrangs nad rnams la thug

po che/ /bgegs dang yams nad sel ba la/ /gu gul dang bcas bdug par bya/ /ril bu'i yon tan mtha' yas ni/ /nam yang brjod par mi nus so/ /gu gul la ni stong bzlas pa'i/ /ril bus bgegs tshogs sel bar byed/ /ke su rtsa dang sde'u gsher dang / /ba la ta ka tsha ba gsum/ /ser po mu zi phye ma rnams/ /sbrang rtsi dang bcas ril bu bya/ /pad+ma gar dbang sngags stong bzlas/ /zos pa tsam gyis lus rgyas te/ /nad dang gdon dang dgras mi tshugs/ /'dod rnams thams cad grub par 'gyur/ /ta ka'i rtsa ba ba ru ra/ /skyu ru ra dang ti la til/ /mnyam byas srin bya'i khrag dang ni/ /ril bu byas la mig la byug /klu dang yi dgas khang pa dang / /sa 'og thams cad mthong bar nges/ /byis pa zla ba gsum pa'i lce/ /nyin gcig spos por nang du gzhug /gnyis pa ra 'o gsum dang 'byung / /bzhi pa ril bu tshil chen btso/ /lnga pa sbrang rtsi nang du ste/ /drug pa dngul chu'i nang du bzhag /bdun pa rigs ngan thod par ni/ /byi la'i khrag gis bsku la gzhag /skams nas bya dang spyang ku'i sha/ /lhan cig rang gi khar bcug na/ /de ma thag tu mi snang 'gyur/ /gzhan yang yon tan dpag tu med/ /ldong ros gyen du bcas pa dang / /dza ti lo ma sa bon bcas/ /ril bu sngags stong bzlas pa yis/ /bar snang la ni 'gro bar nges/ /ban+du ma dang kir ma dang / /ma ka ri dang su mi tam/ /bra pan ta ma'i ril bu ni/ /nyi zla gzas bzung dus su mid/ /shes rab phul du 'byung ba ste/ /thos pa 'dzin 'gyur smos ci dgos/ /gi'u wang swa hā tsi na dang / /sre ta sbrang gi ril bu bya/ /sngags stong bzlas nas khar bcug na/ /'das pa'i don rnams shes par 'gyur/ /gi'u wang sug pa phye ma dang / /ba ra swā ta ha su ri/ /a ra

hu ri sbrang rtsir bcas/ /ril bu byas nas sngags stong bzla/ /mid pas ma 'ongs don rnams shes/ /gzhan yang nad 'don byed pa yi/ /ril bu chen po bshad par bya/ /rgyal dang rnam rgyal na gu la/ /kan dha na gu li dang ni/ /ru ṇi a pa ya ba ni/ /i pa ya na ta ga ra/ /gan dha ga dang pri yang ku/ /'khor lo che dang 'khor lo dang / /biṣ+ṇu ka ṭi de bzhin du/ /so ma ra tsa un na ti/ /re re la yang sngags phreng dang / /brgya rtsa brgyad du brjod par bya/ /de nas brdungs te sbrang dang bcas/ /byis pa la ni dpung par te/ /bu 'dod mo la mgul bar gdags/ /'di btags pa yi de ma thag /'jigs pa brgyad dang nad las grol/ /ba mar shu dag ba lcir bcas/ /lcags kyi snod du btsos pa yi/ /ril bu a mra'i 'bras bu tsam/ /sngags 'di stong phrag brgyad brjod de/ /phyis ni nyi shu gcig brjod nas/ /snga bar mid pas shes rab 'phel/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+yā ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ shud+dhe mṛ taṃ/ ba la bar+dha ni swā hā/ srod dang tho rangs dge sbyong dang / /dal smra gsong po dul bag can/ /khrus la dga' zhing dri bzang bsten/ /spyod lam rab zhi khro ba med/ /rtag tu bsngags brjod brtse sems can/ /spyan ras gzigs nyid la cher dang / /gdung bag gdong la mchi ma can/ /lung thob bla mar rab dga' ba'i/ /skyes mchog de la rab dge zhing / /'jig rten skyong gi lha rnams dang / /'byung ba la sogs smos ci dgos/ /rtag par rang gi yid la ni/ /snying po gsang sngags bcang bar bya/ /nye ba'i snying po lus dag pa'i/ /lha yang rang la nye bar byed/ /rtsa ba'i sngags rnams brjod mang ba/ /khri dang 'bum dang sa ya dang / /sa ya gsum dang drug brjod de/ /kha cig la yang bzhi dang ni/ /lnga tsam gyis ni de grub

yin/ /las la sbyar ba bdun dang ni/ /bcu bzhi nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / /brgya dang de bzhin stong gis rdzogs/ /de ma thag tu chu yin te/ /cung zad ba ni mar gyis bya/ /brtan par gyur pa ka ra ste/ /ches brtan pa la srad bu yin/ /sman dang sngags kyis sel byed de/ /ril bus ring du skyong byed yin/ /sngags sgrub pa la mi mos pa'o/ /mdun du rtsom na de dag rnams/ /de skad gsungs pa'i de ma thag /rdo rje snying po nyi 'od dang / /pad dkar rin chen snying po dang / /pad spyan gzigs kyi snying po dang / /ye shes dbang phyug pad dbang phyug /byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams/ /rang rang sde dpung sder bcas pa/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po rnams/ /'jig rten dbang la cher dmigs nas/ /mchod pa'i tshogs rnams bkram byas te/ /rin chen rigs las 'khrungs pa yi/ /mchod pa nam mkha' gtos par bkang / /rol mo du ma lhab lhub dang / /sil snyan lha yi tshogs rnams kyis/ /sprin mdzes tshogs rnams rab 'khrigs ltar/ /bkod pa mtha' yas bsham bya ste/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ /mgon gyur ye shes mnga' ba rnams/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang gsung snyan la/ /yi rang skyes nas mtshan chen brjod/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang mchog brtan che/ /'jig rten dbang po dbang phyug che/ /pad+ma sems dpa' pad 'byung che/ /rdo rje chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa chen po chos rgyal gtso/ /blo gros chen po sems dpa' che/ /pad+ma 'chang dang pad+ma dpa'/ /pad+ma'i mgon khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+ma las byung dam pa'i yid/ /pad+ma gsal mdzad dga' mdzad po/ /pad+ma'i rdo rje pad+ma'i sku/ /khyod mchog spyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snang ba kun chen thabs po che/ /che mnyam dga' ba dgongs pa che/ /dpa' bo chen po brtan chen rgyal/ /bde ba chen po khyod

phyag 'tshal/ /bsam chen mkhyen chen theg chen po/ /rnal 'byor chen po mes po che/ /bde stsol bde mdzad dga' mdzad che/ /pad+ma rgyas zhal phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos mnga' don mnga' pad+ma rgyal/ /dag pa chos mnga' chos mchog 'dzin/ /rmad 'byung chen ldan chos rab 'chang / /chos kyi tshogs khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog sems dpa'/ /rin chen sems dpa' chos sems dpa'/ /dam tshig sems dpa' las sems dpa'/ /kun mkhyen sems dpa' khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'jig rten dpa' bo dpa' bo mchog /rnam par gzigs gtso skyob mdzad che/ /'jig rten gsal mdzad 'jig rten don/ /'jig rten mgon po phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten yi ge kha dog che/ /yi ge che mtshungs yig drug mchog /yi ge'i rang bzhin yi ge gzigs/ /yi ge 'khor lo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya pad+ma'i lag /legs so sbyin mdzad dbugs sbyin ba'o/ /sangs rgyas tshogs de sangs rgyas chos/ /sangs rgyas che khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshad med che sku sangs rgyas sku/ /gzugs bzang 'chang ldan rdo rje gzugs/ /gzi brjid che mchog chos snang ba/ /snang bar mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtso mgon rgyal po pad+ma'i dpal/ /chos kyi dpal mgon 'dren mdzad pa/ /tshangs pa'i mgon chen khyab 'jug mgon/ /tshangs pa'i sras khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /cher gsal gtso bo snang pa mchog /'od chen mdzad pa rang gsal mdzad/ /snang ba chen po kun gsal mgon/ /snang ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas spyan can spyan po che/ /chos kyi spyan te gzigs pa che/ /ting 'dzin chen po ye shes mtsho/ /rdo rje spyan khyod phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dren pa'i gtso bo dbang sgyur gtso/ /mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas sras/ /rgyal thabs mnyes pa khyu mchog che/ /sangs rgyas dpag med phyag 'tshal lo/ /drag po

chen po rtul chen po/ /ha la chen po seng ge sgra/ /mgrin sngon gar gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /ye shes gtsug tor phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar ming brgya rtsa brgyad gang / /'chang la nad med bgegs med de/ /dpal 'byor 'jig rten dbang phyug mthong / /yang yang lhar skye mya ngan 'da'/ /de skad gsungs nas blo ldan rnams/ /rang rang stan la mngon par 'khod/ /de tshe phyogs bcu rnam par g.yos/ /bdud rigs thams cad mog por gyur/ /de nas gzungs kyi dbang phyug gis/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams la/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /nga yi mtshan nyid 'di gsungs so/ /kun du bzang po'i spyod yul can/ /dkar lam bcu pa rnam spro ba/ /sems can gang du 'dod sbyor ba'i/ /rigs ni rigs chen thams cad pa'o/ /lus ngag yid bcu spyod bcu ni/ /rgyun mi chad du sbyor mod kyang / /rags pa yi ni gzugs brnyan mthus/ /sngags sbyor gsang sngags 'dzin pa yi/ /lha la goms pa lha mthong ngam/ /mngon shes dang po sems gsal bas/ /mkha' mnyam sems kyi rdzu 'phrul che/ /sems snang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa/ /mtshan ma phra ba la sogs pa'i/ /mngon shes 'jig rten gsal ma thongs/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i snying po ste/ /brtan pa'i ye shes las byung ba'o/ /dam tshig sdom pa mkha' mnyam spyod/ /sems dang sems dpa' dbyer med dang / /zhi lam sgro skur chad pa dang / /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog dang lam/ /bzhi bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang / /rten 'brel zab don mngon gyur pa/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i rigs kun mchog /mtshan med ting 'dzin la gnas nas/ /rtsol bcas gzhan don sgrub pa dang / /rtsol med shugs kyis bde 'byung dang / /nges tshig chos don spros pa'i mtha'/ /rdzu 'phrul du ma spyod yul la/ /rigs chen yongs su grub pa'i sa/ /mkha' spyod phun sum tshogs ldan cing / /sems

kyi snang ba du mar sgyur/ /dngos rnams spros spang bsdu spyod pa/ /rig 'dzin phyag rgya chen po yis/ /chos sku kun snang kun du 'od/ /bde skur snang ba pad+ma'i spyan/ /yi ge 'khor lo sprul tshogs che/ /mtshon bya mtshan nyid rdo rje 'dzin/ /zag med ye shes bla ma'i sa/ /'du 'bral med pa'i bde chen sa/ /de ltar drug ni sangs rgyas kyi/ /sa chen bla med mthar gnas so/ /ngo bo spros med chos sems pa/ /gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i rgyu gcig go/ /sems can sems snyoms byang sems 'dzin/ /nges par sgrub pa'i rgyu gnyis so/ /sems can mi gtong tshul khrims bsrung / /sngags don mi spong nyid dang gsum/ /rang gis sngags bsgrub gzhan gyis sngags/ /bar mi gcod dang 'gro ba la/ /byams pa bsgrub dang snying rje bsgrub/ /grub par byed pa'i rgyu bzhi'o/ /dben pa bsten dang 'du 'dzi spong / /thos pa bsam zhing de don spyod/ /phyi rol sngags spong zhe sdang skyung / /de dag sngags sgrub rgyu lnga'o/ /dad pa 'dun pa gsol ba dang / /phyi nang sngags la mi spyod dang / /spros med ston pa'i gzhung 'jug dang / /theg chen mdo gzhung 'dzin pa dang / /sngags gzhung tshol ba mi skyo dang / /dge spyod brtson dang drug pa'o/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg mchod gtor brtson/ /phyi rol dka' thub gdung med dang / /snod bcud 'og min gnas lha dang / /bu mo pha rol phyin yul lha/ /'gro ba mi bslu chos mi 'byed/ /theg dman mi len pa dang bdun/ /nyan thos rang rgyal blo ldan dang / /rig 'dzin rdzu 'phrul the tshom med/ /lha dang bla ma'i bsnyen bkur dang / /dbang bskur lung nod spro ba dang / /ser sna med dang gtong la dga'/ /gsang ba dga' zhing mi g.yengs dang / /gzi brjid dbang che'i lus thob dang / /grags kun blo ldan brgyad por blta/ /skur pa med cing bden par smra/ /bag yod tshul 'chos spangs pa ste/ /brgyad pa de yang bsgrub pa'i rgyu/ /rgyu med 'bras bu ga la srid/ /gang zhig lcags kyus bzung bas gnyis re nas/ /klu phrug 'bum phrag 'dren ltar dge ba'i sems/ /

kun slong byang chub rin chen thob mdzad rgyu/ /rtag par 'chang na gnas sgyur byed par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan thub pa ches/ /blo ldan rnams la bka' stsal pa/ /legs so legs so sems dpa' che/ /gang dag de dag de bzhin du/ /bde 'dod rnam par g.yeng ba dang / /des ni sdug bsngal mya ngan 'das/ /gdung ba chags sdang 'khrug pa dang / /des ni log pa'i chos 'dor yang / /dge sbyong log ltas tshangs pa'i gdon/ /sngags log spyod byed rig 'dzin gdon/ /gdul dka' dag la rgyun rings so/ /skye ngan 'jigs phyir blo zab spyod/ /gang gi khyim du rgyud 'di yod/ /bri dang bklag dang mchod pa dang / /rim gro ched du gsal byed dang / /bkra shis tshe ring dpal 'byor skye/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshogs de dag dang / rig pa'i lha mo dang / khro bo du ma dang / nyan thos kyi tshogs thams cad dang / /lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma dra ba zhes bya ba las/ sbyor ba sna tshogs kyi le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po pad+ma dra ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //rig pa'i 'byung gnas rig pa'i 'od zer gyis shes rab pad+ma rgyas pa'i kha che'i yul bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i gtsug lag khang chen por paṇ+ḍi ta chen po so ma shrī bha bya zhes bya ba dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba kyu ra dge slong tshul khrims 'od zer gyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa// //

༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+yā mo gha pā sha hṛ da yaṃ nā ma ma hā yā na sū tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das po ta la ka'i ri'i rtse mo 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gnas sa ma la dang / ta ma la dang / tsam pa ka dang / mya ngan med pa dang / a ti muk+ta ka la sogs pa mang po dang / sna tshogs pa'i rin po che'i sdong pos yang dag par brgyan par dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po stong phrag bcwa brgyad dang / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgu dang / gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu stong phrag du mas yongs su bskor cing mdun du byas nas mang po dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so/ /dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu rnams gtsor byas nas chos ston to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas ba'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ gang bcom ldan 'das la de yis thal mo sbyar zhing phyag 'tshal nas zhal 'dzum par gyur pas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba yod de/ gang sngon bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig na 'jig rten rnam par gzigs pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams su/ 'jig rten gyi dbang po rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las bdag gis blangs te/ gang yang bdag gis dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po gtsor byas pa'i gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu brgya stong mang po yang 'dus so/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub don yod

zhags pa'i ye shes kyi gtso bo'i ting nge 'dzin bcu pa brgya stong bdag gis rab tu rnyed do/ /gzhan yang gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das sa gzhi'i phyogs gcig tu rab tu spyod pa las rtog par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das de'i tshe sa phyogs de dbang phyug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / tshangs ris gtsor byas pa'i lha'i bu stong phrag bcu gnyis kyis srung ba dang / skyob pa dang / sbed pa'i don du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /gang 'dir don yod zhags pa'i snying po rab tu spyod na bcom ldan 'das sa'i phyogs gcig po de mchod rten du 'gyur ro/ /sems can gang dag don yod zhags pa'i snying po nyan pa de dag ni sangs rgyas mang po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong la mchod par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' gang 'dir don yod zhags pa'i snying po thos pas bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /gang kha cig bcom ldan 'das sdig pa'i skyon byed pa/ sdig pa'i chos thams cad la yang dag par spyod pa/ 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa/ dam pa'i chos la smod pa/ mnar med pa la gzhol ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la smod pa po de gal te 'gyod par gyur cing slan chad gcod cing sdom par gyur na/ bcom ldan 'das des re zhig de nyid smyung bar gnas pa gcig gis de bzlas na de'i skye ba 'di'i las yongs su dag cing yongs su zad par 'gyur ro/ /phyir bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /rims nyin gcig pa'am/ nyin gnyis pa'am/ nyin gsum pa'am/ nyin bzhi pa'am/ de'i phyir khrag tu 'khru ba'am/ tshad pa'am/ lag pa na ba'am/ rkang pa na ba'am/ mgo na ba'am/ ha la ha la yis btags pa'am/ mdze'am/ rkang shu'am/ 'brum bu phra mo'am/ lhog pa'am/ 'bras sam/ bye'u 'bras sam/ g.yan pa'am/ mtshan bar rdol ba'am/ 'brum bu'am/ brjed byed dam/ khyab par na ba'am/ gsod pa'am/ 'ching

ba'am/ brdeg pa'am/ bsdigs pa'am/ mi snyan par brjod pa'am/ mdor bsdu na bcom ldan 'das lus kyi na tsha'am/ sems kyi sdug bsngal lam/ rmi lam ngan pa mthong bas de'i las yongs su dag cing zad par 'gyur ro/ /sngar nyid nas dag pa'i sems dad cing lhag par mos pa rnams shin tu yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te bcom ldan 'das 'khor bzhi po dang / rigs bzhi pos ji snyed du bdag la sgyu dang g.yos kyang / mchod par byed/ gang 'dir don yod zhags pa'i snying po nyan par byed pa dang / don 'dzin par byed pa/ 'chang bar byed pa/ klog par byed pa/ 'dri bar byed pa/ 'drir 'jug par byed pa/ kun chub par byed pa/ sems can gzhan rnams nyan du 'jug par byed pa'am/ tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa'i rna bug tu gtugs te zlos par byed/ sngags kyi tshig 'di sems par byed pa dang / dor ba med pa/ gzugs med pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa/ yang dag par 'byung ba med pa/ yun ring du 'byung ba med pa/ sgyu med pa/ gos pa med pa/ mnyam pa'i sems g.yeng ba med pa/ phung po lnga dang bral ba'i sbyor ba 'dis ni sangs rgyas rjes su dran par bya'o/ /de dag la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas brgya stong gis zhal ston par 'gyur ro/ /khyed kyis bzlas pas sdig pa bshags par 'gyur ro/ /ji snyed po tir bri ba byas nas khyim du bzhugs su gsol bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mang pos ci bya ste/ phan tshun 'gran pas nyan pa'am/ rje dpon gyis 'jigs pas sam/ gzhan gyi rjes su 'jug pas sam/ gzhan smad par bya ba'i ched du nyan pa ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi byin gyis brlabs su mkhas pas shes par bya'o/ /de dag gi rna bug tu de'i sgra grags par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ gang la la'i skyes bus tsan+dan nam/ ga bur ram/ gur gum mam/ gla rtsi gnur zhing brgyad cing rngo ba'am/ sa la gzhibs nas bdag nyid la byugs na/ de la

tsan+dan nam/ ga bur ram/ gur gum mam/ gla rtsi gnur ba'am brgya dpas de ltar dri 'pho bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yang dri zhim po'ang de nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das de ltar kho nar bdag gi don yod zhags pa'i snying po 'di la yang gang la la zhig gis 'phya zhing smod pa dang / snga ma ltar ji snyed bdag la sgyu dang g.yos mchod pa byed pa de dag ni bcom ldan 'das dmu rgod kyi sems can de dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /'dod pas dka' bar 'dzin par brjod de phyi ma la'ang ngo / /gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang de ru tshul khrims dang ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab dang bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi dri dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi dri zhim po nyid du byed do/ /gang yang bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ de las gzhan pa'i kha cig don yod zhags pa'i snying po ched du byas nas dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes brgyad la smyung bar gnas par byas te/ lan bdun du don yod zhags pa'i snying po tshig tu mi brjod par yongs su bzlas na/ de la bcom ldan 'das mthong ba'i chos nyid la phan yon nyi shu tham pa so sor 'dod par bya'o/ /nyi shu po gang zhe na/ gang de'i lus la nad mi 'byung ba dang / las kyi dbang gis nad byung ba yang myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /snum zhing yid du 'ong ba'i lus dkar bar yang 'gyur ro/ /skye bo mang po'i yid du 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang po sbubs su nub pa dang nor rnyed par yang 'gyur ro/ /nor yod pa yang rkun pos khyer bar mi nus so/ /mes mi 'tshig go/ /chu yis mi 'khyer ro/ /rgyal po'i yid kyis kyang 'phrog par mi nus so/ /de'i las kyi mtha' rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de'i lus la chu'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rlung dang char pa'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lan bdun du don yod zhags pa'i snying po chu'am thal ba la yongs

su bsngags te/ phyogs dang mtshams dang steng dang 'og gi zhing la bcing ba byas na nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /mdangs za bas mdangs 'phrog par mi nus so/ /sems can thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /dgra yis 'jigs pa 'byung ba yang myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /mi yis 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /khyab par na ba'i 'jigs pa dang / /mkha' 'gro ma'i 'jigs pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs pa drag po'ang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /me dang chu dang mtshon gyis 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /lhas kyang rgyun du nye bar srung ba dang / skyob pa dang sbed par 'gyur ro/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang de ru byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms dang bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /phan yon nyi shu po 'di dag so sor 'dod par bya'o/ /gzhan yang chos brgyad so sor 'thob ste/ brgyad po gang zhe na/ 'chi ba'i dus su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dge slong gi gzugs kyis zhal yang dag par ston par 'gyur ro/ /bde bar tshe'i dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba 'khrul pa med do/ /lag pa g.yob pa med do/ /bshang ba med do/ /gci ba med do/ /rlung gi rnam pa med do/ /shin tu legs par gnas shing dran pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /kha 'og tu bltas nas tshe'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /'chi ba'i dus su nyon mongs pa med par rab tu brjod par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang dang gang du smon lam btab pa de de dang de ru skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /nyin re zhing dus gsum du lan gsum du bklag par bya'o/ /chang dang sha dang btsong dang sgog skya dang / bde byed la byin pa'i lhag ma khyad par du bsrung bar 'dod pas de rnams spang bar bya'o/ /don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di sems can rnams la nus sam mi nus shes par byas la mnyan du gzhug par bya'o/ /slob dpon gyis ser sna mi bya ste/ gang gi phyir phrag dog dang ser sna'i dri ma spangs pa ni byang chub

sems dpa' yin no/ /sems can gyi don gyi ched du sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun du yang 'gyur ro/ /shes rab ni byang chub tu brjod la sems dpa' ni thabs te/ de gnyis dag gis sems can gyi don nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te chos 'di rjes su zlos shing snying po de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdun du rjod par byed pa ni 'khor bzhi po rnams la phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyi phyir dang / sdig pa byed pa gzhan rnams kyi yang phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bka' stsal pa/ gang 'di dag pa'i sems can la khyod kyis bstan pa'i dus la bab ste/ de bzhin gshegs pas kyang rjes su yi rang ngo / /phyi ma'i tshe phyi ma'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi pha'i bya ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug spyan mi 'dzums par gyur pas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gson cig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag byas pa'i rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di skye bo mang po la phan pa dang skye bo mang po la bde ba dang 'jig rten la rjes su brtse ba dang skye dgu'i tshogs chen po la phan pa dang bde ba dang rnam par thar pa'i don gyi phyir yang ngo / /na ma s+t+rai ya dh+wā nu ga ta pra tiṣ+ṭhi te bh+yaḥ/ sarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twe bh+yaḥ/ na maḥpra t+ye ka bud dhār+ya shrā ba ka saṃ ghe bh+yo3 tī tā nā ga ta pra t+yat+pan+ne bh+yaḥ/ na ma s+samyak+ga tā nāṃ/ na maḥsaṃ mya k+p+ra t+yut+pan+nā nāṃ/ na maḥsha ra dwa tī pu trā ya/ ma hā ma ta ye/ na maḥ.ār+ya mai tre ya pra mu khe bh+yo ma hā bo dhi satwa sam̐ ghe bh+yaḥ/ na maḥsu pra tiṣ+ṭhi ta shaṃ len+d+ra rā dza pra mu khe bh+yaḥ/ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ/ ar+ha d+bh+yaḥ/ samyak+saṃ bud+dhe bh+yo bha ga bad+bh+yaḥ/ na maḥsu bar+ṇ+ṇa bar+ṇ+ṇa su pra ti bhā sa bi na rdi te shwa ra rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ namaḥsiṃ ha bi krā ḍi ta rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ namaḥsu pra

tiṣ+ṭhi te ma ṇi kū ṭa rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ namaḥs man+ta ra smyu t+ga ta shrī kū ṭa rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ na mo bi pa sh+yi ne ta thā ga tā ya/ namaḥshi khi ne ta thā ga tā ya/ na mo bi shwa bhu dze ta thā ga tā ya/ namaḥkra kuts+tshā n+dāya ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥ ka na ka mu na ye ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥkā sh+ya pā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ namaḥshākya mu na ye ta thā ga tā yār+ha te saṃ myak+maṃ bud dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ oṃ sha me sha me ma hā sha me rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ sarba satwāṃ sh+tsa sarba pā paṃ pra sha ma ne swā hā/ na maḥsu pa ri kīt+ti ta nā ma dhe yā ya shri ye ta thā ga tā ya/ na maḥs man+ta wa bhā sa bi dzi ta saṃ grā ma shri ye ta thā ga tā ya/ na ma in+d+ra ke tu dh+wa dza shri ye ta thā ga tā ya/ na mo rat+na tra bhā se shwa ra rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ na mo3 pra ti ha ta bhai ṣa dz+ya rā dzā ya ta thā ga tā ya/ na mo bikrān+ta gā mi ne ta thā ga tā ya/ na mo bud dhā ya/ na mo dhar+m+mā ya/ namaḥsam̐ ghā ya/ na mo3 tī tā nā ga ta pra t+yut+pan+ne bh+yo bud+dhe bh+ya bha ga bad+bh+yaḥ/ tad+ya thā/ smṛ ti bar+bha ni/ ma ti bar+dha ni/ ga ti bar+dha ni/ dhṛ ti bar+dha ni/ pradz+nyā bar+dha ni/ pra hi bhā na bar+dha ni/ dh+yā na bar+dha ni/ shā ma tha bar+dha ni/ bi pa sh+ya na bar+dha ni/ sarba bo dhi bak+ṣa dhar+m+ma bar+dha ni/ sa ka la bud+dha dhar+m+ma pa ri pū ra ṇā ya swā hā/ na mo ra t+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+yā wa lo ki te shwa rwa ya bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ na mo ma hā s+thā ma bra p+tā ya bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ e bh+yo na ma skṛ tā i dmār+yā wa lo ki te shwa ra mu kho t+gi r+ṇ+ṇaṃ/ a mo gha pā shwa rā dza nā ma hṛ da yi ta thā ga tā saṃ mu khaṃ bhā ṣi taṃ mahā tāṃ bar+ṣan+ma dhe a ha mi dā nī mā bat+ta yi ṣ+ya mi/ sid+bh+yan+tu me man+t+ra pa dāḥ/ sarba kār+yā ṇi sarba bha yo bh+yo ma ma sarba satwā nāñtsa rak+ṣa bha ban+tu/ ta d+ya thā/ oṃ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ma ra ma ra/ mi ri mi ri/ mu ru mu ru/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka/ sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tsi ri tsi ri/ pi ri pi ri/ bi ri bi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ ma hā pad+ma ha sta/ ka la ka la/ ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ ma hā shud+dha satwa/ bud dh+ya bud dh+ya/ bo dha bo dha/ bo dhi bo dhi/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ki ṇi ki ṇa/ ku ṇu ku ṇu/ pa ra ma shud+dha satwa/ ka ra

ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ ma hā s+thā ma prāp+ta/ tsa la tsa la/ sañtsa la sañtsa la/ bi tsa la bi tsa la/ pra tsa la pra tsa la/ e ṭa ṭa e ṭa ṭa/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ ti ri ti ri/ tu ru tu ru/ e h+ye hi ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /ma hā pa shu ba ti be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ sa ra sa ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ pa ra pa ra/ ba ra ba ra/ ma ra ma ra/ la ra la ra/ ha ra ha ra/ hā hā hī hī hū hū/ oṃ kā ra brah+ma be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ sa ra sa ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ na ra na ra/ ba ra ba ra/ ha ra ha ra/ ra smi sha ta sa ha sra pra ti maṇ+ḍi ta sha rī ra/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ta pa ta pa/ bhā ṣa bhā ṣa/ bh+ra ma bh+ra ma/ bha ga wān+sau mā di t+ya/ ya ma/ ba ru ṇa/ ku be ra/ brah+men+d+ra/ bā yu/ ag+ni/ dha na dā/ ṛ ṣi de ba ga ṇā bh+yar+ts+tsi ta tsa ra ṇa/ su ru su ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ ghu ru ghu ru/ sa nat+ku mā ra/ ru dra/ bā sa ba/ piṭh+ṇu/ dha na dā/ bā yu/ ag+ni/ ṛ ṣi/ nā ya ka /bi nā ya ka /ba hu bi bi dha be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ tha ra tha ra/ gha ra gha ra/ pa ra pa ra/ la ra la ra/ ha ra ha ra/ ya ra ya ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ba ra ba ra/ ba ra dā ya ka /sa man tā wa lo ki ta/ pi lo ki ta/ lo ke shwa ra/ ma he shwa ra/ tre bhu ba ne shwa ra/ sarba gu ṇa sa mā laṃ kṛ ta/ a wa lo ki te shwa ra/ mu hu mu hu/ mu ru mu ru/ mu ya mu ya/ muñtsa muñtsa/ ra k+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ sarba sa twāṃ sh+tsa/ sarba bha ye bh+yaḥ/ sarbo pa dra be bh+yaḥ/ sarbo pasarge bh+yaḥ/ sarbo gra he bh+yaḥ/ sarba byā dhi bh+yaḥ/ sarba bi ṣe bh+yaḥ/ sarba dz+wa re bh+yaḥ/ e pam̐/ baṃ dha ban+dha na/ tā ḍa na/ tardza na/ rā dza/ taska ra/ ag+ni/ ud ka /bi ṣa sha s+t+ra pa ri mo tsa ka /ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ku ṇu ku ṇu/ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ in+d+riya/ ba la/ bo dh+yaṃ ga /tsa tu rā r+ya sat+ya saṃ pra kā sha ka /ta pa ta pa/ ta ma

ta ma/ da ma da ma/ sha ma sha ma/ ma sam sa/ dha ma dha ma/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /ma hā tamo3n+dha ka ri/ bi dha ma na/ ṣaṭ+pā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ka /ma la ma la/ mi li mi li/ mu lu mu lu/ ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ṭha ṭha ṭha ṭha/ ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi/ ṭu ṭu ṭu ṭu/ ṭhi ṭhi ṭhi ṭhi/ ṭhu ṭhu ṭhu ṭhu/ e ṇe ya tsarma kṛ ta pa ri ka ra/ e h+ye hi ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /ī shwa ra/ ma he shwa ra/ ma ha bhu ta ga ṇa saṃ bhañdza ka /ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ pa ra pa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ ba ra ba ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ma ra ma ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ki ṭi ki ṭi/ ku ṭu ku ṭu/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ma hā bi shud dha bi ṣa ya ni bā si ta/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka shwe ta yadz+nyo ba bī ta/ rat+na mu ku ṭa/ mā lā dha ra/ sarba dz+nya shi ra si kṛ ta dza ṭā mu ku ṭa/ ma hā ad+bhu ta ka ma lā laṃ kṛ ta ka ra ta la/ dh+yā na sa mā dhi bi mok+ṣa pra kam+p+ya/ ba hu satwā san+ta ti pa ri pā tsa ka /ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /sarba kar+m+mā wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha ka /sarba dz+nyā dz+nyā na pa ri pū ra ka /sarba byā dhi pa ri mo tsa ka /sarba satwā shā ba ri pū ra ki /sarba satwa sa mā shwā sa na ka ra na maḥstu te swā hā/ a mo ghā ya swā hā/ a mo gha pā shā ya swā hā/ a dzi tā ya swā hā/ a pa rā dzi tā ya swā hā/ a mi tā bhā ya swā hā/ a mi tā bhā su tā ya swā hā/ mā ra sai n+ya pra mar+d+da nā ya swā hā/ a bha yā ya swā hā/ a bha ya pra dā ya swā hā/ dza yā ya swā hā/ bi dza yā ya swā hā/ dza ya bi dza yā ya swā hā/ ba ra dā ya swā hā/ ba ra pra dā ya swā hā/ a kā la mṛ t+yu pra sha ma nā ya swā hā/ i dañtsa me kar+m+ma ku ru na maḥstu te swā hā/ om̐ ra ṇa ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ om̐ dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ dz+ra dz+riṃ dzuṃ swā hā/ om̐ hūm̐ dza ya swā hā/ om̐ hrīḥs+t+rai lo kya bi dza yā mo gha pā shā pra ti ha ta hrīḥhaḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ om̐ pa su pa ti swā hā/ om̐ ā ro lika swā hā/ om̐ ba hu le ba hu le swā hā/ om̐ ā ro li ka hrīḥhrīḥhum̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ni ya tā ni ya ta/ bi da nī yā shu bha s+ya me bha ga wān karma ṇo3 she ṣa taḥk+ṣa yaṃ ku ru swā hā/ om̐ pad+ma hastā ya swā hā/ om̐ bud+dha dhar+m+ma saṃ ghā ya swā hā/ bklags pas

las thams cad 'grub pa yin no/ /dus gsum du bzlas na mtshams med pa lnga rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /a ga ru'i bdug spos dang / thal ba dang / chu dang / yungs kar dang seng ldeng gi phur bu la sogs pas mtshams bcing ngo / /rims nad thams cad la srungaskud bcing bar bya'o/ /nad thams cad la mar ram/ mar nag gam/ chu la yongs su bzlas te sbyin par bya'o/ /lus la khyab pa'i nad la mtshon chas gcad cing srungaskud kyang bya'o/ /lto na ba la tshwa chus nyams par byed pa'am/ 'jim bag gam/ chus kyang bya'o/ /mig gi nad la skud pa dkar po rna ba la bcing bar bya'o/ /so'i nad la ka ra bī ra'i so shing gis so/ /mtshams bcing ba la ni tshon sna lnga'i skud pa la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du yongs su bzlas nas seng ldeng gi phur bu bzhi la bcings te phyogs bzhir gdab par byas na mtshams bcings pa yin no/ /thams cad du srung skud dam/ chu'am thal bas bya'o/ /gza' thams cad la tshon sna lnga'i skud pas bya'o/ /rims thams cad la skud pa dkar pos bya'o/ /sbrul dang / srin bu dang / ba spu byi ba dang / lhog pa dang / gre ba 'gags pa rnams la sbrang rtsi pi pi ling dang ldan pas bya'o/ /mig gi nad la dri zhim po'i chu'am/ rgya skyegs kyi chu'am/ sbrang rtsi'am/ shing mngar gyis bya'o/ /rtsod pa'i dus thams cad du rtsod pa dang mi snyan par brjod pa la chu la yongs su bzlas te gdong bkru bar bya'o/ /yul gzhan gyi rgyal po'i 'tshe ba la yul 'khor du bum pa gang ba yang dag par bzhag nas gtsang mas gos gtsang ma gyon te mchod pa chen po byas shing bklags na zhi ba chen por 'gyur ro/ /de'i chus kyang gtor bar byas nas sems can thams cad bsrung ba yin no/ /nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad dang / yams rnams zhi ba yin no/ /phyag rgya tsan+dan gyi

thig le la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du yongs su bzlas na mtshams med pa thams cad zad par byed do/ /rtag tu bzlas na khyim bsrung ba'o/ /pad+ma'i sbyin sreg gi sems can thams cad kyi bsrung ba'o/ /tsan+dan gyi sbyin sreg gis gza' dang / 'byung po dang rgyu skar thams cad las bsrung ba'o/ /rgyal ba dang / rnam par rgyal ba dang / gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / na gu li dang / dri'i na gu li dang / dha ra ni dang / mi 'jigs pa'i lag pa dang / dbang po'i lag pa dang / dri'i pri yang ku dang / ta ka ra dang / 'khor lo dang / 'khor lo chen po dang / rnam par gnon pa dang / so ma rā dzi dang / su nat+ta zhes bya ba ste/ de dag gang yang rung ba la lan brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du yongs su bzlas nas nor bu lta bur byas nas mgo bo dang dpung pa la bcing bar bya'o/ /byis pa rnams kyi ni mgul du'o/ /bud med rnams kyi mdoms su bcangs na rang nyid mchog tu skal ba dang ldan par byed do/ /g.yang med pa nyams nas bu yang ster ro/ /nor bu 'di bcangs pas thams cad du bsrung ba byas pa yin no/ /dug dang mes mi tshugs so/ /dug gis byas pa yang skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /nad byung ba yang mi skye zhing myur du zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gza' rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rlung dang sprin dang thog ni chus rengs par byed do/ /ka ra bī ra'i lcug mas ni las thams cad byed do/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po mchog tu grub pa 'dis ma bsgrubs par yang las 'di rnams byed do/ /de nas bsgrub par 'dod na thang sku'i cho ga ni tshon sna ma lus pas sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs mnyam par bri bar bya ste/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ral pa'i cod pan 'chang ba ri dgas kyi pags pas smad dkris byas shing phyugs bdag gi cha lugs 'chang ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bya'o/ /lha bzo mkhan gso sbyong dang ldan pas ri mo bri bar bya'o/ /de nas sgrub pa pos sku gzugs de'i mdun du

ba lang gi lci bas dkyil 'khor byas la me tog dkar po bkram ste/ dri zhim po'i chus bkang ba'i bum pa brgyad gzhag par bya'o/ /nye bar spyod pa brgyad dang nye bar mkho ba drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / khrag med pa'i gtor ma sha dang bcas pa bya'o/ /a ga ru'i bdug spos bsregs la rig pa stong phrag brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /nyin zhag gcig tu smyung bar gnas pa'am/ dkar gsum za zhing dus gsum du khrus byas nas gos gtsang ma gyon par gyur pas bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas sku gzugs kyi mdun du rang nyid bris pa bltas te de mthong bas dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /ji srid du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug byon te/ bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /ldong ros sam mig sman la yongs su bzlas te mig la bskus na de nas mi snang bar 'gyur zhing nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par rmongs pa med pa'i tshogs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu 'thob bo/ /sgrub pa po gang 'dod pa de 'dis byed do zhes bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang / dge slong de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po a mo gha badz+ra dang / bod kyi lo ts+tsha ba dge slong rin chen grags pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //

༄༅༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya a mo gha pā sha hṛ da yaṃ ma hā yā na nā ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas dang / 'phags pa nyan thos thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par song ba dang / yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /blo gros chen po sha ra dwa ti'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug snying rje chen po dang ldan pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthu chen po thob pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi kha nas brjod pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar 'khor mang po'i dbus su smras pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bgyi ba da ltar bdag gis bshad par bgyi'o/ /bdag gis sngags kyi tshig dang dgos pa thams cad ni grub par gyur cig /bdag 'jigs pa thams cad las srungs shig /ta d+ya thā/ oṃ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ma ra ma ra/ mi ri mi ri/ mu ru mu ru/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ tsi ri tsi ri/ bi ri bi ri/ pi ri pi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ ma hā pad+ma hasta/ ka la ka la/ ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ ma hā shud dha satwa/ budh+ya budh+ya/ bo dha bo dha/ bo dhi bo dhi/ bo dha ya bo dha ya/ ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ku ṇu ku ṇu/ pa ra ma shud dha satwa/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku

ru ku ru/ ma hās+thā ma prā p+ta/ tsa la tsa la/ sañtsa la sañtsa la/ pi tsa la bi tsa la/ e ṭa ṭa e ṭa ṭa/ bha ra bha ra/ bhi ri bhi ri/ bhu ru bhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ ti ri ti ri/ tu ru tu ru/ e h+ye hi ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /ma hā pa shu pa ti be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ sa ras ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ pa ra pa ra/ bar ba ra/ ma ra ma ra/ la ra la ra/ ha ra ha ra/ ha hā hi hī hu hū/ oṃ ka ra brah+ma be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ sa ras ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ na ra na ra/ ba ra ba ra/ ha ra ha ra/ ra smi sha ta sa ha sra pra ti maṇ+ḍi ta sha rī raṃ/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ta pa ta pa/ bhā sa bhā sa/ bh+ra ma bh+ra ma/ bha ga wan so ma/ ā dit+ya/ ya ma/ ba ru ṇa/ ku be ra/ brah+man+b+ra/ bā yu/ ag+ni/ dhan da/ de ba/ ṛ ṣi ga ṇa a bh+yar tsi ta tsa ra ṇa/ su ru su ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ ghu ru ghu ru/ sa nad ku mā ra/ ru dra/ bās ba/ piṭh+ṇu dhan da/ bā yu/ ag+ni/ ṛ ṣi/ nā ya ka/bi nā ya ka ba hu pi bi dha be ṣa dha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ ta ra ta ra/ tha ra tha ra/ gha ra gha ra/ ya ra ya ra/ la ra la ra/ ha ra ha ra/ pa ra pa ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ba ra ba ra/ ba ra dā ya ka /sa man+ta a wa lo ki ti/ bi lo ki ti/ lo ke shwa ra/ ma he shwa ra/ tri bhu ba ne shwa ra/ sarba gu ṇa sam a laṃ kṛ ta/ a wa lo ki te shwa ra/ mu hu mu hu/ mu ru mu ru/ mu ya mu ya/ muñtsa muñtsa/ shī gh+raṃ shī gh+raṃ/ bdag 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gdon thams cad dang /

gnod pa thams cad dang / nad 'go ba thams cad dang / 'khrug pa thams cad dang / dug thams cad dang / nad thams cad las srungs shig /srungs shig /de bzhin du bsad pa dang / bcing ba dang / rdeg pa dang / spyo ba dang / rgyal po dang / me dang / chu dang / dug dang / mtshon las yongs su thar bar gyur cig /ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ki ṇi ki ṇi/ ku ṇu ku ṇu/ tsa ra tsa ra/ tsi ri tsi ri/ tsu ru tsu ru/ in dri ya/ ba la/ bo dh+yaṃ ga /tsa tur ār+ya sa t+ya saṃ pra kā sha ka /ta pa ta pa/ ta ma ta ma/ da ma da ma/ sa ma sam/ dha ma dha ma/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /ma hā ta mo/ an dha ka ra bi dha ma na/ ṣa ṭa pā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ka /ma la ma la/ mi li mi li/ mu lu mu lu/ ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ṭha ṭha ṭha ṭha/ ṭi ṭi ṭi ṭi/ ṭu ṭu ṭu ṭu/ ṭhi ṭhi ṭhi ṭhi/ ṭhu ṭhu ṭhu ṭhu/ e ṇe ye tsar+m+ma kṛ ta pa ri ka ra/ e h+ye hi ma hā kā ru ṇi ka /ī shwa ra/ ma he shwa ra/ ma hā bhū ta ga ṇa saṃ bhañdza ka /ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ pa ra pa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ ba ra ba ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ki ṭi ki ṭi/ ku ṭu ku ṭu/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ma hā bi shud dha bi ṣa ya ni bā si na/ ma hā kā ru ṇi ka shwe ta yadz+nyā+e u pa pī ta/ ra t+na mu ku ṭa/ mā yā dha ra/ sarba dz+nyā shi ra si kṛ ta dza ṭā ma ku ṭa/ ma hā ad bhu ta/ ka ma la a laṃ kṛ ta ka ra ta la/ dh+yā na/ sa mā dhi/ bi mok+ṣa/ a pra kam+p+ya/ ba hu satwa san ta ti pa ri pā tsa ka /ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ka /sarba dz+nyā dz+nyā na pa ri pū ra ka /sarba byā dhi pa ri mo tsa ka /sarba satwa ā shā pa ri pū ra ka /sarba satwa sa mā shwā sa na ka ra na mastu te swā hā/ a mo ghā ya swā hā/

a mo gha pā shā ya swā hā/ a dzi tā ya swā hā/ a pā rā dzi tā ya swā hā/ a mi tā bhā ya swā hā/ a mi tā bha su tā ya swā hā/ mā ra sain+ya pra mardanā ya swā hā/ a bha yā ya swā hā/ a bha ya pra dā ya swā hā/ dza yā ya swā hā/ bi dza yā ya swā hā/ dza ya bi dza yā ya swā hā/ ba ra dā ya swā hā/ ba ra pra dā ya swā hā/ a kā la mṛ t+yu pra sha ma nā ya swā hā/ id ñtsa me karma ku ru na ma stu te swā hā/ oṃ ra ṇa ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+ra dz+riṃ dzu hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ hūṃ dza ya swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥtrai lo kya bi dza ya a mo gha pā sha a pra ti ha ta hrīḥhaḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs sngags 'di'i cho ga ni a mo gha pā sha'i gzungs bum pa la bzlas pas mi bgegs kyis brlams pa'am/ 'dre gdon gyis zin pa'am/ byad 'og tu chud pa'am/ bud med byur ngad cing bu med pa'am/ bu mi 'tsho ba la sogs pa la phan par bya ba'i phyir cho ga bya na/ 'bab chu'i 'gram mam/ shing gcig pa'i drung ngam/ lam gyi bzhi mdo'am/ khang stong la sogs pa'i dbus nas dkyil 'khor gyis blang bar bya ste/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi la/ nub phyogs sam/ byang phyogs kyi sgo btod pa cig tshon rtsi dkar po sna gcig gis bris te/ dbus su yang pad ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa cig bris la/ gser dngul lam zangs kyi bum pa ma zhum pa/ mi 'jig pa'am/ kham pa'i bum pas ra pa so btang ba'i nag po dang ra ri med pa gcig spos chus bkang ste/ rin po che sna lnga/ sman sna lnga/ 'bru sna lnga blugs la/ mgul ras dkar po sar pa kha tshar ma bcad pa dang / me tog gi phreng bas bcings te/ khar shug pa'am/ thang shing gi mgo lcogs bcug la

me tog dang 'bras bus brgyan pa gcig pad ma'i steng du bzhag la/ gzungs klog pa nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi skur bsgyur te/ bum pa de yang rin chen rdzing bu bdud rtsi'i chus gang bar bsams la/ chu de'i nang nas pad ma dkar po cig byung bar bsams te/ pad ma de la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po yi ge dkar po bsams te/ yi ge de las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tu gyur par bsams la mchod pa dang / bstod pa byas te/ gang bsgrubs pa'i dngos po grub par gyur cig ces gsol ba btab pas/ a mo gha pā sha'i gzungs mang pos bum pa de la lan bcu gsum du tshig gzhan mi smra bar bzlas te/ bum pa de'i chus de'i spyi bo nas blugs na bgegs dang gdon la sogs pa las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de la gos dang bcas par spyi bo nas blugs la/ blugs pa'i tshe yang gzungs klog pa dang / klog par bya ba gnyis kas kyang lus phyi nang gnyi sa dag pa dang / 'dre gdon las thar bar sems rtse gcig tu sems shing bklag go/ /gos gsher ba de yang yugs dor ba'i thabs su bor la/ gos dkar po sar pa gon te/ spos dang / me tog la sogs pas lus brgyan pa de nyid lan cig bklags pas lus bsrungs te bkra shis kyang bklag go/ /dkyil 'khor de'i kho ra khor yug tu 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad kyang so so'i ming smos te spyan drangs la mchod nas/ las gang bsgrub pa de grub par gyur cig ces smon lam btab nas/ mchod pa rnam pa lnga pa gcig gis mchod la/ 'byung po phal rnams la yang gtor ma rgya cher sbyin no/ /bdag srung ba dang / mtshams bcad pa yang a mo gha pā sha'i gzungs de nyid kyis tshul bzhin du byas na/ de yang tshes brgyad la bya ba'i

rigs so/ /cho ga 'dis bgegs kyis brlams pa la sogs pa gong du smos pa rnams las thar bar 'gyur ba 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyi/ mi tha mal pa la byas na yang phyis bgegs dang / byad stems kyis mi tshugs/ nad 'go bas mi thebs/ dpal che zhing bsams so cog 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rin po che sna lnga la gser byi ru/ mu tig /dung / shel/ sman lnga la/ sing ha/ byā gh+ri/ gi ri kirni/ sa ha/ sa ha de ba/ 'bru sna lnga la/ nas so ba/ 'bras so ba/ til/ gro/ mon sran/ ma sha'o/ /'phags pa don yod zhags pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// //oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa da ta/ te ṣā ñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa ye swā hā// //oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā// maṅga laṃ// //shu bhaṃ// //

༄༅/rgya gar skad du/ nārāya na pari pṛts+tsh+wa ār+ya mahā māyā bidza ya bā hi nīnā ma nghā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ srid med kyi bus zhus pa 'phags pa sgyu ma chen mo rnam par rgyal ba thob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na bcom ldan 'das gser gyi rwa zhes bya ba'i ri bo'i rtse na rnam thos bu'i khang pa na bzhugs te/ lha dang klu dang gnod spyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang chu skyes ma la sogs pa mang po rnams kyis bstod par byed pa'i chos snang ba'i sgo zhes bya ba'i chos rnams grangs bstan bar mdzad do/ de nas lha ma yin rnams kyis bcom pa pham pa kun tu nyams ba gzi brjid kyi stobs dman pa'i srid med kyi bu gang de bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du nye bar 'ongs so/ nye bar 'ongs nas kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la mgo bos mngon par btun nas mtha' gcig tu 'dug go/ mtha' gcig tu 'dug nas de nyid du gsol ba/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad gzigs pa sems can thams cad la rjes su brtse ba can/ chos kyi rnam grangs gang gis lha dang klu dang gnod spyin dang srin po la sogs pa rnams sam mi rnams kyang rung ste/ g.yul 'khrugs pa'i tshe mtshon cha chen po ltung ba'am nye bar 'tsho ba'am rtsod pa thams cad las thams cad du rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur pa de lta bu bstan par mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba/ sred med kyi bu sgyu ma 'chang ba khyed/ sred med kyi bu sgyu ma dang ldan pa/ stobs chen po mchis pa g.yo sgyumang pos sems can rnams slu bar byed pa khyed 'dir 'jigs nas g.yul du rnam par rgyal ba 'dri zhing yongs su 'dri bar byed pa ci yin/ sred med bus 'di skad gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'dod pa'i lha ma yi gyi dbang bos lha ma yin gyi sgyus 'dir bdag bcom

ste lha rnams 'ga' zhig ni 'chi bar gyur/ 'ga' zhig ni pham bar gyur/ 'ga' zhig ni bcoms par gyur lags so/ bcom ldan 'das chos kyi rnam grangs gang gis sems can rnams g.yul du rnam par rgyal bar byed par 'gyur pa/ lha ma yin rnams pham par byed par 'gyur ba/ lha ma yin gyi dregs pa snyil bar byed par 'gyur ba de lta bu bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba/ sred med kyi bu/ sngin byung 'das ba'i dus su ma ga nghā ro hi ta'i ri la rin chen dpal zhes bya ba'i rgyal po byung ngo / de'i tshe de'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa bla na med pa skyes bu 'dul ba kha lo sgyur ba lha dang ni rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad dbang phyug ces bya ba byung ngo /bcom ldan 'das thams cad dbang phyug de'i zhal snga nas sgyu ma chen po rnam par rgyal ba thob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rig sngags kyi tshig 'di rnams bdag gis legs par mnos te 'dzin pa dang klog pa dang kun chub pa dang rjes su yi rang par byas te gzhan rnams la'ang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu bstan to/ /sred med kyi bu gzungs 'di'i mthus nam du'ang dgra'i 'jigs pa med pa dang ma ི'phrod pa'i 'jigs pa med pa dang chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa'ang 'byung ba med par lo stong phrag brgya'i par du chos bzhin gyi rgyal srid byas nas/ slad mar yang grong khyer dang grong khyer gzhan dang skyed mos tshal rnams su gzungs kyi mthus ltad mo bzhin du bde bar rgyu bar byed do/ skye ba brjes nas mā nghā hā zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal bo rin po che bdun dang yang dag par ldan pa/ 'jig rten gsum po mtha' dag la bka'i lung bsgyur ba byung ngo / sngon du sbyin ba'i pha rol du phyin pa ma nyams pas sems cad thams cad ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du phan 'dogs par byed ba'i phamir phun sum tshogs pa'i skal ba can nor gyi rgyun 'bebs par byed pa/ sems

can thams cad bde bar byed pa/ thams cad la phan 'dogs par byed pa byung ngo / sred med kyi bu/ de ltar gzungs 'di'i mthus bskal pa brgya phrag mang por sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas tshogs yongs su rdzogs par byas so/ gang yang lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang rig 'dzin dang mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams bka' bzhin du gnas par byed de/ de rnams bka' las phyir phyogs par mi byed do/ bskal ba stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi rnams su sngon du phyogs par byas te phyi nas skye ba gcig tu mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa las thar ba'i klu'i dbang po yang dag par gnas pa bzhin du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten na bla na med pa'i dgra bcom pa lha'i bla mar gyur to/ sred med kyi bu/ de'i phyir sgyu ma chen mo rnam par rgyal ba thob bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs sngags kyi tshig rnams khyed kyis zungs shig /tad+yathā/ nam

de bh+yaḥ.oṃ mā ye ma hā mā lā nghā ra ṇi i yaṃ sā mahā mā yā man+te ṇa ma hā mā lā rā pe ṇa/ bh+ra ma bh+ra ma ma sarba satwā nāñtsa ye bi rū ngha kaṃ tsin+ta sarba duṣ+ṭa satwā stān+t+rā/ ma ya maya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ mu
ng+tāṃ sa ya bi ng+tāṃ sa ya/ ma ra ma ra/ ma hā mā ye a la la la la ma hā mā yā dzā la saha sra mu khis ha sra shi re sa ha sra ghu dze dz+wa li ta ne tre sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya ga

sa t+ye na de bar+ṣi ga ṇa sa t+ye na ma hā mā lā bi dza yā bā hi ni/ sma ra sma ra sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na rū pe ṇa/ ga ts+tsha ga ts+tsha sarbā ba ra ṇa k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri ba ra si n+ya bi drā ba ṇi mo ha la mo ha ya maṃ ma sarba sa twā ṇā bhañtsa sarba du ṣ+ḍā r+sha/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ sarba satwā ñtsa sak+sha bha yo ba dra be bh+yaḥswā hā/ oṃ ma hā mā yā nghā ra ṇi ye
swā hā/ oṃ ma hī maṇ+ḍa lā nghi
te swā hā/ oṃ a ba rwa dzi te swā hā/ oṃ mo ha nī ya swā hā/ oṃ sta

omā yā rā k+ṣa sī ye swā hā/ oṃ rar swā hā/ oṃ rū rū hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa he dza ye mā yā bha ga ba ti ma hā mā yā bi dza ya bā hi nī gṛ h+ṇa sh+ṣi gh+ra mā bi la mā swa ma ma sarba sa twā nā ñtsa sarba kā

byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi tshig rnams zungs shig klogs shig gzhan rnams la'ang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston cig /sred med kyi bu/ de nas g.yul 'gyed pa de'i tshe dmag dpung gnyis kyi bar du gnas lnga rnams su gzungs 'di'i 'khor lo shing rta'i dbyibs su sbyar bar bya'o/ /sred med kyi bu/ gang gi tshe gnyis ka'i nang gi dbus su pha rol gya ིdpung gi spyi bor shing rta'i dbus der sgyu ma chen mo rnam par rgyal ba thob par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal mo brgya stong phrag du ma'i gzugs dang brgya stong phrag du ma'i phyag dang ldan pa spyan gsum pa dmar nag 'bar ba'i zhal bzhi rnams kyis pha rol gyi dmag dpung za bar byed pa bzhin du bsam par bya'o/ /rang nyid 'khor los sgyur ba'i rnam par byas nas gdugs la gzungs gur gum gyis bri bar byas te rgyal bo dang pha rol gyi dmag dpung rang bzhin gcig pa sgyu ma lta bus rab tu sgrib par byed cing snying bo du mas rgyal bor 'gyur ro/ /sred med kyi bu/ pha rol gyi dmag dpung rnams bcoms shing pham ste kha cig ni brgyal nas sa gzhi la ltung bar smra'o/ /sred med kyi bu/ de ltar ltung ba'ang ji ltar mi dge ba

bcu'i las kyi lam gyi chad pas drang bar bya ba ste/ de rnams kyi 'tsho ba la bar du gcod pa'i 'bras bu can ni ma yin no/ /sred med kyi bu/ bsngags par 'os pa'i gzungs kyi mthu ni de lta ba'o/ /sred med kyi bu/ yang gang zhig gzungs sngags kyi tshig 'di rnams gtsang bar byas pas sam gtsang bar ma byas pas kyang rung / bsnyung bar byas pas sam bsnyung bar ma byas pas kyang rung nyi ma so so la lan gsum du rjod par byed pa de nyid ni mtshams med pa lnga byas pa'ang sdig pa'i phung bo zad par byas nas bsod nams kyi phung po thob cing skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kun tu khyab pa'i nor la nye bar longs spyod cing dge ba'i chos rnams la mngon par dga' ste mi dge ba log par ltung ba rnams la ni ma yin no/ /sred med kyi bu/ yang gang zhing rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo'am dge slong ngam dge slong ma'am dge bsnyen nam dge bsnyen ma'am rgyal bo'am rgyal bo'i bu'am bram ze'ang rung gzungs 'di 'dzin par byed pa 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na dam pa'i chos kyi snang can du 'gyur zhing tshig pa'am thal bar gyur ba la'ang skyes pa'am bud med gang la la zhig gis reg par bgyid pa de nyid nges par skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sred med kyi bus byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la kye ma'o zhes ngo mtshar bar byas nas dung dang 'khor lo dang dbyug pa dang me tog gi phreng ba rnams bzhag ste stan las langs nas bcon ldan 'das la lan gsum du bskor zhing phyag byas te rab tu 'dzum pa dang bcas pa'i bzhin gyis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod pa/ e ma lha dang lha min 'jig rten gyi/ /gtso bo mchog gyur bla na med pa ste/ /zhi ba zhi bar gyur ba legs bzung nas/ /'jig rten 'das la phyag 'tshal bstod par bgyi/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /byung ba'i chos ni rab tu ston/ /chos dang chos min rnam par grol/ /chos bden khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas sred med kyi bus

bcom ldan 'das la rab tu btud nas bcom ldan 'das khyed ni bdag gi bya ba bdag go zhes byas nas song bar gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs ba 'di thos pa'i lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang chu skyes ma la sogs pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de rnams dang / lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rang ste bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ /sred med kyi bus zhus pa'i 'phags pa

bcu gsum pa'i dngos po'i lor/ rje btsun bla ma dpal rig pa 'dzin pa gang gis ne gā la'i yul nas rgya dpe btsal te bsgyur dgos pa'i bka' lung rta zam brgyud pheb par brten lo re'i khums zla'i yar tshes bzang par mdo smad sde dge'i mnga' ris dpal spungs dgon par chos smra ba bstan pa'i nyin byed kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa shu bhaṃ dza yan+tu// //༄༅// //rgya gar skad du/ nā ga da t+ta nghā ra ṇi nā ga hṛ da ya nā ma/ bod skad du/ klus byin pa'igzungs klu'i snying bo zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klus byin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /gsungs pa'i rig pa klog byed gang / /skyes bu de la klu tshogs kyis/ /'jigs pa cung zad 'byung mi 'gyur/ /tad+ya thā/ oṃ a ri ba ri bi bā ra/ sha ba ri/ sharba ri/ mā ri/ mā ma ṭi/ ṭi ṭa mā mā ma ṭi/ mā bi ṣa mā/ ban+na ga phuḥ phuḥ sha ba rī ye/ phuḥphuḥ
sha ba rī ye/ phuḥphuḥ ki rā ta/ sha ba rī ye/ phuḥphuḥ ṭhaḥṭha/ swā hā/ oṃ sha ba ri/ sha ba ri/ ma hā sha ba ri/ bi
mā hi n+sa nū/ ban+na gaḥ i dan+d+ri th+bā sa ma yi nā gā rdzū nī ya

baṃ/ phuḥphuḥ ṭhaḥṭhaḥswā hā/ oṃ sū tre bār+b+te su ti ṣe swā hā/ i h+ye maṃ kā sh+ya bo dz+nyā ba oṃ ti/ a na ku li na ku li ma hā na ku li sar+b+ba s+ya mu khaṃ ban+dha ban+dha/ bi ṣa bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa phuḥphuḥ ṭhaḥṭhaḥswā hā/ oṃ ka dru nā gā nāṃ/ mā te ma hā bā she saṃ ha ra sarba bi ṣā r+tha de bi bhā ta/ swā ba ra dzaṅga mā nra phuḥphuḥ ṭhaḥṭhaḥswā hā/ oṃ na gu li na ku li ma hā na su li ha ra bi ṣaṃ/ a

sha ti byan+ta rā ṇāṃ hu/ ā ha ra bi ṣi bha k+ṣa la bi ṣaṃ hrīḥ k+ṣe maṃ ka ri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ buṃsaḥ oṃ bā suṃ ki/ oṃ a na n+ta/ oṃ tik+ṣan/ oṃ ka ke ṭa ka oṃ pad+ma/ oṃ ma hā pad+ma/ oṃ shā kha bā la/ oṃ ku li ka oṃ ā sti ka oṃ ba nate la kha ra buts+tsha/ draṣ+ṭa gho ṇa sa kharba rī ya ka ha nā mā lā tsi lu ra so+oṇ+ḍa su bar+ṇ+ṇa re kha/ nā ga rā dza pu trā ṇāṃ ṣa da bing+sha ti nā ma sra ha ṇā tra bi ṣa nā ste/ kā la bar lā nā stī phuḥphuḥṭhaḥṭhaḥswā hā/ gal te nyin dang mtshan mo ru/ /kun tu gnas pas 'jug pa na/ /gang zhig rtagatu 'di dran pa/ /sbrul gyis 'jigs pas 'jigs mi 'gyur/ /klus byin pa'i gzungs klu'i snying po
rdzogs so// //klu sgrub zhabs kyis sa 'og nas spyan drangs/ /ces pa'ang kun khyab kyis bskul ba ltar bstan pa'i nyin byed kyis bsgyur ba'o// //na mi rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ ye ngha
